chapters.title: Chapter 1: Transmigrated as a Cannon Fodder
chapters.html:
When Phainon started to gain consciousness he felt that his throat was parched and his hands and feet felt uncomfortable when he tried to move them. He opened his eyes to find himself in what could only be described as the ‘little black room’ from corny mafia novels.

“System, what grudge do you have against me?!” was Phainon’s first coherent thought. He lamented his shitty luck for being bound to such a system who didn’t care about its workers.

A few months ago, Phainon was just a homebody who could stay at home for months on end. But he was conned into bonding with the Befriending the Most Powerful Person System, who stuffed him right into a book called "The Most Powerful Person in the Apocalypse". That was his first world he had to endure.

As for this broken Befriending the Most Powerful Person System, it was really just a system that would cling to the powerful without any regard to their own reputation. You could tell just from the name! This kind of system wouldn't make you happy.

This system would automatically lock onto the most powerful person as the capture target. A daily task would be assigned based on the situation. If it wasn't completed, there would be a terrible punishment, namely electrocution.

Before, he only transmigrated into a world as someone who, despite having some problems, most people generally saw as a straight male (the important part). In any case, it seemed that there weren't any problems.

But now, the system actually had him transmigrate straight into a BL novel. Phainon was already being poisoned to death just looking at the original novel... He didn't need to think about the system's sinister intentions to be clear about them, but he was resolute!

Even if he had slept with a guy in the previous world, even if he had kissed a guy, Phainon still felt that he was a straight... Forget it, he suddenly felt like he couldn't say anything.

There were three genders in this world. They were divided into alphas, betas, and omegas. The difference was roughly that alphas couldn't get pregnant, and betas and omegas both could (._.) and omegas had a heat that was even scarier than a Zerg's.

Although there were males and females in these three genders, from Phainon's understanding, it seemed that there were girls with peepees who were together, and there was no difference from being gay... Female omegas and such were simply the clear springs in this world!

And this was a novel where the main gong had a harem. The protagonist, Khaslana, was an alpha. He was born in the slums, only knowing that his mother died because of the difficult birth. He didn't know who his father was, and grew up in a welfare agency. Naturally, in this kind of novel with an unknown father, the protagonist's background was terrifying. Khaslana's biological father was actually the empire's emperor.

Although he was just an orphan, Khaslana was extremely gifted, and his face was quite attractive. Using schemes and tricks, he made his way up step by step, using countless people and discovering his own background. Finally, he succeeded in the struggle for the throne and became emperor, becoming a winner in life.

As for the harem, in any case it was already a harem. It was totally normal for a male protagonist to be a bit more douchey. Besides, the people he played were all guys (thankfully, they were all male alphas. According to this novel's settings, AA love was gay).

The protagonist would seek revenge for anything. He was a deep schemer. When someone displeased him, he wouldn't say anything, but in secret he would get revenge with ruthless methods.

Who knew how many boys had gone through this. Phainon didn't feel too much about it at first. He wouldn't care at all if it wasn't for the fact that he had actually transmigrated into a cannon fodder, and it was even a male beta cannon fodder who would often sneer with a tone that was just looking for a beating.

Anyone would know that a character who offended so many people couldn't keep going in this kind of novel, okay!! Out of the people who taunted Khaslana, if their reputations weren't utterly ruined, then they were furiously eating their lunchboxes. And Phainon, who had transmigrated into this cannon fodder, was even more miserable.

After this cannon fodder had been wrongly named a peeping tom (and it was a peeping tom who was looking into the men's bathroom), because the situation was too embarrassing, he had been ruthlessly expelled from the school... And when he was on the way home, the protagonist's worshippers had people tie him up and take him away.

Phainon transmigrated right into that moment. He was bound in ropes, laying on the ground, and his clothes were already torn up. At the side, there was someone holding a whip, constantly lashing him. The system suppressed most of the pain, but it was inhumane to feel the pain that came time and time again.

"What the fuck?!" Phainon simply didn't understand why it was such a heavy start. It was whatever to transmigrate into a BL ABO world. Now that he had come somewhere where he was being whipped, could it still be better?

At the side, there was a young man wearing black. He was extremely attractive, so that he could even be called beautiful, but he wasn't feminine. But his handsome face was filled with disgust. He looked down at Phainon, having his lackeys continue to brandish the whips.

[Beep beep beep... Detected a powerful character... Beginning to select capture targets in accordance with the system's regulations... Selection complete. The current capture target is Caelus.]

Caelus was the son of a duke with an honorable status. He was a naturally gifted alpha, and he was one of the original protagonist Khaslana's fanboys... In the future, he would also give Khaslana a lot of help.

Although Khaslana had just entered the military academy, he was already an influential figure in the school. The first time he participated in the mecha tournament on the virtual net, he fought his way into the top hundred. Caelus was one of the fanboys that became a fan of Khaslana after the tournament.

Besides, Caelus's personality was completely that of an arrogant, spoiled young master. After finding out that the person he worshipped had actually been taunted -and by a laze-about beta too- he was extremely unhappy. He grabbed Phainon, who had dared to sneer at Khaslana.

"You actually had the guts to mock Senior Khaslana." Caelus laughed coldly. "But you're just a useless beta. Where did this courage come from?"

Phainon: "!" Hey, this is gender discrimination!! Don't think you're so amazing just because you're an alpha, how is being a gender with pain-in-the-ass heats any better than the convenience of being a beta?

"It seems you're pretty strong-willed." When he saw that Phainon wanted to retort, Caelus snorted. "Whip a bit harder. We'll see how long you can take it."

Wait, he wasn't strong-willed! Stop quickly!

"I..." can't endure any more... Before he finished begging for mercy, because he was hungry and tired and had been whipped for so long, he finally fainted.

Phainon didn't wake up until an unknown amount of time later.

He was, of course, still laying in a little black room. How could someone like Caelus prepare a place to live for someone he dragged here to beat!!

The little black room was clearly used for illegal punishment, but because the duke was rich enough to use his money to shut people up, the floor even had a rug spread over it. It was at least better than sleeping on normal floorboards.

There wasn't even a window on the wall. The door was also shut tightly. There was no way for Phainon, who felt weak all over, to escape.

Normally, what Caelus was doing was illegal, but with his status, even if he beat Phainon to death, nobody would have the courage to set things straight with him.

"This is basically murder." Phainon used his ability to heal his wounds before he was able to recover some energy. But he was still hungry and thirsty and tired, and his clothes were still torn up. There was even some crusted blood on his clothes. He was ready to collapse.

He must have the most rotten luck to have made an enemy of the original protagonist and an entire group of people right after transmigrating!! This was beginning right at hell level. What in the world was he going to do?

As soon as he thought about the capture target Caelus, Phainon felt that the future was dim. But if the capture target was the original protagonist, the situation would be impossible to look at... He knew what the original protagonist would never be good to someone who had cursed him out just by thinking about it!

The one thing that he was able to rejoice in was that he had transmigrated into a beta. How nice was it to be a beta! Phainon felt very emotional. He had already had enough of things like heats from the last worlds!

[Actually, host, you're an omega pretending to be a beta.]

Phainon: "...Huh?!"

Phainon thought back to the members in the body he had transmigrated into. The original owner's father was a downtrodden noble, and his mother, who had squeezed her way into the upper class, was the daughter of a rich merchant. They sent their only child into the military academy with the help of their family's connections.

Although it wasn't mentioned in the original novel, it was obvious after a bit of thought. The original owner who had offended the original protagonist had definitely caused his entire family to fall into a sorry state.

"Wait, I don't have a reason that makes me have to pretend to be a beta, right?!" Phainon said. "Why not think about how strange it is for a cannon fodder that was here for faceslapping to have such a background!"

[These are all settings patched in by the world consciousness. It's probably because the original host's mother can't have any more children, and omegas can't inherit titles. Being afraid the title would fall into other hands, the original host was forced into pretending to be a beta.]

Phainon: "...Th-then it's already been concealed for ten-some years. There won't be any problems if I keep concealing it, right?"

[The inhibitors on the host have a strong effect. As long as no alphas mark the host, there won't be any problems.]

"System, why do I feel like your words are always some flags." Phainon's face was green. But when he thought about how most of the alphas in this world were gays who liked other alphas (deduced from the original protagonist's harem), he felt he wouldn't have any problems.

Phainon struggled in the little black room for a long time, continuously using his healing ability the system had given him when he first bound to it to replenish his blood before he was able to recover half of his strength and stop laying prone on the ground. Today, Phainon discovered this healing ability really was convenient.

Soon, the sound of footsteps came from outside. Phainon's heart tensed, and he quickly laid back on the ground, pretending to be unconscious. If Caelus saw that he was as lively as a golden retriever and decided to whip him a few more times, it would be no good.

This time, there was only the sound of one person. The door opened, and a voice full of loathing came. "Hmph, you really are trash. Wasn't it just a few whippings? But you're still not awake."

Phainon: "..." You try not eating or drinking after getting beaten up and laying here for an entire day!!

[Daily task refreshed. The current task is [Kiss the capture target once]. Host, please do your best.]

Phainon: "???" System, you... Hey, do all systems have such an immoral setting as soon as it's a BL world??

Well, forget it. He's had sex before, what was a kiss?

After the depressing situation from the last world, Phainon had become very adaptable.

As Caelus looked at the pallid youth laying on the ground, he actually felt that Phainon was a little bit pitiful. Immediately, he was disgusted by his own thoughts.

He remembered his goal in coming. Using hands covered by gloves, Caelus grabbed Phainon by the collar, his eyes flashing with disgust and thinking about how he would throw away the gloves that had touched Phainon when he went out later. He said coldly, "Trash, wake up!"

As an outstanding alpha, Caelus had innate disdain for betas. He even looked down on betas who were the same noble rank as he was. There was no need to talk about Phainon, whose father came from a tiny noble family. As long as Caelus wanted to, he could have Phainon's entire family driven away from the planet the very next day.

Phainon finally pretended to be waking up slowly. He said weakly, "W-what are you doing?"

"You got lucky. I wouldn't let you go so easily if it wasn't for the fact it'd be a bother to clean up after a death." Caelus remembered what his older brother had told him that morning and snorted coldly. "Hmph. Hurry up, get up and get things together. You're going with me to apologize to Senior Khaslana today. Don't think you can get out of it by playing dead. I won't let you go as long as Senior Khaslana doesn't accept your apology."

But Phainon didn't absorb any of the later words that Caelus said. He was thinking about something even more serious.

Did he fail to complete his daily task and get the system's abuse, or did he complete the daily task and get beaten by Caelus? These two situations swirled around in Phainon's head.

It was obvious which one was scarier. Compared to the soul-crushing torture from the system, Caelus wouldn't hurt him much even if he was whipping him for an entire afternoon. After he made his decision, Phainon heartlessly, firmly grabbed Caelus's hand.

Caelus didn't expect that Phainon actually had the guts to resist. He also didn't expect that Phainon still had the energy to grab him. He was stunned, then furious. He, someone with such a high status, was actually given a sneak attack by a useless beta. This was simply the most embarrassing thing to happen to him in his entire life.

Without waiting for Caelus to move, Phainon suddenly leaned in.

Because he was too rushed, rather than saying Phainon leaned in, it was more accurate to say that he knocked his head towards Caelus. With strength that came out of nowhere, he managed to press Caelus directly to the ground. His teeth even scraped Caelus's lip. The scent of blood dissipated from between them.

Caelus laid on the soft grass in a trance, seeming like he could see a faint fragrance coming from Phainon's body. His lips were unimaginably soft. He was clearly just a beta, so why could he actually...

Phainon was simply acting as though he was about to die. When he heard the system's prompt that the task was completed, he slowly sat back.

"..." Alright, now he could wait for Caelus's temper to erupt.

The room sank into an unusual silence.

"You... B-brazen! Shameless! That was my fir-first..." When Caelus finally reacted, he immediately sat up, wiping off the blood at his mouth quickly. He gritted his teeth. "So you're going to offend me. You're just an insignificant waste beta, but you actually did something like this... I absolutely won't let you off!"

Phainon had already prepared to get whipped. He lowered his head, closing his eyes, but after a long time, nothing happened. He opened his eyes in confusion.

And he was pressed down by Caelus, who kissed him abruptly.

Phainon's heart flew into a panic. "...Mmmm?!" Wait, the revenge Caelus was talking about was this kind?!

Caelus seemed like he was competing with Phainon. He gripped Phainon's jaw stubbornly, opening his mouth and using his tongue to invade his mouth. Although he had never kissed anyone before and his actions were a little unfamiliar, Phainon almost couldn't breathe.

When Phainon was kissed until he was about to faint, Caelus finally leaned back proudly. He reached out to lift Phainon's chin. "Hmph. You're just a waste and you want to compete with me."

Phainon looked at Caelus in shock. "..." Was this something normal people would do?!

Or was this perfectly normal in an ABO world... After all, men could even get pregnant and women could have pee-pees. What was impossible?

"Still, since you made an enemy of me, I won't let you go so randomly." Caelus snorted again. "I have to lock you up. I'll make you understand how things will end when you offend me."

Immediately, Caelus rushed out.

Phainon stayed in the room, trembling in wait of the end Caelus was waiting for. Of course, when he was waiting, he switched rooms.

This was a room in quite decent condition. There was a bed, a bathroom, and a desk. There was even a helmet that could surf the net!

Hey, did Caelus really have the intentions to illegally imprison him?! He even had things that could connect to the outside world set out openly in the room.

But even if he could connect to the outside world, Phainon despairingly discovered that he still had no way to leave... Even his parents had no way to take him away.

It seemed that Caelus didn't have a big heart. He just had absolute faith that Phainon wouldn't escape.

Phainon couldn't understand what Caelus was trying to do either. In any case, it was boring to stay here, so he put on the helmet.

The virtual world was no different from the real world. In the future, there were many people who stayed engrossed in the virtual world all day, because in the virtual world, they didn't need to worry about heats or anything like that. The omegas who could only stay in school and or at a home especially liked to stay in the virtual world. There were even game cabins with nutrient fluids made for these people, which could let them stay in the virtual world for two to three days.

If they were like Phainon and used the helmet to connect to the net, they were forced to disconnect every five or six hours to eat.

After Phainon put on the helmet, his consciousness went straight to a lively street. It was full of people. Nobody noticed Phainon. They were all looking at the fight on the virtual screen at the side in excitement.

Phainon's attention was also drawn by the fight. When he read the novel's introduction, he understood that other than ABO, this world also had a mecha setting, but it was his first time seeing them for real.

On the virtual screen, there were two mechas fighting fiercely. One of them was gorgeous and even had a high-tech weapon, but its opponent was an old, worn-out mecha that looked like it was about to fall apart.

The victor seemed obvious, but in reality the gorgeous mecha was suffering defeat after defeat, and the worn-out mecha was growing more and more valiant. It had an overwhelming advantage.

Everyone was excited. They kept cheering. It was obvious that they were fans of the worn-out mecha.

"How awesome..." Phainon couldn't stop himself from crying out.

Someone next to him said in excitement, "After all, that's the amazing Time! Although he's a newcomer to the competition this time, he's this strong! Even if he's using an outdated mecha, nobody can compete with him! I think he'll definitely get to the finals this time!"

Phainon: "...!"

Wasn't the guy named Time Khaslana from the original novel?!

Chapter End Notes

I am a big lover of reading trashy Chinese QT novels and i also am a lover of all things Phainon and so this combination has formed. The original novel is also called Befriending the Most Powerful Person and you can read its translation online if you'd like. This is just my take on it with my favorite characters. This is also my first time writing on ao3 so hopefully this goes well. Feel free to give me constructive criticism in the comments.

chapters.title: "surrender" emerged
chapters.html:
According to the rules of the competition, the competitors could choose not to expose their faces or their real names. Khaslana had entered concealing his face and name. But while his identity was hidden from the common people, he couldn't hide it from Caelus and people with a background. In minutes, they guessed who he was.

In the original novel, this competition was also Khaslana's first step on the path of glory. After Caelus saw the competition, he became a fanboy of his technique. Besides Caelus, he also met several friends who were talented and of strong backgrounds. They became the base that he used to seize the throne in the future.

In the end, Khaslana took first place and became famous throughout the entire empire, and he defeated the Zerg spy that had been planted in the capital planet (all kinds of interstellar novels had these overused villains). After that, his reputation spread far and wide. Overnight, the number of have fans he had broke through to several billion. They retaliated against the people who had humiliated him in the past, and they couldn't stay in the capital any longer.

As a cannon fodder who had been expelled from his school not long ago because of such a shameful reason, Phainon's mood was complicated. He just had to think to know that Khaslana's revenge wasn't over. When he gained more power in the future, who knew if Phainon would even be able to continue living.

And he had to capture Khaslana before he could leave!! The favorability score was absolutely in the high negatives already.

Phainon felt a huge mental burden just thinking about it. It would be good if he could follow the original protagonist's path and participate in a mecha competition like this. He wouldn't be shut in a room and beaten because his strength was so trash.

[Host, you can go participate in a virtual mecha competition if you want. Also, because everyone is a projection in the virtual world, you won't bind to a new capture target.]

"The important thing isn't whatever about the capture target. Although that's also very important... If someone who has the strength of a radish like this body goes participate in a mecha competition, I'll get wiped out in the first first round," Phainon instinctively retorted, but his heart was wavering.

Although the original relied on inhibitors to act as a beta for over ten years, his physique was about the same level as other omegas. He was just a little stronger than other omegas, so his grades in school were also at the bottom of the rankings and he would just bully commoner students like the original protagonist.

The reason the original host had taunted Khaslana was probably really because he was secretly jealous that he was an alpha. Although he didn't want to admit it, alphas were just naturally superior in terms of strength.

But as long as it was a boy, who wouldn't be excited by a mecha? When Phainon first became a homebody nerd, he really liked watching mecha war movies. Every time he saw the protagonist start the mecha, he wanted to try it himself. Now, the opportunity was right before his eyes. If he didn't give it a try, he wouldn't be able to explain himself.

Phainon turned to look at the rules screen at the side. As long as he paid sixty empire coins, he could participate. Of course, sixty empire coins only provided the lowest training mecha. If he wanted a better one, he had to pay more.

In some sense, it was possible to net good results from these competitions buy throwing money at it. For the most part, anyone else who broke into the rankings was skilled. Still, someone like Khaslana, who could crush other people using a high-grade mecha that cost several billion empire coins with just practiced ease of an outdated mecha, was someone who came once in a hundred years. That was why he attracted so many fans.

Now, as long as they wanted to, anyone could join the competitions. The competition adopted a point system. The top one hundred people by the end of the competition could rise to the finals. If they won, they would get 2 points. If they lost, they would lose 2 points. A draw was 0 points.

Although it was just a battle in the virtual world, it would use up spiritual energy. When there was less spiritual energy, it would affect their performance, so most people would only fight two or three battles.

"Well, it's just sixty empire coins. It's about the same cost to go see a movie. Besides, I can be anonymous." Phainon walked to the side where he could register automatically, without the slightest burden, swiping his personal terminal. Immediately, his surroundings faded to black, and several virtual screens appeared in front of him.

[Please select the mecha you would like to use.] An emotionless, robotic voice sounded.

Phainon looked at the screen in front of him. There were all kinds of mechas in all kinds of colors and all kinds of weapons. Several were kinds that common people in the outside world had no way to even touch, but in the virtual world, they just needed to pay some empire coins to use it.

Of course, Phainon selected the free older generation mecha without hesitation. As if he would spend a single extra empire coin on a competition he had no chance to win!

Next was whether he wanted to conceal his face, and the name he would use to compete.

Phainon naturally picked to conceal his face, and he barely thought about the name. He typed in the words Prince Latiao (means spicy stick, a type of popular chines snack like jerky) ... Actually, this was the nickname he used to use when he was surfing the internet.

People from the future definitely didn't know what latiao were. This way, he could maintain a sense of mystery as well as allowing him to remember the latiao he liked to eat before he transmigrated... After he thought about it, he suddenly felt this name was simply perfect.

After he finished his selections, the screen glowing in front of Phainon's eyes dimmed completely.

[Selected the old style mecha... Succeeded in registering for the competition... You currently have 0 points... Matching with an opponent...]

After a series of mechanical noises, Phainon's vision turned bright. He discovered that he was currently sitting in an old mecha, and the exterior was the field. It felt unnaturally genuine. There wasn't the slightest difference reality. Phainon felt around the mecha with excitement.

This round of the mecha competition had already been running for several months. It would end in just half a month, and most of the people at the top of the rankings had fans already. Every time they competed, countless people would fight to spend money and buy tickets to watch up close. People like Khaslana had already reached the level where their competitions would be broadcasted outside.

Generally speaking, people wouldn't come to watch the matches of people who were low in the points rankings, and the competition system would match people with similar points, so Phainon's opponent should be someone who was at the end of the ranks.

But the field was full of people, and across from Phainon was a top-grade mecha. The crowd around him was cheering unceasingly.

Phainon had a bad feeling. He looked to see who his opponent was, and he was stunned. "...What the fuck?!"

The opponent that the competition system had matched Phainon with was actually a contestant in the top hundred players whose name was Mydeimos. He was a nouveau riche who had gained fame with the help of a huge sum of money and his extreme skills. He wouldn't hesitate to use several of the weapons that needed several million empire coins to use once. On top of that, Mydei was quite attractive, so his fans were naturally numerous.

Phainon was different from other people, because he understood who this was. Mydeimos's real identity was actually the crown prince's younger cousin. His family was a superpower that could influence the entire empire's trade, and his mother was the descendant of a family with a strong reputation.

In addition to this, he was also Khaslana's close friend. Later, he even betrayed his older cousin, the crown prince, to support Khaslana. This was why the crown prince, the villain boss, lost so quickly.

Phainon didn't expect that as soon as he came out he would meet an opponent like this. He felt like he had been abandoned by the world.

Phainon wasn't the only one who was shocked. When Mydei and the crowd saw the enemy was actually a hopeless lose with 0 points and using an outdated mecha, they were also shocked.

"Did the system run into an error?"

"You can tell right away that someone like this just came to join in on the fun, but he can actually be with Mydeimos?"

"In the case, I can also participate in the competition, right?!"

"And Prince Latiao is a weird name. It just sounds funny."

These people thought the name Prince Latiao was already so far from down-to-earth it was at the level of a punk edgelord.

Mydei, sitting in a high-level mecha, pondered earnestly. He had brilliant blonde and auburn hair, amber eyes eyes, and a handsome face often sporting a calm and determined expression. Just a single smile from him was intoxicating. He hadn't announced his identity, otherwise his fans would be ten times as numerous.

"I heard that even if it's your first time competing, if the system detects a strong spiritual strength, it will still match you up with an opponent with a corresponding strength... Maybe it's that kind of situation." When Mydei thought of it, he immediately turned serious, fixing his gaze on the enemy opposite him.

The match hadn't officially started yet. Using a technique gained from the host's school memories, Phainon began to operate the mecha with difficulty. He fumbled around for the controls, trying to move.

To the crowd outside, this outdated mecha suddenly began to shake like a drunkard. It couldn't even walk properly. Several times, it even fell to the ground for real, then crawling back up with difficulty.

Jeers immediately exploded from the stands. "My god, this is totally a mecha newbie, isn't it? Even my little brother in elementary school can move better than him."

"Where did this kind of guy get the courage to join a mecha competition? What a joke."

"I'm going to record this match and put it on the forum so everyone can have a laugh."

Even Mydei was a bit hesitant. No matter how he looked at it, it was obvious his opponent was a beginner. Was the system matching really wrong?

After a moving his limbs a flurry for a long time, Phainon suddenly remembered that they had also been taught how to use spiritual energy to connect directly to the mecha. Because this method needed formidable spiritual energy, most people couldn't do it.

But if they succeeded in connecting to the mecha, they would feel as though they were the mecha themselves. It was many times better than operating it by hand. If the mecha was injured, the operator would also be wounded, and it was also a more dangerous method.

[Count down. 10, 9, 8, 7... 4, 3, 2, 1-begin!]

Phainon gritted his teeth, closing his eyes and trying to use his spiritual energy to connect to the mecha. In moments, it was as though a blue ocean appeared before his eyes, and he was a tiny speck of light in the sea.

"Is this my spiritual world?" Phainon was frozen.

The original novel said that normal people had spiritual world that was just the size of a well. Even the peerlessly talented main character Khaslana had a spiritual world just the size of a lake.

But the host, as a cannon fodder, didn't even register as a B-grade spiritual energy... In other words, the sea in front of him wasn't the original host's spiritual energy. It was his own spiritual energy.

“…..”

“…”

When the countdown ended, the barrier between the two mechas immediately disappeared.

The crowd in the stands began to shout. "Knock down this newbie who doesn't know the limits of the sky!"

"We bought tickets to see experts, not to a rookie like this."

"A weak chicken has the guts to use an outdated mecha? Do they think they're God Time?"

Mydei just manipulated his mecha to charge in front of his enemy. His mecha was the newest model that had been developed, and it was much faster than a normal mecha. The power of its weapons were also extremely strong. He could cut open his opponent's cockpit with ease.

Unexpectedly the other party's mecha still hadn't begun to move. It was obvious the person in the cockpit had already gave up on opposition.

It seemed as though the system really had an error during matching. Somebody who gave out without even a fight was simply a disgrace on the competition.

Disappointment flashed through Mydei's eyes. He had come to the competition to cross swords with even more strong people, inexperienced trash like this was really not worth his time.

Mydei manipulated the laser scalpel directly to point directly at his opponent's cockpit. At this point, this enemy wasn't worth his serious attention. He just wanted to use the quickest method to deal with him.

The stands rose with cheers. Almost everyone could imagine how the outdated mecha's cockpit would be skewered by the laser scalpel in the next moment.

But Phainon's eyes suddenly snapped open.

In that moment, it was as though he had become the mecha... No, his powerful spiritual energy had nearly encompassed the entire space. He saw everything. He could even see the expressions of the crowd in the stands as clear as day.

And in Phainon's eyes, Mydeimos's nimble laser scalpel was as slow as if it was in a slow motion film. He could avoid it with ease.

Phainon avoided the surprise attack without thinking.

When the anticipated result of slicing open the cockpit didn't happen, Mydei was stunned. He realized that his opponent had actually evaded him at a rapid speed.

The people on the stands were stupefied. Several people thought their vision had gone blurry, reaching up to rub their eyes.

"What just happened?"

"Is it a coincidence...? Just now he couldn't even control his mecha properly, how could he suddenly avoid it?"

"It must be a coincidence. Even a genius couldn't learn how the controls in a second... Unless he connected with his spiritual energy just now. But how could that be?"

Someone unwittingly spoke the truth.

Mydei furrowed his brows, lunging for Phainon with the laser scalpel in his hand. But it was just like it was seconds ago. The opponent easily dodged. Even the mecha's speed was no slower than his own modern mecha.

Generally speaking, if it wasn't superb technique, it was only possible to reach such a level by connecting to the mecha with spiritual energy.

Mydei was also using his spiritual energy to control the mecha, but he hadn't achieved such a complete, seamless connection. Among the people he knew, people who could achieve such a level of connection with an outdated mecha...

In that moment, Mydei unexpectedly thought of the friend he thought of in high esteem, Khaslana.

"How could it be, this guy is just trash." When he realized that he had actually put this newbie and Khaslana on the same level, Mydei felt a wave of fury. Comparing Khaslana with this person was an insult.

Mydei looked up at the outdated mecha, chopping at his opponent. At the same time, he prepared to fire ammunition at the opposing mecha's four limbs to destroy it. "Aren't you good at hiding? You don't have luck on your side this time."

But this time his opponent didn't dodge. He pulled out a worn-out laser weapon to block Mydei's attack.

Naturally, the outdated mecha's weapons couldn't be compared with the latest laser scalpel. In a few breaths, it was destroyed, but in those few breaths, the old mecha had already charged in front of Mydei. It grabbed Mydei's mecha's arms.

In the next moment, Mydei could see several different ways to struggle free, but no matter how he tried to move his body, he couldn't move. The places his mecha was touching his opponent's made him feel very clearly the other party's spiritual strength.

It was a terrifyingly strong spiritual energy. In that moment, Mydei felt as though he was drowning in the sea. He couldn't breathe. His spiritual strength was S-rank, the cream of the crop, but compared to his opponent he had no way to resist. He couldn't even struggle. He just wanted to surrender himself to this powerful person.

Exactly... At that moment, in Mydei's mind, the word "surrender" emerged.

Mydei didn't know how long it took before he returned to his senses. By then, his opponent's weapons were already resting against his cockpit. As long as the mecha used a little bit more strength, it would be able to cut through his cockpit and skewer through him.

[Number 09364 is victorious.]

A mechanical voice like the competition system's rang along with the sound of the crowd sucking in a cold breath. Nobody had expected that a beginner that nobody thought highly of could actually defeat Mydeimos so easily.

The people who had been mocking Phainon now felt that they couldn't face the situation. If it wasn't for the rule that someone could only compete with one identity, they would even suspect if this Prince Latiao was a side entry for the terrifying Time.

There were even people who turned into Phainon's fans on the spot. They completely forgot about Mydeimos, cheering Phainon's name continuously from the side.

"Ahh... I-lost." Mydei finally reacted. He had actually lost to a newbie with 0 points.

If this was spread around, it would be absolutely humiliating, but Mydei didn't feel humiliated at all. Instead, a strange feeling began to bubble in his heart.

"No, if there's someone as strong as this, how could he be a newbie." When he thought about how he had been totally steamrollered by this other peron's strength, his complete inability to fight back, the feeling of being almost suffocated, a red glow appeared on Mydei's pale, handsome face. He was ecstatic.

That was the feeling he was chasing after. Before, Mydei thought that the person who fit these requirements was Khaslana, but now...

"Exactly. This is the person I've always been looking for." Mydei looked at the opposing mecha with shining eyes, but instead discovered that the mecha had already left.

After he won, Phainon rapidly left the competition. He was stupefied.

"What just happened? Why is my spiritual energy so strong?" Phainon felt like he had just been dreaming. After he connected to the mecha with his spiritual energy, it was as though he had been given a cheat. He had defeated his opponent as easily as if he was fighting an elementary schooler.

And that wasn't a normal opponent. It was the most important male character in the original novel, Mydeimos!

Even now, the rush of victory was still left in Phainon's blood, and he couldn't calm himself down. It was as though he could still see everything in the blink of an eye, as though he could still behead his opponent easily.

[Host, it's because after you experienced so many worlds and underwent all different kinds of transmigrations, your soul's strength is already much stronger than the average person's. When you participate in this kind of competition, you naturally would have no problem. Of course, if this was reality, the strong spiritual energy would make host's body fall apart.]

"...Since it's already like this, can't you give me a body that's a bit better?! Something like my original body." Phainon's impassioned heart quickly cooled. He had even thought that he could finally become one of the strong and wouldn't need to get thrown about by a nutjob. He didn't expect that he could only be strong in the virtual world.

[If host is too strong, it will draw the world consciousness's attention. Host's identity was already hidden in the competition this time, otherwise if you're found out by others it will cause unnecessary trouble.]

"Well, that's true." Phainon thought that he wasn't a Gary Stu protagonist anyway, and he didn't have a protagonist halo. If there actually was someone with such incredible strength, he might get his lunchbox in minutes. But it didn’t stop his heart which would still sometimes miss his carefully maintained body from his original world when he was now forced into these bottom roles.

But after resting for a bit, Phainon's mind filled with high aspirations. "Since I can only be strong in the virtual world, I won't let this opportunity get away. I'm going to get into the finals." If he changed worlds in the future, where would he get this kind of chance?

After making his decision, Phainon immediately continued into the competition site.

Meanwhile, the people who had just watched Mydeimos and Phainon's match had put a video up on the forums.

The people of the empire worshipped the strong and often had mecha competitions around the country. Almost everyone paid attention to virtual mecha competitions. There were also always countless people visiting the forums every day.

And a post titled "A newbie with zero points using an outdated mecha actually killed one of the top hundred in seconds, could it be that a second God Time has come up into the clouds?" attracted countless people's eyes. After the people who thought it was some fake rumors and disdained to click in saw the video, they were stunned.

In just a day, the post had countless replies. Several people questioned it simultaneously, all in shock, asking whether Mydei had made a mistake, or if Mydeimos and that Prince Latiao had some dirty transactions between them.

But Mydei's fans jumped on them like a pack of rabid dogs. Everyone knew Mydeimos was a nouveau riche who had all the money he wanted. How could he ruin his own name for something like this? It was even less likely he would take any bribes.

As the people in the post were fighting endlessly, someone suddenly tossed out a video, saying they had happened to see Prince Latiao at the competition by chance. Because they were too shocked, they had recorded it, and they would also let the people in the post see what the circumstances were really like.

Chapter End Notes

Gary Stu: (male version of Mary Sue) protagonist is an unrealistically perfect, overpowered male lead who is incredibly skilled, universally admired (or feared), faces no real challenges, and often bends the story's logic for wish fulfillment.

Getting Lunchbox: The phrase "getting a lunchbox" or receiving a lunchbox means that a character is going to die or be killed off. In earlier productions, an actor who had finished all their scenes in a show (often because their character was about to die) would receive their final "box lunch" from the catering crew on set. Once an actor received their final lunchbox, it was an informal signal that their work was done because their character's story had concluded with their death. ---

The character that i am basing Mydei on is very very very different from our aloof king but i am trying to reach a middle ground because Mydei in this fic serves the role of devoted protector and fanboy who ends up being Phainon's biggest supporter and comrade (and more ofc-). Lmao thats like my biggest grip with this whole story, i feel like

im making Mydei's character too strange but alas we must persist. I've already edited it two times.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Meeting the Original Protagonist
chapters.html:
The contents of the video that was put online was a scene between Prince Latiao and a more well-known contestant in the top ninety.

On the battlefield, Prince Latiao was the same as before. He easily steamrollered his opponent. Even the people on the sidelines could see his skillful maneuvering, while his seasoned opponent seemed like he had gone stupid. He lost without the slightest resistance. He didn't even realize his loss for a long time.

And there were several videos appearing. As long as they had been watching outside, they could see the videos. This person named Prince Latiao participated in tens of matches without stopping, and nearly none of the opponents he met could make it past ten minutes in the battlefield.

Generally speaking, it was already impressive for a participant to compete three or four times, but this Prince Latiao seemed not to know how to get tired. What terrifying level had his spiritual energy reached?

All the recordings were spread around. In moments, most of the people who had been cursing in the forums disappeared. Everyone had a sense of disbelief. Was it possible that there were actually two incredible competitors that appeared this year? Other than God Time, there was actually another person who could use an outdated mecha and reach a level of an immortal.

With such incredible power, it was impossible that this was someone unknown to the public. Was it some influential family's young master who came to participate in secret?

On the side, Mydei expressed in his social accounts that what had happened was absolutely genuine. There wasn't a single bit that was fake. Moreover, he deeply respected Prince Latiao's strength, and he hoped he could get to know him.

Mydei's fervent tone gave his fans a shock. Everyone knew that Mydei didn't have any interest in things outside of the battlefield, and he rarely spoke. They didn't expect that as soon as he opened his mouth today, he would sound just like a devoted fanboy of Prince Latiao.

Mydeimos had several million fans. After they saw his messages, several who didn't know what had happened went to look up this person named Prince Latiao. Immediately, they were stunned by the video of their match.

Overnight, Prince Latiao gained an unknown number of fans. Everyone was on the forums guessing who he was. All of the disbelievers had disappeared without a trace, and the people replacing them were countless worshippers.

"Ahhh, why is he so hot, he's just like my idol God Time! I think I'm falling in love again!"

"Me too, me too. It's obviously just an old, outdated mecha, but why is it so hot? I've licked the videos online tens of times already! It's not nearly enough!"

"Who knows when God Latiao will come back to compete again. I want to see what it'd be like if he competes with the top fifty."

"We'll definitely see it. An expert like this entering the semifinals is certain!"

But Khaslana's fans were considerably unhappy. They felt that this new person was imitating Khaslana, and they sent all kinds of jeers on the forum, saying that the newbie was just trash that couldn't even get in the top fifty. If he met with God Time, he would be beaten down.

But most people were strongly anticipating the clash of the two people using old-style mechas.

During the same time period, there were countless people who wanted to investigate who was behind Prince Latiao, but they had no results no matter how they looked. In the end, they could only drop it.

In a dormitory in the empire's advanced military school, a teenager with off white hair walked out of the bathroom in a bathrobe. He was handsome with a few hints of devilish seduction, a constant, kind smile always on his face. He could make other people trust him unconsciously.

This white-haired teenager was the protagonist of this interstellar ABO mecha novel, Khaslana. Khaslana toweled off his hair and put on his helmet. As soon as he entered the virtual world, he saw several emails.

These emails were basically all about how a competitor like Khaslana who used an outdated mecha had appeared recently. They were asking him if there was any connection between the two of them.

Khaslana's lip curled in a disdainful smile. Immediately, without the slightest hesitation, he cleared all of the emails.

"It's just someone not worth mentioning. He wasn't worth my time from the start."

Khaslana had absolute confidence in his own strength. It was impossible for someone to have spiritual energy stronger than his.

His spiritual energy was SSS grade, and he had maneuvering technique honed from years of diligent practice. How could a random guy who even had such a disgusting name pop up and compete with him so easily?

After tens of matches, even someone with spiritual energy as strong as Phainon couldn't take it anymore. He watched himself climb up to the first couple hundred in exhaustion, then exhaustedly logged out of the virtual world.

When he took off the helmet, Phainon discovered that he was covered in sweat. Since omegas were too physically weak, when they stayed a little too long in the virtual world, it was a huge strain on their bodies.

So Phainon went to the bathroom to shower. He even discovered that there were new clothes in his size in the drawer that he could change into.

The sky outside had already turned dark, but there was actually a meal on the table. It even seemed like it was one of those top-quality meals. Phainon felt a bit emotional, but immediately remembered that even the food that the dogs in Caelus's house ate was better than the meals Phainon normally had... This was probably the worst food they had at his house.

"But what in the world is Caelus thinking?" Phainon sat at the table eating, still puzzled after thinking for a long time. "He beat me up so badly before, but now he's not hitting me, and he even locked me up somewhere with such good conditions... Is he afraid that after I leave I'll destroy his image, so he wants to bribe me...?"

When he remembered Caelus's arrogance, Phainon quickly wiped the unrealistic thoughts from his mind.

Still, Phainon wasn't sure about anything else, but he knew that if Caelus still didn't come, then his daily task [Greet the capture target] couldn't be completed.

Phainon began to think. If Caelus still didn't come by nighttime, he would have to brave the dangers and make some trouble to draw Caelus over... Getting beaten up wasn't nearly as scary as the system's punishment.

Luckily, Caelus didn't forget that there was someone locked inside. When Phainon finished eating, Caelus pushed open the door with a haughty expression and walked inside.

Phainon hurriedly said, "Young Master Caelus, hi." It was wonderful to have the task completed.

"I don't have the leisure to be greeting trash like you. Don't think that if you're a bit more enthusiastic I'll consider you important," Caelus said angrily. "And don't think you can stay here comfortably just because you changed rooms. I won't let you mooch off of me."

He wasn't even the one who wanted to come mooch!!

"T-then can I go home?" Phainon hadn't forgotten that he had a mother and father in this world. Still, he had sent a message home while he was in the virtual world, so they wouldn't worry even if he didn't go home for now.

Of course, their son getting expelled because he peeped in the male bathrooms was extremely embarrassing... Phainon felt that the host's parents really weren't simple.

"No." Caelus crossed his arms across his chest, smiling coldly. "You think you can go as you please after offending me like you did yesterday? Don't joke around."

Didn't you offend me right back yesterday?!

Phainon thought, but of course he couldn't say that out loud, otherwise Caelus would definitely beat him half to death. He could only say, "Then what do you want me to do, Young Master Caelus?"

"To make up for what you did to me, I want you to be my servant," Caelus said arrogantly. "Of course, there are other servants to do those specialized things. You just need to be in charge of waiting on me at school. You know, you're just a beta, and you managed to become my servant. If your parents knew, they would be proud of you."

Although Phainon really wanted to curse Caelus for being too proud, it really was fact. For a family in dire straits like his, a family had the name of a noble but didn't have any true power, they would be honored if even the son of a duke greeted them.

Phainon: "But I was already expelled..." This was so cruel.

"So what? You can keep going to school tomorrow. I already had people settle it with the dean," Caelus said. "Of course, if you don't serve me well, the institute will expel you just as before. So you'd better do it properly. Don't think that you can slack because you're a beta. My expectations are very high."

After sarcastically making things clear, Caelus turned to leave.

Phainon: "!!" Hey, that's so careless. You think you're amazing just because you have power and influence?!... He really was amazing. Phainon could finally go back to school!!

It was lucky Caelus didn't mention the thing from yesterday about apologizing to Khaslana. For the time being, Phainon didn't have the guts to go see Khaslana. He was afraid that as soon as such a disreputable and tormenting thing was publicized, Khaslana's name would be ruined.

Khaslana would seek revenge if someone just glanced at him the wrong way. To reach his goal, even his friends were calculated. It would be better to say that, in his eyes, nobody was his friend. They were just chess pieces that he could use. In the original novel, he had used Mydeimos thoroughly. In the end, his family had been thrown into bankruptcy, and he committed suicide in his guilt over causing his cousin's death.

Although there were plenty of gay alphas who liked Khaslana in the original novel, all of the people who succeeded in joining his harem were omegas. After all, the protagonist's interests were still normal... What kind of danmei novel was this?!

Anyway, even Mydeimos, the crown prince's younger cousin, the young master of a financial magnate, was so miserable. Phainon didn't think he, as a cannon fodder, could protect his life!!

The one thing he could rely on was charging out to suck up when the original protagonist became successful and famous. Then he could have his lunchbox and leave the world immediately. It was fine as long as he avoided seeing Khaslana.

The more he thought, the more Phainon felt that his method was absolutely perfect. He slept peacefully. - The next day, Phainon dragged himself out of bed early in the morning and changed into his school uniform. After yesterday's experience, he was full of interest for mechas. He wanted to hurry up and go to school to learn... If he could, it would be best to train his body to be a bit more sturdy. This way, there might be a day where he could succeed in piloting a mecha in the real world.

Although he could surpass most people relying on his spiritual energy alone, if he was matched with someone extremely strong, he probably wouldn't be able to defeat them, particularly because the original host didn't study properly before, and Phainon didn't know a bunch of different things about mechas. How was he supposed to fight like this, huh!

He went downstairs to eat. It was just like yesterday. When Caelus was eating, there were several different people waiting on him. There was no need for Phainon to lift a finger.

Phainon wondered what Caelus was thinking when he made him a servant for no good reason, but it was fine as long as he could benefit.

After finishing breakfast, Phainon got onto the aircar with Caelus.

Phainon sat solemnly, thinking about how he could study well, when he heard Caelus suddenly speak. "By the way, you were on the virtual net yesterday, weren't you? Did you see the virtual mecha competition or not?"

Phainon didn't realize Caelus was actually talking to him for a long time. He immediately let out a noise of surprise, then when he saw Caelus's expression turn much darker, he immediately said, "Of course I did. Is something wrong?"

"Hmph. You really are a useless beta. You don't even know when someone is talking." Caelus continued with his ad hominem. Phainon felt that if Caelus wasn't the son of a duke, the surrounding betas would have jumped him and started beating him up.

"Then you should know about that Prince Latiao who made a huge splash at the competition yesterday." Caelus's gaze filled with disdain. He sneered, "What a horrible name. He even copied Senior Khaslana, using an old mecha. He's just a joke. He just beat a couple of weak chickens and he thinks he's so great."

Phainon didn't expect that he would hear his virtual world's nickname from Caelus. He began to cough violently.

"When someone else is talking, you listen properly." Caelus glared at Phainon with extreme unhappiness, then continued to vent his fury with Prince Latiao.

Although Caelus had the character design of an arrogant young master, he truly admired the strong, which was why he looked up to Khaslana and even became his fanboy.

When he saw a ton of people bringing up Prince Latiao and Khaslana in the same breath, Caelus was extremely unhappy, but he couldn't find anyone to talk to. When he thought about it, Phainon still had some use, but he was embarrassed to have a proper conversation with him. He hesitated for a long time before he finally spoke.

"Ahh, yeah." When Phainon heard Caelus's words, he nodded again and again. Once in a while, he would even say indignantly, "You're exactly right. This Prince Latiao is absolute garbage."

Hearing Phainon speak, Caelus felt that he was getting easier and easier on the eyes. He even nodded amiably at Phainon. "Not bad. Although you're trash, you've still got some taste."

Phainon: "..." Was raising the favorability score ever easy! He even needed to curse himself out this time. It was lucky that after Caelus heard the first bit, his favorability score seemed to skyrocket. When the favorability rises up, he wouldn't need to worry that his future would be so crappy!

"Hmph. I don't know why I can't find Prince Latiao's identity, either. Otherwise, I would grab him and take him for some torture," Caelus said, annoyed.

Phainon: "..." Actually, you already tortured him.

Soon, they arrived at the empire's military school. It was a pretty famous school. Many noble families studied here, and even some underage princes were here.

As a special student, Caelus's aircar could drive straight into the school into the parking lot before stopping. He didn't have to weave through the huge garden before he could get to the school like the normal students.

Although they both made it into the school with their connections, there was a big difference between someone from a rundown family like Phainon and Caelus, the son of a duke. The places they learned were also different. Even the teachers and the study materials were as different as night and day.

Phainon got ready to leave, wanting to go to the other area he remembered from the host's memory to study, but Caelus stopped him. "Hold still. Where are you trying to go?"

"Huh? I-I'm going to the classroom," Phainon said.

"Are you an idiot?" Caelus snorted. "Since you're my servant, you have to stay by my side. You're trying to go somewhere else? Hurry up, come here."

"But won't there be a problem? I'm not a student here..." If he could go somewhere better, Phainon would naturally be happy, but would he really be able to avoid getting kicked out by the teacher?

Caelus shot him an arrogant glance. "There's nobody with the guts to touch my people. Just come here."

Phainon: "!" Ah, he suddenly thought that Caelus was super cool.

Thus, Phainon was forced along with Caelus to go to the higher ranking classrooms.

Who would expect that because he offended the male protagonist he falsely accused of being a pervert who peeped into the male showers, and then after the protagonist's fan brought him home for a whipping... things would actually turn out for the good. He succeeded in coming back to school, and even came straight to a higher ranking area. Was this called profiting from disaster?

Feeling complicated but excited, Phainon and Caelus walked into the classroom. All of the students in this class were alphas. There were probably betas before, but Caelus must have crowded them out.

At first, everyone was sitting at their desks, silently reading. When they saw Phainon had come in with Caelus, their expressions changed immediately.

Actually, based on Phainon's status as a cannon fodder, there was no way these people would remember him. But what had happened was too shocking. Nobody had expected that someone would actually peep in the men's bathroom. He was a pervert among perverts! When everyone in the school thought about how they might have been seen while they were in the bathroom, their entire bodies filled with goosebumps.

It nearly made the news. If it wasn't for the fact that the dean was afraid it would ruin their reputation and he suppressed the news, Phainon might be a well-known pervert throughout the entire empire.

It was easy to tell how terrifying of a person Khaslana was. Because of his framing, the original host had no way to continue living.

Phainon: "..." Although it's not my first time being seen as a gay, I don't know why but this seems especially humiliating.

The thing that was even more surprising was that Phainon actually came with Caelus. Was Caelus possessed?! This guy was a beta, and he was also a pervert who peeped on the men's bathroom!

Even if other people didn't know, they were very clear how much Caelus despised betas. He was even arrogant to his alpha classmates. How the heck did this guy manage to suck up to Caelus?!

Under everyone's peculiar stares, Phainon sat down stiffly.

But Caelus was completely at ease, not feeling like there was any problem at all. He called Phainon to open his books for him.

Class started soon. The teacher just glanced at Phainon for a moment before naturally beginning to lecture.

Phainon could understand most of what was going on. He could even relate the circumstances from when he was connected to the mecha. What he couldn't really figure out were the few more profound topics. Whenever they got to those topics, he would unconsciously begin to take notes.

When Caelus was in class, he was also completely focused. His attitude was completely different from his normal arrogance. After all, he was chasing stubbornly after this goal.

While he was listening earnestly to the lessons, time passed quickly. Soon, it was the end of class. Phainon felt a bit like he hadn't heard enough, but when he saw the notebook full of questions, he didn't have the guts to go and ask.

Because he was just a student who was stuck in as a transfer. How could he go and ask the teacher questions.

The original host just came to school to pass time. His test scores were just okay, and during mecha battle classes, it was painful to watch.

But it was also because of his family. After all, the original host was actually an omega, and his natural physique had its drawbacks. His parents felt some remorse for him, but they didn't ask that he became someone amazing.

"I'll go on the virtual net to look it up later." Phainon sighed, then realized Caelus was looking at the notebook in his hands.

"Hmph, you don't even know something so simple." Caelus jeered at him with disdain first, then leaned over. "Look, it's not like this... You have to do this part like this. You don't even know something like this? Did you even listen properly?"

Like such, Caelus explained all of the questions Phainon had. Although he had an extremely impatient attitude, and he would often add in a few barbs, he explained in great detail. Even Phainon understood in moments.

When Phainon was done listening, he suddenly realized, wasn't Caelus just like the tsunderes in rumors?

Wait, he didn't want to keep thinking about something scary like this!

The next class was about the same. Caelus explained the things Phainon didn't understand. Finally, his expression turned much warmer. "It seems like you're not completely trash. You've got a bit of drive."

Phainon: "..." It seemed that Caelus liked people who loved studying.

Next, it was time to eat lunch. There were several restaurants in the school. There were restaurants with low prices that even the commoners could afford, restaurants with sky-high prices, and restaurants that only allowed noble students to eat there. Although Phainon was technically from a downtrodden noble family, he was broke. He just ate the food from the noble restaurant.

Of course, the restaurant Caelus picked was the most expensive kind. When Phainon thought about how he could eat all kinds of delicacies later, he was incredibly moved.

But what happened next extinguished Phainon's belly of fire.

Weren't the people over there Khaslana and Mydeimos? What the fuck!? Hey, all of the beautiful plans he thought of last night were destroyed!

Chapter End Notes

Yay! New Chapter. The only slang in this chapter was lunchbox but i explained it already in the previous chapters end notes but if there's anything else that is unclear just let me know, I'll explain it in the endnotes! Thanks for reading.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: "Your actually....an Omega?"
chapters.html:
It was Phainon's first time seeing their faces. He had to admit that they were extremely attractive, and they both had their own uniqueness.

Although Mydeimos had an illustrious background, he didn't like other people nagging him. When he dealt with things, he was very lowkey, even hiding his own status. Most of the people in the school didn't know about it.

And right now, Khaslana was also a new student who had talent and popularity. Nobody knew he was the renowned God Time in the online mecha competitions.

So both of them looked like normal students strolling around the school. There weren't any crazy fans following after them, either.

Thus they strolled straight into Phainon.

In the next moment, the system began to sound.

[Beep beep beep... Detected a more powerful character... Beginning to change capture targets in accordance with the system's regulations... Change complete. The current capture target is Mydeimos.]

Phainon: "???" Hey, wait, why was it Mydeimos?! He thought it would be Khaslana.

[It's because the capture target Mydeimos's strength is higher, of course.]

Phainon: "..." Well, that was true. Khaslana was technically still in the first stages of his development. It was normal if his power couldn't compare to Mydei's.

When Khaslana saw the two of them, he was different from Phainon, who had been scared out of his wits. Instead, he smiled slightly, greeting them, as though he was seeing a friend. He didn't treat Phainon with the slightest bit of strangeness.

Just seeing Khaslana's attitude, anyone could tell he was the one who had unjustly accused the original host of peeping on the men's bathroom!

The more Khaslana acted like this, the colder Phainon's heart got. He would rather Khaslana come over and whip him a few times to work out the problem. He didn't want Khaslana to keep plotting against him secretly. Still, there was nothing he could do if his character was just like this.

When Caelus saw his adored idol, he became excited and opened his mouth, but because of his nerves he couldn't say anything. After struggling for a long time, in the end he only gave a casual nod, not even saying anything. His attitude was obviously icy... If it wasn't for the fact that he was always praising Khaslana at home, even Phainon couldn't guess that he was Khaslana's fanboy.

No wonder the original novel's Khaslana thought Caelus was his enemy for a long time. He even thought of killing Caelus several times.

When Phainon thought of this, he felt that Caelus was absolutely miserable. He was actually fanboying after someone like this. Sincerity really was difficult.

Mydei was just indifferent. He gave a careless greeting to Caelus, completely ignoring Phainon.

To Mydei, giving a second glance to someone like this was an insult on his own eyes. He was still thinking constantly of the dozens of mails he had sent to Prince Latiao in his excitement yesterday, and whether Prince Latiao would disdain him for being annoying after seeing them. He couldn't help feeling regretful.

But Caelus looked at Mydei coldly. After all, he was just some guy who lost to Prince Latiao and let things progress so far. If he was a little more useful, the circumstances would be different.

Phainon, staying self-aware, said nothing. He wouldn't make things hard for himself.

It was just some greetings, but things actually got so awkward.

Since both parties had things to do, they dispersed quickly. When Khaslana passed by Phainon, he threw out a sentence casually. "I didn't think you still knew some schemes. But you won't be so lucky next time. Just wait and see."

His voice was very quiet. Only Phainon could hear him. His heart tightened, and he whipped his head back, seeing a friendly smile appearing on Khaslana's devilishly handsome face.

Then Khaslana turned away, leaving together with Mydei.

To be honest, when Phainon saw Khaslana's smile, he was so shocked he nearly fell to his knees.

Could things still be okay when the original protagonist set his eyes on him! With his schemes, he could cause Phainon to lose his reputation easily... Although his reputation was already gone. Forget it, why think about him so much? Even if the entire empire thought he was a pervert who peeped on the men's bathroom, so what! He would still live on.

Phainon was simply giving up on a hopeless situation.

Caelus, who had already walked ahead by several steps, turned to glance at Phainon. "What're you looking at? Stop looking, hurry up."

Phainon hurried after him.

Caelus went straight to selecting a private room in the restaurant, then ordered a bunch of expensive food. When the food came, he looked straight at Phainon and said unhappily, "What are you still sitting there for? Hurry up and come to serve me. Don't you have the sense of a servant?"

...Phainon was wondering if Caelus didn't even eat when he was by himself and didn't have someone to serve him.

Well, the capture target had changed. Similarly, Phainon was a lot lazier. He hesitantly said, "Huh? But I'm just a beta. It's not very good if I come in contact with you, right?"

Caelus said haughtily, "Although you're just a beta, you're doing alright, you're much better than other betas. I'll permit you to serve my meal more closely."

Phainon really wanted to say, "So what if you die of starvation", but he had to lower his head under this roof, and he still went over to feed Caelus.

Phainon was very curious about Caelus's favorability score, so he asked the system, even though this laze-about system could only check if the score was negative, zero, or positive.

[The previous capture target's favorability score is zero.]

Phainon: "..." Hey, then why did Caelus even make him feed him.

[It's because the previous capture target's favorability score towards most betas is negative, so the host's 0 is more acceptable.]

Phainon: "..." He actually had no way to retort.

Now that he thought about it, Caelus probably felt very annoyed when he was eating by himself normally. so after he seized Phainon, he made him a butler along the way...

Growing alphas had especially large appetites. Caelus didn't finish eating until Phainon's arms were already numb, then he started to drink tea with the utmost elegance. Phainon had no idea how Caelus, someone who could be called thin could eat so much.

Phainon didn't start eating until he finished feeding Caelus. He quickly sank into the blissful taste of the food, flinging all the unhappy things into the back of his mind.

Was there anyone on the planet as easily satisfied as him.

After Caelus finished eating, his mood improved significantly. He watched Phainon and said, "There's a mecha battle lesson in two days. You'd better practice properly when you go back. I don't want to see you humiliating me."

Phainon immediately remembered how terrible the original host's mecha battle grades were. Immediately, his face turned pale. The reason he could be so amazing on the virtual net was all reliant on his spiritual energy. But in reality, where his body would collapse as long as he used spiritual energy, he could only operate manually.

And his manual mecha operation experience was only from the warm-up during the battle with Mydeimos yesterday. He even fell down several times.

That was even on the virtual net. Falling down didn't hurt much. But in reality, with an omega's frail body, it would probably break his bones, and he would have to lay in bed for several months...

The original host's mother and father had already talked it out with the teachers. Every time they had mecha battle lessons, he just wouldn't attend. But it was obvious that Caelus wasn't someone who could be reasoned with.

...It looked like he would have to go into the virtual net and practice his manual operations properly.

Most of Phainon's good mood dispersed in moments. He picked up the tea on the side, taking a sip.

"There's still that damn Prince Latiao," Caelus snorted. "I'm going to go teach him a lesson today. I'll let him know how high the heavens are."

Phainon nearly spat out the tea he just drank. He began coughing.

"What's wrong?" Caelus immediately frowned. "You don't think I can win?"

"No, no..." Phainon hurriedly said. "How could Prince Latiao win against you? I believe you will definitely succeed!"

"That's just about right," Caelus said. "You did pretty well today. Keep working hard in the future. I'll think about increasing your salary."

Phainon was shocked: "!" He actually had a salary! He even thought he was just working for nothing.

In fact, Caelus was a good person, huh... But when he thought of how he was given a beating as soon as he came, Phainon decided to forget it.

-

Physical education was in the afternoon. Phainon worked hard to toughen himself before he realized exactly how bad omegas' physical strength was.

He only ran for a bit, but he was already panting for breath, while the surrounding alphas were full of energy.

But Phainon felt he was doing pretty good for transmigrating into an omega pretending to be a beta.

Although he would occasionally feel jealous of alphas, he wouldn't go around cursing that life was unfair or anything like that... After all, most omegas were locked up at home, otherwise they went to all-omega schools, and once they came of age they waited to be married off.

If he had transmigrated into that kind of omega, Phainon would just choose death.

When school was over, he returned to the residence. Caelus went fiercely back to his own room.

Phainon went back to his room too, putting on the helmet and entering the virtual world. As soon as he went in, he was stunned by the amount of mail. Before this, the original host only had ten-some letters cursing him out for being a pervert...

These letters were all from people who sent them through the competition, and the competition's system forwarded it to him. There wasn't any problem with keeping his identity secret. Nobody would know Phainon's mailing address.

Yesterday, Phainon just fought a couple dozen rounds and left. He didn't think of going to take a look at other places like the forum. He didn't expect that he would actually become a small celebrity in the competition.

Phainon poked open a few letters to take a look. Shockingly enough, there were a significant number of love letters filled with all kinds of selfies. There were even some from male and female omegas. It really gave Phainon a shock.

And even Mydeimos sent him several dozen letters. When he picked them out, he discovered that they were written in the same tone as a fanboy's. Phainon really couldn't imagine the cold Mydeimos from earlier in the day actually writing something like this... If he knew Phainon was Prince Latiao, who knew how he would react.

And this Mydei guy was actually ecstatic after being beaten. In fact, he was a total masochist, wasn't he! ...But living like this, he wouldn't have any problems doing his daily task. Phainon thought about contacting Mydei to meet up online after this stuff was dealt with.

He could do his daily task in dreams in one of his previous worlds, so it should be possible online too.

Another portion of the letters were related to a collaboration. There were also several strong people who wanted to pull him over onto their side. When Phainon saw the huge number of empire coins, he got emotional, but in reality he was a potato. What use was an expert that could only live in the virtual net? He could only reluctantly ignore these letters.

As for the ones saying how much money he could get by doing a couple random commercials during the competition, Phainon was very interested. It was just doing a few ads, how wonderful it was to earn money so carelessly.

Thus, after Phainon got the system to thoroughly conceal his location, he went to ask the other party about the fees. Finally, he asked around several places and earned a good amount of honest money. In moments, he had tens of thousand of empire coins.

Although the original host's family were nobles, they lived about the same as commoners. A year of their expenses was only a few tens of thousand empires coins.

When Phainon finished settling those things, he arrived at the square with the most people. Shockingly, the most conspicuous advertisement had a declaration of war.

It invited Prince Latiao to go to a certain virtual mecha training site to exchange pointers. If Prince Latiao won, then he could get a million interstellar coins. If he lost, then he would have to withdraw from the virtual mecha competition, and never participate again.

There were a huge number of people competing in the virtual world every day, but there were only a few people who were so arrogant. It quickly drew many people's attention.

People could see the ad as soon as they walked into the district. It cost dozens of thousands of interstellar coins per day.

Phainon understood immediately. No wonder so many advertising companies were looking for him just now. It seemed it was because of this ad's positioning.

Phainon: "..." The damn person who put up this declaration of war was definitely Caelus. Should he go or not... Although Caelus wasn't participating in the competition this time, he was very strong. He had avoided death from Khaslana's schemes several times. After the plot in the original novel finished, he even became a general and Khaslana's capable assistant... So should he go or not?

Wasn't this nonsense? Of course he should go! Phainon had confidence in his spiritual energy. If Caelus was giving away money, why wouldn't he go collect it? That was a million interstellar coins!

Phainon went to an individual-use competition terminal at the side without a sliver of hesitation. These one-on-one matches were also held through the virtual mecha competition's system.

After he entered, a screen to select his mecha appeared just like it did yesterday.

Generally speaking, a contestant would use the mecha he was most familiar with. They usually wouldn't change at will. They were also more personalized, where they would put a special symbol on the mecha. For example, it was easy to identify who it was just by looking at the mecha for the experts in the top fifty.

But Prince Latiao's appearance made Khaslana's outdated mecha look less unique, which was why Khaslana's fans fans were so unhappy.

Yesterday, Phainon only picked randomly because he was poor. Now, he had so much money from down payments that he had become rich in moments. Why would he pick the worn outdated mecha? He immediately picked the latest, most popular mecha. It only cost a few hundred empire coins.

In the real world, he couldn't pilot any of these amazing mechas, so of course he would give it a try online. He wasn't trying to play cool like the original protagonist or anything. And if he was going to shoot ads, then he had to pick a custom appearance and spend a few thousand more empire coins. Still, compared to his ad appearance fee, it was nothing.

Phainon went straight to initiate the new functions, copying the lines the ad companies gave him onto his mecha. The plain white mecha quickly became colorful. It looked absolutely stuck-up. It was obvious the owner's sense of beauty was trash.

Still, Phainon didn't care about these things. Compared to getting cursed out for his sense of beauty, empire coins were obviously more important.
