Phainon opened the screen. As expected, he saw Caelus sending out a challenge. There was an attached agreement explaining clearly what would happen if he lost and what would happen if he won. It had been approved by the competition and was legally binding. As long as he signed, he couldn't back out.

It even had Caelus's signature at the bottom.

In the virtual world, Caelus was also hiding his true identity. Here, his name was Stay Away From Me. It really matched his personality...

Phainon signed the agreement at once, then clicked accept. His sight filled with color, and he was sent directly to the battlefield.

It was already filled with spectators. They were people who had just heard the news and quickly bought tickets to come in. These unofficial battle rooms all had to be paid out of pocket, but one percent of the ticket revenue would be split between the two participants.

So when Phainon saw all these people, it was like he was looking at empire coins. He felt very emotional.

Most people had come to see Prince Latiao. They also wanted to know who had challenged him, even wasting his money to buy the ad space in the square. When they saw Phainon's mecha, they were stupefied.

Didn't Prince Latiao use an outdated mecha? Why did he suddenly change now? And it was whatever if he changed, but why did this mecha look so tacky? And it was full of a mess of words... Wait, these were ads!

A perfectly good mecha had been tormented into such a ghastly state. Just how many ads did Prince Latiao take?!

This completely shattered the showiness of Prince Latiao in their hearts!! Although this name was showy to begin with, they really wanted to ask exactly how poor Prince Latiao was...

And Mydei, who had people paying attention to news about Prince Latiao at any moment, was the first person to have bought a ticket. He looked at the battlefield, both anxious and excited. He couldn't calm himself down ever since what happened yesterday. His mind was full of Prince Latiao.

Through the filter of his brain, Mydei thought that even such an ugly mecha had personality. He even thought of making his own mecha similar when he went back.

"Hmph." Caelus sneered when he saw the mecha. "As expected, you're just trash. You're doing something like this to get strong for a moment, and even wanted to be compared with Senior Khaslana. Today, I'm going to make you lose and never think about competing in mecha competitions again."

But Phainon didn't care too much. He just looked at the various buttons inside the mecha, remembering what he had learned in school that day, and excitedly realizing he had remembered them. Now, he pretty much knew the things he hadn't known yesterday.

Anyway, there was still a bit of time before the warm-up time ended. He would use this time to practice a bit.

Phainon began to attempt to operate the mecha manually. After his experience yesterday, his maneuvering was much better today. Although it couldn't compare to the feeling that he and the mecha were one when he was using spiritual energy, at least he could walk without falling over.

The surrounding spectators watched the mecha take extremely stiff steps, just a tiny bit better than a beginner, and their expressions turned shocked. They had only seen videos of Prince Latiao's heroic displays. They had no idea that at the beginning of the first match, Prince Latiao had gotten plenty of ridicule because of his terrible operations.

"Maybe he's not used to the new mecha?"

"Gosh, he should be using a mecha he's used to for a match as important as this. Why did he have to change?"

"Will he really lose because of this? Then I bought this ticket for nothing."

Only Mydei was excited. His gaze fixed on the field, remembering the first time he met Prince Latiao. Through his mental filter, even if Phainon fell over, Mydei would probably still think it was a skillful, beautiful fall...

Soon, the warm-up time ended. Caelus also got serious, despite how he hadn't considered his opponent a true threat before. Caelus had seen all of Prince Latiao's videos before, and even he had to admit that his opponent had some skills. But if he wanted to be compared with Khaslana, he still fell short.

Although he was very strong, Prince Latiao's techniques were very unpracticed, and he didn't seem to have any understanding of strategy. He often seemed like a mecha operating beginner.

"Based on the video from yesterday, this Prince Latiao is going to try and sneak attack me as quickly as possible. For many people, their cockpits will be skewered before they can react," Caelus thought. "As long as I block this first strike, then take the opportunity to attack, I can defeat him easily."

Caelus sat calmly in the same spot, connecting to the mecha with his spiritual energy, waiting for his opponent to move.

People on his level typically use spiritual energy to maneuver the mecha. Otherwise, their hand speed wasn't fast enough.

In this world, spiritual energy was decided at birth, but their physiques could be improved. Many things were set at the beginning. Even if Khaslana was the original protagonist who climbed up from the slums, his biggest cheat was his powerful spiritual energy.

In the moment the match began, Prince Latiao's clumsy bearing disappeared. His mecha began to move quickly, attacking immediately.

"Just as I expected. If I hadn't prepared, I might really have lost." Caelus caught the blow as he had planned, his mind at ease but moving quickly. He seized the opportunity to attack his opponent in return.

It was reasonable to think that at such a high speed, according to his plans, Prince Latiao couldn't possibly avoid him, but in that moment, his opponent disappeared in a flash, quicker than he had in the video.

"How could it be." Caelus's eyes widened, then he realized that yesterday Prince Latiao was using the most worn, outdated mecha, but today he had changed into a new mecha. It was normal for him to be faster.

So Caelus missed his best opportunity. Prince Latiao had already flashed away to a safe place.

"Shit, I actually made this kind a mistake. Forget it, I'll use Plan B." Caelus's expression turned ugly. He pulled out a laser scalpel, rushing towards his opponent.

After watching the videos, Caelus deduced that his opponent wasn't very good in combat. Since his first plan failed, then he would go with the normal method. In any case, he was confident in his strength.

Caelus's guess was correct. Phainon really wasn't good in combat. He hadn't learned many skills to begin with. Yesterday, he had relied on his speed and the element of surprise to win. Now that he was faced with Caelus, who had investigated him thoroughly, it quickly exposed his shortcomings.

But with his powerful spiritual energy controlling the entire arena, Phainon could practically see anything Caelus was trying to do. He could avoid any blow. He could even avoid sneak attacks like he had eyes on the back of his head. If he wanted to lose, it was hard, but it wouldn't be easy if he wanted to win, either.

As they exchanged blows, Phainon's spiritual energy recorded all of Caelus's movements in his memory. In the next exchange, it unconsciously exerted itself. Phainon didn't even realize it himself, but when he unconsciously used such a movement to attack, Caelus was stunned.

"He actually learned my moves. He learned so quickly. It's even a move that not many people in the school learned," Caelus thought back to the strange movements from the warm-up, and a terrifying thought surfaced in his mind.

"Could it be that this guy is a mecha piloting beginner? So when he wasn't connected to the system, he was like that... In this case, then how terrifying is his spiritual energy?

"If this is the case, then he wasn't purposefully imitating Senior Khaslana yesterday. It was because it was his first time, and he didn't know what mecha to use, so he used the outdated mecha. But he won so easily..."

After thinking of this, Caelus couldn't stay calm. He looked towards Prince Latiao's mecha, his original disdain gone. Instead, it was filled with strong curiosity.

He wanted to know exactly how strong this person's spiritual energy was.

Before that, the person with the strongest spiritual energy that he had seen was Khaslana. He could tell at a glance that even though Khaslana was much stronger because of his experience and all kinds of reasons, if it was just based on spiritual energy, this person would, without a doubt, be the strongest person in the future.

Besides, Khaslana still had terrifying skill, and he had an aura of infinite possibilities. It was exactly because of this that Caelus became Khaslana's fanboy without the slightest hesitation.

But now, it seemed that he had found someone even more amazing.

In fact, from a certain viewpoint, Caelus and Mydei very alike. Both of them sought the strong, and their attitudes were close to being twisted. It was related to the original protagonist's setting, to make it easy for him to collect followers, but now it had made it easy for Phainon.

Caelus's eyes flashed with fanaticism. Without the slightest hesitation, he approached his opponent, even using the most dangerous method, reaching out with his spiritual energy to probe the other mecha.

It was an extremely dangerous method. Only people who were very confident in their spiritual energy would do it. When they had the upper hand, they could make their opponent fall into a trance so they had no way to operate their mecha, seizing victory for themselves.

If their opponent's spiritual energy was stronger, as long as they were careless, the initiator could even fall into a coma. It was also likely for them to lose themselves in their opponent's spiritual world due to the disparity in energy. It was a gamble.

It wasn't that Caelus didn't know the risks. But in that moment, all he wanted was to know was exactly how strong this person's spiritual energy was, so much that his own safety was secondary.

The people in the stands thought they were about to see an intense battle. Nobody expected that Stay Away From Me would actually fling himself over to embrace Prince Latiao's mecha. What the heck Weren't they fighting perfectly well before?!

When Mydei saw what was happening, he nearly crushed the arm of the chair he was sitting on. His expression turned ugly. "What the heck is this guy doing? Is he trying to use tricks because he can't beat Prince Latiao?"

The noise of the outside was distant. As his spiritual energy touched his opponent's spiritual energy, Caelus sank into the middle.

In moments, this powerful spiritual energy dispersed most of his willpower. It was as though he was soaking in an ocean spiritual energy. There was a faint fragrance in the air.

No, this fragrance... Caelus jolted suddenly from his stupor, waking up from his daze.

Although Caelus felt like a long time had passed, it had only been a moment in the outside world.

Phainon felt awful. Someone invading his spiritual energy was just like someone peeling off his clothes. Since Caelus had sent himself to his door, then Phainon would move directly.

Just as Phainon picked up his weapon and aimed at his opponent's cockpit, Caelus opened his eyes. His pale cheeks were flushed a faint red, and he looked towards the opposing mecha in shock. In the moment before he lost, his voice tore from his throat.

"You're actually... an omega?"

Chapter End Notes

Oop- The drama.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: That's My Destined Companion
chapters.html:
Chapter Notes

I edited this chapter while i was writing but i didnt reread it today so let me know if anything is amiss. Thx <3

Of course, Phainon couldn't hear what Caelus was saying. After his victory, he simply exited.

After he left the competition venue, Phainon received a notification of a million empire coin deposit into his account. He still felt like it was a little unreal, but he didn't think... in just a moment, he had become a millionaire.

Suddenly, he really wanted to have a few more dumb rich people like Caelus come challenge him.

When the competition ended, the video also went up on several forums and social media sites. It quickly caused everyone to gasp in shock.

Although everyone had wondered about Prince Latiao's sense of artistry when they watched the first video, now that they were watching the second video they automatically overlooked it.

In the empire, as long as you were strong, nothing else was important. Even if Phainon's mecha was filled with advertisements and looked ridiculously flashy, in that moment there were several people copying him and spray-painting a mess of things on their own mechas.

But Phainon just received even more letters about advertisements. Now that he wasn't poor, he set them aside, beginning to think about his daily task.

Thus Mydei, who had become incredibly excited after watching the match, received Prince Latiao's letter of reply.

There were all kinds of facilities in the virtual world. Whether someone wanted to enjoy delicious foods or go on a leisure tour, they could do anything. Moreover, these experiences were almost the same as reality, but the prices were significantly lower, and it was also safer.

For example, in the past, to see the beautiful sunrise on the legendary and extremely dangerous Planet A, they would have to brave fatal dangers in order to see it. Now, they could experience it in the simulation facilities, and the price was only a few hundred empire coins.

Because there was heavy human traffic, there were also many people who did their everyday work in the virtual world. The virtual world and the real world didn't have that much of a difference. It could almost be called a second world.

But simulation facilities were still pretty expensive. For example, if the richest magnate in the empire constructed a high-end restaurant in the virtual world, though the food was simulated, it had a considerably high price. If a commoner went in to eat once, they could keep showing off for a long time after.

And at that moment Mydei was sitting at a table in the highest balcony garden, restlessly staring out at the scenery outside the glass.

Today, he was wearing an expensive custom suit. In the real world, it would cost at least a million empire coins to buy. He had went specially to get his blonde and auburn hair styled and make him look more lively. He was even more handsome than he was normally.

Like this, Mydei could make people shriek just by sitting there. Of course, there wasn't anyone else there at the moment. He had booked the entire balcony. In any case, it was his family's business.

There was a simulated aurora from Planet Mofei, said to be the most beautiful and most romantic view in the universe, outside the window. Numerous light pink flowers were in full bloom in the garden, their faint fragrance dispersing into the air.

To couples, this was the holy land for a date and the best place to propose, but when Mydei was making his choice, he didn't think of it. He just thought that only such a nice place would match his male god.

"I wonder if he'll be dissatisfied with this place?" Mydei was very anxious. After he got Prince Latiao's letter, he hesitated for a long time before he finally settled on meeting at this restaurant. Still, he worried that Prince Latiao would dislike it.

The door opened. Someone with a mosaic over their face walked in, waving over at him.

That's right. This person with a mosaic over their face was Phainon. He had to give a big thank you to the virtual world's privacy protection. As long as he didn't want others to see his real appearance, he could adjust his privacy settings... After that, people wouldn't be able to make out your face no matter what happened.

Otherwise, Phainon wouldn't come out to meet Mydei so casually. If his identity was exposed, it would be a bother.

At the moment, only Prince Latiao, who had received his invitation, could come in. Mydei immediately stood up in excitement.

Even though Phainon's face was covered with a mosaic, and he was wearing a very casual outfit, Mydei didn't have any complaints. He even felt that his male god managed to be good-looking even with a mosaic over his face. He awkwardly cleared his throat as he got up “Ah..Greetings, I..” Mydei tried to contain regulate his emotions in accordance with his regal bearing.

Because he was too excited, Mydei nearly stumbled. You could tell he was out of his element. Luckily, Phainon was close, and he hurried to catch him. "Are you okay?"

Of course, Phainon's voice was also being processed by the privacy protections. It sounded very distorted, but in Mydei's ears it was just like a sound of nature. His typically icy face immediately turned red. "I-I'm fine. I-it's truly an honor to have you here."

Phainon: "..." Hey, was this the same Mydei he met yesterday? How come his aura was totally different!

They sat down at the table. Mydei despite being very nevous managed to hide it well, the only tell being the slight bobbing of his leg under the table. "What would you like to eat? You can order anything you'd like. Please, don't be polite."

Phainon knew this restaurant was owned by Mydei's family, so wasn't polite and ordered several dishes. Mydei also ordered a few dishes.

Because it was just simulated food, they could only experience the food's taste, but they wouldn't feel full. As a result, many people who wanted to keep their figures but also wanted to taste fine food were interested.

After the simulated foods were selected, they automatically appeared on the table, and the two of them began to eat. In fact, only Phainon was eating. Mydei was just staring at him with adoration. Fine food or whatever else was nothing to him.

Mydei summoned his courage to speak. “I- I have come to respect your prowess immensely… In the moment that you defeated me, I was already deeply interested by your bearing. Since you possess a strength that I have been looking for please allow me to follow at your side. If I ever have the luck to meet you in reality…”

At his words, Phainon's entire body erupted with goosebumps. "!" Hey! There's too many things you can pick apart in these words! And why is it so boastful? People out of the loop might even think he was reading prose or something.

In fact, these words were something that Mydei had paid a good sum of money to have someone write for him before he met Phainon. He had spent a long time memorizing them before Phainon arrived.

Phainon sighed. "Sorry. Right now, I can't reveal my identity, so I can't meet you."

"I see... I've been rude." Mydei was a bit disappointed, then he hurriedly added, "It doesn't matter. It'll be good as long as you can think of me when you have time. If you don't dislike it, I would like to compete once more and have you instruct me on how to pilot a mecha. No, there's no need to instruct me, it's fine as long as you defeat me ruthlessly... I will, of course, pay for the expenses. The price doesn't matter."

If someone could get paid to fight, who wouldn't agree! But Mydeimos really was a super masochist, huh!

Phainon said, "... Of course we can do that."

Since he was just getting some money in exchange for beating up Mydeimos, it wasn't good for Phainon to take too much money so he went by the price of the mecha trainers online, about five hundred thousand empire coins per session. When Mydei heard the number, he felt it was a little low, and doubled it.

Phainon: "..." Sure enough, he was being too polite, wasn't he? He was actually thinking of helping the son of the richest person in the empire save some money...

After they finished eating, Mydei took Phainon directly to his residence in the virtual world. Inside, there was even a designated mecha training field. The average person wouldn't specially purchase a residence in the virtual world. Only Mydei was so leisurely.

The facilities were incredibly luxurious. It could even compare with the mecha competition's facilities... Even though it was just simulated, he had to spend a lot of money to get things to such a level.

"If we battle each other, isn't it even better to do it outside?" Phainon said. Furthermore, competing outside would have an extra entrance fee. He might even earn a profit after giving a beating.

"But you came especially for me. I don't want other people to see." Mydei's voice was low, a dissatisfied tone in it. "Only I need to see this. I'll fully enjoy my time alone with you."

Phainon: "...As long as you're happy."

Although he could pick anything he wanted for free, Phainon naturally picked the best, most gorgeous mecha, while Mydei only selected the one he used the most often, the newest model.

Mydei had already anticipated today's match for a long time. He had dreamed of that day's events so many times. In the daytime, other than when he was practicing, he was always absentminded. Several times, Khaslana even asked what was going on with him.

But Mydei was embarrassed to tell this to his friend, so he just found a random excuse to cover it up.

Today, just sitting in the cockpit, Mydei's heart was already beating in anticipation. He looked at the opposite mecha, his energy in a stage of high excitement, looking very fierce... If Phainon saw what he looked like, he would be given a shock and think that Mydei was about to kill him or something.

On the other side, Phainon quickly realized the benefit of these high-level mechas. When he was using the old mecha or regular mechas, there was a pause before he could completely connect with his spiritual energy. For these high-level mechas, he only needed the blink of an eye before he was connected.

When he was using other mechas before, he couldn't tell. Now that he was using a high-level mecha, he discovered exactly how awkward it was to pilot the lower-grade mechas from before.

Phainon suddenly realized something bad. "..." Crap, now that he had used such a high-level mecha, how was he supposed to go back to those lousy mechas?

But he was a millionaire now. Even in the real world, he would be able to buy a mecha. In the insignificant virtual net, those several hundred thousand empire coins were nothing.

After warming up with the mecha controls for a bit, Phainon nodded. The two of them began to fight.

In these few days, because Mydei had trained properly when he wasn't daydreaming, his skills were a decent amount better than they were before. And because he had watched Prince Latiao's videos an uncountable number of times, he had ways to counter most of Phainon's moves.

But he didn't want to beat Phainon. He just wanted to elevate himself to a position where he could overtake his opponent naturally. Besides, he thought that as long as he was stronger, the excitement he would feel after being defeated would also feel stronger.

Although he had lost several times before, only the utterly crushing feeling when he lost to Prince Latiao had made him so excited. When he lost to other people, he would only feel uncomfortable.

Mydei's combat ability had been strong to begin with. The reason he had lost to Phainon so quickly was because he hadn't been prepared.

But Phainon was no longer the same old Phainon who didn't even know how to maneuver a mecha. After his fight with Caelus, he had learned several cunning moves.

In a rapid exchange of a dozen blows, Phainon found an opportunity to press Mydeimos into a corner. He ruthlessly pushed down on the ground. The match should have ended in that moment. Yet simultaneously, Phainon suddenly remembered what Caelus had done.

The current Phainon was full of curiosity towards spiritual energy. Now that he knew this method, how could he not want to try it out?

"Only people with strong spiritual energy can do it. If I'm doing it, it shouldn't be a problem," Phainon thought, sending his spiritual energy probing outwards and enveloping Mydei's mecha directly.

The sensation of spiritual energy touching spiritual energy was very unique. It was just like the deepest part of two people's consciousness crashing into each other until they were one and the same.

Apparently, if he could adjust properly, sometimes the intersection of spiritual energy could actually produce a pleasure even stronger than horizontal tango.

Because the people in the virtual world had all sent their consciousness inside, their reactions regarding spiritual energy were exponentially stronger than in the real life.

In the moment Phainon's spiritual energy touched Mydei's, a sharp spike of excitement passed through to him. In moments, it infected Phainon. He felt his body heat up in moments. He wanted to do something to drain away this feeling.

If Phainon's spiritual energy and Mydei's spiritual energy were about the same level, he might momentarily have no way to control himself. Luckily, Phainon's spiritual energy was much stronger than Mydei's. He quickly suppressed the emotion.

"Haaa..." Phainon let out a breath, wiping the sweat on his forehead. Sure enough, he couldn't try these things so randomly.

And at that moment, Mydei had completely given up on fighting back. After a long time, his voice finally sounded. "...I lost."

Phainon couldn't tell if he was mistaking it, but he felt that Mydei's voice was a little strange.

After Phainon got down from the mecha, a few moments passed. Just as Phainon was thinking whether he should go up and take a look, Mydei finally climbed out. His clothes were soaked in sweat, his amber eyes shining. He was panting lowly. His cheeks and even his ears and neck were all red.

Phainon: "...!" Fuck, you're really a super masochist! Didn't you just lose a match? Is that enough to become like this!!

Mydei looked at Phainon, his face completely flushed, then walked over. Phainon was nearly shocked into retreating a step.

It was too scary. Although he knew there were an especially large number of gays in this world, someone like Mydeimos was even scarier than a normal gay, okay.

Shockingly enough, when Mydei walked in front of Phainon, he kneeled down, taking Phainon's hand devoutly. With a warrior’s respect, he said, "Although you aren't willing to let me follow at your side, if there's anything you need to deal with in the future, you must think of me first. I’ll help with most anything."

Phainon was already shocked silly. "Oh, yeah, okay. Don't be like this... Quick, get up..."

How was he supposed to look straight at Mydei in reality! Well, in any case he probably wasn't going to see Mydeimos often... This shouldn't be too much of a problem.

Today's random task was to praise the capture target once. Although Phainon felt that this was a very inopportune moment, if he didn't say it soon he'd be late. He accepted Mydei's hands. "Yeah, you're really good too. Today, being with you, I was also really happy..."

Although he was scared by Mydei's super masochism, in the future he could complete his task and even get some empire coins. How wonderful! So what about those little things.

Mydei had barely calmed down. Hearing Phainon, his felt immensely satisfied and a handsome smirk made it’s way onto his face. "I will hold you to that, ….Deliverer.”

Phainon had no idea how Mydei could stay so excited with the entire face before him mosaiced.

Phainon hoped Mydei could keep his calm when he found out exactly who Prince Latiao was.

-

Soon, it was the next day.

Phainon was a little tired after all the fighting from yesterday. In the morning, he almost couldn't get himself out of bed. He went downstairs still bleary, but when he saw Caelus he was scared into full consciousness.

Today, Caelus, who had been full of pride, was unexpectedly absentminded. He ate the breakfast that the servants brought over sluggishly, occasionally thinking of something and flushing pink.

Normally, if the servants did something a little bit wrong, Caelus would lecture them. Today, however, he was completely unlike himself. When someone made a mistake, he acted just like he hadn't seen it. Occasionally, he would look stunned, then smile a little.

What the heck was going on? Was this the same arrogant, headstrong Caelus who always looked angry no matter the time of day? Why did he look just like a young maiden in love?

Phainon's own imagination gave him a huge shock. Who was so unlucky to have Caelus fall in love with them?

When they got on the aircar, Caelus captured Phainon in conversation again. After all, with Caelus's lousy temper, he didn't have any friends. He could only chat with Phainon.

"Listen to me properly. In the past, I always thought of omegas as annoying living beings." As soon as he opened his mouth, Caelus began to discriminate. "They're fragile and delicate and start crying if you just say some stuff. They make me annoyed just looking at them. I was prepared to never get married in my lifetime."

Phainon: "..." Dang, this Caelus didn't just look down on betas, he even looked down on omegas. Still, this was normal! After all, in the original novel he was a gay who liked alphas. With him like this, he could probably only like gays...

"But yesterday, my thinking changed." Caelus said, "I met an omega, and I finally understood. He's my destined companion..."

Phainon: "...Ah, this is great news."

Still, thinking about it, who did Caelus meet yesterday? Wasn't he always in school? There were only alphas and omegas. Or could it be in the virtual net? Did he meet someone after he lost?

Just as Phainon was racking his brains, Caelus said, "If I say it, you'll probably laugh at me. You can't laugh. The person I'm talking about is that Prince Latiao."

Phainon choked. "...!?"

What the heck?!

Phainon wanted to grab Caelus by the collar and make things clear. How the fuck did he know Phainon was an omega! This was just unscientific! Or did something happen to his inhibitors?!

"But," Phainon said, organizing his thoughts with difficulty, "That Prince Latiao is an alpha, isn't he? How can an omega have such strength? Besides, it's not likely for omegas or whatever to join virtual mecha competitions, right? Haha hahaha..."

Because of the restraints of their constitutions, omegas typically wouldn't study mechas. Even if they had high-grade spiritual energy, they wouldn't consider it.

"No, he's definitely an omega," Caelus said confidently. "When I was in his spiritual energy, I sensed the scent of an omega's pheromones. I didn't expect that there were actually omegas who could make it so far. It seems that I've been too narrow-minded. It's not just alphas who are strong."

You know it yourself, too?!

Although Caelus began self-introspection from this, Phainon couldn't get happy at all.

That poor soul that Caelus had fucking fallen for was actually himself.

Why were these inhibitors so garbage?! He had been seen through in seconds, but maybe this was a problem with spiritual energy... Damn it, Phainon felt that he should be more careful about using his spiritual energy.

Now, the only thing that was worth celebrating was that he had chosen to be anonymous when he first entered the competition. Phainon was even more afraid to expose his identity. If it was exposed, Caelus and Mydeimos might rip him thoroughly into shreds.

"Thank goodness I didn't show my real appearance during the fight yesterday. I just need change to a new name and he probably won't know who I am." Caelus looked as though he was letting out a breath of relief.

Phainon: "..." In fact, the other party knows everything.

"By the way, how do you think I should pursue him." Caelus looked towards Phainon, his attitude much better than before and completely sincere. "After all, I don't have any experience with courting someone. It'll be no good if I do it badly and scare him off."

Phainon': "...About that." You think I've got experience with courting someone?!

If Caelus was interested in someone else, Phainon would say some random things, but the someone was him. He couldn't go through the motions casually. If he did one thing wrong, it would get annoying. Not responding was even worse. Who would Caelus go ask next?

Phainon just blabbered, "Most omegas should like gentle and soft alphas, especially these kinds of awesome omegas. They definitely hate forceful alphas, so you just have to show him your gentle side and be more soft. Don't do anything too fierce. If you do things like this, he'll probably think more highly of you."

Exactly, don't do anything too fierce! As long as you do this, nothing will happen!!

"Yeah, you're right." Caelus nodded pensively, then returning to his normal appearance. He looked towards Phainon loftily. "If I succeed in courting him, you'll be my best advisor. I won't treat you unfairly."

Phainon faked happiness, but inside his emotions didn't fluctuate in the slightest. Anyway, he knew that Caelus would never succeed in this life.

After he got off the aircar, the two of them unexpectedly met Mydeimos, who was alone. Caelus didn't want to greet him at all. Phainon remembered what happened yesterday and was afraid of being recognized, so he didn't want to speak.

Mydei glanced at them coldly, sweeping over Phainon like he was looking at trash, and left even more icily.

Phainon: "..." Looks like he had thought too much. With Mydei's attitude, it would be weirder if he could recognize Phainon was Prince Latiao.

Caelus sneered. "...Being so arrogant all the time as if he's so amazing, but he couldn't even defeat my companion."

When Phainon heard Caelus's term of address, he was shocked enough that he started hacking.

"By the way, did you catch a cold recently? You're coughing a lot." Caelus turned to look over.

"No, no," Phainon said quickly. "My throat just hurt a bit from the air conditioning just now."

Caelus said calmly, "If you're sick, just go straight to the doctor. You can find me for reimbursements for the cost."

The news about Prince Latiao drew even more attention from the powerful. After all, he wasn't just strong. At a glance, it was obvious that he needed money... It was obvious that he was easy to win over.

If it wasn't for the fact that Phainon was more lazy, he might really agree, but now he was ruthless.

At that moment, in the most expensive sky-suspended restaurant in the capital planet, it was rumored that His Highness the Crown Prince Nanook was sitting inside, looking at the scenery outside. From there, he could see most of the capital, and the scenery was beautiful.

As the final boss in the original novel, Nanook was extremely cunning. He had silver hair like the moon and eyes that resembled molten gold. He was incredibly beautiful. After all, compared to His Majesty the Emperor, who looked steadfast, he resembled the empress, once the most beautiful face in the empire, more.

This empress was most well-known for her beauty. Most people had even forgotten that she had married into the imperial family thanks to her illustrious family background.

Along with her beauty, the empress had a very extreme personality. She was terrifyingly possessive of her companions, and had thusly killed an innumerable number of maids who had tried to seduce the emperor. She couldn't even stand a few concubines.

Just as he had inherited the empress's beauty, Nanook had also inherited her bigotry. He was scarily possessive of the things he liked. In his youth, he wouldn't let anyone else even touch his toys.

The most dramatic part of the novel was that the person His Majesty the Emperor really loved was Khaslana's mother. She was an innocent sweetheart who was born into low status, but because of the empress's possessiveness, he didn't have the nerve to bring her back. This was why Khaslana was born in the slums...

And later, when the empress found out about what had happened, she poisoned drinks right in front of the emperor, wanting to drag him down with her. In the end the emperor was saved. If it wasn't for the fact that he needed the help of the empress's family, he would have gone directly for the empress's corpse to vent his anger.

It was exactly for this reason that the emperor didn't like Nanook, who looked just like the empress. He felt guilt towards the son of his lover, Khaslana, and did his utmost to pave the way for him to move forward. He didn't spare the slightest thought for the eldest son from his political marriage. It was why Nanook had withered so thoroughly.

But at that moment, Nanook was still His Highness the Crown Prince with boundless paths in his future, and Khaslana's past as an illegitimate child was still a secret.

"By the way, I saw someone interesting on the virtual net yesterday," Nanook said with a slight smile.

"Oh? What kind of person managed to draw Your Highness's attention?" The young man at Nanook's side was extremely handsome. If Phainon was there, he would notice that he looked around seventy percent similar to Caelus, but he looked much more mature.

He was Caelus's elder brother, the heir to the dukedom, Anaxagoras.

In the original novel, Anaxa had always stood on Nanook's side. Later, because he couldn't steel his heart and kill his younger brother, he let Caelus go. Consequently, he had indirectly caused Khaslana's victory. Finally, thanks to Caelus's reputation, he was able to survive, but the rest of his life was spent in suffering.

As Anaxa spoke, he silently said a prayer for that person. He couldn't say whether that person was fortunate or unfortunate to have drawn His Highness's attention.

"Look at this." Nanook brought his smart computer in front of Anaxa, his voice calm. "The most interesting thing is that I actually can't find out his identity. In the recording I got, his face is still blurry. How did he do it?"

For competitions like this, although they said it was anonymous, in fact those with influence could easily discover who it was. For example, plenty of people had discovered who Khaslana was.

But to have someone that even the crown prince Nanook couldn't find was a shock.

Anaxa looked at the screen. It was a contestant fighting with an old-fashioned mecha, but he still beat Mydeimos easily.

After all, Mydeimos was the crown prince's younger cousin. Anaxa had some understanding of his strength. He immediately gained some interest towards the person on the screen. "There's actually someone who can be as good as that time. He even defeated Mydeimos. I'll have people go investigate..."

When it first happened, Anaxa had also been excited by the commotion and had interest in drawing that person in, but the other party tactfully rejected him. Anaxa only felt it was a pity, and didn't think too much about it. He hadn't thought that he was actually someone who could overturn the empire.

"By the way, I heard your younger brother brought an impoverished young noble home to torture recently?" Nanook looked over with a raised eyebrow, his golden eyes cold.

Anaxagoras's heart tensed, but his expression was calm as if nothing had happened. He sighed helplessly. "Caelus was spoiled by our entire family ever since he was young, and now it turns out that he's grown unafraid of anything. I already told him many times. He should have let that person go already. Although those impoverished nobles aren't anything much, it wouldn't be very good if someone insisted on investigating."

"Yes," Nanook said calmly. "After all, things are more bothersome these day. It's best not to let anyone else get any information that could be used against you."

"Right." Anaxa relaxed. As His Highness the Crown Prince's right-hand man, he understood what Nanook's true personality was like very well.

The perfect, gentle person everyone else saw was an act. His Highness the Crown Prince's real personality was extreme and distrustful.

When he thought about how the empress was so extreme that she had tried to bring the emperor to death with her, Anaxa thought that the person His Highness the Crown Prince would like in the future was a bit miserable.

After they finished discussing the topic, Nanook looked at the mecha on his screen again, his eyes filled with interest. He said, his voice low, "It really is interesting... After so many years, it's the first time that someone has drawn my interest. Who in the world are you?"

-

At that moment, Phainon had no idea he had drawn the attention of the main villain in the original novel. He was looking at the old-fashioned practice mecha in front of his eyes with trepidation.

The scary mecha combat class wasn't until tomorrow, so Phainon came to school without any worries. He didn't expect that there would be a mecha training class today.

Although Phainon enjoyed the feeling of operating mechas in the virtual world, it was his first time touching a mecha in the real world. He was very worried about what might happen.

At his side, Caelus said calmly, "You'd better practice properly today. If you lose tomorrow, it won't be as simple as getting humiliated. You might even be putting your life on your line. Everyone has to participate in the combat class tomorrow, don't put blame on me for not reminding you."

Caelus walked towards his mecha. During the mecha training lesson, most people were practicing their movements. Some people had arranged to learn from each other.

Out of the entire training field, only Phainon was still standing in place and idling his time away.

The sound of jeers began to erupt around him.

"Isn't this that pervert beta who peeped in the men's bathrooms? I heard he got expelled ages ago. Why is he still staying here so brazenly?"

"Didn't he manage to come back to study by clinging onto Caelus? Or which school would want this student, huh?"

"Look at him. Even if he came back thanks to sucking up, he doesn't even know how to turn on the mecha. What a joke."

How were these chatting alphas so bored? If they had time to gossip, they could go and practice properly!

Though Phainon didn't care about what they said, it wasn't good of him to keep standing here either. He had to face the things he had to face, so be gritted his teeth and climbed onto the mecha.

Phainon had touched mechas who-knows-how-many times in the virtual net, but feeling them in the real world was a completely novel experience. There was even a wonderful feeling where his fingers were touching the buttons.

"It would be all good if I could connect to the mecha with my spiritual energy in the real world." Phainon sighed, thinking about his lousy body again. He could only throw this way of thinking to the back of his mind, beginning to maneuver the mecha.

Because he had practice from the virtual net, he didn't have any problems making the mecha walk. He could also do a few simple moves. Phainon let out a breath of relief. "Still, this is really far from a real fight. Tomorrow, I'll just surrender and end it quickly."

But on the other side of the training field, three people had gathered sneakily. "That's right, isn't it? That guy's the useless beta, right?"

"Exactly, I saw him." Another person nodded. "He's just a beta, but he's actually so arrogant. He even has the guts to come back to class. Let's teach him a lesson."

"Still, it'll be bad if the teachers catch us," someone said with worry.

"Don't worry. I checked, the teachers are busy right now. It'll be at least half an hour before they come back. There's enough time for us to teach that guy a lesson."

After they finished discussing, they got into their mechas and moved secretly towards Phainon.

Phainon was in the middle of practicing his movements. Suddenly, something banged next to him, and his mecha immediately unbalanced. After flailing for a long time, he managed to return to his center of gravity. He looked to his side with irritation.

But he found that there wasn't just one mecha next to him. There were three. They were surrounding him on all sides.

"Fuck." Phainon had a bad feeling. "They've come to pick a fight." After all, the original host's foul mouth had offended many people. Besides, Khaslana had so many friends. It was normal for them to come to pick a fight.

Against three mechas' attacks, Phainon's response was all over the place. His mecha operation technique was simply unpracticed, and he was forced to keep retreating. He couldn't even fight back.

When he had retreated until he couldn't keep retreating, the three of them shockingly began to attack his mecha's limbs. It was obvious they wanted to destroy the mecha to humiliate Phainon.

Phainon: "!!" Humiliation was just some bullying, but if they destroyed the training mecha he would have to pay for the damages, okay!!

Even Phainon's anger was building. He questioned the system gloomily, "Will my body collapse as soon as I use my spiritual energy? There's not any buffer time? Can I heal my body with my healing ability?"

[There is indeed a process to your body's collapse after you use your spiritual energy. Based on the current circumstances of the host's body, it can probably endure for three minutes. After three minutes, your body will quickly deteriorate, and even your healing ability won't be able to save you.]

"To face these people, three minutes is enough." Phainon's expression turned cold. He began to connect his spiritual energy to the mecha.

Khaslana was standing in a tall building at the side, observing the training field with calm amidst the chaos. When he saw Phainon being cornered, his voice was indifferent. "If you need to blame something, blame yourself for not practicing well normally. That's why people are bullying you now."

"What? Is there something interesting down there?" Mydei walked out, looking downwards with interest.

"Nothing. I was just taking a look. I'm going back first," Khaslana said as if nothing had happened. He turned back towards the classroom. Things were about done with. He had no interest in continuing to watch and see how a good-for-nothing was getting taught a lesson.

Mydei was about to go back, but suddenly something flashed in the corner of his eye.

"That's...."

Chapter End Notes

chapters.title: Chapter 6: A fight with the original protagonist
chapters.html:
In a remote area of the training field, there were several mechas in battle. It was very normal for fights in the training field, but what was unusual was the mecha in the center being attacked.

It was obviously just a normal, outdated mecha, but it fought back against the other three mechas easily, as though it saw their every move. When blocking blows, it could simultaneously attack with skill. Moreover, each of its attacks landed directly on the other mecha's vitals.

After all, the outdated mechas in the training field were mechas that had fallen out of use for many years. Their weak points were obvious. With a few blows at the weak connections between the limbs, they would fall apart. Still, it was clear that these students couldn't do it.

Mydei stared fixedly at the scene, not even daring to blink, afraid of missing even the smallest detail of the fight. His hands began to tremble in excitement. "Yes, exactly, that's... That has to be... I wouldn't make a mistake!"

The person down there was Prince Latiao!

The fight ended quickly. It didn't even last three minutes in total. The other three mechas had been attacked until they had no ability to fight back. The mechas were even falling apart. The cockpit had protective installations, so the people inside should be okay.

And the mecha Mydei thought was being piloted by Prince Latiao unexpectedly rushed to a hidden corner.

"...Crap." Mydei jolted awake from his battle-induced daze. He gritted his teeth, spinning around and moving to rush down the stairs. He didn't even hear when Khaslana called for him to come back.

Seeing Mydei hurry away, Khaslana's gaze darkened slightly.

Recently, Mydei's behavior was a bit strange. Khaslana hated being unable to control everything in the palm of his hands.

"It looks like I need to investigate a bit."

After his momentary explosion of power just now, Phainon quickly left the scene.

In fact, he had been a little panicky. In his agitation, he had actually broken the three mechas facing him. If he had to pay it back, even a million empire coins wasn't enough! Though it was those three provoking him to begin with, anyway.

...Even if the school rules said that if a mecha was damaged, the pilot would have to pay for the expenses, Phainon started worrying whether his sudden explosive strength would draw anyone's attention.

Luckily, the area was relatively hidden. According to the system, the security cameras didn't record that area, and the system also blurred Phainon's appearance when he was leaving.

Everything started quickly and ended quickly. Nobody had noticed anything. Even if the three people said what had happened, nobody would believe a beta was actually able to attain such a level.

When Phainon thought about it, he finally let out a breath of relief.

During the period of Phainon's explosive power, his body was slowly beginning to collapse. At first, when he used his healing ability to heal himself, he felt significantly better. Now, the effect had passed, and he felt weak and limp all over. He had no energy left in his limbs, and his head was spinning.

Phainon climbed out of the cockpit with difficulty, and met Mydeimos, who was walking over quickly, head-on.

Mydei glanced at Phainon coldly, then walked rapidly ahead.

"Huh? Isn't that where I just came from?" Phainon felt a little suspicious, but he really had no energy and he felt exhausted. He didn't feel like thinking about what Mydeimos was doing.

Mydei rushed to where the fight had been happening, but only saw the three fallen mechas. "As expected, he already left... I was too slow."

Disappointment settled into Mydei's heart, but he clung to a tiny sliver of hope, stepping forward to open the cockpit of the mecha on the ground, hoping to interrogate the person inside and ask if he knew who his opponent was.

But Mydei's hopes were dashed. The person inside the cockpit seemed to have been given a huge shock. He huddled in his mecha, trembling. It was obvious that being defeated in just three minute had been too much of a blow. Mydei couldn't get the slightest bit of information out from them.

"Useless guy." Mydei gave up on the interrogation, looking at the person inside the mecha coldly. "You don't have enough strength yourself, but you went to provoke someone else in vain. You were asking to sink this low..."

Mydei went off to investigate the security cameras.

But out of some kind of coincidence, there were no security cameras aimed at that area, and for some reason the image of the outside area was blurry. It was impossible to tell who it was.

He could only give up on it.

"Still, in this case, the scope of my search can be narrowed down." Mydei thought of something, his face beginning to faintly flush red.

"I didn't expect us to be so close. I can't believe I never realized there was someone so skilled at the institute. Could there be some reason that he has to stay lowkey?"

Phainon waited for class to end in the lounge, completely exhausted, then went home with Caelus. Caelus seemed to be thinking something, and didn't notice Phainon's weary appearance at all.

Well, Phainon didn't really want to hear his romance worries anyway. Instead, he was able to relax.

But before long he would regret it and ask himself why he didn't ask. In the end, it led to something terrifying.

When he returned to his room, although he was tired, Phainon still had to log on to the virtual world. After all, he didn't finish his daily task yet... Besides, it was almost the last day of the competition. If he didn't hurry to participate in some matches, he wouldn't have enough points to enter the finals.

As soon as he logged online, Phainon's inbox was stuffed full again.

Phainon skimmed them. They were all about the same as the emails from yesterday, with a dozen more from Caelus. He didn't even need to think to guess what was inside. Phainon didn't look at them at all, deleting them immediately (._.)

As for the ads, Phainon was famous now. He picked a few with higher prices, then wrote an email to Mydeimos, asking him to reply when he had landed. It would make it easy for Phainon to do his daily task.

And then Phainon strode out of the room, appearing at the virtual square. As soon as he arrived, he was stunned by the sight.

Every possible location for ad placement, whether it was big or small, had been bought. The same picture was in all of them, and the picture was a video from when Prince Latiao was fighting.

Rather than calling it a video, it was more accurate to call it a montage. It spliced pretty much every cool movement from Prince Latiao's fights. It looked extremely exciting. Even Phainon was feeling affected. He didn't think that he was actually so heroic.

The montage finished quickly, then a youth with black hair appeared on the screen, holding a bouquet of roses in one hand. It was Caelus.

The memory of what Caelus had said in the morning suddenly surfaced in Phainon's mind. A bolt of lightning jolted through his mind. Fuck, Caelus wasn't getting up to some crap again, was he?

To be honest, although Caelus's personality and brains were a little off, he was extremely handsome. When he appeared, the people in the virtual square began to shriek. Several of them began to ask other people if he was some new celebrity.

Phainon felt very complicated, but people were always face-cons. He was too. He didn't have any right to judge someone else.

The Caelus on the screen wasn't as vexing as he usually was. Instead, he looked out of the screen with a serious expression, beginning to introduce himself. He started from his family background, then to his height and his body measurements, the food he liked to eat, the color he liked... He also recited his grades from elementary school.

It was just like a dating app bio. No, a normal person's bio wouldn't have so much unnecessary information!

Still, as long as he had that face and the status of a duke's son, as long as he said he was looking for romance, the people interested would probably break down the duke's doors.

Phainon had a bad feeling. It was as though something bad was about to happen.

As expected, in the next moment, Caelus began to speak adoringly. "Prince Latiao, when I saw you, I knew that you were my destined partner. I really wish to understand you well... In fact, I'm not someone with a forceful personality. I just wanted your attention, which is why I did those things..."

Phainon: "..." Hey! Do you think you're not forceful as long as you say you're not forceful?! Like this you might as well never have a wife in your fucking life, okay!

Everyone watching the advertisements was shocked. Although they didn't know Prince Latiao's gender, if he was so amazing, he had to be an alpha. The son of the duke had actually come out of the closet in front of a whole crowd! This was breaking news!!

But the omegas that had been full of excitement immediately turned cold. In any case, a gay alpha who was interested in alphas didn't have anything to do with them.

Phainon could pretty much imagine how the breaking news would spread through the entire empire by tomorrow. He didn't even want to become famous like this, okay.

Now, the only thing worth celebrating was that now this brainless guy Caelus didn't announce Phainon's gender. Otherwise, even if Phainon had to put his life on the line, he would have charged over to have them die together.

Even if Phainon was completely unwilling, because of Caelus, talks about the name Prince Latiao went crazy again. His popularity was competing with the top fifty competitors... Although this popularity was super weird too.

To vent some of his anger, Phainon went straight to compete in the virtual mecha competition.

This time, Phainon used the mecha full of advertisements just like last time, and started to begin the selections.

The opponent that the system randomly selected for System this time was a competitor in the top fifty. Those in the top fifty were all incredible people. To keep them with the competition, the competition organizers would even give them one percent of the ticket prices.

In other words, every time someone in the top fifty competed, there were heaps of empire coins to collect. Phainon envied it a lot. He also wanted to be in the top fifty and make money.

The current Prince Latiao wasn't the same as the confused, nameless newbie he was a few days ago. There were many of his fans in the stands, calling his name continuously.

Phainon's heart burst in pride, but when he looked towards the stands, he immediately noticed that all of the screens in the stands were playing Caelus's image.

Is having money so great, huh?! Just how much money did Caelus spend?! Did he think the other person had accepted him after a bombardment of brainwashing?!

Phainon's heart filled with grief and indignation. He attacked the other person with an almost furious blow. Before they could react, Phainon's momentum bowled them over. Luckily, they had experience, and wouldn't lose immediately like other people. After they dodged the blow, they began to fight back, but in the end they still couldn't resist Phainon.

---

At the other side.

In a dormitory that was almost like a small mansion in the Empire Military Institute, Mydei took a deep breath, then sank into his nutrient cabinet impatiently.

In order to attain the best conditions, Mydei had bought the most expensive nutrient cabin in the beginning. He wouldn't even think about using a helmet.

In the past, Mydei had logged into the virtual net only for mecha competitions, but now he had a new goal. He wanted to see the person he thought almost…. longingly about, Prince Latiao.

As soon as he logged on, he received Prince Latiao's email. Mydei's heart skipped a beat. It was just a few dozen words, just asking him to respond when he went online, but Mydei felt like every word was precious. This was the email that his male god had taken the initiative to send! He couldn't stop himself from reading it a few more times

before he calmed down to write a reply. His hands were shaking. He thought over every word for a long time before he finally hit send.

Mydei couldn't calm himself from his excitement. When he looked up, he spotted Caelus's ridiculously expensive ads. When he saw Prince Latiao's familiar bearing, he paused, unable to move.

After seeing half of the advertisement, Mydei's joy immediately turned to fury.

This Caelus was nothing. Other than his background and his face, he didn't have the slightest redeeming quality. He even had some beta clinging onto him for influence. He must be confessing just to play around... Damn it, he used such an attitude to Mydei's male god? He couldn't be forgiven!

What would he do if his male god was seduced by Caelus? Mydei couldn't help beginning to worry. "No, it won't happen. He wouldn't be so easily seduced."

And where did Mydei get the right to interfere with his decision?

Mydei couldn't stop himself from beginning to ponder. If someday Prince Latiao really wanted to be with someone else, then what would he do... Just thinking about it made Mydei's chest ache like it was about to split apart. He felt strangely uncomfortable.

He was too greedy, wasn't he? Before, he could easily watch from afar, but now he wanted to take another step forward even if they were close together.

Mydei began to feel perturbed. He could only cheer himself up when he saw Prince Latiao.

Phainon also noticed that Mydeimos seemed a little off today. After he finished his daily task, he blurted, "You seem a little gloomy today? What's wrong?"

"It's nothing, I'm fine. You don't need to worry about someone like me," Mydei said gruffly, feeling a bit shy from the sudden attention. "But... if you don't find it offensive, I have something I'd like to ask you. If you would rather not hear it, don't need to say it."

Phainon was curious about what Mydeimos wanted to ask him. "Go ahead."

"You must have seen the advertisements today, right?" Mydei said carefully.

Phainon nearly vomited a mouthful of old blood. He began to choke. "Yeah, I saw them."

Phainon began to feel embarrassed now that someone had actually brought it up.

"What do you think about it, then..." After he finished speaking, Mydei hurried to explain, "I don't mean to interrogate you, I just think... well, someone like that doesn't seem very reliable..."

He was absolutely right! Phainon practically wanted to shake Mydeimos's hand.

"I don't have any particular thoughts about that video," Phainon said calmly, trying to revive his awesomeness. "To me, the most important thing is the competition. I won't think about anything else. Besides, those kinds of people are just talk. They'll probably forget it quickly."

"That's true..." Mydei let out a breath of relief. He said, "After all, you're an alpha. You naturally don't have any interest to other alphas like you, right?"

When he finished speaking, Mydei, who realized he was also an alpha, felt his chest begin to ache.

"I don't have any interest in alphas," Phainon said absently. "I like omegas... But right now I won't think about those kinds of things anyways."

Something like two omegas being together was simply impossible, but Phainon had only come to do a daily task. He didn't think anything about romance.

"By the way, it's not that convenient to send emails every time we want to meet. How about we exchange contacts?" Phainon said without thinking.

Mydei was stunned. His depression instantly dissipated. Excited, he said, "Of course we can. That would be my honor."

Mecha combat classes were that night.

It was a ten minute class that they only had once a month. All the first and second years would participate. Nobody could ask for leave.

Generally, they would draw two random students to fight. Because they were using armed mechas, they were much more dangerous than the outdated mechas. Thus, this time of year was also the time that students had the most injuries.

Phainon was incredibly anxious. He looked up at the people on the podium, completely unable to calm himself down.

Although he could use his spiritual energy for three minutes, if he suddenly became skilled, it wouldn't be easy for him to end things. If someone overestimated his skills in the future and assigned him to some more difficult classes or duties, Phainon would have no way to complete them.

Actually, it didn't matter if his opponent was someone else, but Phainon was most worried that he would be unlucky enough to draw Khaslana as his opponent. What would he do then?

Compared to this, even all of the news he saw this morning about Caelus coming out was nothing.

Like Phainon, Caelus was extremely anxious, but he wasn't worried about the mecha combat class. Instead, he was worried about what he had done yesterday. "Was I too much yesterday? I didn't want to go so far, but if I didn't do that, then how would I express my sincerity? Should I apologize?"

Phainon didn't have the guts to believe that the apology Caelus was talking about would be a normal apology. He said hurriedly, "He definitely understood you already. He probably didn't reply yet because he was too shocked."

...Although he really didn't want to answer Caelus, with things like this he didn't have a choice.

"I hope you're right," Caelus sighed.

Phainon wondered why the duke and duchess didn't care a bit more about their son. Don't ignore your younger son just because you have an outstanding eldest son as the heir! Was coming out so openly really not a problem... Would the dukedom really stay unaffected!

After he finished spitting curses in his head, Phainon forgot about his nerves. Anyway, he'd just do his worst. It was fine.

At the same time, in the luxurious private box at the other side, Mydei was staring fixedly at the image on the broadcasting screen that filled up the entire wall. It was displaying the fifth or sixth match that was currently ongoing.

After Mydei investigated, he found that there were only first and second year students in the training field yesterday. They were certain to appear in the combat class, and Prince Latiao was certain to be in their midst.

Prince Latiao had such strength. If he wanted to appear to the public, he could, but instead he was quiet and unknown. He must have been hiding his true strength all this time.

So in the combat class, he would definitely behave very discreetly. He might even lose on purpose. Mydei was prepared to survey the details. He watched Prince Latiao's videos countless times, and he had already engraved the subtleties of his movements in his mind.

Mydei was both excited and nervous.

Khaslana sat at the side, looking at the screen expressionlessly. He had already cleared up the investigation. Mydei's abnormal behavior was actually because of that Prince Latiao.

"He's just someone who failed at imitating me, and he can only pick such a sensationalist name to capture people's attention," Khaslana thought. "Even if there's someone even stronger, so what? I'll let him be proud for a few days."

Khaslana's favorite thing to do was letting his enemies crawl upwards, then, right when they were at the height of their pride, knocking them off of their throne and enjoying their grief.

By that time, Mydei would understand that the real person deserving of his loyalty was Khaslana, not that lowly copycat.

"Ah, it's my turn." Khaslana stood up, smiling slightly at Mydei. "I'll be back soon."

Match after match passed. Soon, it was Phainon's turn.

Phainon gritted his teeth, getting up from his seat, his steps heavy.

He had already decided. He would use his normal ability to fight. The competition rules dictated that he couldn't surrender until five minutes had passed. It would be fine as long as he managed to endure five minutes and then surrender. In any case, he wouldn't get expelled if he surrendered... Normal people should stop fighting after the other party surrender.

But Phainon saw his opponent-Khaslana.

Phainon was so shocked he nearly buckled and fell to his knees. "...???" Wait? What kind of luck was this? Out of all the people in the school, he really ended up matching with Khaslana? Holy fuck.

Khaslana gave Phainon a friendly smile. "What a coincidence. I didn't expect that my opponent would actually be you."

Phainon: "Ah, hello..." No, this had to be one of Khaslana's plots. How else could it be so coincidental?

"I still remember the circumstances when we first met," Khaslana chuckled. "In the blink of an eye, so much time has passed. I really miss it."

If someone out of the loop heard Khaslana, they would think he and Phainon were friends or something.

But Phainon knew that the first time they met was when Khaslana had just started school, but he had been utterly humiliated by the original soul of the body Phainon was currently inhabiting... Khaslana's words were totally a threat!

Phainon gritted his teeth. "Um, Khaslana, don't you think classmates should exchange our views... There's no need to be too serious? It should be okay as long as we don't overdo it."

"Oh?" Khaslana raised an eyebrow. "I'm very sorry. I'm very serious about everything relating to mechas. Still, I'm confident in your strength. It'll be fine as long as we both do our best. I think it's certain that no accidents will happen. Right?"

Right your foot! This is already a complete threat!

Phainon already knew that it would be no use if he surrendered. For someone like Khaslana, even if his opponent surrendered, he would definitely pretend he didn't hear it and continue beating his opponent even more fiercely.

Feeling a huge amount of pressure, Phainon climbed into the cockpit of the mecha.

It was his first time using a standard mecha in the real life. If he wasn't facing Khaslana, everything would be wonderful.

Soon, the competition began. Khaslana was calm despite the situation, maneuvering the mecha to attack with ease.

Like a cat playing with a mouse, Khaslana didn't prepare to take Phainon out in one blow. Instead, he wanted to thoroughly play around with him, waiting until he didn't have anymore patience before he acted.

Phainon continuously evaded Khaslana's attacks, only feeling that every second was taking longer than the last. He didn't know when Khaslana began to move, and he didn't know what he would do in the next second. Sweat trickled down his face.

If he could use his spiritual energy, he could observe his opponent's movements, and he wouldn't be in such a miserable situation. Dammit.

At the side, Mydei sat in the private box, examining for a long time. He hadn't found anyone who moved like Prince Latiao. He looked towards his friend's match, feeling disappointed.

He knew very clearly that there was probably nobody in their grade that could compete with Khaslana. The opponent today looked especially weak. Even with Khaslana deliberately going easy on him, he was barely able to evade.

"How could someone like this be him." Mydei sighed. He didn't know whether he would be able to find Prince Latiao today.

--

Fierce attacks flew towards Phainon. He swayed in place, discovering that one of the mecha's legs was no longer stable.

When Khaslana had attacked just now, the mecha's left leg had been disconnected.

"Crap." Phainon bit his lip, understanding immediately. Khaslana was preparing to use the method he had used on the three guys from yesterday to deal with him.

And with Khaslana's personality, he might pretend that he had accidentally hit the cockpit. If he got Phainon injured, Phainon wouldn't let him off.

"If things keep going like this, I'll be a sitting duck." Phainon's gaze turned cold. "Even if my opponent is the original protagonist, there's nothing I can do. If I don't fight back..."

Since the beginning, Phainon never wanted to fight the protagonist head-on. After all, the other party was the blessed son of the world consciousness. If he fought back, it would always be him on the short end of the stick.

But he understood now. There were some things he couldn't avoid no matter how much he wanted to. If he didn't face them, the other person would just get more intense.

Phainon closed his eyes, connecting his spiritual energy with the mecha.

On the other side of the field, Khaslana was leisurely operating the mecha. With his SSS-grade spiritual energy, his mecha was just like part of his body. Sometimes, it could even react faster than his own body. Nobody was his opponent, no matter who it was.

Khaslana thought of himself as a natural mecha operating genius. It was the gift the heavens had bestowed on him. Nobody could defeat him. Even if he was born in the slums, he had incredible luck. He had anything he wanted, and he had barely met any setbacks.

Because of this, Khaslana had grown into a warped personality. For example, he could easily kill off this beta, someone who didn't understand his own limits. But what he enjoyed the most was a weakling's last struggle before death.

The weakling was obviously destined to defeat, but because he had the slightest hope of succeeding, he continued to endure. Finally, in his despair, he discovered that there was only one road forward to defeat.

Every time he saw the painful despair in his opponent's eyes, Khaslana would feel joy. When he attacked, he specially left his opponent an opportunity to escape. Sometimes, he would let them escape. Sometimes, he would shoot them in their vitals.

When he thought about what expression this beta had on at that moment, Khaslana couldn't hold back his glee.

In the next moment, Khaslana suddenly froze.

His opponent suddenly evaded the blow that should have landed.

No. According to his plans, he would certainly land his blow. With the strength of a beta, how could he avoid it? And the left leg of his opponent's mecha was malfunctioning.

Again, Khaslana felt the anxiety of the situation slipping out of his hands. His eyes turned cold. "I'm done playing... Now, you should get ready to lose."

Chapter End Notes
