chapters.title: Chapter 7: Fallen Sockpuppet
chapters.html:
Phainon could feel very clearly that Khaslana's attacks were no longer as sluggish as before, but swift and fierce. Each blow was aimed at his vitals.

If he was still operating manually, Phainon would definitely have lost already. But with his spiritual energy connected to his mecha, his sense of his surroundings was incomparably clear, and he could see everything on the field. No matter how cunning Khaslana's attacks were, he could dodge them all.

Of course, in order to avoid exposing his true strength, when Phainon dodged, he purposely faked panic, making it look like he was able to dodge thanks to luck. He was successful at looking like a useless potato.

"But this is no good..." Phainon racked his brains. "There's not much time less. I have to finish things in three minutes, but I can't just win against Khaslana... If that happens, it'll draw people's attention."

And Mydei, watching the scene from the private room, was nearly standing up.

To an outsider watching the two people fighting, it looked like Phainon was dodging blindly, as though he didn't have the slightest ability to resist, and even like he was in a sorry state. But Mydei could sense the peculiarity clearly.

Based on his understanding of Khaslana, Khaslana was already using all of his strength. This was no longer a level that normal people could compare with. After all, Khaslana was someone at the top in the virtual world.

But if that Phainon was really useless, then he wouldn't get lucky enough to dodge so many times. Moreover, Mydei saw each and every one of the details in the movements Phainon made when he was dodging.

He was very familiar with the particulars of those movements. They were just like the movements he saw countless of times in videos. They were the same as Prince Latiao's movements in the arena. They were the movements that Mydei had been searching for in the arena all morning.

Mydei couldn't believe his eyes. "How? It couldn't be..." A completely implausible theory began to take shape in his mind. "...No. No, it's too early to come to a conclusion." Mydei stood up. "I have to go see it personally."

Mydei rushed out the door without hesitation, running to the region Khaslana and Phainon were fighting in.

He was fairly close to the arena, and he was in a position high above. It was easy to see everything in the arena.

Mydei looked straight at the mecha that seemed like it was being piloted with an unpracticed hand, his molten amber eyes filled with struggle.

"Come on, let me see... Are you truly that person?"

On the other hand, Khaslana was getting more and more annoyed. Now, the opponent that he should have been able to handle with ease was actually able to avoid his blows again and again and wearing his little bit of patience down to nothing.

Khaslana liked toying with the weak, but if these weaklings began acting out of his control, he would fall into hysteria.

"It looks like I've only got one choice." Khaslana's gaze turned cold. He aimed at Phainon's weak point and thrust forward.

As long as he hit that spot, Phainon's mecha would immediately get out of control. Even the mecha's safety mechanisms would be affected. Even if he suffered injuries, it wouldn't be unusual. Every year, students would get hurt because of that spot.

But Phainon maneuvered his mecha into a twist just enough to dodge that blow.

"It's just as I thought... What should I do then?" Things played out just as Khaslana had anticipated. His attack from just now had been to test the waters. When Phainon dodged, Khaslana controlled the other arm of his mecha to pull out its weapon, aiming a blow at the place Phainon had dodged towards.

"Can you still dodge this?"

Khaslana had never shown this trump card. In fact, he could fight with weapons in both hands, and he could bring out the highest level of power from each of them.

In the original novel, Khaslana didn't reveal himself until later. At first, he hadn't wanted to reveal his hand in the combat lessons, but faced with a situation no longer in his control, he finally made up his mind.

But what Khaslana didn't know was that his opponent knew his each and every move even more clearly then he himself did.

Khaslana's mecha was completely blocking off Phainon's escape route with one weapon in each hand. There was nowhere Phainon could run. If he dodged, he would be skewered by one of the weapons.

Khaslana was sure that as long as Phainon's mecha was skewered, then he could seize the chance to batter his opponent's mecha into scrap metal.

Phainon's mecha stayed stiffly in place, as though he was at a loss because he had nowhere to run.

The crowd cried out in shock. "He's incredible, he can actually fight at such a level!"

"I know Khaslana's pretty good with mechas, but I didn't expect that he was actually so skilled."

Khaslana didn't hear any of their amazed gasps. He was thinking only of Phainon's mecha broken into pieces. He couldn't control his glee, maneuvering his mecha to attack. "It's time. Where will you run now? There's already nowhere to run, hmm?"

Then, as if Phainon was too nervous and couldn't control his mecha, his mecha slid backwards drunkenly, just in time to avoid Khaslana's blow.

"How..." Khaslana was stunned.

But it wasn't done yet. Before Khaslana's disbelieving eyes, Phainon's mecha just happened to crash towards him, even sending his weapons crashing straight towards Khaslana's cockpit, causing it to sway. The connection between Khaslana's spiritual energy and the mecha snapped.

The cockpit was the most critical region of the mecha. As long as his opponent touched his mecha, the victory was practically set in stone.

The combat lessons didn't require their students to really go into close combat, so when Phainon's mecha crashed into Khaslana's cockpit, an earsplitting bell rang into the air. It meant the victor had been decided.

All the surrounding students were stunned. "Fuck, you can even win like this?"

"Isn't this guy's luck crazy? I expected him to get taught a lesson. I didn't expect..."

"Poor Khaslana. He was sure to win, but he lost because of something like this."

The fragments of the conversations around Khaslana drifted into his ears.

He... had lost?

He, who had never lost since he started school, had lost to a beta?!

When Khaslana realized what had happened, his alluringly handsome face sank. He looked towards the opposing mecha with a death stare.

"At first, I was thinking of having you back out and leave the school after getting some heavy injuries. Now it looks like I was being too kind," Khaslana said lowly, his spiritual energy sinking into the air in the blink of an eye.

He knew his spiritual energy was stronger than most people's. As long as he wanted to, he could even use his spiritual energy to make anyone under A-grade go crazy.

When he was in a low-level school, he would have anyone who got on his bad side take spiritual damage in the battlefield. They couldn't even stay in school. They would be forced to stay in the sanatorium for life, not knowing what had happened to their own spiritual energy.

Khaslana was planning to use the same tactic to counter Phainon. After all, spiritual problems were difficult to detect. Even the best military institute in the empire had no way to find out what was wrong.

But in the next moment, Khaslana felt an indescribable dread from his spiritual energy. Other than his luck, the reason Khaslana could climb so high was because of his occasional, strong intuition that allowed him to evade danger at a critical moment several times.

It was his first time sensing this fear. Khaslana unconsciously stopped diffusing spiritual energy.

Just as Khaslana stopped, Phainon maneuvered his mecha into a standing position, retreating from the training field rapidly, unwilling to stay near Khaslana for even a second longer.

Khaslana looked over coldly, hammering his mecha with both fists. "Phainon... I'll remember you."

It was his second time moving against Phainon, but he hadn't succeeded. He wouldn't let himself face defeat a third time.

Everyone watching the fight to the death was thoroughly shocked. In their ten-odd years of life, it was their first time seeing someone win from sheer dumb luck. None of them realized anything strange.

But Mydei stood at the side, his hands balled tightly into fists, staring fixedly at the replays on the screen. His eyes were filled with disbelief.

When he hurried over, he had examined Phainon's every move closely. The more he looked, the more he felt that Phainon's movements were exactly like Prince Latiao's.

"Still, he could be imitating Prince Latiao..." Mydei thought, "If he's really imitating, it's not impossible to copy the details."

But when Phainon dodged Khaslana's attack and crashed into him, a sliver of spiritual energy unconsciously dissipated into the air.

Because Phainon was focused on Khaslana, he couldn't keep hold on his spiritual energy. He reasoned that there was nobody above who had their spiritual energy saturating the air, but he didn't expect that his energy would run into Mydei upstairs.

When he felt the strong, familiar spiritual energy, Mydei's handsome but always cold face flushed red. He clutched onto the wall to keep his cool, almost causing It to crack from the force.

"That's right... Everything can be faked except for this spiritual energy... This strong spiritual energy..." Mydei mumbled. "It must be him. Ah... I managed to find out now..."

Mydei thought of when he had rushed to the mecha training field and ran into Phainon. Back then, he thought he was just a useless beta hiding there to slack off, and hadn't bothered to spare him a single glance.

But things seemed different now. Phainon must have rushed to leave as soon as the action ended, and ran into him. Mydei clenched his fists. He should have noticed something was off back then, but because of his innate prejudice he hadn't even though about it.

No wonder he hadn't been able to find Prince Latiao in the school by looking for an alpha. It was because the person he looked up to the most was actually a beta.

Mydei's opinion didn't change because Prince Latiao wasn’t an alpha. Instead, his admiration deepened.

His idol was really worth his title. He could even attain such a level as a beta.

Phainon's victory absolutely wasn't just luck. Mydei thought back to the scene from just now. It was clear that it was a result that had been carefully planned and crafted for the outsider. He had the skill to defeat Khaslana as he wished, but he went for a roundabout way to achieve his goal.

Now that he thought about it, Phainon's uselessness in the past was an act he had put up. In fact, to cover up his true power, Phainon had always kept himself hidden. Even if others insulted him, he didn't care.

That's right. Mydei thought of what Prince Latiao had said to him in the virtual net. Phainon doesn't care about this at all. He thinks wholeheartedly of mechas and becoming stronger.

Mydei sat back at his seat, disappointed. The things that had happened to Phainon flashed through his mind one by one. Now, the things that he had practically forgotten were as clear as day.

Before, every time they met, he would always pretend not to see him. He had even thought that looking at Phainon was an offense to his eyes... But the other person hadn't said anything when they met in the virtual net. He had even been so friendly.

But even if Phainon didn't care, Mydei couldn't forgive himself for looking down on him in the past. He wished he could turn back time and give himself a slap across the face.

Back when people accused Phainon of being a pervert peeping on the men's bathrooms, Mydei had known very clearly that he was an innocent, but he had thought that such a person was getting his just desserts, so he didn't come out to say anything. It had even forced Phainon to leave the school.

After that, Phainon only came back with the help of Caelus's power. Otherwise... wait.

Mydei was suddenly shocked. He thought back to when Caelus had confessed to Prince Latiao in broad daylight on the virtual net yesterday.

He had thought it was weird. Caelus and Prince Latiao didn't have many chances to meet, so why would Caelus start wooing him so quickly? It was as though they already knew each other for a long time.

Now he understood. So they had already gotten acquainted with each other then... In the end, it was all his, the cold bystander's, fault.

When he thought about how he had caused Phainon to get to know Caelus, Mydei felt incredibly bitter. He didn't come back to his senses for a long time.

The second Phainon entered the mecha prep station, he disconnected his spiritual energy from the mecha, wiping off the sweat on his forehead. His entire body was soaked with sweat.

After all, he wasn't just using his spiritual energy to control the mecha. He also had to face Khaslana, who had a protagonist halo, and pretend to be weak, then gain victory by chance...

Still, Phainon hadn't expected to win so easily. It seemed that Khaslana took him too lightly and was too relaxed.

Another factor was that it was only a combat lesson, and it couldn't influence the real story. Otherwise, even if the world consciousness had to give Phainon a heart attack and give him a lunch box, it wouldn't let Khaslana lose. It wasn't so easy to face the original protagonist.

"Even Khaslana won't realize anything is wrong. He'll just think I won by chance." Phainon was ready to admire his own resourcefulness.

Phainon didn't know what would happen when he met Khaslana in the future either... Anyway, things had already gotten to this state.

After being sprawled out in the cockpit for a while, Phainon finally clambered up, feeling absolutely exhausted. He felt like he was walking on air, completely unlike he was on real ground, but like he was walking on clouds.

"As I thought, I should work on doing some more exercise." Phainon began panting after a few steps, supporting himself on the wall. He couldn't help beginning to complain, "This omega body's just too garbage. I'm so tired after just a bit of spiritual energy. I won't be able to find a job once I graduate, will I?"

As soon as he walked out of the mecha prep station, everyone's attention focused on Phainon. Their gazes were filled with awe. After all, it was rare to see someone as lucky as Phainon. It made them want to come and touch Phainon and let some of his luck rub off on them, but they weren't close enough for that.

If someone put this online, Phainon would most certainly become one of those "repost for luck" posts that had been reposted several hundred thousand times.

Then the main entrance opened. Mydei stood in the doorway. He looked as though he was in a rush. His blonde hair was a mess, but it made him look more approachable and not as though he was a thousand miles away.

After seeing Mydei, everyone's expressions changed.

Someone had spread the word about how Mydeimos had requested surveillance footage yesterday. Most people in the school were aware that someone who could get the footage couldn't have an ordinary background. A few people discovered Mydei's true background through their own means.

Thus, overnight, Mydeimos's true identity had had spread through the entire school, and he didn't have any intention to cover it up either.

Only someone who didn't pay attention to the school sites like Phainon wouldn't know.

Now, everyone wanted to get close to Mydeimos. They hated themselves for not noticing someone so amazing in their school and envied Khaslana's luck.

But Mydeimos was so hard to approach that nobody was daring enough to talk to him. In the past, there were people who wanted to get close to him because of his looks, but he didn't even spare them a glance.

When Mydei saw Phainon, his expression changed. He walked over quickly.

Phainon unconsciously stopped in his footsteps, looking at him alertly. "...!" What did Mydeimos want to do?! Did he come get revenge because he was upset with the method Phainon used to win over Khaslana?!

When the crowd thought about Mydeimos and Khaslana's relationship, they thought of the same thing as Phainon and thought Mydei came to settle the score with him... Fuck, this must be the best chance for them to get on Mydeimos's good side.

Because Phainon usually stuck to Caelus, nobody had the guts to say anything. Now that Caelus was gone, each of them began to rack their brains to jeer at Phainon and curry favor with Mydeimos.

"Is this the guy who just beat Khaslana? Why does he look like a weak chicken? He doesn't look like he can beat Khaslana at all. I think there's something fishy about him."

"Heh, look, that guy just won by luck. How else would a pervert who got expelled then came back with no shame win against Khaslana? Everyone knows how amazing Khaslana is."

To curry favor with Mydeimos, these people began praising Khaslana shamelessly.

"Poor Khaslana, I bet this will even affect his grades for the year... This kind of trash shouldn't have been at our school in the first place. If he can't stand it, that's whatever, but he even affected someone else. He's absolutely shameless."

"Exactly. Someone as amazing as Khaslana actually lost to a beta. If this gets around, even his reputation will get affected."

"And he's so tired after just getting on a mecha. If he really goes and participates in some mecha competition, won't he just be vomiting blood? If you're as weak as an omega, don't come to study at our military institute. If I was him, I would have left school ages ago."

…….

…

Phainon didn't know how to react. "..." Hey, do you guys have to act like this just to suck up! These jeers are so awkward, okay, and that last one accidentally came a bit too close to home...

But Mydei's expression turned uglier and uglier. Everyone thought they had gotten the main point and got even more excited, beginning to let out curse after curse.

Although their personalities looked bad, as long as they could get the favor of the crown prince's younger cousin, the heir of the richest tycoon in the empire, so what if they had bad personalities? Wouldn't their futures be limitless?! Everyone had the same thing in mind.

Phainon was pretty sure that Mydeimos wouldn't hit him in front of so many people, so he kept walking forward, pretending it had nothing to do with him.

He didn't expect that because he had been standing for so long, Phainon's legs suddenly went numb. He lost control and fell forward.

When he saw that Phainon was about to fall, Mydei flew over, grabbing ahold of Phainon. He asked anxiously, "Are you alright? Do you feel any discomfort?"

Phainon was given a huge shock. "??!" So polite?!

The surrounding crowd: "...???!!" The fuck?!

The people who were talking cheerfully shut up immediately.

Hey, why were things going different from what was agreed on! Where was the "picking a fight for my good friend" that they were promised? Why were things suddenly going like this? How were they supposed to bear it!

"I-I'm fine..." Phainon couldn't figure out if Mydeimos had recognized him. He could only ask, "Do you need me for something?"

"I truly apologize. I came too late, I couldn't bring you away before those people started talking." Mydei's eyes were filled with guilt. He got on one knee in front of Phainon, putting himself in a most humble position.

Mydei's behavior shocked Phainon. He began to panic. "T-t-th... Wait, don't be like this..."

How did Mydeimos have the mental strength to kneel down in front of so many people!

The crowd was also so shocked they nearly peed their pants. Was this still the always-cold Mydei who looked like everyone owed him money?! And the person he was facing was just a beta with no strength, was someone impersonating him?! Or did they have a collective hallucination? Or did Phainon actually have a deeply hidden history?!

Because it was too shocking, everybody was beginning to doubt their eyes.

But Mydei didn't care about them at all. His sunset-like eyes drilled into Phainon, his voice steely.

"I apologize for the things I did in the past. I hope you would be wiling to forgive me... I understand that my actions cannot be brushed over in a few sentences. I can accept any punishment you give me, but I ask that you do not push me away."

Phainon: "...!" Fuck, such grand lines, Mydeimos must know his identity, right? Although he had no idea where he got this information... In any case, the most important thing right now was to keep it from anyone else.

The crowd: "???" What kind of development was this! Did something happen that they didn't know about? They obviously came to school every day, but it seemed like they had missed out on some shocking news.

The people who had been mocking Phainon earlier wished they could rip their own mouths off. They wanted to run away, but they were afraid of being to obvious and being noticed by Mydeimos. They could only stay in the crowd, suffering.

What exactly was up with this Phainon guy? He was just a beta, and he was even expelled from the school. A normal person couldn't make a comeback, but he actually befriended two amazing people in one go. How the heck did he do it?!

Their stares were about to poke through Phainon. He hurriedly grabbed Mydei's hand. "Okay, I forgive you. You should stand up quickly... There's some stuff that isn't good to say here, let's find somewhere more private."

When Phainon grabbed Mydei's hand, his eyes glimmered. He immediately stood up, nodding. "Alright, I'll leave all the decisions to you."

Then he turned his head, giving the crowd a cold stare. He said coldly, "I won't pretend I didn't hear what you said earlier. By the end of the day, you'd better make a public apology on the school's website, or you can prepare to face the Kremnoan family's fury."

Mydei's words showed he had no intention of keeping his background a secret any longer. The crowd was stunned. Bringing out the Kremnoan name so directly meant that Mydei had decided to stand against those people.

The people who had cursed at Phainon before had no choice but to start thinking about how they would apologize to Phainon online no matter how bitter they felt. Although it was humiliating, compared to the consequences of facing the Kremnoan family's suppression, humiliation was just humiliation.

They hadn't forgotten when a celebrity from a noble family mocked the head of the Kremnoan family. In the end, they were blocked and suppressed, and their entire family was pressured into bankruptcy. The emperor even took away their title of nobility.

Immediately, Mydei pulled Phainon's hand, rushing to a lounge nearby. When he noticed how hard Phainon was panting, he questioned in concern, "What's wrong? You seem to be in poor condition."

"It's nothing, I'm fine." Phainon waved a hand, looking at him seriously. "You figured out my identity?"

Mydei blurted, "I truly apologize, I didn't do it intentionally. I just happened to notice."

"As I thought, you found out..." Phainon could feel the terrifying power of a fanboy acutely. He even found out something kept so secret. "I'm begging you, please never say anything about this, especially to Khaslana. Please?"

Mydei was shocked. He nearly got back on his knees. He gritted his teeth. "Of course I will do as you say, but there's no need to use 'please' with me..."

Although Khaslana was his friend, he was nothing compared to Phainon. If Mydei had to choose between the two, he would abandon Khaslana without hesitation.

In the original novel, Mydei could betray his own cousin for Khaslana. He could betray anyone for Phainon.

"Alright." Phainon let out a breath of relief. He continued, "You saw it too. Although I'm really strong online, I'm just a normal student in real life. If you can't accept it, just pretend like nothing happened at all."

"You're truly too kind. You're still so kind to someone like me." Mydei was ready to cry. His voice hoarse, he said, "Even if you are different in reality, I already decided that I would follow after you for a lifetime. I absolutely won't change because of such a reason."

Fuck, Mydeimos's basically already been possessed by the devil.

Phainon: "...As long as you're happy." If Mydeimos wanted to stick to him for no reward, he couldn't do anything about it.

"Then, when we're in school in the future, you don't have to talk to me like this. You can just say my name normally." Phainon felt this was a very serious matter. "Okay?"

"Of course, it's no problem," Mydei said. "Then in the future, I'll address you... address you as Ph-Phainon..." His face was turning more impassive by the second but there was an almost happy glow emanating from him and Phainon swears he could see a lion’s tail swishing behind him.

Phainon felt embarrassed by Mydeimos's reaction. "..." Isn't it just a name? There's absolutely no need to be so excited!!

"Oh, right, it's getting late. I'll leave first," Phainon said. If Caelus couldn't find him and ran over it would be annoying.

Mydei suddenly remembered, and probed, "Right, your relationship with Caelus..."

But before Phainon could leave, the door burst open.

Caelus's silhouette appeared in the doorway. His impatient voice rang out. "You're just a servant, don't always make trouble for me. When you're done fighting, just go and sit back down properly. Now you even had me come find you personally."

Phainon: "!" Hey, coming as soon as he finished talking makes it just seem like it was on purpose, okay?

Chapter End Notes

The Author has something to say: Yay! Two Chapters in one week! And I feel like this is one that you all have been waiting for for a while. I hope it lives up to your expectations hehe. From here on out I have a lot of fun things planned. I'm very excited and I hope you'll enjoy them too. See you next week!

chapters.title: Chapter 8: As long as I’m at his side, it’s enough
chapters.html:
When he saw that there were unexpectedly two people inside, and one of them was Mydeimos, Caelus paused and frowned, but he promptly ignored Mydeimos, looking towards Phainon. He said coldly, "What are you standing there for? Hurry up or you might as well just sleep here tonight."

Without the slightest hesitation, he turned and left.

When Mydei saw Caelus's attitude towards Phainon, he wanted to say something, but Phainon stopped him.

After Phainon rested for a bit, his energy was pretty much recovered to normal levels. He gave Mydei an apologetic glance. "Let's talk another time." He scurried out the door.

Mydei swallowed his half-asked question, watching their fading silhouettes. His gaze was several times colder than usual, and his hands were clenched tightly.

"Someone like this... How is someone like this good enough to stay by his side..."

---

In the aircar, Phainon suddenly remembered Caelus was Khaslana's fanboy. He didn't make Caelus angry by accidentally winning, did he? He felt a bit panicked.

"Congratulations on your victory." Caelus glanced at him and said, "Although I was hoping Senior Khaslana would win, I wouldn't do anything to you because of something like this. After all, your victory was genuine too."

Phainon: "....!" Liar, you're obviously the kind of guy that could even lay a trap for your biological brother! You even secretly plotted against a few of Khaslana's enemies.

Still, when he thought about it, in the original novel Caelus was already head over heels for Khaslana, so it was normal that he was so lovesick. Now, he just worshipped Khaslana... so it was understandable that he wasn't so crazy.

Phainon immediately let out a breath of relief. He decided to completely ignore that the person Caelus currently liked was Prince Latiao.

"By the way, how come you and that Mydeimos guy were together?" Caelus said casually. "He was always scowling at you until just a while ago, wasn't he?"

You talk like you're not always scowling yourself.

Phainon's heart skipped a beat. "Oh, yeah, we just happened to met in the lounge..." Though the news about how Mydeimos got down on one knee would be spreading by tomorrow... Phainon guessed that with Caelus being how he was, he had probably never listened to gossip around the school, so he didn't bother to explain (._.)

"Oh? I see." Caelus snorted. "In any case, it doesn't have anything to do with me. Still, that Mydeimos guy really doesn't know his own limits. He actually went and confessed to my companion online. It's just wishful thinking. If I'm wooing ahead of time, nobody will fall in love with someone like him."

Phainon: "..." Hey, you and him are two of a kind, okay! And who was your companion, huh? Don't be so confident.

"By the way, tonight, you don't have to stay in that little room upstairs anymore. Just come down to eat," Caelus said calmly. "With your performance these days, I think I should give you a bit of a promotion."

Phainon: "..." Did Caelus's favorability score rise a bit because they talked a bit about love problems?

He hoped Caelus would never find out the truth.

Dinner in the dining room was, as he expected, more delicious than the meals he had in his room. Phainon ate so happily that he was ready to cry. As he ate, he began to think about how to reply to Caelus on the virtual net.

After logging in, Phainon went to the school site to take a look first. Contrary to his expectations, there wasn't a single thread about what Mydeimos did that day. There weren't even any threads about Phainon. There were only a few threads about how unlucky Khaslana was.

After searching a bit, Phainon discovered that the keywords had actually been blocked.

Phainon: "..." He nearly forgot that Mydeimos was the crown prince's younger cousin. Blocking out news like this was no problem at all.

After letting go of the burden in his heart, Phainon scurried over to fight a few rounds in the competition before going to find Mydei. This was pretty much his everyday activity by now.

After accumulating points over the last period of time, Prince Latiao's points had climbed up to the top two hundred. With another hundred-some points, he could squeeze his way into the top hundred.

Other people could fight two or three rounds a day. They would need at least two months before they could collect a hundred-some points. But to Phainon, who wanted to fight in the arena every day, a hundred-some points was about what he could accumulate in a day. There were many people who both envied and admired him.

Because Mydeimos knew Phainon's true identity now, he didn't bother distorting his face and voice. He went directly to look for Mydei with his real face.

After he saw Phainon, Mydei just about sank into his happy place. He felt like he was a step closer to Phainon. Now, they could meet in both the real world and the virtual world every day. It was another step closer to his dreams.

If that damned hindrance Caelus didn't exist, things would be perfect.

After they finished practicing together, Mydei and Phainon sat in the room together drinking tea, resting leisurely and taking the chance to chat.

"Why do you conceal your strength?" Mydei asked uncertainly. "With your strength, it's clear that even at school you could be one of the strongest people, but why do you hide your identity? Those ignorant people even shame you for it."

As soon as Mydei remembered how those people had jeered at Phainon, gloom began to swirl in his heart again. He wished he could get all of those people expelled. In truth, Mydei searched up news about Prince Latiao every day. Every time he saw something bad, he would find the person who posted it and bring them out for a beating.

"Oh, that." Phainon sighed, putting on a desolate expression of a worldly gentleman. "I don't want those people to know my identity... Because I just want to live my school life peacefully without any disturbances as a normal person, not as a prodigy."

If someone else was saying something so pompous to Phainon, Phainon would definitely slap them, but when Mydei heard these words, his eyes sparkled. He sighed with emotion. "Indeed, someone like you naturally has different goals than someone as lowly as us."

Phainon thought about what he had turned his entire mecha into for the sake of advertisement fees. It was totally super lowly, but Mydei was still lavishing praise in a frenzy... Phainon suddenly felt a little embarrassed. Even if he was more shameless he would feel embarrassed, okay.

"Um, I also hoped to ask, what kind of relationship do you have with Caelus?" Mydei asked carefully. "I apologize; I must be terribly annoying. I already asked yesterday... but I still don't understand why someone as beautiful and strong as you would stay by someone like him."

Fuck, what was up with that sentence! The word "strong" was obviously enough! Mydei's words nearly made Phainon spit out a mouthful of blood... It was his first time hearing someone use the word "beautiful" to describe him in all his years of living. The power of a fan's rose-tinted glasses was simply terrifying.

"It's nothing." Phainon had just managed to get over the shock of those words. He absolutely wouldn't say anything about how he was acting as a servant at the moment, so he explained, "You know too. Back then, I was expelled because of that thing. Caelus was the one who saved me, so to repay him, I stayed by his side to help him out."

"Then you don't have any way to leave?" Mydei said quickly. "If it's about money, I can provide assistance, no matter how much money, it's..."

"That's not necessary, Phainon said. "Life is pretty good like this. There's no need for a change at the moment."

The important thing was that if he didn't stay and keep an eye on Caelus, who knew if he might go crazy and expose the truth that he was an omega.

"I see..." Mydei's face fell.

Sure enough, he hadn't done well enough. If he did enough, why wouldn't Phainon pick him, and instead pick that Caelus guy?

It must be because that Caelus found out Phainon's online identity and used it to force Phainon to stay with him. He was even shameless enough to put up ads to express his love. He obviously wanted to use it to pressure Phainon.

As Mydei went on an imagining spree, Phainon took the rest time to send Caelus a letter under Prince Latiao's name.

In the letter, Phainon said that he liked people who were lowkey and strong. If Caelus could make it to the finals of the empire's real-life mecha competition held every few years, then Phainon would consider dating him.

If Phainon remembered correctly, the real-life mecha competition would begin soon. It could also draw Caelus's attention.

As for the stuff about the finals, Phainon knew very clearly that while Caelus was pretty strong, he wasn't fully grown yet. It was impossible for him to make it to the finals.

After pressing the key to send the letter, Phainon couldn't help feeling very clever.

He had spent enough time online. Phainon said a quick good-bye to Mydei and logged off.

Mydei stayed in his seat, looking at the cup Phainon had drank from. Unconsciously, he picked up the cup, pressing his lips to the edge of the cup gently.

Like this, it was as though he could touch the other person just as closely.

After some time, Mydei returned suddenly to his senses. The hand holding the cup trembled. "What did I just do..."

---

Everything that happened later went without a hitch.

The next day, when Phainon was still asleep in bed, Caelus dragged him up.

Phainon, still bleary, was pulled to the garden of the duke's residence and began to train with Caelus.

"What's with this?" Phainon yawned, looking dazedly at Caelus.

"I need to make it into the finals of the mecha tournament. To achieve that goal, I have to start training now." Caelus gritted his teeth. "I'll become an alpha worthy of him."

Phainon: "!" Fuck, Caelus was really going all out for the sake of a letter. It looked like he was really serious...

Although Phainon felt complicated, things progressed smoothly. As expected, Caelus forgot about those lousy online confessions and switched his focus to training for the real-life mecha competition. He even took any time he could get during break time at school to practice with mechas.

Because Phainon had told Mydei not to look for him and be a little more lowkey, Mydei had no choice but to keep himself hidden upstairs.

Seeing Phainon pressed to close to Caelus, Mydei's heart filled with envy, but he couldn't tell Phainon how he felt. He could only use his terminal to take pictures of Phainon training.

Though nobody could talk about how Mydei got down on one knee online, everyone pretty much understood what had happened, and their attitudes towards Phainon changed greatly. Instead of their previous disdain, they would avoid him if they saw him from a distance, like he was a landmine that would explode with the slightest touch.

Although Phainon found it a bit weird, it was fine as long as it was convenient for him. In any case, their attitudes wouldn't affect him at all.

Phainon attended classes in the morning and trained in his free time. At night, he fought in the virtual mecha competition. A dozen days passed as such, and his body was finally much stronger than before... Still, "much stronger" was only relative to his previous strength. After all, omegas were born with limited physical strength. Even if he was impressive, he couldn't train himself up to an alpha's level.

Phainon's goal was to achieve the strength of a beta.

And in the virtual world, Prince Latiao had finally succeeded in making it to the top hundred in the virtual mecha competition. It was enough to enter the finals that would be beginning soon.

Phainon didn't know how many matches he had fought. He encountered terrifying opponents several times.

But they were only terrifying to other people. To Phainon, they weren't very strong, and after several days of combat, Phainon's strength increased rapidly. He was solidly undefeated.

Unwittingly, the number of Prince Latiao's fans skyrocketed. There were many crazy fanboys and fangirls who would praise Prince Latiao madly at all kinds of different places. There were even people who claimed that Prince Latiao's strength was already in the top ten, and that as long as he was given time, he would certainly be able to take first prize.

Because of his fans' words, fans of other competitors were indignant. They would begin to argue time and time again. But even if they slandered Prince Latiao, they could only attack his name and the ads on his mecha. They didn't have the nerve to slander Prince Latiao's strength. After all, Prince Latiao's strength was obvious to anyone with eyes.

Everyone asked Prince Latiao to get a social account for publicity, but Phainon felt that it would expose his identity, so he didn't show any signs of making one.

During this period of time, Prince Latiao's ad-filled mecha actually became a new trend. Many young people stamped a mess of words on their own mechas, feeling very stylish.

The first person to imitate him was actually Mydeimos.

Once, Phainon went to watch one of Mydei's matches. When he sat into the stands and saw Mydei's mecha, he nearly spat out a mouthful of blood.

The kinds of mechas that Mydei piloted were all stylish and bougie. They all made him seem extremely rich and cool.

But now, although he was still using expensive mechas, his coolness was completely gone. There were a bunch of words printed on his mecha, and looking carefully they were all, shockingly enough, Prince Latiao's name... Mydei even had a design of Phainon's mecha stamped on his mecha...

This was no longer at the level of someone without a sense of beauty. It was simply offending the eye. It was terrible to look at. It was as hair-raising as a brainless fan's work.

No... Mydeimos was a crazy fanboy to begin with.

It was the first time, Phainon, as the person printed on Mydei's mecha, felt so ashamed of his nickname...

And he finally realized how hideous his own mecha was when he piloted it out. Even so, Phainon wouldn't change!

The surrounding crowd was actually used to the terrible style of Mydei's mecha. Phainon had to ask around a bit before he found out that Mydeimos was actually the president of Prince Latiao's fanclub. He was the one who started many trends.

Phainon: "..." In some ways, Mydei was really terrifying.

Because Mydei didn't choose to hide his identity, the view of the inside of his cockpit was projected directly onto the screen in the middle of the arena.

Everyone could see clearly that Mydei was wearing a school uniform. His handsome face was cold and he looked at his opponent carelessly, as though he didn't take his opponent seriously at all.

His opponent was infuriated by Mydei's gaze instantly. He pulled out his weapon, rushing him furiously.

"Too weak." Mydei shook his head, but he thought of Phainon. "If it was that person, his movements wouldn't be so slow." After fighting with Phainon, these people's strength was nothing to him. "If it was that person, he would already be in front of me..."

Mydei's mind was filled with the scene of Phainon teaching him. He didn't have any patience for the fight before his eyes and stabbed through his opponent's cockpit without the slightest hesitation.

"Fighting with people like this is simply a waste of my time," Mydei thought coldly.

Phainon almost felt like he couldn't recognize that this was the same Mydei that had been following him recently. After all, the way Mydei acted with him was too different from the way he acted with other people.

When the match ended, the two of them met up in front of Mydei's house.

"I saw your match just now," Phainon said.

Mydei was stunned. His turned his face shyly. He said gruffly, "I... Just now I didn't even perform very well. You actually saw such a failure..."

"It's okay, I think you're great," Phainon said. "You were really cool when you were fighting, your opponent couldn't match up to you at all."

Phainon really felt that way. Besides, in the original novel, Mydei was truly strong. Moreover, he was currently even more powerful than Khaslana... He rescued Phainon who nearly had to go have Khaslana as his capture target.

Mydei froze. He felt like something had struck him right in the heart.

He had been praised by Phainon. Mydei felt like there would never be another moment so happy again. He didn't react for a long time, his deep green eyes filled with joy. He looked at Phainon earnestly. "Thank you very much. That you approve of me... I'm incredibly happy."

He was so happy that he would rather this moment never ended.

After he logged off, Mydei opened his eyes within the nutrient cabin.

The room that was once bare and plain, now had pictures pasted all over the walls. The person in every one of the pictures was, naturally, Phainon.

The pictures were all pictures that Mydei had taken of Phainon behind his back recently. He had taken so many, but he couldn't bear to delete any of them.

Mydei crawled out of the nutrient cabin and walked over to the wall. There was a live-size picture of Phainon. It was as though he was really there.

Mydei reached out and pressed his hand to where Phainon's hand was. He rested his forehead against the wall, his eyes full of infatuation.

In the next moment, he caught sight of Caelus in the corner of the picture.

"There's always some people in the way who shouldn't exist..." His eyes turned as cold as ice. "It's obvious that having me alone at his side is enough. There's no need for anyone extra."

---

A few days later, the finals of the virtual mecha competition began.

The finals were different from the preliminary competitions. It was no longer a point system. Instead, everyone was divided into ten groups, and within the groups everyone would fight with each other to select the best results. In the end, the ten remaining people would enter the real finals.

At this point, every contestant would earn five percent of the earnings from ticket to their matches. Though the people at this ranking typically didn't value that little bit of money, it was still a symbol of glory.

Phainon felt great emotion for the officials' sense. Although he was already a wealthy man with a million empire coins, this little bit of money was nothing on the capital planet.

If he didn't have this many opponents, Phainon would wish that he could fight a dozen matches every day.

But Mydei gave up on the chance to participate in the finals. Recently, he had less and less interest in fighting with these people. He might as well say that other than fighting with Phainon, everything was dull.

Mydei felt that rather than wasting his time on the competition, he should just take the time to watch Phainon compete and let himself get a bit more excited.

Of course, it would be worth celebrating if he got to fight Phainon in the finals, but Mydei didn't want to become an obstacle in Phainon's path forward. Even if it was unlikely to be in the same group was small, he wasn't willing to take that chance.

All contestants were required to attend the opening ceremony of the finals. Normally, many contestants who never appeared in public would show their true faces. After all, this was something honorable.

Of course, if they didn't want to reveal themselves they could put on a mosaic.

Phainon really, really wanted to show off in front of so many people, but he absolutely couldn't reveal his identity, so he had to reluctantly put on a mosaic, feeling like the entire world had turned gloomy.

Everyone was disappointed. They had thought that they could see Prince Latiao's real face. They started guessing why Prince Latiao was hiding his identity.

What the people of the empire prized the most was strength. Even if someone was ugly, everyone would accept it. Out of the people who entered the finals, there were several unattractive contestants, but they still had plenty of fans.

So there weren't many people who guessed that Prince Latiao had a mosaic to hide his face. Most people thought that he had an identity that he couldn't publicize, like being a noble or a member of the imperial family or something.

But Khaslana felt that it was about time, and revealed his own face at the finals.

Immediately, the crowd began to stir. Nobody had expected God Time to be such a handsome man. His every smile had an effect on their hearts.

If he was strong, fine, but being strong and being so attractive, and being so attractive while still being so young, this was hard to come by! Khaslana quickly gained a sizable number of fans.

At the empire's military institute, the students were also stupefied. The people at the school would naturally pay attention to the virtual mecha competition, and they all had their own favored contestants. Because of his broken techniques, God Time had naturally gained many of them as fans.

Now that everyone knew Khaslana was actually the legendary God Time, they were completely and utterly stunned.

Those who didn't get how Khaslana became close friends with Mydeimos suddenly understood. They must have met at a match... Damn it! They wanted to be God Time's bro too!

When Phainon went to school the next day, he spotted Khaslana in the middle of a crowd. Everyone was staring at him with admiration, asking for autographs one after another and lavishing praise on him.

But Khaslana's expression was as calm as always. He looked at everyone with a slight smile. "Guys, there's no need to hurry. Let's take it slow. I'll sign an autograph for everyone. I just got lucky, I'm not that strong. There's no need to care so much about me either."

His gentle manner allowed many of them to sink into the trap. With the addition of Khaslana's protagonist halo, he gained several people who were willing to act as his underlings in seconds.

But when Phainon walked over, everyone's gazes turned strange. Everyone knew that after Phainon first jeered at Khaslana there was no way for him to come back out with his head held high, but Phainon went straight to give them a slap in their faces.

But in the few days before at the combat training lesson, Phainon won over Khaslana with sheer dumb luck. Although the process was amusing, it wouldn't change the result of the victory.

When they thought about how this useless beta had managed to use such a reason to be victorious over their amazing God Time, everyone's mood turned complicated.

Someone who could enter the finals of the virtual mecha competition wasn't a normal person. There were numerous strong people vying for a spot. Moreover, Khaslana was just a student. It was easy to imagine his bright future.

After a short internal struggle, nobody could be bothered to pay attention to Phainon. They continued to praise Khaslana. Who had the time to care about a passerby? It was more important to build a good relationship with Khaslana, who seemed easy to talk to.

But Mydei was hidden away, watching them ignore Phainon as such. His fingers were practically digging into the post. When the surroundings cleared of people, he finally rushed down to Phainon. "Don't bother with those people. They don't have an eye for talent. To me, you're the most amazing."

"I don't care, but shouldn't you go congratulate Khaslana a little?" Phainon said. "Recently I think you and Khaslana haven't been spending as much time together."

Mydei looked as though he had just realized something. "Oh, I've always been paying attention to you recently. I forgot about communicating with him for a while."

Mydei spent most of his time salivating over Phainon's videos and pictures. Where would he find the time to go talk with Khaslana?

Phainon was stunned. "!" Hey, is this really no big deal?

--- In the most central region of the capital planet, Anaxagoras was sitting next to the window, his head lowered and his eyes focused on the papers on Prince Latiao that he was holding.

After an investigation by his subordinates, while the materials on Prince Latiao were significantly greater than before, there was still nothing on his true identity. They could only get reports about his mecha piloting habits, what kind of ads he liked (...), and all kinds of completely useless things.

When he thought about how his little brother had actually come out of the closet on the virtual net a few days ago, and that the person he had come out of the closet for was Prince Latiao, Anaxa felt his head ache.

The duke and duchess were both travelling on other planets, but Anaxa couldn't go back home because of business. He didn't expect that just leaving his little brother alone for a month would give him the chance to make such a big mess. Anaxagoras had no idea how he would face his parents.

Why would his little brother, who didn't take a second glance at anyone lower than him, suddenly fall in love with an alpha of unknown identity? What in the world happened when Anaxa was gone?

Even His Highness the Crown Prince was focused on news about that person... Anaxas suddenly had a thought. His own little brother wouldn't become His Highness the Crown Prince's enemy by accident, would he?

No, it was impossible. Even if His Highness the Crown Prince paid more attention to Prince Latiao recently, how could anyone like someone who didn't even show his face? He must be thinking too much.

After he finished thinking, Anaxa furrowed his eyebrows and looked down at his hands. "You can only find this much? Who in the world is this Prince Latiao? There are even such open permissions. It can't be that even the central computer can't find him?"

"We have no way to search the central computer or find the details of his location," the subordinate bent on one knee at the side said hurriedly. "But we finally did everything possible and locked onto his approximate location. This shouldn't be wrong."

"Oh? Go ahead and say it." Anaxa raised an eyebrow, looking over.

"Prince Latiao's location is exactly in the direction of the capital planet's academic district. But we couldn't find any more details," the subordinate said.

"Very good, he's actually over there... That Prince Latiao must be a student here." Anaxagoras glanced in the direction of the academic district. "There are only a few schools there. Finding one person is still so difficult?"

When he thought about his little brother, who was still in the academic district, Anaxagoras suddenly realized that Prince Latiao might have connections with his little brother in reality.

"It looks like I need to make a trip personally."

Chapter End Notes

chapters.title: Chapter 9: The Omega Inhibitors Failed
chapters.html:
After Khaslana's identity was revealed, the way he was treated at school changed immediately. He had many more followers and there were even several retired teachers who came looking for Khaslana to give him extra lessons.

Back in the day, these teachers were heroes of the battlefield. They would treat even princes with cool attitudes, but the way Khaslana made his way into the finals using an outdated mecha spurred them into action. And when the school learned of Khaslana's family circumstances, they immediately exempted him from the high tuition fees and even gave Khaslana the highest scholarship... Although Khaslana wasn't impoverished anymore.

Though Phainon changed the plot quite a bit after arriving and caused two of the important people in the original novel to be less fervent around Khaslana compared to the original plotline, the story still continued to develop along its original path.

On website in the virtual world, the hottest topic was how the real face behind God Time was a shockingly handsome man. Khaslana was basically the man of the hour in both reality and in the virtual world.

Under these circumstances, as someone who had never been close to Khaslana, Phainon's situation was getting dangerous.

Phainon even thought that Khaslana would target him on purpose. He didn't expect that Khaslana would act as though he had forgotten the enmity between them. When they met, he would say a proper hello. He didn't mock Phainon for what had happened in the past, either.

Thus everyone applauded Khaslana for his benevolence. He could even forgive someone who had mocked him so easily.

In contrast, Phainon felt even more uneasy. "..." Khaslana just wasn't the kind of guy who could forget grievances so easily, okay? He was definitely brewing up some big move.

And there was another thing that made Phainon feel a bit conflicted. Recently, whenever he was training, he would suddenly get dizzy. Several times, he had nearly fallen down because of his vertigo. The nape of his neck would often start feeling hot.

Phainon hadn't thought much about it at first. But once when Mydei sat at his side, he leaned in unconsciously, his voice casual and low. "Your scent smells so fragrant..." Phainon was suddenly shocked to his senses. He was so shocked that he shot to his feet.

With what he remembered of this scary ABO novel's setting, the nape was where an omega's scent gland was, fuck! And Mydeimos was an alpha. This was very bad, very very bad.

Mydei realized what was happening. He immediately apologized. "I truly apologize; I've been offensive to you."

"It's nothing." Phainon waved a hand, but he felt a bit uncomfortable Could it be that his omega inhibitors were starting to lose effect...

Although he hadn't been bitten by an alpha or anything, pushing his limits with training every day might have affected his inhibitors...

[Host is exactly right. The omega inhibitors you've been using have indeed been slowly losing efficacy. At most, after a week, the effect will completely disappear.]

This time the problem is terrible, okay!!

As soon as he imagined what it would be like if his status as an omega was revealed to the school, Phainon felt uncomfortable all over. Being expelled from school was just a small thing. Being discovered by Caelus was the scariest thing. Caelus would definitely feel like he got cheated and retaliate against him in fury.

Phainon immediately got ready to ask for leave and go home for a few days to ask the original host's mother and father how he should fix it.

Meanwhile, Anaxagoras pretty much understood what his little brother had been doing these last few days.

"The teenager he captured has been staying at our house as a servant? Anaxa said disbelievingly. He really couldn't understand what Caelus was thinking. Based on his understanding of Caelus, it was already pretty good if he didn't beat someone he didn't like half to death. He had actually let the other person stay at home for days?

Although he was called a servant, with the other party's background, it was something good, not a punishment.

"No... I have to investigate this person." Anaxa felt there must be something he hadn't noticed.

His subordinate quickly sent Phainon's information over.

The first half of the files were very standard. In summary, he was a beta from an impoverished noble family and managed to get in the institute with the help of some connections. He drifted through his school days, and even taunted Khaslana.

But in the second half, things suddenly began to change. This male beta had shockingly been expelled because he peeped in the male baths (in all his years of life, it was Anaxa's first time hearing of such a reason for being expelled), but he later returned to school with the help of Caelus. After that, he sucked up to the crown prince's younger cousin Mydeimos, and even defeated Khaslana in the mecha battlefield.

"He was able to defeat the Khaslana? He's just a beta. How in the world did he do it?" Anaxa was stunned. He immediately began to think about whether Phainon might be Prince Latiao in the virtual world.

Anaxa pulled up the video from the mecha combat lesson to take a look.

Back then, all of the people in the crowd were just students. They didn't notice the details of the battle. On top of that, they didn't have much of an eye for things, so naturally they couldn't see the truth. But Anaxa saw the issue acutely.

"In the first half, his performance was absolutely disappointing, but in the middle he suddenly changed. Even his dodging became smoother, and he managed to win like this... Could it be that this Phainon person and Prince Latiao have some relation?"

After he returned home, Caelus and Phainon spotted Anaxagoras sitting in the living room. Caelus's expression changed immediately. When he thought about the dumb shit he had been doing recently, he obediently called, "Gege."

Anaxa clearly looked like he wanted to teach his brother a lesson. "So you still remember I'm your brother?"

Phainon was shocked. He didn't expect he would be able to see Anaxa. He thought that this house was just Caelus's. Phainon started thinking about how to explain being a manservant to Anaxa. Finally, he decided it was too much of a hassle. He stood behind Caelus, playing dead.

"You must be Phainon?" Anaxa turned to look at him.

Phainon was given a shock. He nodded quickly. "Yes, I'm Phainon."

In the original novel, although Anaxagoras was good-tempered and didn't have as much attack power as the other characters, for better or worse he was still the heir of the duke's title, and he absolutely wasn't as easy to get along with as he seemed on the surface. In fact, he was incredibly two-faced.

In comparison, while Caelus was a bit more cocky and would curse someone out at the drop of a hat or capture someone to give them a whipping over a disagreement, for better or worse he was easy to understand. Phainon could feel more at ease with him.

"It's really been hard on you to take care of our family’s Caelus so far," Anaxa said. "I'll have to trouble you to continue taking care of him in the future."

"I don't need anyone to take care of me," Caelus said.

Phainon hurriedly nodded. He saw that they both looked like they wanted to say something. "If there's nothing else, I'll leave first."

Caelus snorted. "If you're going, go quickly. Don't forget to come back down for dinner."

Phainon rushed upstairs. The two brothers went to the study to converse.

"Ge, how come you came back so quickly?" Caelus said uncertainly. "Didn't you say you'd be gone for a year?"

"I came back because something happened. It's lucky I came back, or who knows what kind of mess you'd kick up." Anaxa said coolly. "What's between you and Phainon? Why did you decide to let him stay?"

Caelus's expression didn't change. He said, "He offended me, so to compensate I had him stay for a bit as a servant."

Anaxa said, "Then how long will he work?"

"I haven't decided," Caelus said very calmly.

"..." Anaxa rested his forehead in his hands. He said, "Don't you hate betas? What is it about this beta that makes you see him in a different light?"

Caelus thought for a long time, then said, "Maybe it's because he's got more sense. I feel like he's better than other betas."

Anaxa was also wondering why his little brother didn't get beaten to death. "...Why did you confess to Prince Latiao online? Do you know how much of a hassle this brought our family?"

Because of it, there weren't many people who would get close to Anaxagoras recently. After all, everyone thought that since the younger brother was a gay who liked alphas, the older brother might just have the same problem. It made things indescribably difficult for Anaxa.

"Because I like him," Caelus said without the slightest hesitation. Although he secretly knew Prince Latiao was an omega, he wouldn't say it.

"Alright. In fact, I don't want to bother with managing you." Anaxa's head was beginning to ache. "But do you know what he really looks like? Does it matter if he's a big, tall, muscular man or if he's an old man?"

"Of course he won't look like that!" Caelus said huffily. "My future partner's very normal!"

"Are you saying you've already met him in reality?" Anaxa's voice suddenly turned cold. "Like Phainon from just now. What's his relationship with Prince Latiao?"

"Impossible." Caelus was stunned for a moment. "Ge, don't joke around. How could Phainon have any relationship with Prince Latiao? They probably haven't even met."

"Then how did he win against Khaslana? You're Khaslana's fan, you should be very clear about his strength, right?" Anaxa looked straight at Caelus. He said, "Are you hiding something from me?"

"No, of course not," Caelus said. "Phainon just got lucky. Normally, he isn't that strong..."

Despite what he said, Caelus felt a bit strange. Things really were like that. Even if Phainon got even luckier, it was too much of a coincidence...

"You've realized yourself that there's something strange, haven't you?" Anaxa studied Caelus's expression. He said slowly, "In that case, use your own eyes and take a look. I'm not saying that Phainon and Prince Latiao definitely have some relationship, but he definitely isn't as useless as he seems. Don't have too much faith in other people."

Caelus couldn't even retort. He thought back to the things that he had discovered, and it seemed that he really had overlooked some things. And the thing that confused him the most was that stuff with Mydeimos. Something he didn't know about must have happened between them.

Caelus gritted his teeth. "I'll look over it carefully. I'll see what exactly he's hiding from me."

Phainon took leave easily. After all, he was just a manservant, not selling his body. Of course there would be no problem going back home to see his parents. And Phainon didn't even need to pack his luggage. He went straight to the port to take an airship back home.

As an impoverished noble family, Phainon's family naturally didn't live in the capital planet. They lived in another planet in the same galaxy. There was an airship that left for that planet at the same time every day. It only took a few hours there and back, and it was incredibly convenient.

When he arrived at the gate, Phainon ran into Mydei, who had been waiting inside for a long time.

"Why would you be here?" Phainon was given a shock. How did Mydei know he was leaving? He didn't say a thing.

"I was worried about letting you leave alone," Mydei said, "so I bought my own ticket and came. I truly apologize."

Phainon said, "But don't you still need to go to class?"

"There's no need for something like that. I already took leave," Mydei said calmly. "Compared to being in class, I would rather go with you. If something happens, I'll be able to help immediately."

Phainon didn't feel any need to turn him down, so he said, "Okay then. You can just come along..." It was nice for Mydei to be with him. If something happened and he couldn't go online, he could still accomplish his daily task."

Before Mydei arrived, he bought a ticket for the best room in the highest grade airship. Phainon was originally planning to squeeze into some random airship. Now that he saw there was such a good seat, he went straight to get his original ticket refunded.

After getting on the airship, the two of them waited in the room. After all, Mydei had spent a good sum of money. It was incredibly comfortable and there was even a view out the window and a meal provided.

When the flight was half over, Phainon needed to use the bathroom. When he walked out and opened the door to the hallway, he crashed straight into a teenager.

The teenager had blonde hair pale enough to be white and a delicate, pretty face. His looks could put anyone at ease, but his current expression was horrible. When he ran into Phainon, he fell straight down.

Phainon: "!" He just wanted to use the bathroom, why did he encounter this kind of situation?

And he didn't look like a normal person either. Of course... how could someone who could afford a VIP seat in an airship be a normal person. If he was some amazing noble, if something happened he wouldn't be able to pay for it even if he sold himself.

Phainon panicked. He bent over to see how he was doing.

But he saw the teenager frown. His forehead was full of cold sweat. He looked like he in a rough state.

"Crap, his situation looks really serious." Phainon didn't think he was doing very well, and remembered the ability he hadn't used for a long time. He gritted his teeth. "Well, we're all humans here. Nothing will happen if I use it."

The Zerg from the last world had really set him up.

Phainon grabbed the teenager's hand, sending his ability into his body.

The teenager who had been frowning immediately relaxed. His bloodless face slowly regained its color-but it didn't stop there. His cheeks gradually flushed red, and his body began to grow hot. He unconsciously nuzzled Phainon from inside his arms.

Phainon: "...?!" The fuck, why did this person get so excited after a little bit of healing?!

[The answer is simple. It's because the other person isn't human, or rather he isn't fully human.]

It was just a moment, but Phainon remembered that this novel still had Zerg as the villains in the middle.

The Zerg in this novel were much more dangerous than the Zerg in the previous world. There were many Zerg who pretended to be humans and mixed into society, and they had masked themselves for several years already. There were many who even married humans and had children. Plenty of Zerg hid even on the capital planet.

In the original novel, these Zerg were the same people who began to attack humans madly. Khaslana fought his hardest and was finally able to rescue everyone. His reputation rose another level. But the crown prince Nanook did nothing, so he lost much of the people's support.

It was totally unrealistic. Even if Nanooks really didn't do anything, he would find a couple of people to come and praise himself, alright? In any case, there wouldn't be anyone who would go investigate whether the crown prince really didn't do anything.

At first, Phainon felt that the villain was very far from him, but now he had discovered that the Zerg was right at his side.

But Phainon couldn't say anything about the Zerg, because with the progression of the original novel, humans hadn't discovered anything about it. If he said it aloud, it would be a spoiler. The world consciousness would obliterate him.

He spotted the Zerg teenager stirring on the ground. Phainon propped him right against the wall, running back to his room.

Anyway, he would just pretend nothing had happened.

As for what the Zerg in heat would do, Phainon wouldn't bother with it.

After a few hours on the airship, they finally arrived.

Now that Phainon thought about it, it was his first time going home after transmigrating into this world for so long.

Although his family was already poor, for better or worse they were a noble family. They still had their ancestral home located in a planet in the outskirts of the capital. Housing was much cheaper too.

Mydei had no idea what had happened during the flight. He followed after Phainon like an obedient daughter-in-law, looking shy.

When Phainon pushed open the door, he finally saw his body's parents.

People of the future had long lifespans, and they aged slowly. The original host's parents looked quite young. It actually felt very strange. These two people looked very different from Phainon's real parents, but when he first saw them he felt very close to them.

It was probably the original body's pre-installed feelings.

Hieronymus and Audata were both people who doted on their child. Since their child had been away for so long, when they saw Phainon they pulled him over to look over him carefully, insisting that Phainon had gotten too thin. In fact, after eating well and drinking well and training for several days, Phainon's body was in much better condition than before.

Then Hieronymus saw Mydeimos behind him. "And this is...?"

Because he was meeting Phainon's parents today, Mydei was wearing extremely formal clothes. Combined with his bearing and his incredibly attractive face, it was obvious at a glance that he wasn't a normal person.

"Hello, Aunt, Uncle, I-I'm..." Mydei was extremely nervous. When he was facing His Majesty the Emperor he was completely calm, but in front of Phainon's parents, he couldn't even speak.

"This is my friend Mydeimos. He goes to the same school as me. Since he was worried about me traveling by myself, he came along." Phainon didn't mention Mydei's status at all, feeling it would be bothersome to mention.

"Oh, our child has such a good friend! It's such a surprise." Audata looked at Mydei with great emotion. She had a maidservant bring him to put his things down in the guest room. Although they weren't wealthy, there were still several maidservants. For the most part, they were beta girls from some poor families in the area.

At night, the four of them ate together at a restaurant.

Audata asked Mydei about how Phainon was doing at school. As soon as they started talking about Phainon, the shy Mydei turned fervent. Although his face was calm, anyone could tell how excited he was almost as if there was a glow surrounding him. He kept praising Phainon, making Phainon seem like the most amazing student in the school.

Phainon listened to their conversation, feeling embarrassed. He didn't know what exactly Mydei was saying.

But which parent didn't like hearing their child being praised? They liked Mydei more and more, so much that Phainon suspected they were looking at their daughter-in-law... Phainon quickly banished the thought from his mind.

Soon, Audata asked Phainon about what had happened recently. She had been horrified to find out that he had been expelled, then he had gone back. What exactly had happened?

Phainon remembered how awkward the situation was when he had been expelled and avoided the topic, turning the subject onto a better direction and completely skipping over how Caelus had him whipped. He said that he had been rescued by the kind-hearted Caelus.

Mydei's mood sank as he listened.

"Oh, that's the child of the duke. He has so much compassion." Audata was moved. "We have to make sure to go thank him."

Phainon said hastily, "There's no need, I'm still at Caelus's house as a servant..."

Normally being a servant was embarrassing, but it was being a duke's servant. Someone could even brag about it. Audata and Hieronymus looked honored. Mydei felt even more uncomfortable. A scumbag like Caelus was able to make Phainon's parents regard him so highly. Mydei had to work hard too. But he had already promised Phainon not to reveal his identity. Mydei prepared to fight from a different front.

Late at night, after Mydei went to sleep, Audata and Hieronymus called Phainon in and they began to discuss serious matters in another room. Phainon went straight to the main topic, his expression ugly. The omega inhibitors he was using seemed like they were about to be ineffective.

Hieronymus's expression sank. "God, these inhibitors are technically banned. When we bought them, they told us they weren't stable. It's already lucky that you could use them for so many years."

Audata sighed, wiping her tears. "If I wasn't so useless, you wouldn't have to endure such hardships. You could be just like other omegas, growing up well at home and marrying and having children. It wouldn't be like this, acting like a beta all the time."

Phainon said quickly, "You guys don't need to be sad. I think it's great this way." If he really married and had children like a normal omega he would be peeing his pants in fear, okay?

"We were too paranoid in the past. Thinking about it now, the title of duke isn't worth anything much. Why don't you quit school and come back?" Hieronymus muttered to himself. "Other omegas around your age are already starting to look at partners. It's not too late for you. It just so happens that I've been paying attention to unmarried alphas."

"Right, and that Mydeimos who came with you this time is pretty good. He looks like he cares about our little Phainon a lot."

Wait, the reason he came back was to continue suppressing it, not to get hurried into a marriage! It absolutely wasn't to let his parents take a look at Mydei!

If they really had Phainon go on arranged blind dates, he might as well kill himself.

"I've grown up as a beta, I don't want to be an omega anymore either." Phainon gritted his teeth. "And I always helped out at the duke's house as a beta. If Caelus discovers that I was deceiving him, he definitely won't spare me."

If the first part could be considered a child not seeing eye-to-eye with his parents and ignoring their words, the second half was a critical blow. After all, that was the duke.

Hieronymus and Audata were confronted with reality. They quickly abandoned the idea of having Phainon come home for blind dates and went to inquire about how they could continue using the inhibitors.

Phainon let out a breath of relief. He didn't expect that he would use Caelus as an excuse one day.

After he returned to his room, Phainon got in bed and went to sleep. There was only one match a day in the virtual mecha competition. There were still several days before it was his turn to fight, so he would just take the chance to rest up and recharge.

When he woke up the next day, Phainon crawled out of bed lazily, yawning as he went downstairs. He spotted Mydei wearing an apron, a plate in his hands. His face was impassive but the faint blush on his ear gave away his embarrassment.

Phainon was so shocked his jaw nearly fell off. "....?!"

Audata beamed, coming to Phainon to say, "What a good kid. He woke up early to help out and even asked about what you like to eat and made a big breakfast... This is my very first time seeing an alpha that knows how to cook."

Mydei looked embarrassment. "This isn't anything much, I made too little."

"Oh, child, you're too modest. Our Little Phainon's only ever known how to play around. I don't even know if he studied properly at school."

As soon as she mentioned Phainon, Mydei turned serious. Unexpectedly, he began to explain to Audata how Phainon hadn't been playing around and just how serious and inspiring he was. All the praises he sang yesterday were being repeated.

The more Audata listened, the happier she got. If it wasn't for what Phainon had said yesterday, she would have promised Phainon to Mydei then and there.

Phainon sank into a sea of fear. "..." Fuck, how did he not know that Mydei was so good at sucking up to people's parents.

The way Audata and Hieronymus looked at Mydei was already like the gaze they would use to look at a son-in-law. Luckily Mydei didn't know that Phainon was an omega, so he didn't notice there was anything wrong. He just thought that Phainon's parents were very kind.

After they finished eating, Mydei dashed to the kitchen to deliberate what to make for lunch... Such kindness was terrifying.

Besides, based on what was in the original novel, Mydei was still a young master who had never even touched impure water, these skills came late in life. Could it be that he had practiced these skills out of his own will, wanting to be Phainon's follower? ...Phainon suddenly felt a bit confused, still feeling that there was something weird about how Mydei was working hard.

Phainon simply came back to his room. The three of them continued to discuss yesterday's topic, their expressions serious.

Hieronymus sighed. "I went and asked. The inhibitors we bought back then can only be used once. If they're used a second time, it will cause severe harm to the body. It might cause you to be infertile for the rest of your life, so we can't use it a second time."

Phainon: "..." Fuck, that's awesome, that harm is great!

But Phainon thought it over some more and realized that it might cause his physical ability to be even worse. If he took it, he might not be able to pilot a mecha for even three minutes. He quickly tossed this method aside.

"And if we want to buy it, we might not even be able to get it." As he spoke, Hieronymus pulled out a bottle. "Luckily, in the beginning I thought there might be an accident, so I bought a bottle of medicine. This medicine can temporarily suppress an omega's scent. One pill can probably last for a week..."

Phainon took the bottle, relaxing. It would be enough to last for a few months. If the plot went ahead as it should, his identity wouldn't be revealed before he left this world.

Immediately, Audata sighed, putting a hand on Phainon's shoulder. "When you finish this medicine, why don't you come home like a good child? We'll just leave this galaxy. Even a duke won't know anything's wrong... Let's start anew."

"Okay..." Phainon nodded, feeling a bit sorrowful. They didn't know that the original host had already died a long time ago, and when he finished his task he would leave this world.

Luckily Phainon still had his healing ability. He planned to use it to heal Audata and let them have another child. In the future, they would slowly forget the pain of their first child.

At that moment, there was a sudden noise from the door.

Phainon's heart turned to ice. He rushed forward to push open the door, but he crashed into Mydei, who was in a trance. The tray he was holding fell to the ground, the snacks on it flying everywhere. He must have been about to bring in the snacks, but by coincidence he heard what they were saying.

While he was in side, Phainon had thought of plenty of dramatic soap opera plotlines that were always burst to pieces by other people, he didn't expect that something like this would really happen to him.

"Did you hear everything we just said?"

Chapter End Notes

The Author has something to say: Things are getting thrilling! Hello! Hello! Another reveal I'm sure you all have been waiting for, I hope it lived up to your expectation.
