I had a lot of fun with house wife Mydei and his idol Phainon XD. We also got to meet the parents! I haven't played Amphoreus as I had to delete the game due to storage issues so I haven't met them personally so I apologize for any ooc behavior.

Also i am currently working on another fic on the side and wanted your opinion. Which do you prefer? Sadistic and Seductive Predator Ratio x Pretending to be Stoic Aventurine or Sadistic, Cruel and Seductive Aventurine x Stoic but Internally Rake Ratio Who’s Bordering on Sociopathy

chapters.title: Chapter 10: I’ve Found You
chapters.html:
If he didn't still have his task to do, Phainon would have gone straight for the throat to silence him.

Mydei said, "Yes, I heard everything."

After his shock, Mydei went calm. He finally understood why Phainon had always hidden his identity. It was because Phainon was actually an omega. He couldn't be too flamboyant or he would draw all kinds of troubles.

After he understood, Mydei admired Phainon even more. As an omega, he could actually make it so far. He was even more amazing than an alpha.

Only someone like his idol could achieve a level that even alphas couldn't attain as an omega.

As a fanboy, he had to be biased towards his idol no matter what.

Mydei immediately said, "No matter what happens, my way of thinking won't change. I absolutely won't say anything about this."

Phainon sighed. He said, "The reason I never told you this isn't because I didn't trust you. It's just that if this gets out it'll be big trouble... Do you really not care? An alpha being the one to woo an omega... It's just ridiculous, isn't it?"

In this world, there were a ton of alphas who looked down on omegas. They thought omegas could only stay at home, taking care of children... For some people, as soon as they knew their genders, even if they were close before, their attitudes would change.

Of course, Phainon didn't have any prior experience with something like that. Everything he said was just based on his impression of the original novel. After all, in the original novel, omegas were really just pretty, useless flower vases.

"No, you are you. Even if you're an omega, my desire to woo you hasn't changed at all." As though he was afraid Phainon wouldn't believe him, he got down on one knee, looking into Phainon's eyes. "Gender or anything like that wouldn't affect anything. My intentions will never change."

The first time Phainon saw Mydei get on one knee, he was scared silly, but now he felt a bit used to it. But the previous two times were both when Mydei didn't know his gender. Now that he knew his real gender, it was obvious what Mydei thought about the situation.

When he saw Phainon hesitate, Mydei bit his lip. Internally, he knew that if he answered wrong, Phainon might not have the same faith in him anymore. His mind flew into a panic. He grabbed Phainon's hand.

"I'm willing to sign a contract. If I say anything about this, I'll never fight with a mecha again... If I do this, might you be able to believe me?"

Phainon was stunned. After all, Mydei had such a high status. Phainon himself had suspected that he had simply been humiliating Mydei... But Mydei was even willing to make such a concession. If Phainon was Mydei, he would have walked away without looking back.

He knew very clearly what mechas meant to Mydei. Being, shockingly enough, willing to write such a contract... It was enough to see how resolute Mydei was.

In that moment, Phainon felt a bit emotional, though his emotion was worth absolutely nothing.

Mydei was perfectly happy to do it. Ever since he met Phainon, he felt more and more like he had found the goal he was chasing after. If he couldn't stay at Phainon's side anymore, he would feel terror in the depths of his heart.

Compared to Phainon, even if he used to like mechas, they were incredibly boring now... If his opponent wasn't Phainon, even if he could continue piloting mechas, he couldn't feel happy at all.

"I believe you." Phainon inhaled deeply. "Let's pretend nothing happened at all and just go about our lives normally when we go back to school."

In any case, even if Phainon was still a bit skeptical, he couldn't really beat Mydei to death... It was really a hopeless situation.

"Alright." Mydei's eyes gleamed. He said, "Then I'll continue preparing snacks for you."

Phainon: "...!" Hey, is it really okay to have such wifely virtue!

---

And so things were resolved as such. After all, education was very important. That afternoon, the two of them got on the airship, returning to the capital planet. On their trip, there weren't any accidents like what had happened on the way out of the capital.

Phainon felt he had been a bit mean. He just tossed a Zerg in heat outside. If that person was really crazy in heat, he might have even been seized by police.

Still, Phainon hadn't heard anything about a youth assaulting someone on an airship. It should be all fine.

Soon, Phainon and Mydei separated. Mydei's worry was obvious, but he didn't say anything.

When Phainon went back to Caelus's house, he discovered that Anaxagoras had already left. Phainon let out a breath of relief. He wasn't really used to a character like Anaxagoras. He always felt like he was being seen through.

Although he hadn't done anything to feel guilty about, either.

Caelus was reclining on the sofa, his ash gray hair like a Grey Catbird's feathers, his almond-shaped eyes fixed on Phainon. His elegant facial features were full of arrogance.

Phainon sighed emotionally. Despite his terrible temper, Caelus was extremely attractive.

"You were gone for a long time. Weren't you just going home for a bit? There was nothing big happening." Caelus was fuming. "Do you know how much trouble you caused me being away these days?"

Wasn't the only thing missing someone to feed you at lunch! Can't you get used to eating by yourself!

"It was all my fault, I'm truly sorry." Phainon knew how to deal with Caelus. Anyway, he could think about whether it was really his fault after he apologized... And with the system's plug-in, Phainon's apology sounded extremely sincere.

"Hmph." As expected, Caelus didn't spit out anymore venom. He just said, "I've been training hard recently, I think I've gotten much stronger. Do you think if I participate in the upcoming mecha competition I can make it to the finals?"

The mecha competition in reality was much more of a hassle than the mecha competition in the virtual world. Registering alone had many procedures, and it was impossible to completely hide identities like on the virtual net.

Similarly, getting hurt in the competition was a real injury. Of course, these competitions were more prestigious than competitions on the virtual net.

Obviously, Caelus wasn't asking to hear Phainon's opinion. He was looking to hear praise first.

Even more falsely, Phainon praised, "I'm sure that with your abilities you'll definitely be able to make it to the finals. Nobody else can compete with you!"

"Well, of course." Caelus looked satisfied. Suddenly, he added, "Say, aren't you curious about why I'm participating in the mecha competition?"

"Huh?" Phainon was confused. "You need some other reason to participate?"

Though he was very clear about why Caelus wanted to participate, he definitely wouldn't act like he knew

"It's got nothing to do with you. Go away." Caelus looked annoyed.

Phainon: "..." Why the heck did Caelus seem even more bothersome to deal with? Was it because he had fallen in love... Well, it didn't have anything to do with him.

Phainon turned away, making to head up the stairs. Tonight was Prince Latiao's first match in the finals. He still had to get ready properly.

"Wait." Caelus suddenly spoke again. "I'm going to go train today, so don't do anything, just go with me. You look too weak to stand a gust of wind. If you don't train properly, I'll be embarrassed to take you to school."

Phainon: "Oh, um..." Wait, he had an important competition tonight! And Caelus wasn't watching, but was instead going to train? Phainon had the feeling that he might be scheming something bad.

"Don't tell me that you have something tonight and you can't come?" Caelus looked casual.

"Oh, um, I want to watch the mecha competition finals. Isn't Prince Latiao fighting tonight?" Phainon didn't think there was anything worth covering up, so he didn't beat around the bush. "Isn't he the contestant you're cheering for? Aren't you going to watch tonight?"

"Now that I think about it, is there something about Prince Latiao that you know and I don't know?" Caelus said. "After all, I don't really like interacting with people. I'm not very clear about what happens on the virtual net."

I already know you don't have friends...

Phainon bolstered his shamelessness and boasted, "Oh, if it's about that, I'm not too clear about it either, I just think he's amazing. He must be a formidable alpha in reality."

"Mm, exactly. You're right." Caelus thought back to what his brother had said, feeling like he had read into it too much.

Prince Latiao was an omega, and he could tell that Phainon was someone who hadn't met very many omegas before... As for Mydeimos, after he confessed online and became the president of Prince Latiao's fanclub, he must have met Phainon in the fanclub.

Caelus relaxed completely, waving a hand casually. "Then we won't train tonight. Go ahead and leave."

Phainon: "!" Although he didn't know why, he felt like he had missed a very big problem by a hair.

---

The arena for the finals was different than the previous ones. It was several times larger, and the entirety of the match would be broadcasted live. They even had people to commentate.

The seats were filled with onlookers, and there was a clear demarcation between the two sides' fans, seeming diametrically opposed.

Phainon's opponent this time was a contestant who ranked in the top forty. He was a middle-aged man named Rex.

"The contestant on this side is Rex. He's only thirty-seven this year," the host introduced. "This is already his fifth time participating in the mecha competition. I'm sure everyone feels like he's very familiar. In the past, he was only able to advance a single round. Will he achieve victory this time?"

The camera changed to Phainon's side. A big, bulky mecha plastered with all kinds of ads appeared on the screen.

Exactly-in order to get more ads, Phainon had changed to the biggest mecha.

The people who had heard only about Prince Latiao and never seen him in real life were shocked, but Prince Latiao's fans were proud. In their words, "An ordinary person couldn't get so many ads even if they wanted to. This is the symbol of our idol's strength."

"Um..." The hosts had never seen such an impoverished contestant. They were stunned for a moment before they explained, "This is the newcomer, Prince Latiao. Although it's his first time competing, he's shockingly strong. In a short timespan, he fought his way into the finals. Who knows how he'll perform?"

The host had another bout of boasting about the contestants' performances before starting the competition.

Rex looked towards Phainon with disdain. "Though this Prince Latiao's pretty strong, he's just too young. He doesn't have much combat experience, and his movements are choppy... He's far from my level."

Because he didn't have the privacy protection up, his words made it straight onto the screen. In seconds, Prince Latiao's fans were unhappy.

"Hmph." Rex continued, "And who knows what kind of person has so little confidence in their appearance. If you're still hiding your face at this point, I bet you've got some kind of problem."

Of course, he wasn't suddenly taunting him for no reason. He just wanted to rile up his opponent. If his opponent lost his reason, it would be easy to get at his weak points.

Phainon was thinking along the same lines as Rex. As soon as the match started, he maneuvered his mecha to charge forward.

"You can't keep your cool now, huh?" Rex moved to fight back gleefully, but reality was different from what he expected. Although Prince Latiao's movements were choppy, he was faster than he expected. Before his every attack, Prince Latiao had already disappeared.

Forget about aiming for a weak point to seize victory. If it wasn't for Rex's rich experience, he might have been humiliated in a loss right off the bat.

"Dammit, you're just a little brat." Rex gritted his teeth.

They engaged in combat a few more minutes. From Rex's perspective, their strength was about equal, and they were in in a deadlock. For the moment, there was no way to seize victory.

"I didn't expect this brat to be so strong..." Rex was a bit shocked, but he felt even more unhappy. He had worked so hard for years to climb up to his spot. How could he give in to this brat so easily? "But you just got unlucky facing me. You should just come back next year."

Rex had been hiding his true strength from the beginning just so he could erupt now. He attacked fiercely, but Phainon dodged it stubbornly. It looked like Phainon was completely disadvantaged.

But Phainon had done pretty much the same thing. Exactly-he had also hidden his strength from the beginning.

Although Phainon had always stuck to fighting a quick battle, this time there was something unexpected.

When an advertising company was negotiating with Phainon, they said that as long as his match lasted for longer than ten minutes, the compensation would be tripled.

Under the seduction of money, Phainon had been going easy in the beginning without any moral integrity... If Rex knew he might choke on his anger.

To outsiders, their match looked like a thrilling struggle. In fact, Phainon was only using a portion of his spirit to face Rex. He hadn't brought out most of his strength.

Still, it was more strenuous than how he normally fought as he pleased. If it wasn't for the fact that he wanted to maximize the time the audience saw the ads on him in order to get even more ads in the future, Phainon wouldn't do such a thankless job.

If this was the real world, it would be hard to say, but in the virtual world, it wouldn't be an exaggeration to say that there were few people who could be Phainon's match... After all, based on spiritual strength, these people were who-knows-how-many leagues away from Phainon. The opponent he feared the most was the person with the protagonist halo, Khaslana.

Prince Latiao's fans looked towards the battlefield anxiously. Ever since they had become Prince Latiao's fans, there had never been a battle that took more than ten minutes.

"Why is today's match dragging on for so long? I guess the opponents in the finals really are different," someone said nervously.

"Hmph, I think your Prince Latiao's done for," one of Rex's fans jeered rudely. "That Prince Latiao of yours has just been crushing weaklings. When he's facing an expert as skilled and experienced as Rex, he certainly won't last long before he fails. Hmph."

Many people at the match thought the same. After all, it was more realistic. Some of Prince Latiao's fans were losing hope. They liked the Prince Latiao who could sweep his enemies in one go, but now they had to face with the harsh reality that their idol wasn't the strongest."

Mydei was also watching, but he worried even more. He was afraid that Phainon wasn't at his normal standards because the omega inhibitors had lost their effect.

"It looks like Prince Latiao has really met his match this time," one of the commentators narrated, watching Phainon continuing to dodge. "Although Prince Latiao's strong, Rex has experience with five years of competitors. I don't think Prince Latiao's situation is looking too good."

Just as everyone thought the winner was pretty much decided, the situation suddenly changed.

"Time's up." When Phainon thought of the huge sum of money that would be entering his bank account later, a smile appeared on his face, and he looked up at his opponent. "I'm really sorry, but let's end this now."

Just as Rex was attacking in glee, he discovered Prince Latiao had begun to fight back.

"It's too late. If you fight back now, all you'll do is work yourself up into a frenzy," Rex sneered, thinking that his attacks had upset Prince Latiao's rhythm. He seized the opportunity, raising his weapon to stab at Phainon's vitals and getting ready to finish their match then and there.

But in the next moment, Prince Latiao's mecha avoided the blow in an incredibly difficult maneuver. From a tricky angle, he thrust forward.

Before Rex could react, the cockpit of his mecha had been skewered cleanly. If this was reality, the pilot would be dead, but in this virtual world, the contestant was just forcibly ejected from the competition.

At the same time, Rex and his mecha both faded away from the battlefield.

Everyone looked on in shock. It had only been a few dozen seconds since they thought Prince Latiao was sure to lose. In those few dozen seconds, Prince Latiao had suddenly triumphed, just as if the heavens were on his side.

Prince Latiao's fans began to shout in excitement, and the people who had said Prince Latiao was going to lose wished they could bury themselves in a hole.

The commentators were also stunned, then hurried to explain, "It looks like this was Prince Latiao's tactic. First, he fakes weakness to confuse his enemy, then he seizes the opportunity to fight back. Based on his counterattacks, we can see how amazing his operation skills are."

After Phainon finished his task, he planned to ignore the ruckus and leave the field.

Just as he was checking whether the money had been deposited into his bank account, Phainon suddenly received a message.

The message was pretty much the same as the letter of challenge that Caelus had sent in the beginning. The letter expressed a desire to battle Phainon one-on-one, and there was no worry of being seen by other people. He had purposely chosen somewhere without a crowd. Moreover, regardless of whether Phainon won or not, he would receive two million empire coins.

Phainon: "!" If it wasn't for the fact that the letter's tone was totally different from Caelus's, he would have thought Caelus had come to pick a fight again. But this person was even richer than Caelus!

The empire's so big, so there are so many rich tyrants_(:3」∠)_

Although Phainon felt there might be something wrong, under the seduction of money, his soul was stirred and completely unsteady. He agreed without another thought.

When Phainon arrived at the arena the other party had mentioned, it was just like it was described in the mail, empty without a single spectator... For a moment, Phainon felt a little unaccustomed to it.

A mecha was standing in the opposite corner. His opponent had also screened their personal information, and it was impossible to tell who it was. Similarly, the mecha was extremely ordinary. It was the most widely used mecha, and it didn't have any individuality at all.

Was another opponent doing this to test his strength? Despite his thoughts, Phainon didn't care about these things. In any case, it was fine as long as he had money. If every one of his opponents came this way, he would make a fortune instantly.

Of course, not everyone was as much of a spendthrift as Caelus...

The competition system beeped, and the match began.

Phainon focused his attention, but the opposing mecha suddenly rushed at him.

Phainon was stunned. His opponent was lightning quick, and they reacted speedily when they dodged. They were completely unlike any opponents he had faced before.

If it wasn't for the fact that Phainon's spiritual energy could keep track of the entire field, he might have lost already. Yet it was also precisely because of his spiritual energy that he could pay attention to all kinds of details, and it was how Phainon noticed exactly how terrifying his opponent was.

"Who the heck is this?" Phainon's mind flew through thousands of possibilities. He kept feeling that the most likely person was Khaslana, but Khaslana wouldn't bring out two million empire coins to give to his enemy.

After a flurried exchange of blows, the two of them fell into an impasse.

Phainon could use his spiritual energy to crush his enemy, but he typically didn't want to do it. Just as he was hesitating, his opponent's spiritual energy suddenly reached over.

Because spiritual energy was a very mysterious thing, it was practically impossible to prevent someone else from coming into contact with him while he was operating a mecha. Still, everyone would pay more attention to their own spiritual energy. After all, if something happened, they would be left in a vegetative state.

But, shockingly enough, he had met someone who was so careless. The last time he met someone like this, it was that arrogant, bold, carefree guy, Caelus.

In the next moment, their spiritual energies touched.

Phainon froze. He felt that his opponent's spiritual energy was a somewhat different from an ordinary person's. Still, he had only felt Mydei's and Caelus's spiritual energy before. He might be feeling it wrong.

A typical person's spiritual energy was bright like the sun, but this person's felt gloomy and clammy. Being squeezed close to a spiritual energy like this made Phainon feel incredibly uncomfortable.

Soon, the spiritual energy began to probe deeper. Last time, when Caelus did the same thing, he had discovered Phainon was actually an omega. This time, Phainon wouldn't let this person do the same thing. He immediately hardened his heart, banishing the other person's spiritual energy and abruptly crashing into their spiritual world.

Phainon felt like he had arrived in a sinister world. His limbs were slowly going cold. He was starting to feel like he shouldn't have used his spiritual energy so rashly.

"Ahh, this is exactly the feeling... I finally found you." A low voice rang out, sounding like it was right by Phainon's side. The voice chuckled slightly.

"?!" Phainon jumped in shock, withdrawing his spiritual energy almost unconsciously. He maneuvered his mecha to retreat rapidly.

What was up with this person? Why were they so scary... He felt like he had transmigrated into a horror movie.

His opponent's mecha didn't look like it would chase after him. It was as though this fight was just to feel him out. In the next moment, it faded away from where it was standing. His opponent had actually withdrawn.

"Wait, system, what was that just now? How come he could talk?" Even if he was going to get two million empire coins, Phainon couldn't forget what had just happened. He had been scared to death.

[When spiritual energy is high enough to be at a certain level, it's possible to use spiritual energy for interrogation. It's a similar principle with the spiritual transmission in cultivation novels.]

"I see... Well, as long as it's not some mysterious magic." Phainon let out a breath of relief.

But what the heck did that person mean? "Found you"? Who was it? Who was looking for him? He just felt really uncomfortable hearing it.

Forget it... The other person was completely anonymous. Even if Phainon wanted to find him, he would be able to. Rather than getting tangled up in something he didn't know about, he might as well be realistic about it.

So Phainon left this alone temporarily and logged off.

After coming out, Phainon felt a sudden wave of vertigo. His body was beginning to feel hot, and he felt incredibly ill. His limbs were weak, and he fell over immediately.

"Crap, i-is this an oncoming heat like I've heard about?" In the dry heat of his body, Phainon was dumbfounded. He attempted to reach for his bag to get the medicine inside.

Based on this ABO novel's settings, a typical omega would start heats after they finished maturing. Phainon had been fully matured for a long time, but he had been constrained because of the inhibitors.

He had heard that heats would be even more strong like this. If he didn't roll around in the sheets for a few days and nights, he wouldn't be able to calm it down.

If Phainon was a gay, he would die of happiness, but he thought of himself as a straight guy! He had no choice but to reach for his medicine with difficulty, hating his past self for not keeping it on him.

There was a knock on the door. Caelus's voice came from behind it. "Have you slept yet? I want to talk with you a bit."

"Fuck!" Caelus's sudden visit made Phainon break out in cold sweat. He had barely managed to prop himself up, but he nearly fell back down.

When he thought about it, shouldn't someone like Caelus just kick open the door and burst in? He had become so polite. It was really unscientific.

No, this wasn't the time to be thinking about how Caelus became so polite.

Perhaps because Caelus had shocked him into his senses, Phainon suddenly regained a bit of energy. He scrambled to grab the inhibitor in his bag, managing to twist it open with trembling hands. He grabbed a pill and swallowed it.

The medicine was extremely effective. Within a minute, the heat in Phainon's body settled, and his heat was pushed back down. He was now clearheaded, as if what had just happened was a dream. He didn't feel so weak anymore either.

Phainon quickly put away the medicine and aired out the room, getting rid of the omega pheromones that might have overflowed into the room.

Although Phainon couldn't feel it himself, alphas were extremely sensitive to omega scents. If he was discovered, he would be done for, so he pulled out a bottle of perfume that he had never used before, spraying it all around the room. The fragrances intermingled. Even an alpha with the keenest senses couldn't smell any omega scent anymore.

When he finished, Phainon went to the bathroom to take a quick shower, putting his sweat-soaked clothes to the side and changing into a new set of clothes.

When he finished, Phainon went to open the door, freshly showered.

Phainon said uncertainly, "What happened? What do you need me for?"

"You let me wait so long? You've really got some guts." Caelus looked over, arms crossed across his chest and looking unhappy. "My time is precious, you know."

Who's fault was it for coming over to look for someone so late!

"I truly apologize." Phainon was already well-practiced. Even if he was roasting Caelus silently, he kept a remorseful expression up on his face. He said quietly, "I was just taking a shower, so I didn't hear you... So, what did you need?"

"Nothing much. I just wanted to ask how you're feeling recently. After all, as the master I need to pay some more attention to our servants' situations." Caelus looked haughty. These kinds of action were the ones that made people want to give him a beating the most.

"It's great," Phainon said. "The room and board are both great." And all he had to do was keep Caelus company. It was super relaxed. At least it was better than keeping Anaxagoras company.

Although he had only exchanged a few sentences with Anaxagoras, Phainon felt guarded against him.

"Well, of course. Nobody would dare to look down on the dukedom. Still," Caelus said, frowning, "why does your room smell so weird? It's disgusting. Your sense of smell's got some problem..."

In order to cover it up, Phainon had no choice but to make himself look bad. "...Well, actually I like it like this. I can't sleep well unless it smells like this."

"I really don't know what to do with you. Don't do something like this outside. Alright, go and rest." Caelus humphed and left quickly.

Phainon guessed that Caelus hadn't noticed anything and let out a breath of relief. When he closed the door, he realized he had broken out into cold sweat, but he didn't have the energy to go shower again. He gave up and got in bed.

The day had been full of too much excitement. He had nearly been discovered by Caelus. Still, he couldn't keep going like this. He might be able to fudge it once, but next time might not be so easy.

It looked like he needed to find a way to move out.

And in the hallway, Caelus, who had turned to leave, had a somber expression on his face, and his hands were clenched tightly.

---

In the heart of the capital planet.

Anaxa looked uncertainly at the inhumanly beautiful teenager on the screen. "Your Highness, why did you suddenly call me back again?"

Recently, he had found many interesting things in the empire's military institute, though he hadn't found Prince Latiao's true identity. But Anaxa had looked into Khaslana's matters.

"You don't need to keep looking." Nanook had a slight smile on his face. "I've already found part of it on my own... In comparison, there are other things that need you more. Having you investigate is really a waste of your talent."

"It's as you say. I'll defer to your instructions." Anaxa knew that even if they had grown up together, Nanook had never believed in him. Chances were that this was also a decision made based on other factors.

In any case, he would stop looking into this.

"By the way, I've been a bit tired lately. Arrange a few rest days for me next month. I'm going to take a vacation," Nanook said.

Anaxa was stunned. In all his years of knowing Nanook, it was his first time hearing him say he wanted to take a vacation... Before this, he thought His Highness the Crown Prince was a working machine.

"Understood. I'll arrange it for you."

---

The next day, Phainon discovered that Caelus had practically become a new person.

Although Caelus was hard-working before, now he was training like he had no other purpose in life. He was using up almost all of his free time. Every night, he would be exhausted to the point that he could barely move.

Phainon didn't expect he would work so hard just for the mecha competition. He felt a bit surprised.

Though Phainon thought about leaving, he could never find a time to tell Caelus. He could only put it on hold for the time being.

In any case, with Caelus so exhausted, he wouldn't be able to see anything wrong.

And during that time, the inhibitors that had already been losing efficacy finally stopped working completely.

Phainon finally understood how great it was to have an inhibitor that could work for ten-odd years in one go. Now, he had to take an inhibitor every day in order to control himself, or his omega pheromones would start to diffuse.

Mydei seemed like he didn't know that Phainon was an omega. He acted exactly the same as he did before, and didn't change because Phainon's gender changed.

If it wasn't for what had happened before and how exciting it was, Phainon would wonder if he was dreaming...

Phainon thought that being a fan on the level of Mydei was amazing. Still, thinking about how much the novel's Mydei liked Khaslana, even if he didn’t get to be with Khaslana. Phainon probably didn't need to worry about it.

The next few competitors in the mecha competition couldn't match up to Phainon at all. He rose directly to first place of their group. By this stage, even more people Prince Latiao's strength.

Before, there were people who said that he was just a low-grade Khaslana copycat. If anyone said that now, his fans would rip into them. Besides, it was obvious that Prince Latiao's strength wasn't that much different from Khaslana's. Slowly, there was nobody who would say it anymore.

Khaslana had also succeeded in becoming number one. Of course, his success was more of a journey. There were several times that he had nearly lost, but in the end he was victorious.

As Khaslana watched videos of Prince Latiao, who he expected to be his opponent, his expression turned unhappy.

In the beginning, he thought Prince Latiao was just trash copying him. He didn't expect that the other person would climb step by step up to this level and even be equally matched with him.

Khaslana had always been the one above everyone else. There had never been anyone who stepped into his position.

Still, for now, Khaslana just didn't like Prince Latiao. The person he hated the most was still the evil, ever-present person who had taunted him several times and managed to win over him somehow, Phainon.

"For some reason, whenever I see Prince Latiao, I think of that guy." Despite his thoughts, Khaslana didn't think too much of it.

Although Prince Latiao had always kept his identity hidden, everyone knew he had to be an alpha. On the other hand, Phainon was just a weak, potato-level beta. Even if Khaslana didn't like Prince Latiao, he wouldn't bring Phainon into the conversation.

"Even like this, won't he become my subordinate anyways?" Khaslana smirked.

---

After the small group competition ended, the last ten people were basically the strongest people in the competition. Of course, there was an element of luck involved.

By now, their popularity had pretty much reached the peak. The person who received the most attention was the undefeated Prince Latiao, but it was different from the beginning. Now, most people thought that Prince Latiao must be a seasoned veteran who had dozens of years of experience.

Compared to a middle-aged person, a student like Khaslana had more future prospects.

Phainon wasn't happy about being stuffed into the box of a middle-aged person at all.

Besides, there was still half a month before the ultimate finals would take place. During that time, there would be all kinds of publicity and even merch of the competitors (when Phainon saw it, he was really shocked).

Still, even if this was happening, Phainon didn't know why exactly it had been dragged out for so long... When he thought about the original novel's plotline, Phainon felt that everything was secondary. The most important thing was to let Khaslana be promoted.

Exactly. The next thing that would happen was the most important event in original novel.

And in this plotline, Khaslana's strength would surpass Mydei's.

Chapter End Notes

The Author Has Something to Say: This was supposed to be two chapters but I'm really excited for the next couple of chapters so I decided to just get this one out in one go. Everything from next chapter onwards is very exciting! Some more flags were planted in this chapter with Khas, Caelus and Nanook. Hope you enjoy! <3

chapters.title: Chapter 11: Battlefield (Pt.1)
chapters.html:
Chapter Notes

CW: Non-Con Kissing (One of them is asleep)

In the original novel, the five major military institutes of the empire would soon join to hold a competition on a remote planet.

In the original novel, Khaslana had, of course, also gone.

The planet was quite dangerous. The surface was filled by an ancient, towering forest, and within the forest, there were all kinds of alien beasts and poisonous plants.

These alien beasts were unintelligent, and they couldn't leave the planet. They couldn't compare to the danger level of a Zerg, but it was difficult for these students, who only had weapons and couldn't use mechas to face them.

But with the help of his strength and his physique, Khaslana took to the situation like a duck to water. Later, he found an ore in a hidden cavern that could strengthen his physique, and his strength rose up another level. It even stimulated the imperial blood in his body, and thus he discovered that his father was actually the emperor.

Basically, this plot point was an important turning point in the original novel.

Generally speaking, someone couldn't go and snatch the original protagonist's opportunities. If it went poorly, the world consciousness would lock onto them and kill them straightaway. But when Phainon remembered how the ore could increase his strength, he was intrigued.

Still, these were all things that happened later. Right now, what he had to worry about was how he would complete his daily task after binding to Khaslana!

Phainon felt that compared to Khaslana, all of his previous capture targets were angels (._.)

Regardless of how much Phainon was dreading it, that day was coming up soon.

Every new student had to go to the competition, even if they were the kind that just came over to the academy hang out. Phainon didn't know whether or not the original host had thought about the competition when he came to hang out. After all, in the original novel, he had been expelled.

Everyone got on the airship with excitement. The empire's military institute was the wealthiest of all the five major institutes, and it had the most students from noble and imperial families. Naturally, the airship was very comfortable. It could compare with a luxury tour airship. Even the rooms were double rooms.

Then problems began to occur.

Phainon and Caelus were assigned into one room.

When Phainon found out, he was ready to curse up a storm. The more he didn't want something to happen, the more likely it would happen. He was getting more and more unlucky these days... But it was no big deal as long as he didn't get put in a room with Khaslana.

A spoiled rich kid like Caelus would naturally prepare a ton of luggage when he traveled. After all, how could someone of his status make do in the wilderness?

Phainon grabbed a few clothes at random and some things that he thought he might need in the wilderness, then went to help Caelus with carrying his luggage.

"There's no need." Caelus turned to look at him and said, "With the way you look like a gust of wind would blow you over, if you help me with my luggage people will think I'm treating you poorly. Besides, I have a space button that I can put them in."

Phainon let out a breath of relief. If he had to carry the luggage for such a long time, he really wouldn't be able to last... He had also forgotten that there was something like a space button. Still, in the future, a space button was extremely expensive. It was usually used to store a mecha. Only someone like Caelus would use it to store luggage.

Phainon carried his own luggage and got ready to leave, but Caelus stopped him in his footsteps, looking cold. "Give your luggage here too."

"Huh???" Phainon was stupefied.

How could someone who disdained betas as much as Caelus be willing to put someone else's things with his own things? And this "someone else" was even his family's servant. Caelus's favorability score for Phainon was still at zero, too.

Still, people changed. Phainon didn't read into it too deeply and handed his luggage to Caelus.

After the students gathered, they began to board the airship one by one, and the people everyone paid attention to the most, Khaslana and Mydeimos, were assigned to the same room.

After the airship took off, nobody could calm down. They assembled in the airship's training room and began to temper themselves.

Caelus was, of course, not an exception, but when he was preparing to go train, he received a message. He frowned, heading towards a hallway in the airship that was relatively more isolated.

Mydei had already been waiting there for a long time. In front of outsiders, he looked aloof and like he kept people at a distance. Even if he was standing in the most bustling place on earth, nobody would have the courage to approach him.

"What did you want me for?" Caelus said impatiently, looking over with a frown. "My time is precious, you know."

"Let's change rooms," Mydei said coolly, looking like he was disgusted but had no choice to speak.

Caelus snorted. "And what if I don't want to? If I change rooms just because you said to change rooms, what should I do with my reputation?"

"Don't you admire Khaslana a lot?" Mydei was about to lose his patience. "You're still not happy when you've been given a chance to get in close contact with him?"

When Mydei mentioned Khaslana, Caelus froze.

For a while, ever since he had fought with Prince Latiao, he had unconsciously pushed Khaslana to the back of his mind. Even during the finals of the virtual mecha competition, he hadn't paid attention to Khaslana's matches.

Now, the overflowing admiration he had held for Khaslana had disappeared completely. When he thought of Khaslana, he didn't even think of him more than he would of a passerby.

Yes, because he had found someone even better now. Khaslana was no longer important.

"That's in the past. Now, I already..." Caelus looked like he had thought of someone. His expression was complicated. Immediately, he continued, "Anyway, I don't have any interest in Khaslana anymore. Isn't he your close friend? You want to avoid living with him that much?"

If Khaslana knew that he had been shunned by these two people, and was even being thrown around like a hot potato, he would be furious.

"You know what my goal is," Mydei said frankly. "If you have any conditions, name them."

"Hmph. I really don't know what it is about a beta that has drawn your attention," Caelus said. "No matter what else happens, don't think about changing rooms. I absolutely won't agree... I've got stuff to do, so I won't keep wasting my time with a guy like you."

When he finished speaking, Caelus turned to leave without the slightest hesitation.

Mydei watched Caelus leave. His deep green eyes iced over, killing intent seething in his gaze.

---

Meanwhile, Phainon laid down to rest in his room as soon as he finished his meal. How could he have the heart to go train when he thought of the situation he was faced with? He should take the chance to enjoy himself a bit while he still had the chance.

And now he was staying in the same room as Caelus. If his inhibitors expired, he was done for. As Phainon thought, he took out a bottle of medicine and swallowed a pill, finally feeling more at ease.

Dammit, who thought of a terrifying ABO setting? He felt like he really couldn't endure until the end, alright!

Although Phainon didn't want Khaslana to level up, he also wanted him to level up. This way, he could leave the world quickly.

After he finished his medicine, Phainon felt himself getting sleepy. He laid down in bed and fell asleep.

At some point, the door opened. Caelus's silhouette appeared in the doorway.

When he saw that Phainon was sleeping, Caelus kept even more quiet. He closed the door tightly, walking slowly to the side of his bed.

Phainon was sleeping fitfully. His brow was slightly furrowed, as though he was dreaming of something bad.

Caelus extended a hand, caressing Phainon's forehead. His movements were a little stiff. He had never tried to touch someone so gently.

Phainon's eyelashes suddenly quivered. Caelus froze, but he didn't pull his hand back.

After a moment, Phainon didn't show any signs of waking. He continued to sleep soundly.

"...Rest well," Caelus said in a low voice. He lowered his head, planting a soft kiss on Phainon's cheeks.

"Mm..." Phainon mumbled.

Caelus's pale cheeks flushed completely red instantly and he raised his head in alarm. He looked back at Phainon, who didn't stir, feeling a sense of defeat.

"Dammit, you cheat, being so cunning... You clearly knew all along, but you never said a word to me. Do think of me as a joke?"

As Caelus spoke, he thought back to how he had people whip Phainon the night they first met. His mood sank.

"So what exactly do you think about me..."

Caelus looked at Phainon, lowering his head helplessly. He kissed Phainon on the lips. He could only feel how soft those lips were, becoming intoxicated in moments. He used his tongue to probe between Phainon's teeth.

A sticky, liquid noise sounded in the room.

After a long time, Caelus finally lifted his head, his face scarlet, and wiped his mouth of silvery threads of saliva. He unconsciously moving to undo Phainon's buttons, reaching out to press Phainon down and lowering his head to nip at Phainon's fair, slender neck.

Though it was already weak, he could smell the faint fragrance at such a close distance. It made him recall the day that he had fought with Prince Latiao, as well as that night.

He had never told Phainon that even with all kinds of fragrances around the room, that faint omega scent was so clear that there wasn't any smell that could cover it up. Even a slight sniff would make someone sink into an inescapable trance.

And now, if he bit down, Phainon would be marked by him. Phainon could be his.

But Caelus let out a breath, looking at Phainon who was sleeping calmly. As though he was venting, he reached out to pinch Phainon's cheek. "You dummy."

---

The airship arrived at its destination by the second day. It was a planet that looked beautiful from a distance. From its appearance, it was impossible to tell what kind of dangers were hiding within.

Normally, there was nobody who would come to this planet. After all, it was dangerous and had no resources worth mining. There was simply nobody who would come besides for thrill seekers.

Phainon yawned, disembarking from the airship. He had slept so early yesterday, so why was he so tired today?

And he didn't know why, but his neck hurt a bit. Maybe he had slept wrong... Phainon had no idea what had happened yesterday. He even felt that yesterday had been peaceful.

The only problem was Caelus's temper early that morning. Of course, Phainon was already used to this.

The planet's air quality was excellent, and just smelling it made him feel refreshed. When he tilted his head back, there was a never-ending forest before his eyes.

It was pretty good to look at it from a distance, but as soon as he thought about how his future days would be spent inside, he wasn't happy anymore.

Most of the students from other had already arrived. Everyone gathered at a simple and crude base. Despite the short time, there were already several students disputing with students from other institutes.

Phainon noticed that there was a group of students from the neighboring military institute clustered around a youth. He looked familiar, and Phainon unconsciously looked back at him several times.

Next to him, Caelus became unhappy. "What's there to look at?" He followed Phainon's gaze and discovered a beautiful teenager. He immediately snorted. "That guy's not even as handsome as I am."

Phainon: "..." Hey, why are you competing over something like this!

The teenager noticed Phainon. He turned towards him, smiling slightly.

Caelus's fury washed over him again. He stepped in front of Phainon. "You can't look."

Phainon had no idea how looking at the students from the neighboring institute had got on Caelus's nerves, but he finally remembered. Wasn't this teenager the Zerg he had met on the airship the other time?!

Fuck, he didn't expect to meet him again somewhere like this. He didn't expect a planted Zerg agent would actually sneak into one of the five major military institutes... Still, this was pretty normal, huh.

The Zerg in this world were fairly different from the Zerg in the previous world. Most importantly, the lower class Zerg in this world couldn't change into human form, but higher class Zerg could change their form at will. Moreover, their spiritual energy and strength was innately strong.

It was perfectly normal that a higher class Zerg coming over to act as a sleeper agent could simply join one of the five major military institutes... It was under such grave circumstances that Khaslana could drive these Zerg away. It was all thanks to his plot armor.

In any case, he was walking fast last time and the other person hadn't seen his face. Phainon turned away like nothing had happened. He didn't want this Zerg villain to drag him in.

Although the empire's military institute was famous and had the support of the imperial family, it wasn't the most impressive academy. The other academies had their own strengths.

Students didn't get along with those at other academies. Every few years, they would compete, and the victorious academy would become the number one institute for those few years.

This competition would be based on the students' wilderness survival skills. They would have to make it through the primeval forest to their destination, and they couldn't use their mechas or weapons with high destructive power. They could only use cold weapons.

When the competition was mentioned outside, everyone said the purpose was to train their unity and cooperation, but everyone secretly knew that if they could take the lead in this competition, they could say they were winning glory for their school and get even more opportunities in the future. Thus, everyone fought like their lives depended on it.

Of course, they were ensured safety in such a dangerous place. Every student received an emergency alarm. If anything that was serious enough to threaten their life and safety, they could press the alarm, and a teacher would come to their rescue immediately.

But pressing the alarm was an automatic forfeit. It was a more embarrassing method of action.

Phainon didn't care about being embarrassed. Going through the forest with his trash omega body? It was obviously impossible. He might as well just forfeit. The only thing was that forfeiting right at the start was a bit embarrassing, so he would endure for two or three days and then forfeit.

The teachers told everyone a few things to take note of, then divided everyone into groups by drawing lots. There were two people per group, and they would have to stay together for these few days. If one party forfeited, the other person would also lose their opportunity.

Khaslana's student ID was earlier in the numbers. He walked directly up on stage and tapped on the screen casually. The numbers stopped immediately.

Everyone in the audience was worked up. They all knew how strong Khaslana was. How wonderful would it be if they could be paired up with Khaslana! They might be able to achieve a grade they had never obtained before.

Phainon completely ignored the scene. According to the original plot, Khaslana would be paired up with Caelus. It had nothing to do with him.

Khaslana spoke. "Number 154."

Wait, why did this number sound familiar?

Afraid to face reality, Phainon lowered his head to look at his student ID. Number 154.

"Classmate Phainon, what a coincidence! It's truly a blessing." Khaslana walked over, a slight curve on his lips. He stood before Phainon, extending a hand. "I'll be in your care."

Blessing? This is just a curse, okay!!

Why was he the one who got Caelus's chance from the original novel... Phainon had thought that the competition would be a bit more difficult. Now, he felt like he was sending himself to his death.

Though competition had as many safety measures as possible, there had been several students who had died in accidents in the past since it was hard to predict what situations might arise in the forest. In the original novel, Khaslana had offed several of students from other academies who had come to provoke him. It was easy to imagine what was in his future!

The surrounding crowd had complicated expressions. Phainon reached out a hand, almost completely stiff, and shook hands with Khaslana. He could only feel his cold sweat. "I'll be in your care..."

Meanwhile, Mydei and Caelus had been paired together. It was obvious they hadn't expected this situation.

Taking the circumstances into consideration, Mydei walked over, suggesting that his and Khaslana's group advance together. He reasoned, "Two people is too few, and we have better chances with four people. At night, we can take turns keeping watch. It'll be much safer."

Mydei sounded very reasonable. Plenty of people moved as a group of four because of their relationships. There even some who proceeded as groups of six or eight.

Khaslana naturally had no objections. If people as strong as Mydei and Caelus joined his team, it would benefit him.

As for Phainon... Khaslana chuckled. Ever since they had come to this planet, he had no plans to let Phainon leave alive.

Caelus just sneered, giving Phainon a sidelong glance. "I'm only agreeing to come and take on this task because of how weak you are."

Phainon grabbed Caelus's hand in excitement. He said, moved, "Thank you so much, you're amazing!"

Caelus had basically saved his life! Although he knew Caelus probably came for Khaslana, and his words just now were just acting cool to hide his soft spot for Khaslana, Phainon was very emotional.

Caelus froze. His face immediately turned red. He blurted, "What are you doing? Who gave you the right to hold my hand?"

Despite his words, he didn't make any move to throw him off.

Mydei noticed his movements. His eyes focused on where their hands were touching, his gaze turning cold.

---

The four of them headed towards the forest as planned. Though they didn't meet any other academy students, everyone had silently agreed to separate. Nobody would take the same road as someone they saw as their opponent. They were too afraid of being plotted against.

Although their group was strong, Phainon didn't have high hopes... He felt that it was already pretty good as long as these guys didn't mess around. Khaslana in particular had to seize the opportunity. It would be good if everyone could reach the end point.

The beginning of their journey went smoothly. As they went on, the road got more and more difficult to travel. There were all kinds of shrubs all over. While the other three alphas were still full of energy, Phainon couldn't keep going. He was panting in exhaustion.

It was lucky that the other three people were all alphas. Phainon could muddle through with the excuse that he was a beta. If their squad had another beta to compare Phainon to, then he wouldn't have any self-respect left.

"I knew you'd be like this." Caelus turned to look at him, looking disdainful. "As soon as I saw you, I knew you'd drag down our squad. If you really can't keep going, it's not impossible for me to piggyback you."

Phainon was given a huge shock. The first half of Caelus's words were fine, he was used to it anyway... but what was with the second half?!

Was Caelus always such a good person? He was even willing to carry a beta classmate from his team during a competition. Phainon had even expected that he would sarcastically suggest their two teams go their separate ways.

Even if Caelus was affected by what happened with Prince Latiao and no longer discriminated against betas, he wouldn't be so intimate, right? This was already OOC, okay!

"Or do you not want it?" Caelus narrowed his eyes. "Even I don't mind, but you mind?"

"N-no, I just..." Phainon hurried to explain, "I think I can keep going for a bit, I won't impose on you."

Rather than letting Caelus piggyback him, he would be better off gritting his teeth and enduring a bit longer.

"Hmph," Caelus said. "Then let's keep going. If you can't keep up, don't come running to me for help."

Phainon gritted his teeth and endured for part of the way, but he really couldn't manage any longer. He nearly tripped over a tree root. Just as he was about to fall to the ground, Mydei, who had been silently paying attention to him, caught him.

Because of Phainon's instructions, Mydei still kept a delicate distance between them. Now that there were only four of them, he didn't care so much. He said, "It won't work if you keep going like this. I'm stronger than Caelus. I can defend myself better. Let me carry you on my back."

While putting himself forward, Mydei casually stepped on Caelus's reputation.

Phainon approved greatly, because Mydei's words were too true. It was easy to tell based on the system's choice of the capture target who was the stronger one.

"What do you mean by that?" Caelus immediately got into a bad mood. He glared at Mydei. "You're saying I'm not as good as you?"

"That's not what I mean," Mydei said calmly. "I'm just telling the truth."

Caelus's expression turned ugly, but most importantly, he had no way to retort. He just grabbed Phainon's hand. "Say it, who do you want to carry you?"

Phainon: "???" Fuck, why would something like this happen now?! Khaslana is still on the sidelines watching, okay!

Forget about Mydei, but what the heck was Caelus getting in on the action for? But if Phainon didn't let Caelus piggyback him this time, he would definitely kick up a big fuss. After all, he was that kind of person.

One the other hand, Phainon wasn't worried about Mydei. After all, he had always been very reliable, and his personality was much better than Caelus's. He should be able to understand his choice this time.

So Phainon gave Mydei an apologetic look and chose Caelus.

"See? As expected, he chose me." Caelus gave Mydei a smug glance, then put Phainon onto his back. He said, "You'd better hold on tight. I won't be paying attention to you while I walk."

Despite his words, Caelus was very attentive, afraid that Phainon would get scratched by any branches.

Mydei froze. For a long time, he didn't move, and he quickly fell behind the two of them.

Khaslana walked over. Calmly, he said, "Although you want to be kind to someone, they don't seem to want to accept your feelings."

"This has nothing to do with you," Mydei said. "I'm very clear about what he's thinking, and I can understand his actions." He did understand what Phainon was thinking, but he still couldn't really accept it.

But Mydei blamed himself. How could he think Phainon was doing the wrong thing? Phainon couldn't do anything wrong. Everything was Caelus's fault... Exactly, everything was because of Caelus.

"Oh?" Khaslana's lips curled up. "But you don't look very happy... Is it so hard to accept what you think? Do you think you'll be repaid what you have been given? Sometimes, even if you give, you won't get what you want."

Although Khaslana wasn't completely clear on what had happened between Mydeimos and Phainon, he was happy to drive a wedge between them. It would be best to make that damn Phainon learn what it was like to be completely isolated and alone.

"No, I've never thought that way. I'll be happy as long as I can stay by his side..." Mydei suddenly gritted his teeth, looking at the people ahead of him. But he had no choice but to admit that in that moment his heart was filled with a raging fire of envy that almost consumed half of his rationale.

He had never felt such envy since he was born, but ever since he began to stay at Phainon's side, he had almost always felt these kinds of feelings. It was insufferable agony, but he endured it as he had before.

At the beginning, he had just wanted to stay at Phainon's side, but human desires were without an end. As long as they got one thing, they would want even more.

If he was the only one at Phainon's side... it would be wonderful.

Mydei had thought the same thing many times, but now he couldn't restrain himself anymore.

Mydei's expression iced over. He stared at the people up ahead, but he felt relaxed in a way that he hadn't felt in a long time. He finally understood what he had to do.

Extraneous people like this shouldn't have existed in the first place.

Khaslana watched Mydei's expression change and left, smiling.

But he didn't know that Mydei wasn't thinking about betraying Phainon because of his words. Instead, he was filled with killing intent for Caelus.

---

After entering the forest, a few alien beasts began to appear. These beasts looked similar to normal animals, but they were even more horrible.

When he first saw an alien beast scurry out into the open, Phainon was given a terrible shock. He was able to relax after he saw Khaslana kill it easily using a pocket knife.

Even though they looked so terrifying, since they could be killed with an ordinary weapon like that, it seemed that they weren't so hard to deal with. In comparison, those Zerg who could shift into human shape and blend into society were even more scary.

The sky was turning dark. They decided to find a place in the forest to rest.

Caelus had brought a tent specially designed for leisure. It was very convenient, and could pitch itself with the press of a button. He also took out some delicacies and water out of his space button. Who knew if he had come to compete or to vacation.

The tent that Caelus had prepared was quite large. It could fit two people.

Although Caelus wasn't exactly willing, they collectively decided to let two people keep watch and the other two rest. They would switch every two hours.

When they drew lots, Phainon and Mydei were paired up, and Caelus and Khaslana were paired up.

Although Caelus wasn't happy, when he thought of his victory from earlier and how he had carried Phainon the entire way, it was no big deal if he just stepped back for the night watch. This way, he wouldn't make trouble.

Khaslana laid in the tent soundlessly. Even though they were so close, Caelus had completely forgotten his admiration for Khaslana. His mind was full of Phainon, and he couldn't sleep at all.

Though something like that had happened the first time they met, Phainon forced a kiss on him the second day, and he even stayed after that. Phainon always stayed by Caelus's side, and this time he had chosen him over Mydeimos... Could he believe that Phainon had some feelings for him?

When he thought back to the first kiss, Caelus felt a bit embarrassed, but his heart filled with sweetness.

Outside the tent, Phainon was resting against a tree listlessly, looking at the bonfire. He nearly fell asleep several times. He couldn't stop himself from yawning, and his eyelids were closing involuntarily.

Mydei watched him, his heart pained, and said, "If you're truly to tired, go rest first. There will be no problem with me here."

Phainon shook his head, struggling to speak. "No, I can't sleep right now..." If he slept at this kind of time, he had a feeling that something bad would happen.

At some point, the time ticked past midnight. The system's voice suddenly rang in Phainon's mind.

[Daily task refreshed. The current task is [Force a kiss on the capture target once]. Host, please do your best.]

Phainon was immediately jolted awake.

Chapter End Notes

The Author Has Something To Say: AHHH System are you trying to be a wingman or not??? Your gonna be a problem later but while we are bound to Mydei its all good. I hope you all enjoy this arc its going to be my favorite with many squeal worthy moments <3!

Happy Reading!

chapters.title: Chapter 12: Battlefield (Pt.2)
chapters.html:
Phainon had thought that the system had gotten more restrained recently. He didn't expect that it had been brewing up a big move! It even issued a task like this at such a time. Phainon suspected that it had an ulterior motive... No, there was no need to suspect. This system had dedicated itself to fostering gays.

If he didn't finish up this damn task now, it would be even harder to do it tomorrow when everyone was moving together. Phainon absolutely couldn't imagine what it would be like if he forced a kiss on one of the three men.

But it wouldn't be very good if he forced a kiss on Mydei now. Mydei would certainly think of him as gay, and with his personality, there was an 80 or 90 percent chance that he would give himself over to Phainon... The scene was too stunning for Phainon to have the nerve to keep imagining it.

The only method was to take the chance to complete his task when Mydei was sleeping. That way, nobody could see him, and Phainon would be fine, Mydei would be fine, and everybody would be fine.

Phainon relaxed, sitting back to wait at the fireside.

Soon, it was time. Caelus came out from the tent with dark undereye circles, fixing his eyes straight on Phainon and Mydei. He didn't relax until he saw that they weren't even sitting very close to each other.

Caelus didn't sleep at all in the last two hours. Instead, he had been thinking up all kinds of possibilities, worrying that Mydeimos would take the chance to seduce Phainon outside... Exactly. At that moment, in Caelus's mind, Mydei had already become the mistress trying to wedge between him and Phainon.

On the other hand, Khaslana had a good sleep and woke up well-rested, as though he didn't care about whatever problems there were between the other three people.

"Well, we'll go and rest now." Phainon stumbled towards the tent, practically falling asleep on his feet. He could barely keep his eyes open.

Phainon had to admit that Caelus knew how to treat himself well. The tent was well-soundproofed, and as soon as he walked inside, all the noise outside was silenced. There was a mat on the ground made of some kind of unknown material, and it was extremely comfortable. It was almost like he had gone back to his own room... No, his own room wasn't even as comfortable.

But Mydei sat down at a spot closest to the outside. He was extremely vigilant, looking as though he wasn't planning to sleep.

If Mydei didn't sleep, how was he supposed to complete his task! Phainon hurriedly said, "It's already so late, you should come rest too. We'll still have to keep watch in another two hours."

"How could I sleep by your side?" Mydei said quickly. "I'm alright just sitting here. I don't trust the others. At a dangerous time like this, I should be here to protect you."

Phainon said, "...You don't need to think so much, at least for now. You should come and rest."

Mydei: "But I..."

"You already worked hard during the daytime, didn't you? If you don't sleep at night, how will you manage to keep going?" Phainon racked his brains for an excuse. "If you don't rest now, you'll have even less energy tomorrow. Even if you're an alpha, you're not made of stone, right?"

Mydei thought the same. "I suppose you're right. Please excuse the offense." With a little embarrassment, he sat down by Phainon's side, laying down.

They were close to each other, so close that Mydei unconsciously slowed his breathing and pressed his hands unconsciously to his chest, afraid that Phainon would hear his rapid heartbeat.

If Phainon didn't have a task to do, he would have fallen asleep in ten seconds. Now, in order to complete his task, he had no choice but to keep himself lively and keep a constant eye on Mydei.

When he noticed that Mydei was pretty much asleep, Phainon sat up, soundlessly inching towards Mydei's side.

Mydei was sleeping peacefully, his soft blonde hair mussed. In his sleep, his expression was cool and his features looked as though they had been carved by a master sculptor.

When Phainon first met him, he couldn't imagine that there would ever be a day that Mydei would stay by his side with such an attitude.

"Sorry... I..." Phainon felt a hint of guilt. He sighed, reaching out to brush Mydei's hair away. He bent over, aiming his pale lips for a kiss.

In his nervousness, Phainon didn't notice that Mydei, who should have been in deep sleep, had his hands clenched, and his ears had turned unnaturally flushed.

Exactly. Mydei wasn't asleep. How could he fall peacefully into slumber when he was next to his Deliverer? When Phainon leaned in sneakily, he thought that Phainon was about to do something and he got nervous. He didn't expect that Phainon would actually kiss him.

Mydei's heart pounded. He had never thought he would get so close to Phainon. He was happy as long as he was by Phainon's side. Although he would occasionally have thoughts about getting closer to Phainon, he had never thought of something like this.

Rather than saying that he didn't want to think about it, he didn't have the nerve to think about it. Mydei had placed Phainon on a pedestal in his mind. It would only blaspheme Phainon if he was together with Mydei.

Just as their lips touched, the system's task completion notification went off. At the same time, the tent was suddenly flung open.

Caelus, who had found an excuse to come because he wasn't at ease, saw the kiss as soon as he looked in.

The tent tore with a sharp sound. Caelus almost couldn't believe his eyes. He clutched a piece of the ripped tent in a death grip.

Phainon whipped his head up to look over in shock. "?!"

Fuck, what kind of drama was this, huh! Why did this storyline, where he got caught trying to steal a kiss, feature the three of them, who didn't have any feelings above friendship?

He might as well just say that they didn't even have friendship.

Luckily, Caelus didn't have any romantic intentions towards him. Phainon thought for a moment. He could only use gay methods to muddle his way through (besides, it was very normal for betas to like alphas in this world!). Although it was humiliating, it was better than being a pervert who attacked in secret.

"...I didn't expect you to spot me." Phainon was alarmed, then said, "Um, actually- actually, the person I've always liked is..."

"Stop." Caelus cut Phainon off.

Phainon: "Huh?" Was there some reason he couldn't say it?

"How could you... How could you be like this?" Caelus's expression was incredibly ugly. He strode over, grabbing Phainon's hand. "Aren't I the one you like? How could you do something like this with someone else? You even want to try and confess to someone else right in front of me."

Phainon: "Huh???"

Wait, at some point in time Caelus had dreamt up something crazy?

"No... Have you made some mistake...?" Phainon fumbled with his words.

"A mistake?" Caelus was nearly exploding in anger. He gritted his teeth. "Fine then, tell me, if it's a mistake, if you don't like me, then why would you kiss me?”

Phainon: "Huh? T-that was actually because..." Why was something that should have already passed soundlessly coming back out for interrogation?

He had already forgotten this dark past. He didn't expect that Caelus would still remember.

"Actually, I lost my sense of reason after being whipped, so that's why I did something like that." Phainon finally thought of an excuse. "I'm really sorry..." Still, Caelus had already retaliated, though it was with that kind of method.

"What do you mean? You want to deny the things you did yourself? You just seduced me to throw me away... Yes, you just want to toy with me, don't you?" Caelus gritted his teeth. "You want to retaliate against me because of how I treated you at first."

He was just getting a few lashings at the beginning, it didn't have anything to do with seduction! Did he not understand ABO worldviews or something?!

Phainon felt that his and Caelus's understanding had deviated at some point. "No, I don't mean anything like that, if I wanted to get revenge against you, I would have done it ages ago. Besides, don't you like Prince La-ahem..."

Caelus looked furious. He pressed Phainon down under him, lowering his head, and pressing towards Phainon's lips.

Phainon: "!!?"

At that moment, Phainon was stupefied. How in the world did things turn out like this? These shocking lines were something that would only appear in an overdramatic soap opera. Why did someone who had zero favorability towards him do something so absolutely terrifying after catching him kissing another person?!

He must be dreaming... If Caelus was like this when he didn't look down on betas, why didn't he just go and pretend that he was a gay who liked alphas!

Caelus raised his head, looking much calmer, but his eyes were unusually serene. He reached out to cup Phainon's face. He spoke as though he was asking Phainon, but in fact it was to comfort himself. "I know that you actually like me. In the past, we were just at odds with each other. The things you did with Mydeimos were also just to provoke me. It's fine... I can understand it all."

Phainon: "...You know my real identity?" This was the only possibility.

"Yes. I've known for a long time," Caelus said. "Nothing you said to me before was random, right? When you said you wanted me to enter the mecha competition, it was just to encourage me, am I right?"

Caelus's tone didn't sound like he was asking a question. It sounded like a forceful statement.

Phainon: "...Y-yes." If Phainon said that he was actually fooling him, Caelus would definitely beat him to death.

Still, it was hard to figure out how exactly Caelus thought. It was simply unrealistic that he had known about this and kept it hidden for so long.

"I knew it... You did it all for me. It's fine. I won't be mad," Caelus smiled slightly, leaning down to hug Phainon.

But Phainon was nearly shocked out of his skin by the way Caelus treated him so well.

Caelus look at the space at the side, his voice cold. "Alright, now a certain someone can stop faking sleep, can't they?"

Next to them, Mydei jerked into a sitting position, his sunset eyes cold enough to freeze over. He gazed back at Caelus with a death stare.

Phainon: "You're awake?" Wait, faking sleep? Was Mydei not asleep just now? Phainon suddenly felt like he couldn't live to the next day.

"Yes," Mydei said, "I'm awake, and I know what you have done."

"..." Phainon was ready to choke on his blood. "Nonono, it's not what you think... Actually, it's..."

"I don't mind," Mydei said. "I just want to know why exactly you acted like this... I can accept it regardless of your reason."

"What reason do you still need?" Caelus snorted. "Wasn't he just toying with you a bit?"

"You..." Mydei looked at Caelus, gritting his teeth. He couldn't control the gloom he was feeling, and he aimed at Caelus's face with a swing of his fist.

Caelus didn't expect him to lash out. The attack sent him crashing to the ground. He coughed, covering the swelling red mark on his cheek. He looked towards Mydei with a smirk. "I hit the nail on the head, didn't I? It looks like you know a bit about yourself. In this case, why don't you just take the chance to step out early?"

"Watch your mouth." Mydei looked at Caelus coldly. "Everything was said under threat. I really have no idea where you're getting the courage to gloat."

"Hmph. So what if I gloat?" Caelus looked at Mydei with fury. "You bastard. You act so lofty on the surface, but behind you shamelessly seduce someone else's partner in secret? Do you think that you're so great because you're the crown prince's cousin?"

"What did you say?" Mydei sneered. "You know for yourself what exactly happened. I'm sure you're also very clear about who's the shameless person using threats."

Phainon, who was still laying on the ground: "???" Huh, wait, why were these people suddenly catfighting? And Caelus's lines were really too awful.

Forget it. With these kind of circumstances, saving himself was probably more important.

Phainon scurried towards a safe spot. When he was hiding behind the trees, he saw that the two of them had already got their weapons ready to begin to fight. Each and every blow was aimed to kill.

It was lucky that the competition had said they couldn't bring mechas. Otherwise, if they had brought out their mechas to fight... then this would stir up the entire institute-no, even more than the entire institute. It would stir up the five major military institutes.

Just as the fight was growing intense, a hand suddenly set itself on Phainon's shoulder, and a voice rang out. "Don't you think that rather than paying attention to other people right now, you should pay a bit more attention to your surroundings?"

Phainon whipped his head back around and saw Khaslana with a face full of a smile. His heart stuttered.

Khaslana said, "I really didn't expect that a beta would manage to get those two to reach this stage. Still, everything is going to end now."

Phainon said hastily, "Wait, if I die, won't you fail the assignment?! Didn't you want to get first place in the competition?"

"You're right. In this case, I'm in a bit of a tight spot," Khaslana said. "Still, the rules said that if one party forfeits, then the other person loses their opportunity, but they don't say anything about what happens when one party dies, hmm?"

Fuck, this goes too?!

Phainon unconsciously stepped back, but suddenly he stepped into the air, and his body fell backwards.

Was there a slope here before? Phainon couldn't remember. After all, Caelus had carried him the entire way. He didn't notice any of the surrounding terrain at all.

In his moment of peril, Phainon suddenly grabbed onto Khaslana's clothing, but he didn't expect that Khaslana didn't have a steady stance either, and both of them fell.

The slope was incredibly steep, and the two of them went tumbling down. Phainon only felt that his entire body ached, he was sprawled completely on the ground and unable to move.

On the other hand, Khaslana was alright. After he dusted himself off, he looked perfectly normal. After all, he was an alpha, and his physique was significantly better than Phainon's.

"I didn't expect that you would be so calculating, but I underestimated you. This is a great place to kill someone, and there's no need to worry about being found out, don't you think?" Khaslana looked at Phainon with an eyebrow raised, He had a smile on his face, like he was certain that Phainon had no way to escape. He strolled over at an extremely relaxed pace.

Phainon, sprawled out on the ground, quickly used his healing ability to heal himself. Luckily the system's cheat really was strong. In moments, it healed the injuries in moments. At the same time, he played dead so Khaslana wouldn't notice anything.

"You really are an eyesore." Khaslana walked in front of Phainon, taking out a dagger and using the other to prop up his cheek. He said softly, "I can still remember your arrogant expression from the first time I met you in the institute as clear as day. Back then, you spoke like I couldn't hold my head high in public because I came from the slums. I really miss it."

Phainon: "..." Actually, he wasn't the one who did that, ahhh!

"The people who mocked me back then already learned their place and left the school. You're the only one who's been hobbling around in front of me." Khaslana sneered. "The ghost truly does linger. If it wasn't for the fact that I wasn't able to kill you, I wouldn't let you live until now."

Phainon: "!" He didn't want to stay in the institute and keep bumping into Khaslana! The fright was wrecking his emotions, okay!

But with the current circumstances, he had no choice. Phainon gritted his teeth. "Do you still not know my feelings? In fact, when I first taunted you, it wasn't because I looked down on you. It was to attract your attention!"

He was basically powerwashing himself clean. Phainon was just throwing words out. The chance of success should be close to zero.

"Shut up." Khaslana's expression sank. He thrust the dagger into Phainon's wrist, pinning his hands to the ground.

Phainon's forehead beaded with cold sweat, but with the system's pain blocker, the pain was about the same level as being bitten by a kitten or a puppy, and didn't hurt too much.

"Are you joking? Do you think I'll believe you?" Khaslana said. "Ever since you won against me, there was no chance I would let you live in this world."

Dammit, if you have the guts then go kill everyone who wins against you!

Phainon was ready to die from his anger, but he thought about how the original Khaslana seemed to have really killed the brats who had won against him when he was young and in the welfare institution... He really was a cruel person you couldn't cross, but what could Phainon do if he had already crossed him!

"Where should I go for?" Khaslana wrenched the dagger back out, looking at Phainon with a slight smile. "If I kill you so easily, it would be too easy, wouldn't it?"

Phainon's hand shrank back, afraid that Khaslana would go crazy and stab him a few more times.

"Since we're already at this point, then I'll cripple your limbs first, then give you half an hour to run for your life. What do you think?" Khaslana said uncaringly. "If you can escape, then I'll let you live."

Phainon's expression turned ugly. "No..."

This was just a damn villain in a horror movie! He had actually thought of something so disgusting. Phainon knew that Khaslana was a male lead who would seek revenge for a single look, but he didn't expect him to be so twisted.
