"Yes, that's good. I bet that you're happy to die this way, aren't you?" Khaslana said, grabbing Phainon's other hand with even more strength and stabbing down at Phainon's wrist.

That was the right moment!

Phainon took a deep breath, letting his spiritual energy surge towards Khaslana.

After being attacked by the spiritual energy, Khaslana fell into a daze.

That was his chance! Phainon suddenly sat up, pushing Khaslana down and wresting away the dagger in his hand.

When Khaslana reacted, he looked at Phainon in shock. "You have such strong spiritual energy?"

Ever since he was born, Khaslana had never met someone with stronger spiritual energy than him. After he achieved SSS-rank spiritual energy on the assessment, he finally realized that his spiritual energy might be the strongest in the empire. But now there was someone stronger than him... And that someone was Phainon, who had always performed poorly.

"Right, so what? You should be worrying about yourself." Phainon threw Khaslana's own words back at him.

Just now, Phainon's spiritual energy had rushed over Khaslana's spiritual energy, stifling it in moments and making him unable to move. He was as pathetic as he had been arrogant, but Khaslana still chuckled and said, "Since I wasn't skilled enough, then you can deal with me however you want. Don't use something useless like a fist. Why don't you use the knife you're holding?"

"..." Phainon sank into silence.

"You can't do it, can you?" Khaslana spoke as though he knew Phainon wouldn't do anything to him. "After all, you're just an ordinary person, so ordinary it's sickening. There are enough people like you on this planet. It doesn't matter how many of you die."

"How do you know I won't do anything?" Phainon lifted his wrist. In moments, the cut that Khaslana's dagger had dug in his arm healed, but the mental trauma Khaslana caused wouldn't heal so easily.

Although he wouldn't be able to complete his task if he killed Khaslana, would it be fine as long as Phainon injured him?

Phainon looked at Khaslana's long fingers, his mind unnaturally calm. Coolly, he said, "Your hands are quite elegant." Then, without the slightest hesitation, he stabbed the dagger deep into Khaslana's hand, splattering blood everywhere.

Phainon didn't expect anything too scary. He just wanted to do as Khaslana said, that's all. Khaslana could experience what he said for himself. He should be quite happy.

"Ngh...!" Khaslana had to grit his teeth before he could endure the pain. He didn't have the same pain blocker cheat as Phainon, but he forced a mocking smile onto his face. "Just this little bit? This isn't nearly enough for me."

"It's just what you said. There's still your other hand, or..." Despite his hesitance in the beginning, when Phainon saw Khaslana's face, his hesitance mostly disappeared.

Again, he stabbed deeply into the other wrist. Khaslana immediately groaned, cold sweat dripping from his face. He panted heavily, but he still provoked Phainon. "You want to torture me with something like this?"

Phainon would see things through to the end. Khaslana was ready to kill him anyways. It was no use no matter how he tried to suck up. He might as well take the chance to vent his anger... Although he would be trading his future peace.

But he had already caused Mydei and Caelus to fight. Phainon felt that he probably had no destiny with the word "peace".

After a few rounds of suffering, Khaslana's clothes looked like he had been scooped out of the water. There were bloodstains all over, and he was almost passed out where he was laying.

Phainon could get tired out from just using spiritual energy alone. Now that he had tortured Khaslana, he was even more exhausted. He wished he could crawl into bed, but if he went to sleep in front of Khaslana he would definitely wake up to something terrifying.

What was scarier was that Phainon's body was suddenly turning hot... Fuck, he suddenly realized that the terrifying heat had come again!

But his heat suppressant medication was still in the tent. He didn't know if Mydei and Caelus's fight had destroyed the medicine at the tent either... But even if it wasn't destroyed, there was nothing he could do. With his condition, there was no way he could go back and get it.

Why did all the messes come in together? This was indeed the fate of a cannon fodder.

Phainon lowered his head to look at the unconscious Khaslana. He gritted his teeth, searching for somewhere close by. He knew not to stay close by an alpha during his heat. He would just let this Khaslana fellow off this time. As for heat or whatever, it should pass if he endured a bit. He would go back at dawn.

Phainon staggered to his feet, struggling towards a more concealed location. The better locations were all full of all kinds of trees. He thought to himself, If I meet some kind of alien beast, I'm done for.

Then, as if the world had abandoned him after he beat up the original protagonist, an alien beast suddenly scurried out from the side.

It was a giant insect that was the height of a man. It looked terrifying enough that it could act as a villain in a horror movie without the slightest photoshop. Of course, it still fell a bit short of being the final boss.

Phainon: "!" Fuck, did you have to come so quickly? Didn't he just beat up the original protagonist! Fine, beating up the original protagonist was pretty serious.

Some time had already passed since he used his spiritual energy... But if he used it now, his body might not be able to hold on.

Phainon gritted his teeth, wanting to use his spiritual energy as the only weapon he had, but because his energy had been exhausted, he collapsed toe the ground. Naturally, his spiritual energy didn't exert itself either.

At that moment, the large insect walked closer again. Phainon could practically see the insect's pincers. His heart pounded. Was he going to get his lunchbox like this!

Just as his life was hanging by a thread, the large insect hesitated, then quickly retreated several steps. Finally, as though it had encountered its natural enemy, it fled speedily.

Phainon let out a breath of relief. Wait, this wasn't the time to sigh in relief! He did his utmost to sit upright and look over, and he spotted a head with pale blonde hair and golden eyes in the distance. It was a teenager with a friendly smile.

"What a coincidence... We meet again." The youth greeted him cheerily.

Phainon was stunned. "Thank you so much for this... I-it really is a coincidence. I didn't expect that you would remember me." Wasn't this guy the Zerg! No wonder this large insect was scared off! It had probably scented the Zerg's pheromones. Still, why did it happen right at such a time...

"Of course I remember you." The teenager walked over to him slowly, extending a hand to lift his chin. "After all, you were the one who saved me on the airship. I could never forget my savior."

Phainon was way more than a savior. He was also the guy who worked him up into a heat and ran away.

Phainon felt like the way he managed to avoid getting beaten up was lucky enough to win the lottery. "..."

He had completely miscalculated. Sure enough, if they weren't noticed, Zerg could blend into other living beings. They could distinguish other people by scent alone.

It seemed like meeting this youth here wasn't an accident. The other party had followed his scent to seek him out.

Phainon couldn't expose that he knew the other person was a Zerg, or he would be silenced.

"Your body is so hot. It looks like you're not doing too well," the youth said, noticing the other parts of Phainon. "Your clothes are all torn, and your skin is exposed... By the way, you came alone, too. Something must have happened, right?"

Phainon hurriedly said, "It's nothing, I'm fine. I just lost contact with my teammate when I ran into that alien beast just now. I just need to rest for a moment and I'll be fine."

He shouldn't mention the enmity between him and Khaslana. Besides, he didn't need anyone else to help him right now. What would he do if they discovered he was an omega?

"Also, I was wondering about this ever since earlier. Why do you smell like an omega's pheromones?"

Chapter End Notes

The Author has Something to Say: Oh~ Mysterious zerg kid. He's surely not gonna play a major role soon.....

Yay! New Chapter and I think this one is my favorite so far! The kiss with Mydei! Khas and Phai lowkey giving enemies to lovers. Like I cant be the only one imagining them looking hot injured, sweating and still trying to gloat XD. See you all next week!

chapters.title: Chapter 13: Zerg Kid
chapters.html:
Phainon was given a huge shock by the teenager's words, but because of his heat, he was too dizzy to think clearly. He couldn't explain himself even after a long time.

"Are you alright?" The teenager helped Phainon up, letting Phainon lean against him. "It looks like you're having a hard time, hmm?"

Phainon plastered himself onto the teenager's body unconsciously. The cool touch made him feel better, but the fever burning him from the inside out was impossible to bear. The worst part was the part below the neck that couldn't be described. If Phainon was clear-headed, he would wish he could die.

"I... I'm fine..." Phainon murmured over and over again with his last bit of awareness. His body went completely weak, and he could only lay weakly on the other person.

The color of teenager's laughing gold eyes deepened slightly. If he was just a normal, human alpha, the thick omega pheromones would probably have made him lose his sense.

"Yes, you're fine... Don't be scared." The teenager touched Phainon's back tenderly, his other hand cupping Phainon's cheek.

An omega in heat was incredibly sensitive. The teenager's slight touch was enough to make him shiver. If he was given more stimulation, like pressing their bodies together, or touching that most sensitive and most fragile place, it would be enough to make him orgasm.

The teenager leaned close to Phainon's ear, his voice low. "Because you're just in heat."

His words exploded into Phainon's ear like a clap of thunder. Phainon used the last ounce of his energy to begin to struggle, but of course his strength, even weaker than a kitten's, wasn't enough to throw off anyone. He had no choice but to pant, "No... I'm not an omega."

"Mm?" The teenager nuzzled his cheek, chuckling. "If you say you're not, then you're not. But you can't keep going like this either, am I right?"

The situation was clearly dangerous, but Phainon couldn't think. When he heard the teenager's tender voice, it was as though there really was no problem. His body even relaxed unconsciously, and he slowly calmed down.

If he had a little bit of reason left, he would know there was a serious problem.

"Good boy. Although it hurts a little, it'll pass quickly." The teenager arranged Phainon in a new position and picked him up, brushing over his nape gently.

"Nn...?" Phainon had a feeling that something bad was going to happen, but he couldn't get himself to react either.

The gland on the back of his neck was much more sensitive than other parts of his body. The touch made Phainon even more compliant. A mixture of feelings intermingled in his mind, making him sink into a daze.

The teenager lowered his head, gently taking hold of his neck in his mouth and nipping softly. He moved slowly until he was at the back of Phainon's neck, feeling the omega pheromones even more strongly.

Even though he wasn't human, he was about to go crazy.

He closed his eyes gently, and bit down.

The only thing Phainon felt was a wave of pain bursting from the back of his neck. It came with a strong pleasure that he couldn't ignore. His blood was boiling, and he couldn't stop gasping for breath, but he had exhausted his energy while struggling and was too weak to even lift a finger.

His last shred of reason realized... This seemed to be a mark!?

Then Phainon's vision blurred, and he fell completely unconscious.

The teenager opened his eyes, letting go of his nape and planting several kisses on the back of Phainon's neck. "...As I thought, it's not possible... This body is incapable of forming a complete mark."

The teenager looking down at Phainon, who was completely unconscious in his arms, cupping his cheek.

"We'll see each other again..."

When he finished speaking, he stood up. In just a few steps, he sank into the river, and his eyes lost their spirit.

At the same time, far away in the palace on the capital planet, an ashy silver haired gold-eyed teenager laying inside a nutrient cabin opened his eyes.

He sat up, beads of water dripping from his dazzling white hair and sliding onto a cheek that was renowned to be even more beautiful than the Rose of the Empire, the prince.

"As I thought, it's not possible... After all, that body was too weak. It's simply incapable of bearing my power. A few days was already the limit. I'll need to have someone go and retrieve that body."

He spoke softly, as though he disliked the annoyance that was about to happen. His brow furrowed slightly.

"...Still, next time it won't be such a bother."

Because he was already completely certain of that person's identity.

He suddenly fell into a daze, thinking of what kind of reaction that person would have when he discovered his true identity.

---

After some time had passed, Khaslana woke up, his limbs still aching.

If an ordinary person was injured like this, they would already be dead. Yet Khaslana was incredibly clearheaded, and he could feel acutely how serious his injuries were. It was the first time in his life that he had been so injured.

"Exactly... It's this feeling..." Khaslana reached up to press his wound, which was no longer bleeding. He pressed slightly, feeling the pain coming from the injury. Unexpectedly, he felt a faint sense of excitement.

His life had always gone smoothly, and he had practically never faced failure. But time and time again, he had failed against the same person.

He should be feeling fury, but he was getting more and more excited.

Compared to successes that he had gained too easily, failures like this were extremely scarce. Rather than someone that he could deal with easily, Phainon was like a rarity who burst into his world halfway through, shaking his always smooth-sailing life into uncertainty.

Khaslana seemed to have thought of something. "Hahaha... Hahahahaha..." He began to chuckle, but it was followed by hacking coughs.

Even though he was Khaslana, he had lost so much blood, and his emotions were high. For a moment, his head spun and his vision went fuzzy.

And when the necklace around his neck, his last remaining piece of his mother, dipped into the puddle of blood, it began to glow with a dazzling light.

With difficulty, he reached up to grasp the necklace. Khaslana's wounds healed at lightning speed. Although he looked like he was in dire straits, he didn't have a single injury.

Precisely. Khaslana's last reminder of his mother was a precious necklace that the emperor gifted to her. It was an ore that could strengthen this wearer's physique. When it touched Khaslana's blood, its remaining strength dissipated, healing his wounds completely.

"What is...?" It was Khaslana's first time analyzing this plain, ordinary necklace so carefully. After its display of power just now, the jewel of the necklace turned gray and shattered.

And there was a design engraved in the metal the jewel was set into.

It was the emblem that represented the imperial family. Nearly every member of the empire knew that the emblem practically represented the imperial family themselves. If anyone had the nerve to use the emblem without permission, they would get the death penalty.

Then why would the imperial family's emblem appear on the necklace his mother left behind for him?

Khaslana suddenly had a completely unrealistic guess about his background.

---

Meanwhile, Phainon woke up blearily. He could only remember that the Zerg bit his nape yesterday, and because he couldn't bear the mix of pain and pleasure he had passed out.

"Fuck..." Phainon's mind suddenly cleared up. He hurriedly touched the back of his neck, turning pale. "...I was marked??"

The original ABO setting had plenty of extra characteristics. For example, to maintain the protagonist's coolness, Khaslana had the innate ability to resist omega pheromones. Even if he smelled them, he wouldn't lose his reason. Later, when people sent omegas in heat over to him, hoping to befuddle Khaslana, they all failed... Still, wouldn't this make people think that Khaslana had a problem in that regard?

As for the matter of marking, if they were more pressed for time, it could only be a temporary mark, and the marked omega could only calm down.

Of course, completely getting rid of the problem of heats would still require a furious tumble in the sheets...

When Phainon realized this, he was shocked. He looked down at his clothes, which were still properly on his body, before he could let out a breath of relief. As for the mark on his neck, as if he'd go and think about it...

Now that he thought about it, that Zerg was pretty good. Other than biting him, he didn't do anything in particular.

To an omega native to this world, getting bitten on the nape was a terrible thing, but to Phainon, who had transmigrated into this world not even half a year ago, the back of his neck was no different than any other part of his body. He therefore even felt a bit grateful to the Zerg.

But if Phainon knew this Zerg's real identity, he certainly wouldn't think the same way.

If it was a human alpha who ran into him back then, something terrifying would definitely have happened.

"I'd better hurry back and get my inhibitors to prevent something like this from happening again." Phainon struggled to get up, but he discovered that his body was still achy and weak. Even lifting an arm was exhausting. He was so tired he felt like he had been run over.

Well, that wasn't wrong. Yesterday, Khaslana had caused him to go tumbling down the mountain, then he had an intense fight with Khaslana, and even stabbed Khaslana several times... And after that he went right into heat and a Zerg nearly put him to death.

And it all started because he forced a kiss on Mydei.

When he thought about it, Phainon felt incredibly unlucky. Although his secret identity wasn't exposed, the person most important to hide from, Caelus, had found out. He didn't know what he would do in the future, either... Ugh, he wouldn't go thinking about a problem so far in the future. The most urgent thing right now was to get out of here quickly.

Since Phainon really had no strength left, he had no choice but to use his previous method of continuously using his healing ability on himself. Yet the bite mark on the back of his neck seemed as though they were out of the scope of his ability. No matter how he tried, he couldn't heal it. Phainon could only pull his collar a little higher, trying to cover up where he had been bitten.

Still, as long as someone paid a little more attention to that spot, they would be able to see the marks.

Just as Phainon finally recovered most of his energy, a hideous giant insect began to approach slowly from a distance.

Shockingly enough, it was the same giant insect as the one from yesterday night. Though in daylight it didn't look as gruesome as it did in the evening, each feature was terrifying. Phainon was so disgusted that he would refuse to even describe the insect in detail.

"I'm surprised this bug hasn't left yet... It even turned back around." Generally speaking, if it had been scared off yesterday it should have ran away, right? It was just a low-grade bug, so what intelligence did it have!

Phainon was even more sure that it was because he had poked the son of fate, the original protagonist Khaslana, a few times with a knife, and therefore caused the world consciousness to set itself against him. That was why there was so much crap happening to him.

If they swapped to another novel, what cannon fodders would be able to take a knife and go at the protagonist without getting a lunchbox?

Luckily, after a night of rest, his spiritual energy was about enough that he could use it again. Phainon gritted his teeth, looking out at the giant insect, calculating silently in his head.

It would be better to use his spiritual energy when the insect got closer. Otherwise it would be ridiculous if he didn't even injure it and he was the one who couldn't last.

But in the next moment, there was a loud noise. Something flew out from behind him suddenly, piercing through the giant insect's body. The insect, unwilling to resign itself to death, thrashed its legs furiously, but it could do nothing. It slowly stopped moving, black fluid pooling on the ground. It was disgusting.

Phainon's first reaction wasn't celebration. Instead, he turned his head vigilantly. "Who's there?"

At a time like this, there was no guarantee a human would be safer than a giant insect.

But he just saw Mydei leap out from behind him, a gun in his hands. When he saw Phainon, he stored the gun into his space button.

"I finally found you." Mydei looked like he hadn't slept all night. He reached out anxiously to hold Phainon up, giving him a once-over. "Thank goodness you're alright."

Mydei had come down the slope himself and found human blood in the ground. He had nearly fallen apart, but because there was no body he clung to his hopes, searching everywhere.

"Didn't they say we couldn't bring firearms?" When he finished speaking, Phainon realized that his attention seemed to be on the wrong thing.

"Oh, this? Don't worry. As long as nobody sees it, it's fine. Who wouldn't bring some things for self defense when coming to a place like this?" Mydei said.

Phainon, who had not brought any good weapons (and even forgetting that he couldn't get his hands on them at all), felt like he had been shot right in the heart.

Still, he had a point. Who would go searching a space button who belonged to someone like Mydeimos, the crown prince's younger cousin, or Caelus, the son of a duke? Even if they knew there was something hidden inside, they probably wouldn't have the nerve.

"Yesterday, I lost my reason because I got too worked up and I was unable to stay by your side. It led to this situation. I truly apologize." Mydei looked like he wished he could throttle his past self.

"It's okay." Phainon thought that yesterday's events had been too much of a mess. "It was all because of me that you... If it wasn't for Khaslana attacking all of a sudden, things wouldn't have gone so far."

"I didn't expect he would do something so inhumane." By now, Mydei loathed Khaslana from the bottom of his heart. He had completely forgotten his initial appreciation for Khaslana's friendship. "How could he move against you? He's truly too ruthless."

If Mydei knew what Phainon had done to Khaslana, would he still say something like this...

"This is still..." Phainon changed the topic hastily. "By the way, what happened to Caelus?" Mydei had brought a fucking gun, so Caelus should be okay, right... Although he didn't care that much about Caelus, for better or worse they had been together for a long time. It was perfectly normal for him to be concerned about whether Caelus had died or not.

Mydei's expression cooled. It was obvious that he didn't want to talk about Caelus, but Phainon was the one who brought it up, so he couldn't not answer. He said, "After I hit that guy, he was injured. He ran away already."

Phainon: "...It's been hard on you." When he thought about it, Mydei could even bring in firearms, so it would be very normal if Caelus brought in some weapons for self-defense.

"Where did this blood come from?" Mydei finally noticed the bloodstains on Phainon's sleeves and clothes. Because it had been some time and Phainon had also fallen into the dirt, he wasn't able to tell just now. He immediately turned anxious. "Are you hurt somewhere?"

"No, these... these are all from Khaslana's blood." Phainon couldn't avoid the topic any longer. He could only say, "Yesterday when I was fighting with Khaslana, I got worked up, and I was a bit more ruthless... I don't know what happened to Khaslana after that, either."

Though a normal person would certainly have no way to walk off after getting stabbed all over, Pei Shijan was a man with plot armor on his side. No matter what, nothing bad would happen, unless it was something really too ridiculous.

"You truly deserve your renown. You can even fight an alpha down to such a state as an omega." Mydei's eyes sparkled. From the bottom of his heart, he praised, "Having the opportunity to follow at your side is truly the most fortunate occasion of my life."

Of course, even if Phainon wasn't able to beat Khaslana, Mydei would still think that being able to follow at Phainon's side was the most fortunate occasion of his life.

Phainon had a feeling that even if he lost Mydei would find a way to praise him to the skies.

"This isn't the most suitable place to converse. I'll lead you away," Mydei said. Out of the corner of his eye, he noticed the back of Phainon's neck, and he froze.

"Perfect timing. I was just getting hungry." Phainon didn't notice where Mydei's gaze was in the slightest. He was tired, hungry, and ready to sleep. Where would he get the extra attention span to notice what Mydei was looking at?

Besides, after interacting with him for so long, Phainon had confidence in Mydei. At first, he was completely on guard, but after meeting up with Mydei he relaxed. He got sleepy quickly and yawned. He said, "Mm... I still have omega inhibitors at the campsite... I have to go and get them."

"Alright." Mydei turned around, pretending that nothing had happened. He put Phainon on his back, heading back in the direction he came from.

It was clearly what he had been dreaming of for a long time, but his heart sank further and further.

To Phainon, their surroundings were full of forests that all looked the same, but Mydei walked as comfortably as if he was in his own backyard, and his pace through the woods was extremely nimble. He was even able to walk so smoothly that Phainon didn't feel much from his position on Mydei's back.

In those conditions, Phainon quickly fell asleep where he was sprawled out on Mydei's back.

If he hadn't transmigrated and was instead a native who had seen the strength of passerby alphas for himself, he would probably start feeling like Mydei's strength was simply inhuman... But even if Mydei was strong, he wasn't stronger than the strongest villain, Nanook, or Khaslana post-evolution.

When they arrived at the bloody hill, Mydei paid attention to the surroundings. He didn't know where Khaslana was. The blood on the ground had already dried up, but it was still disgusting. It was easy to imagine what had happened here yesterday.

If Mydei was to run into Khaslana now, he would fight him until they took their last breaths.

While Phainon was still asleep, Mydei took the chance to set him down under a tree, clearing up the ground a bit so that nobody could tell what had happened there.

Because Phainon was sleeping too deeply, he had no idea what was happening. When he woke up, they had already arrived at their campsite from yesterday.

It was a complete wreck. When the two of them started fighting yesterday, they fought with control. When Khaslana discovered that Phainon had evaded him, he pulled out any weapon he could. There wasn't a single space left intact.

Now, the area was a mess. The tent was even more tattered. At a glance, it looked as though some robber had swept their way through, and it was enough to make someone worry whether or not they could find what they needed inside.

Phainon nervously walked to where he had put his things down yesterday. He was pleasantly surprised to find that everything was still in one piece... He didn't expect that he would be so lucky during such an unlucky time.

It was okay not to have anything else, but he couldn't lose his omega inhibitors. Phainon went straight to take a pill out and stuff it in his mouth, and he felt the last shred of omega scent in his body dissipate before he could finally relax.

When Mydei saw him, he felt a bit worried. "I've heard that it can be a serious danger if you take too many of those inhibitors... A typical omega won't take them. Is there really no problem if you take them?"

"Well, there's no other way right now." Phainon shrugged. "Anyways, that's nothing to worry about."

Anyway, Phainon didn't have any intention of staying in this world for a long period of time. Ever since he sneakily healed the original host's mother with his healing ability when he went back to the host's house, he was prepared to leave at any time.

But Mydei's attention wasn't swayed but Phainon's words. His gaze turned even more complicated.

Was he imagining things? Why did he have the feeling that Phainon would leave him at any time and go somewhere that nobody could chase after him...

Phainon put away the rest of the things that were still of use. He remembered how Caelus and Khaslana had ran off somewhere, but the rules were that two people had to arrive at their destination to succeed. When Phainon reached that point of his train of thought, he gave up on it.

In fact, based on their power as four, they wouldn't have had any problems at all. It was just that within a day they had an unforeseen mishap....

Speaking of the people in the institute, if they knew that Khaslana, the person they had been anticipating would seize first place, couldn't take first because he had forfeited on his own, they would probably scold his ears off.

Mydei looked like he had thought of the same thing. He hastily said, "No, we can't let those ignorant people humiliate you. I will take you to the destination point. You just need to rest well."

Phainon thought for a moment. He felt the same way... So he nodded. He didn't need to worry about what would happen if he stayed at Mydei's side, and he would also get a chance to train his physique a little.

And so they made their way to the destination, dawdling for several days before they finally arrived. Because Khaslana wasn't with them, things progressed especially smoothly. Nothing out of the ordinary happened at all.

It had already been so much time that most of the other top students at other institutes had arrived at the destination already. What Phainon didn't expect was that Caelus would also be waiting at the destination.

Caelus was sitting outside, looking listless. When he caught sight of Phainon, his eyes lit up, then he put up an expression of disdain, striding over like he wanted to say something.

Mydei immediately blocked Phainon behind his own body.

Caelus glared. "What are you doing? Get out of my way."

"No," Mydei said coldly. "Someone who has lost to me doesn't need to keep up the arrogance."

Caelus knew that he wasn't strong enough to compare with Mydei, and he could only grit his teeth, giving up on getting closer to Phainon to talk one-on-one. He turned to Phainon. "I won't forget our deal. When I complete my end of the deal, you need to fulfill your promise too. Or else I won't let you off!" When he finished, he didn't wait for Phainon to reply before turning to flee.

Phainon suddenly felt like catfishing Caelus might have been a mistake. "..."

Khaslana hadn't arrived yet. Phainon let out a breath of relief. If he saw Khaslana and this shameless system changed Khaslana into his capture target, he really had no idea what he would do.

And Phainon had suddenly thought of something very important. Didn't the system say before that after changing capture targets it would hurt to touch the previous capture target? This effect had never taken place with Caelus.

The system came out to explain, [It's because this world is a bit more unique. It's different from the previous worlds. In order to let the host get accustomed slowly, a safeguard period has been initiated. It will continue for three months, so in these months the host doesn't need to worry about the effect after switching capture targets.]

Phainon: "..." You're saying it oh-so-kindly, but why don't you say something like this earlier! And the three month period was about to pass, too. He felt like it was ending before he could enjoy the special treatment.

All kinds of problems had come up in the previous worlds because of this lousy setting. Couldn't they just get rid of this penalty mechanism completely!

Phainon was just blurting out whatever, not expecting the system to listen to him. As he t thought, the system knew plenty about making excuses, and nothing was unchangeable. What was all that about maintaining the capture target's interest... Phainon actually felt sorry for the capture targets.

But there had been no news about that Zerg teenager. Even when he went to ask around at the institute that he had stayed at before, everyone else was confused. They had no information about him, only that they had seen how powerful he was before, and that was why they had been so flattering of him before.

Phainon: "..." Hey, why is your school so casual about it! They were on track to be finished.

Phainon couldn't do anything about it, and that teenager didn't seem like the kind of person who would go spreading someone's secrets either, so he would leave it alone for the time being.

As time passed, the rest of the students slowly arrived, but Khaslana still didn't appear.

The heads of the institute couldn't hold themselves back from questioning Phainon. Phainon had no choice but to say that they had separate partway through, and he didn't know where exactly Khaslana was.

Other than hiding the part where he gave Khaslana a beating, the rest was all real.

Because he had Mydei and Caelus acting as witness, nobody suspected that Phainon was hiding anything. After all, Phainon didn't look like the kind of person that could fight with Khaslana.

Soon, the competition formally ended. This year, the empire's military institute had ranks in the middle. Khaslana, who they had expected would be able to give a good showing, had disappeared. Everyone was in low spirits. There were even some people that brought up whether or not Khaslana might already be dead.

But Phainon knew very clearly that Khaslana was the central figure in this world. If he died, the world might just collapse. Where would you get the time to keep guessing if he was alive or not...

Khaslana must have encountered some good luck. After all, protagonists would all get their opportunity after a hardship.

Though they left some people behind at the base to search, most of them thought that Khaslana's situation had taken a turn for the worse. Everyone boarded the airship back to the capital planet. They had come in excitement and with high spirits, but now the mood had disappeared.

Because Khaslana was gone, Mydei let Phainon move to his room. Caelus didn't say anything either.

During the few days they spent on the airship, Phainon kept lowkey and typically didn't go out. If he went out and Khaslana's fans came to vent his anger, what would he do?

After he finished his meal, Phainon got in bed and went to sleep. He could relax now that he was staying with Mydei.

But on the side, Mydei gazed at his sleeping face, his eyes gloomy.

He had never asked out loud why exactly Phainon had forced a kiss onto him. Was it the reason that Phainon and Caelus explained? If so, then Mydei knew very clearly that Phainon obviously had no intentions towards him...

Mydei had always thought that it was enough for him to follow after Phainon. As long as he could watch Phainon's shadow from up close, he could be satisfied.

But after that event, Mydei finally understood.

He didn't just want to stay at Phainon's side. He wanted Phainon to have only him at his side, wanted Phainon to only look at him, to talk to him, and to never look at someone else.

"...I really am insatiable." Mydei looked towards Phainon, recalling that day when he had found Phainon and happened to see the bite mark on the back of his neck.

"...Who exactly was the person who marked you then?"

But this wasn't important anymore, because in the future... the alpha who marked Phainon would be him.

Chapter End Notes

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Finals
chapters.html:
And so they returned to the institute. Because of what happened with Khaslana, everyone in the institute was in low spirits. If it wasn't for the fact that they couldn't be sure if Khaslana was dead or alive, everyone might have arranged a memorial for him.

Phainon naturally didn't have the nerve to go to Caelus's house again... He had a feeling that if he went something bad would happen. Anyway, he didn't have much luggage to pack, so he decided to just move to a dorm rented from the institute.

There were several cheap dorms, but most of them were designed for several people. All the singles were in the high-rise. He felt that if his omega pheromones spread out, he would stir up an entire building of alphas in minutes. The scene was too gory for Phainon to imagine.

After they came back to the institute, Caelus never came back to school. It was rumored that Caelus had especially gone to seek out his father for the sake of the finals. He had his father use his influence to invite a retired general to teach him. He trained from dawn to dusk with no time to spare. He spent his days in incredible hardship.

Phainon had thought that Caelus, someone born in a duke's family just needed to enjoy their comfortable life. After all, the one inheriting the duke's title was Caelus's brother, so Caelus just needed to enjoy himself. In the last dozen years, that was just what he did. Nobody had ever counted on him to do anything.

But now that Caelus was suddenly working so hard, the duke and duchess were given a shock. They were even worried that their son might have been possessed.

Phainon knew that in the original novel Caelus had become very powerful in the later parts of the novel, but they were currently in the middle of the novel at latest. Even if he improved, he probably couldn't make it to the finals of the mecha competition right away...

When Mydei found out that Phainon was thinking of looking for a dorm, he immediately offered to let him move to his own residence.

Phainon didn't really want to think too much to begin with, but when he considered how he didn't know when he would go into heat it would be a hassle, it would save him some trouble to have someone with him... Besides, Mydei's residence was huge. He didn't need to worry about his omega pheromones drawing people over.

Phainon had completely forgotten that Mydei was also an alpha... It was all because his impression of Mydei as a loyal lion had been engraved deep in his heart.

When Mydei found out that Phainon had been using a helmet to login to the virtual world, he was ready to faint in anger.

A helmet couldn't completely send someone's consciousness into the virtual world. Although it didn't feel too different in use, there were subtle aspects that would be affected. All of the contestants participating in the competition were using nutrient cabins.

On the other hand, using a nutrient cabin could greatly reduce the amount of stress on the body. For someone like Phainon, who had an especially weak constitution, he would be able to stay online for a few more hours if he used the nutrient cabin, and he wouldn't be as exhausted as if he had used a helmet after he came out. Instead, he would feel very comfortable.

Mydei immediately purchased the latest model of nutrition cabin for Phainon. In his opinion, it was criminal that Caelus couldn't bring out Phainon's full power. He regretted not hitting Caelus harder when he had the chance.

At first, Phainon thought Mydei was exaggerating, but when he used the nutrient cabin, he was stunned by the speed and smoothness at which he entered the virtual world. His body felt much lighter, and the scenery before his eyes was crisper. It was as though he was a character in a cultivation novel who had had succeeded in building his foundation.

In comparison, Phainon felt like his past self was like a lousy computer that refreshed at a rate of one frame per second... Before switching, he was used to the feeling of the virtual net helmet, but now that he had switched, he discovered that it simply wasn't a way to live.

At the same time, because of what happened with Khaslana, other people were getting more and more worked up. There were even people who cursed Phainon, saying that there was no way Khaslana would have disappeared if it wasn't for the fact that Khaslana was paired with such a weak partner. They got angrier and angrier, even demanding for Phainon to be expelled.

But with Mydei there, their goal had no hope of succeeding.

Mydei didn't want to tell Phainon, but when he thought about how serious the problem was, he decided to tell him after all. He advised Phainon not to go out. If there was anything he needed, he could come looking for Mydei.

Phainon hated being a bother. When he imagined the terrifying scene of himself being surrounded by Khaslana's fans, he immediately gave up on the idea of going outside...

Everyone else thought that Phainon was innocent and that he had only gotten paired up with Khaslana and encountered such an event... But Phainon was very clear that there was a strong correlation between the current situation and how he had poked a few stabs into Khaslana.

Because Phainon couldn't out and he couldn't go to class, Mydei decided he might as well not go to class either. He brought over a textbook, giving Phainon special one-on-one explanations.

Mydei's grades were at the top of the class. When he was explaining, he would pay extra attention to the parts that Phainon didn't understand. Phainon learned even more than when he went to class himself, and he understood mechas even better.

Mydei would also make all kinds of delicious foods to feed Phainon. He was afraid that Phainon would get bored staying inside day after day, so he changed his cooking all the time.

Phainon was originally a homebody who didn't have much desire to go outside anyway. His new lifestyle couldn't be any better. He had pretty much anything he wanted, all kinds of delicious foods, and he could go online to practice mecha maneuvering whenever he wanted. He had even less desire to go outside.

Mydei was different. His emotions were extremely complicated.

This wasn't any good to Phainon, but because Mydei could stay alone with Phainon and without anyone bothering them, he was secretly delighted.

He even wished that they could always live like this. He didn't even care what kind of price he had to pay.

---

In the blink of an eye, it was time for the final match of the virtual mecha competition.

Recently, the officials had contacted several of the competitors to let everyone advertise themselves and so on. Occasionally, there were a few who were invited to go on a show for publicity. They were pretty much the same as a celebrity... But in a world like this that worshipped the strong, compared to a celebrity, generals and marshals and others like them had the most fans.

Of course, Phainon never appeared. After all, wasn't it too extreme to go promoting himself with a mosaic on his face? Besides, that wasn't even the important part. It would be an absolute joke if he accidentally revealed his identity!

Anyway, he could market himself as a cool character (Phainon had already chosen to ignore the atrocities he had committed on his mecha to get advertising fees).

He didn't expect that his actions would really make his fans even more frenzied. The idol in their hearts should be as mysterious and aloof as this. He was incredibly cool.

The ad-filled mecha that Phainon usually used was also being praised like crazy. People said the mecha was just like a work of art. Art was something the general populace couldn't understand, so normal people didn't understand Prince Latiao's sense of aesthetic.

Phainon: "..."

During this time, there was no news from Khaslana. Just as the officials were debating if they should withdraw his qualification, Khaslana finally appeared.

Exactly. The protagonist always had to arrive just as the situation was hanging by a thread, except if it was an author that had to abuse their readers and insisted on writing terrifying plotlines about protagonists who could never make it back for the climax and got hurt.

Phainon, who only ever read easy, relaxed novels, firmly rejected those kinds of novels. Maybe those novels had more depth, but he only read for entertainment. Who cared about depth and so on?

But right now, Phainon would rather Khaslana was the protagonist of a novel like that... A protagonist with a cheat on his side had zero friendliness to a cannon fodder like him!!

Especially because Khaslana had definitely got the cheat and leveled up before he came back. Phainon had stabbed him several times, so Khaslana definitely had a deep hatred for him. If he didn't stab Phainon several dozen times in return, then he wasn't Khaslana.

Still, he didn't need to worry about Khaslana exposing him for those stabs. Khaslana was the kind of person valued his reputation more than anything, and he absolutely wouldn't say that he had been given serious stab wounds by a beta. It was too humiliating. It completely ruined his perfect image.

Phainon only had the guts to go on the school website to take a look. As expected, they were all excited. All of the threads were about Khaslana, saying Khaslana was like the representative of the empire's military institute. It was as though the institute was done for without him.

The indignant people who had been calling for Phainon to be expelled weren't saying anything anymore. They were probably too busy licking Khaslana's boots.

Things had pretty much completely blown over, but now that Khaslana was back, Phainon was even more afraid to go out. He would rather curl up at home and bear it until he reached the ending of the novel. He didn't want to go out so soon and bind to Khaslana so miserably!

Soon, it was the day the finals really began.

Phainon naturally won his first match. With his incredible spiritual energy, he wasn't worried about losing at all. Now, there was nobody at the competition who was a threat besides Khaslana.

But when Phainon thought about the guy who paid two million empire coins to face him one-on-one and the words he said, Phainon felt a faint sense of worry. He kept secretly looking at his surrounding opponents, but he didn't find anyone like that person.

Could it be that the challenger had just wanted to toy with him a bit, and didn't have any treacherous intentions? ... Who would have so much free time.

After returning, Khaslana's strength skyrocketed. During the competition, he was even more incredible. He made all kinds of incredibly difficult moves look easy. Recordings were being spread around the internet at an insane speed. Countless people were drawn in by Khaslana's charm. Soon, people were even beginning to call him the Nation's Mr. Perfect.

If they were following the plot of the original novel, he would definitely be the Nation's Mr. Perfect.

But in the very last match, Khaslana's opponent was Prince Latiao.

Over the course of the competition, the two of them had gathered many fans. Even if they said they would always worship their own idol, in reality, whoever could win would be the victor, and nobody would remember the loser.

Phainon was under high pressure. The main worry was that Khaslana was fate's favorite! Under the protection of his plot armor, it would be hard if Phainon wanted to win. Last time he had been relaxed about winning because it couldn't impact the plot too much. This time, there would be a huge effect.

Although he was relying on his plot armor, even if Khaslana lost he would be able to make a comeback. In this novel, the plot typically moved forward with incredible ease. When Khaslana wasn't being abused, he was truly the author's biological son.

Phainon didn't want to lose. He had already made it so far. Even if he had to risk his life, he had to give it his all.

Mydei was also aware that they were in a dangerous situation. Every day, he would make foods to build up one's health and take care of Phainon in all kinds of ways. Sometimes, he would even feed Phainon... Oddly enough, Phainon had a feeling that he had already settled down and gotten married. Mydei was too much of a perfect wife.

Finally, the day of the final match arrived.

Many people had already been anticipating Prince Latiao's fight.

The match was finally about to begin. When the tickets were made available online a few days ago, they had been snapped up. Even though there were people reselling the tickets at a high price, it was impossible to get one. Not everyone had the chance to watch the finals from such a close distance, even ignoring the fact that the two competitors fighting were both figures that would only appear once in decades.

Before the competition properly started, everyone was discussing eagerly. "Who will win?"

"Although I think both sides are strong, God Time should be the one who will win. After all, he's always been competing with the worst model mecha. His true strength is obvious."

"You guys don't know? Prince Latiao used an old mecha in his first fight too. And back then, he won right away. He can't be any less skilled than Time."

"But all the mechas Prince Latiao use now are new models. I bet he knows he's not skilled enough, and he can't defeat anyone with the old models, right? From this perspective, he's taking the upper hand because of his mecha."

"Too bad. God Time will be at a disadvantage in this sense. The mecha he uses is so far behind the other one. It's very likely that even if he's stronger than his opponent, he'll lose. It'd be good if he didn't stick to it."

It was easy to see Khaslana's scheming from this perspective. Even if he lost the competition, he could blame it on his mecha being low quality. There would probably be a bunch of people who complained on behalf of him and saying that even though he had lost the competition he had won in skills or something like that.

In the next moment, their mechas appeared on both sides of the battlefield. When everyone saw the sight, their eyes widened in shock.

"What the heck? They're both old-fashioned mechas?"

"Prince Latiao picked an old-fashioned mecha too? What is he thinking?"

Precisely. Even if it was a mecha packed with ads, the mecha's model was the cheapest old-fashioned mecha no matter how you looked at it. It was exactly the same as the mecha that his opponent Khaslana was using.

These old-fashioned mechas had fallen out of use in the outside world. They only had the most basic functions. Nowadays, only newbies who were just starting to come in contact with mechas would use them, but they had made their way into the finals.

Even the host was shocked. The host explained, "Surprisingly, Prince Latiao is using the old-fashioned mecha. It seems that he wants to have a just, honorable, and fair match with Time."

Precisely. Phainon had always kept an eye on the news online, and already knew what they were thinking. To avoid being accused for unfairness even if he won, Phainon had immediately chosen the same old-fashioned mecha as Khaslana. He would save himself a lot of trouble.

Across from him, Khaslana was sitting in his seat, completely at ease. He looked at his opponent's old-fashioned mecha, raising an eyebrow. "Not bad. You picked the same old mecha as I did... You're really confident in your strength. But if a newbie like you wants to win against me, you've still got a long way to go."

Khaslana had never faced a setback from anyone other than Phainon, and he didn't believe that anyone would get a win by accident the way Phainon had.

Khaslana looked towards his wrist. On it was a hideous wound. In the real world, the wound had already been healed by the power of the necklace, but he had specially added it back on in the virtual world as a memento.

After he had been stabbed several times by Phainon back on that planet, Khaslana had discovered the secret of the necklace his mother left behind by chance. In a series of coincidences, he arrived at a cavern and obtained an ore that might have been left behind by an aboriginal of the native land.

The ore could activate someone's innate potential, and stimulated the imperial blood that had been passed onto Khaslana. In moments, his strength rose up a level, and his features were more attractive than they were previously.

At first, Phainon had roasted the novel. Everyone was human, but why was the imperial family's bloodline so incredible... But if the author wanted to give Khaslana a cheat then there was nothing he could do.

Afterward, Khaslana returned to the capital planet. He had pretty much guessed his identity, and he immediately felt even more unwilling to accept his status in life.

He was the emperor's biological child, so why did his mother have to endure strenuous labor in the slums and pass away? And he had grown up in the orphanage, but the other princes and princesses could life such easy lives... If his mother had simply been treated in a good environment, nothing would have happened to her.

Khaslana's heart burst with an impulse to get revenge against society. He had never been someone moral and upright, so turning evil could happen in minutes... In fact, he had always been evil. He had never been good.

Khaslana knew that while his classmates in the institute flattered him, he was nothing to the imperial family. Thus, he needed to seize first place in the virtual mecha competition in order to increase his bargaining chips.

But ever since he came back, he had never even seen Phainon's shadow. He guessed that Phainon was hiding from him, but Khaslana didn't get annoyed. As long as he possessed power in the future, how would it be difficult to keep a beta at his side?

Even if Phainon wanted to hide, the people at his side would present bring him to Khaslana by hook or by crook.

Besides, after Khaslana's strength increased, he was several levels above other people. He didn't face any difficulty in the previous matches. Now that he was facing Prince Latiao, someone who was always placed on par with him online, he still didn't feel any sense of crisis.

Unless this Prince Latiao was Phainon, who had put him in a bad spot time and time again. But how could that be?

"Let's do it. Use your defeated, pained despair to ingratiate yourself to me." Khaslana smiled slightly, maneuvering his mecha to walk into the battlefield.

At the same time, Phainon mirrored him and walked in.

Both of them wanted to get the match over and steamroller their opponent as quickly as possible. Phainon felt that if he was too late, something bad would happen, but Khaslana didn't feel like wasting his time in a fight. Thinking along the same lines, as soon as they entered the battlefield, they quickly engaged in battle.

The crowd couldn't keep up. They couldn't believe that they were looking at a fight between two old-fashioned mechas. They felt that it would have been worth the money even if they had paid ten times the price for their tickets.

The people watching the livestream were ashamed of themselves. Practically everyone had piloted an old-fashioned mecha before, but there had never been anyone who could bring them out to this level. It was obvious how skilled these two pilots were...

Although strong spiritual energy was said to allow anyone to maneuver a mecha however they wished, being able to maneuver however they wished wasn't enough to win. At first, Phainon was nothing impressive. He had only increased his strength after practicing hard for the last few weeks.

What the crowd didn't know was that in actuality both of them were hiding something. Khaslana was waiting for his opponent to show his full strength before he used his spiritual energy to thrash them. On the other hand, Phainon was afraid Khaslana would discover his true identity, so he didn't dare to use his spiritual energy.

The two of them exchanged fierce blows. Each move was targeted right at their opponent's vitals, but both of them were incredibly quick. The number of times they took a blow could be counted on their fingers.

After all, these were extremely fragile old-fashioned mechas, and the virtual net was faithful to its original construction. If they were hit by a few strong blows, they would fall apart. The victor would be clear as day.

Everyone looked on, holding their breaths, afraid of missing a single detail. A brilliant fight like this might only come once in years.

Phainon originally planned to finish the fight quickly, but he didn't expect that Khaslana would have such strength after leveling up. Just as he was debating if he should use his ability, a familiar heat welled up in his body.

"???!" Phainon was ready to vomit blood. His movements slowed, and he barely managed to stop Khaslana from seizing the chance to defeat him. Luckily, by relying onto his strong spiritual energy, he was able to avoid the blow.

Fuck, he had obviously just used his inhibitors! Why was his heat still... Although he had heard that after inhibitors would lose their efficacy in the long term, it couldn't be so quickly, right! He didn't take that many before either.

As expected, this was the world consciousness preventing him from triumphing over the son of destiny Khaslana. If he kept delaying like this, Phainon felt that there was a very real possibility he would explode lying in the nutrient cabin.

"There's nothing I can do. I can only take this chance..." While his rationale hadn't completely disappeared, he used his spiritual energy in a surprise attack. He couldn't care too much about it now.

In that moment, Khaslana felt a familiar sense of danger. He immediately gritted his teeth, but at that moment, he had no way to dodge the attack. If he avoided it, it would only result in a loss. How could he resign himself to it? He could only block Phainon's attack stiffly.

Thus, in the next moment, Phainon's spiritual energy connected with the spiritual energy stuck to Khaslana's mecha.

It was easy for spiritual energy to taint someone else's emotions. In that moment, Khaslana felt like he was experiencing the same anxiety in his opponent's spiritual energy. It felt like his body was turning hot, but most importantly was that this spiritual energy was so familiar...

If it was the Khaslana of the past, he would probably be terrified by this spiritual energy and faint away, but after leveling up, his spiritual energy had increased significantly. As he struggled to barely resist the spiritual energy, he had some spare energy left to think.

"...So it was you..." In that moment, several things that Khaslana couldn't understand became clear, breaking through the clouds of mystery and into the sun of realization.

No wonder Mydei, who didn't have the slightest interest in Phainon, suddenly chased after him so furiously. No wonder Caelus also treated him differently than he treated others. In fact, the one who had been in the dark was Khaslana.

Khaslana's heart pounded. He got more and more excited. "Phainon, just how many pleasant surprises can you give to me? Let me see your true strength."

To outsiders, the two mechas were both locked in combat, refusing to budge, but those who were familiar with mechas knew that the two pilots were immersed in a fight of spiritual energies.

In normal circumstances, Phainon could drive out Khaslana's spiritual energy, but at that moment he was struggling to focus his attention. His strength was probably equal to just two thirds of his normal strength.

Yet Khaslana's spiritual energy was like a sharp sword, twisting furiously into Phainon's spiritual energy. Both of their emotions were being transmitted almost completely. It was hard for either of them to recognize which ones were their real feelings.

"Dammit..." Phainon gritted his teeth, his body getting hotter and hotter. Although he knew his opponent's situation should be about the same, in the end they still couldn't go on like this. "If things stay like this, I'll definitely lose."

From the other side, Khaslana's spiritual energy probed another level deeper, wanting to come into contact with the core of Phainon's spiritual energy. Normally, only people with the most intimate relationships could do something like this. It was even possible to learn about a portion of the other person's memories. Of course, if one party's spiritual energy was enough to overpower the other person's, they could also do it forcefully.

"No." Phainon jolted awake. Seizing the opportunity, he pulled his consciousness back from Khaslana. Before Khaslana could react, he used his mecha's skewer to impale his opponent's cockpit.

And thus their deadlock ended.

Phainon panted, completely exhausted. He was about to collapse in the mecha's cockpit. "...I...I won..."

He had actually won against Khaslana, someone blessed by the world consciousness. This was something simply impossible... Even if he really exploded in the nutrient cabin, it was fine.

Phainon was about to faint, but because of his heat his mind was overstimulated and his spiritual energy was thusly in an abnormal state. After he left the competition, he was forcibly logged out of the virtual world. It was a function to protect some people from being too stimulated in the virtual world and causing an accident to happen.

--- In the virtual world, cheers rose up in the arena. Everyone was cheering for Prince Latiao in excitement.

Prince Latiao had managed to use the old-fashioned mecha, the one that Khaslana was most skilled with, to defeat him. It was simply more proof for how powerful his strength was. In the future, Time's fans couldn't mock Prince Latiao anymore.

Only Mydei thought there was something off about the situation. When he thought about how Phainon's situation had been recently, he quickly logged off, leaving his nutrient cabin and rushing to Phainon's room.

As soon as he entered the room, Mydei smelled an incredibly thick omega scent. It was the smell of an omega who had thoroughly gone into heat.

"As I thought.. It's your heat?" Mydei's heartstrings tightened.

If he was a normal alpha, he would have lost control and charged forward a long time ago, but Mydei was extremely calm. He made his way to the nutrient cabin step by step, slowly observing the situation.

Phainon was laying in the nutrient cabin, his pale cheeks thoroughly flushed red and his eyes full of tears. He couldn't keep his breathing steady. It looked like he was in horrible suffering.

Mydei leaned over, reaching out to touch Phainon's body gently. Immediately, Phainon let out a low sob. The place he had been touched turned red rapidly... Because he had always suppressed his heat, his body was now incredibly sensitive.

Mydei's cheeks flushed. He leaned in close to Phainon's ear, his voice low. "...Right now, what do you wish for me to do?"

"I-I'm thirsty..." Phainon mumbled. "Water..."

Mydei grabbed a cup of water from the side, taking a sip and holding it in his mouth. He pressed against Phainon's lips, sending the water slowly into his mouth.

Mydei finished feeding him the water, but Phainon wrapped his arms tightly around the back of Mydei's neck as though he was afraid he would leave, sucking the liquid from his mouth as though it would dispel the heat in his body.

Mydei lifted his head after a long time. He picked Phainon, who had lost much of his sense of reason, up from the nutrient cabin walking towards the bathroom. He had to give Phainon a bath.

Phainon was completely immersed in the agony of his heat. He kept squirming in Mydei's hold, saying quietly, "...Help... Help me..."

In these circumstances, Phainon couldn't really tell exactly what was happening to him. He felt as though he was in a dangerous situation, but wasn't sure. He just had the faint feeling that he could believe in Mydei, and so he unconsciously relied on him.

Mydei's deep yellow eyes darkened completely. He pulled Phainon into his arms, his voice low. "Then would you mind if I caused you offense now?"

Chapter End Notes

The Author Has Something To Say: Yay! New Chapter! Sorry for the delay, I've been feeling pretty tired lately. But I hope the wait was worth it. Mydei Finally got that cookie! It's going to be fade to black unfortunately because I've never written smut before but I have read a lot of smut so I might write a bonus chapter once the story ends that fully expands this scene, hehe.

Also we got obsessed Khaslana this chapter! Even going so far as to recreate the wound and wanting to lock him up, Khas I know what you are~

chapters.title: Chapter 15: Mark
chapters.html:
In his confusion, Phainon couldn't distinguish what exactly Mydei had said. He nodded blankly.

Mydei lowered his head, peeling off Phainon's sweat-soaked clothes like he was unwrapping a meticulously packaged gift.

It was only at these kinds of times that Phainon would only see him.

Mydei picked up Phainon and placed him into a bathtub filled with hot water. He lowered his head to kiss him on the lips. When they were red and swollen, he finally pulled back, kissing down the line of Phainon's neck. His deep green eyes were filled with a manic longing, like the most pious believer prostrating himself before his god.

His heat had made Phainon’s usual caution evaporate and all he could think was that he could trust Mydei to not hurt him. His hands subconsciously gripping his shoulders to hold him close.

Phainon had been completely exhausted. He was too weak to do anything but lean against Mydei obediently. Because of his discomfort from his heat, he kept nuzzling against Mydei's body, as though this way he could fill the void inside him.

"Please forgive my offense."

In his daze, Phainon seemed to hear Mydei say something. Immediately, a wave of pain seared through his body, and he couldn't stop himself from beginning to struggle.

The strength of an omega in heat was completely dismissible. Mydei pressed Phainon down easily, leaning down to kiss his pale nape gently. A hint of his desire finally shone into his eyes.

"I'll always be yours," he murmured.

...Could you always keep your eyes on me as well?

Finally, he bit down.

---

When Phainon finally woke up, two days had already passed.

Phainon wasn't aware of what had happened yet. He lay on the bed, feeling like his body had fallen apart. There wasn't a single part of him that wasn't aching. He didn't have an ounce of energy.

But when Phainon felt the strangeness in the part below the neck that couldn't be described, a fragment of his memory welled up in his mind alongside a furious blush.

Phainon: "???" W-wait, what?! He did those kinds of things with Mydeimos just like that?!

How did things reach this stage, huh?!

Phainon felt like his worldview was about to shatter. Even worse, he remembered it!

The door opened. Mydei walked in, holding a plate of food. He looked like he hadn't slept all night. He had dark circles under his eyes and his blonde hair had lost its usual luster.

Phainon had no idea how he would face Mydei in the future. Even after looking at him for a long time, he still couldn't say anything.

Mydei placed the food at the side, but he immediately kneeled down, pulling out a sharp dagger and handing it to Phainon.

Phainon took the dagger, dumbfounded. "Mydei, this is..."

"It was all my fault. I've gone so far as to do such a thing to you." Mydei's voice was low. "If you're unhappy, please vent your anger on me however you like. Even if you want to kill me, I won't say a single word of blame."

"How could I kill you because of something like this..." Phainon said. Besides, he wasn't the kind of person who would go around stabbing people just because he was upset!

He could only remember a few indistinct images. He couldn't remember the details at all and… for some reason he couldn’t bring himself to hate what happened.

"But I've committed an irredeemable offense." Mydei gritted his teeth. He grabbed the dagger, moving to stab it into his heart.

"Wait!" Phainon pulled his hand back hastily, heart pounding. "T-This isn't your fault. After all, in those kinds of circumstances, as long as it's a normal alpha there's no way to hold back."

Except for Khaslana, the guy who had the author's cheat... In fact, when he thought about it, this was all Khaslana's fault, wasn't it! If it wasn't for the sake of debating him, how would Phainon go into heat? Though the system was a big problem too.

Mydei said, "But if I can't gain your forgiveness, I don't know how I could be bold enough to live on."

"It's fine, it's fine, I forgive you," Phainon said quickly. He was afraid that Mydei would try to commit suicide if they disagreed in the slightest.

In any case, Phainon wouldn't die because of this. If he really thought about it, this wasn't actually his first time. Besides, being marked would save him a lot of trouble.

He would just pretend like nothing had happened at all, just like he is pretending to not feel the slight heat on his face as his fingers trail the mark on his neck.

Phainon felt he was someone who came around easily...

---

After the virtual mecha competition, a video of Prince Latiao and Time using old-fashioned mechas spread widely. Quickly, it sets off a resurgence of popularity for the old mechas.

Many people began to praise old mechas. There were even people who thought that people with real skill should use old-fashioned mechas to prove themselves.

And Prince Latiao became the idol in even more teenagers' hearts.

Caelus, who had invested almost all of his time in training, made some time on the day of the finals. After he finished watching the match, he sank into silence.

He had already worked so hard, but he felt like Phainon was getting farther and farther away from him. No, he had to work even harder... He had to catch up to Phainon's pace.

Caelus dived into his training with renewed fervor, and improved noticeably. The people around him were stunned.

When Anaxa found out that his own little brother was training so hard just because of a beta, he was stunned. But recently he had been looking into that beta. Although there were plenty of strange things about Phainon, when he thought of the brilliant Prince Latiao, and then thought about this beta-

It seemed that beta should indeed have no connection to Prince Latiao. In comparison, it was more important that Khaslana had gone missing from that planet for several days. He should report this to His Highness Nanook...

Now that he thought about it, could his little brother really win against Mydei? When Anaxa thought about it, he couldn't help feeling a bit worried.

--- In the original novel, when Khaslana took first place, his renown spread far and wide. It was for this reason that one of his mother's past admirers took notice of him.

Because Khaslana's face was seventy to eighty percent similar to his mother's, the admirer recognized him instantly. Later, the admirer contacted Khaslana in secretly, hiding his identity and offering him a lot of aid. He even organized several opportunities for Khaslana and the emperor get to know each other as father and son.

But because the emperor was afraid Khaslana would be assassinated by a member of the clan backing the crown prince, he had never publicized Khaslana's identity. He only struck at Nanook's power from the shadows. What he didn't know was that Nanook had seen his each and every move, and Khaslana's identity was laid bare before Nanook's eyes.

Now, though Khaslana didn't take first place, his fame rose to a status similar to his fame in the original novel because of his and Phainon's battle with the old-fashioned mechas.

In a certain airship, General Wiley, a man with influence, the empire's hero who had battled against and vanquished the Zerg a dozen years ago, was watching a video on the virtual screen in front of him. When he saw the face on the screen, the cup he was holding slipped from his grip and dropped to the ground.

"Amelia?"

His voice was completely shocked.

It was common knowledge that General Wiley had started as an ordinary commoner born into poverty. He had managed to reach where he was today thanks to His Majesty the Emperor's recognition.

But nobody knew that his beloved childhood sweetheart Amelia was the emperor's mistress. It was also because of his guilt towards Amelia that the emperor had promoted Wiley. How else could he have risen up over the officers from noble families with just hard work?

Amelia had already been dead for over a dozen years. Wiley didn't expect that he would see someone who looked so similar to Amelia.

Wiley sent people to investigate almost immediately. When he saw the detailed report about Khaslana, he was practically trembling.

"There's no mistaking it... This is Amelia's child..."

As soon as he thought of how Amelia had died wretchedly in the slums because of the Kremnoan family's persecution, and as soon as he thought of how that damned Kremnoan family was maintaining their power with the help of their relationship with the crown prince, Wiley's emotions settled. He had to get revenge for Amelia.

But before he did that, he should properly foster the single child that Amelia left behind.

---

After the virtual mecha competition ended, though Khaslana wasn't first place, he was extremely popular in the institute. After all, the only person in the institute who had qualified for the finals was Khaslana.

Everyone consoled Khaslana, saying that Prince Latiao was so skilled that he had to be someone with decades of experience and who had practiced countless times before he had become so powerful. Khaslana was young, and he still had room to grow.

When people were consoling him, Khaslana put on a show of feeling motivated. In fact, he was very clear that Prince Latiao's real identity was the same person these people had mocked again and again... He didn't know what they would think if they discovered that Phainon was actually so strong.

Khaslana didn't expect that he would lose to the same person time and time again.

If he had lost to someone else, Khaslana wouldn't settle. He would want revenge. But after losing to Phainon, his heart filled with another kind of emotion.

Although he didn't take first place at the virtual mecha competition like everyone had expected, he was famous. There were also more strong people getting in contact with him. It looked like he had to get ready to choose his future path.

Before he knew his identity, Khaslana would have chosen the powerful family behind the crown prince, the Kremnoan’s without hesitation. Besides, his good friend Mydei was also on their side. But now that he knew his identity, and with the fact that his ties with Mydei had been split ages ago, Khaslana changed his plans.

"The person standing subtly against the Kremnoan’s is General Wiley. Besides, he was also born as a commoner, so he won't look solely at birth when judging someone. I'll be able to stand out as someone with more strength." Khaslana muttered to himself, "But they've never had someone contact me. Or should I recommend myself to him after I've graduated?"

Khaslana wasn't the kind of person who needed someone else to invite him. As long as he could earn the greatest profit, he didn't care even if he had to abandon his reputation.

Just as he was thinking, a letter sent itself over. Khaslana opened it carelessly. When he saw the contents, he smiled slightly.

"It's come."

---

Although Khaslana didn't win, the plot still developed in the same way under the prompting of the world consciousness.

But there were a few plot points that diverged significantly from the original plotline. For example, after watching the video, General Wiley was extremely unhappy with Prince Latiao who won over Khaslana. He thought Prince Latiao was no stronger than Khaslana.

Moreover, General Wiley could easily see how unpracticed several of Prince Latiao's moves were. He had to be a dumb child who hadn't grown up yet. He had probably made use of his spiritual energy to defeat Khaslana.

General Wiley couldn't find Prince Latiao's true identity, but he wasn't afraid of offending anyone in the entire empire. His Majesty the Emperor was the one backing him.

Soon afterwards, while he was being interviewed, a journalist recalled Prince Latiao, who was famous recently, and asked about General Wiley's thoughts about the recent virtual mecha competition.

General Wiley sneered. He openly and frankly expressed that he strongly disapproved of some young people who did anything for money regardless of their morals. Strength wasn't everything; moral character was also extremely important... Moreover, these people weren't necessarily that strong.

If it wasn't for the fact that Prince Latiao had fought in the final match with Khaslana using an old mecha, General Wiley would even have wanted to take the chance to praise Khaslana and put Prince Latiao down in the same breath. He only avoided mentioning Khaslana in order to stay a bit more lowkey.

General Wiley's popularity wasn't something someone from the virtual world could compete with. After all, when the Zerg invaded the borders of the empire, they were able to fight them back because of General Wiley's strength and his subordinates who risked their lives. He was the hero of countless young people. He had left a strong impression on the people of the empire.

Although General Wiley didn't mention any names, anyone could tell who he was talking about. Now that he had been ridiculed by General Wiley himself, Prince Latiao had absolutely no future.

In these circumstances, Prince Latiao's fans quickly reduced a significant amount. Several media channels also avoided the topic. Even officials of the virtual mecha competition were kept low-key, acting as though the competition didn't happen at all.

There were even a lot of people who didn't know what was going on but went the flow and started cursing Prince Latiao. Anyway, even General Wiley had cursed him. It was impossible for them to be in the wrong.

Many of Prince Latiao's fans couldn't stop themselves from refuting those people, but they were beaten back as brainless fanboys and fangirls. There were even many people who said that the fact someone like this still had so many fans was a sign of how low society had fallen and how the empire's future was bleak.

Under these circumstances, many people left the fandom, but the remaining people held steadfast to their belief that Prince Latiao wouldn't disappoint them.

It was lucky that Prince Latiao didn't publicize his real identity, or he would have been cursed horribly.

This was what Phainon, who had rested several days to recover his emotional wounds, was faced with as soon as he logged on.

When he remembered that in the original novel General Wiley was Khaslana's biggest supporter, he pretty much understood what was going on... General Wiley must have secretly started this trouble because he was unhappy that Khaslana lost.

In the original novel, General Wiley was exactly the kind of person who would defend someone even knowing they were in the wrong. He had basically seen Khaslana as his own son. Regardless of whether or not it was Khaslana's fault, as long as it was someone who made Khaslana suffer, they were General Wiley's enemy.
