Moreover, other than his strength, General Wiley also had significant influence. Without his help, Khaslana couldn't have risen up the ranks so easily.

Right now, the most important thing was that Phainon couldn't say anything yet. He couldn't jump out and run to General Wiley to thrown down the gauntlet. He would definitely get mocked.

When Mydei found out, he wanted to use his family's influence to help Phainon, but Phainon stopped him. After all, General Wiley had a special place in many people's hearts. If he came out to cross blades with him so carelessly, defeat would be the only possible ending.

And based on what Phainon knew of General Wiley, his attacks wouldn't cease so easily. If he pulled out his trump card now, he would have a hard time dealing with General Wiley in the future.

Mydei could only have his family log into the virtual world to spread positive propaganda about Prince Latiao. Of course, it didn't make a significant impact. It made Mydei so angry that he had people gather information about the people who were slandering Phainon online.

---

Just as Phainon thought, General Wiley wasn't satisfied yet. After putting down Prince Latiao's morals, he also wanted to put down Prince Latiao's strength until it was worth nothing.

So General Wiley suddenly said that he wasn't someone who was against the youth of today. He just wanted to temper the other person. After all, if a youth couldn't resist the pressure, how would he succeed in the future?

Immediately, General Wiley said that after seeing the videos of Prince Latiao, he felt that he had some strength, but the strength didn't mean much. If Prince Latiao could win against one of his subordinates, he would retract his previous statements. If he couldn't even do this, then-well, forget about it.

The subordinate that General Wiley dispatched was named Augustine. Although he wasn't famous, and he wasn't well-known among the public, he was truly strong.

But Augustine had a terrible temper. Once, he had even lost control and killed a teammate. If it wasn't for General Wiley's protection, he would have been sentenced to death a long time ago. For that reason, he was stuck in limbo and couldn't be promoted or demoted, but his loyalty to General Wiley was unquestionable.

Under General Wiley's guidance, many media channels came out to report on it. If Prince Latiao didn't accept the challenge, he would certainly be suppressed until he couldn't stand back up. If he accepted and lost, he would naturally meet the same end result.

There would be no good end unless he won against Augustine, but anyone with a discerning eye knew that this was impossible. Even though Prince Latiao was unopposed in the virtual world, he was still a long way from someone who had tempered themselves on the battlefield for decades.

When Phainon found out, the first thing he did was accept the challenge. The news quickly spread through the virtual world.

People who hadn't been paying attention to the virtual world began to pay attention when they found out that this was something General Wiley had prompted. Soon, there even the strong began to envy that Prince Latiao could have so much attention.

Naturally, General Wiley knew that if Prince Latiao won, he would become even more dazzling. But how could he win? He was just a green newbie. How could he win against his formidable subordinate?

---

The officials of the virtual mecha competition offered up a free space for the battle. They even provided several kinds of livestream services. The number of people online reached over a billion. The servers were practically about to explode.

Augustine, General Wiley's strongest subordinate, was also piloting an old mecha.

Augustine was obviously using it to show his disdain for Phainon. Phainon was just using an old-fashioned mecha, but he could still be praised to the heavens? Even if there were a dozen virtual mecha competition champions surrounding Augustine at once, they were no match for him.

The MC introduced Augustine's recent military achievements. Each time he finished listing one, the crowd would cheer.

If Augustine's temper and luck were a bit better, he might have achieved success that could compare with General Wiley's.

In comparison, Prince Latiao's brilliance was dim. Other than his single achievement of winning the virtual mecha competition, there was pretty much nothing else to say.

And under General Wiley's suggestion, the media had already shaped Prince Latiao into a figure who was arrogant solely because of his one merit, his strength. All of the onlookers looked at Prince Latiao with stares full of disdain.

Only the fans who were taking up a minority of the stands and being glared at by the rest of the crowd as brainless fans shouted Prince Latiao's nickname continuously, trying to rouse his spirits.

Soon, the match that had drawn the practically entire empire's attention began.

Phainon took a deep breath. This had nothing to do with the original plotline, so the world consciousness wouldn't affect it. He could move forward completely relying on his strength.

Their mechas locked in combat. Each one of Augustine's moves were sinister attacks that were certain to make Phainon's mecha break down in one hit. On the other hand, Phainon dodged continuously, looking as though he was evading with difficulty.

To an outsider, it was as though Augustine didn't want the fight to end quickly, and he was humiliating Prince Latiao unceasingly. Prince Latiao didn't have any power. It was clear that he wasn't strong enough to match his opponent.

As the MC watched, he felt his hair stand on end for Prince Latiao. "It looks like the victor of the match is already clear."

Internally, he couldn't help but sigh. Ever since the beginning, he had been paying attention to Prince Latiao. He was obviously strong and his future path was boundless. Who expected that he would have offended General Wiley? Now, it looked like he was going to be ground into the mud.

It was lucky his identity hadn't been exposed. In the future, he should be able to hold his head up in public if he changed his name and was a bit more low-key. Of course, he wouldn't be able to match up to his current status.

Prince Latiao's fans looked on in worry.

In their hearts, they also knew that Prince Latiao wasn't strong enough to compete with someone who had risked their life enduring the battlefield for decades. They pretty much thought of this match as Prince Latiao's final match, but they still had a faint sense of expectation in their hearts.

They expected that, just like they had countless times before, they would see Prince Latiao win against his opponent.

In fact, Phainon could use his spiritual energy to win easily, but this way he would expose how strong his spiritual energy was. Moreover, he really didn't have the battle experience to compare with his opponent. Why not take the chance to learn a bit?

What an outsider saw as perilous escapes was easy to Phainon. His spiritual energy could even analyze the principles behind Augustine's moves and see what their goal was.

Although Augustine looked down on Phainon, he couldn't help feeling surprised that this Prince Latiao could somehow keep avoiding him time after time.

Soon, Augustine aimed an attack at him, but Prince Latiao faced it directly, not dodging it at all.

The crowd felt like the time had finally come. It looked like Prince Latiao had also become aware of the disparity between his and his opponent's strength. He should have finally decided to admit defeat.

But things didn't turn out as they expected. Instead, Prince Latiao used a cunning move to grab Augustine's weapon. While Augustine was stunned, Prince Latiao rapidly counterattacked with one of the moves Augustine had used previously.

If Augustine didn't react quickly, Phainon would have hit him right on the mark.

When Prince Latiao's fans saw the scene, their eyes lit up. In his first match, when nobody had known who he was, Prince Latiao had copied his opponent's move. Could it be that he was preparing to use the same tactic this time?

"Hmph." Augustine sneered, his face full of mocking. "If you want to copy me, you're still decades behind in skills."

His moves were all tempered in numerous occasions when his life hung in the balance. A greenhorn like this simply had no way to copy him. Even if he managed the form, how would he understand the principle? Unless he was someone with strong spiritual energy who could pass judgement depending on the situation... But if there really was someone with such strong spiritual energy, then how could General Wiley bring him so far down?

Those with experience shook their heads at the sight. At such a time, Prince Latiao didn't use a move he was familiar with, but instead copied his opponents? How could he defeat Augustine, who knew the move as well as the back of his hand? As they thought, Prince Latiao was still too young.

The MC also sighed silently. Out loud, he said, "It looks like Prince Latiao wants to copy Augustine's attacks to make it through the danger, but can he really do things so smoothly... Wait, his movements aren't quite the same as what Augustine just did..."

Augustine was full of disdain. He sneered. "As I thought, he can't even copy it. I think the competition should be coming to an end..."

But in the next second, Prince Latiao's attack was different from what he expected. It scraped across the front of his mecha.

Augustine was stunned. "How could it be? He managed to touched me? This move isn't performed like this... No, he modified it?"

Prince Latiao's attacks came one after another. Each move had a subtle difference from the attacks that Augustine had shown earlier, but it was clear that they were sharper than the old moves. Even someone who didn't know much about mechas could tell the difference.

And Augustine, who was intimately familiar with these moves, sank into a predicament precisely because of his familiarity. Prince Latiao had made changes to several of the most important points. It was impossible to defend.

All of the onlookers were shocked. "What!?"

"Could it be that Prince Latiao has made improvements to these moves?" The MC was stunned. Unconsciously, he blurted out what he was thinking in his head.

"How could it be? Improving a move, and it's improving someone as strong as Augustine's... He saw every one of the weaknesses in his opponent's moves. Only a mecha piloting expert can manage this."

"Could it be that he really is strong? That's impossible, right?"

"How could someone as strong as this be unknown in reality? He must be someone as famous as General Wiley."

"Impossible... It has to be a coincidence."

Everyone immediately sank into confusion, but Prince Latiao's fans were cheering. It looked like this opponent wasn't as strong as they had thought. As expected, they had thought too much. How could someone as strong as Prince Latiao lose?

"Shit." Augustine gritted his teeth hard, his expression taking on an edge of savagery. "How could I lose do a brat like this."

But his opponent's each and every move was impossible to predict. Even Augustine was having a hard time fending him off. On top of that, because he was confident he could overpower his opponent with his strength, he hadn't chosen a mecha that he was used to. It was even more difficult for him to get into his best condition.

"I'll have to use my spiritual energy." Just like Phainon's previous opponents, Augustine wanted to use a spiritual attack.

But before Augustine could draw out his spiritual energy, Prince Latiao seized his opportunity, His weapon slashed at the weak point of Augustine's mecha.

Old-fashioned mechas like this were fragile. In moments, it fell apart, and the cockpit dropped to the ground.

Victory had, without question, been decided.

The crowd was absolutely flabbergasted. In the time that Prince Latiao went from his disadvantageous position to taking the upper hand to finally being victorious, only a few minutes had elapsed.

He was even able to win against Augustine. It was clear exactly how strong he was... And the moves that he had improved weren't coincidences. It was all because he was much stronger than Augustine that he could reach such a level.

Who exactly was this Prince Latiao?

But Prince Latiao's mecha didn't retreat after his victory. the cockpit opened, and someone jumped down, landing gracefully on the ground.

Even at a time like this, his face was mosaiced. Nobody could tell who he was.

Everyone was stunned. They looked down. At that moment, almost half of the empire was watching.

Phainon only felt a heat in his chest. He was filled with a strength like he had never felt before. Even with all of these people staring at him, he didn't feel timid at all.

After his fight with Augustine, he was suddenly filled with a fierce desire to become strong. He didn't want to rely on his spiritual energy to defeat his opponents, but to learn to use his own strength to learn how to attack. But most people didn't have the strength to satisfy him anymore. Now, he just so happened to have someone he could pick...

"General Wiley, since you won't recognize my strength, then I'll extend a challenge to you right here."

Though Phainon's voice wasn't loud, it resounded throughout the arena. It was so quiet you could have heard a pin drop.

"General Wiley, do you accept my challenge?"

Chapter End Notes

The Author has Something To Say: Yay! A new chapter! Phainon baby just admit your in love! DW Mydei baby he's just in denial, you'll conquer him soon ;) Also the fight was very fun to write, one of my favourites. Phainon! Your finally acting

cool! That challenge scene was lit! I think I'm a fan now too! *Insert lightsticks being waved*

Also I haven't played HI3 so I'm not sure if Khaslana has any parents in that game that I could have used but since I gave Phainon's parents to Phainon. Khaslana gets...Amelia and the nameless emperor XD.

Happy Reading! See You Next Week!

chapters.title: Chapter 16: Cousins Fighting Over A Man (Pt.1)
chapters.html:
It took everyone a long time to react. Immediately, they sucked in a breath of cold air, almost suspecting that they had developed hearing problems.

General Wiley was one of, if not the most, renowned and powerful people in the modern empire, yet Prince Latiao, a newbie who appeared on the internet, wanted to try and challenge him? Even if he had successfully won against Augustine, he was being too arrogant by making this kind of declaration, wasn't he?

General Wiley, who was watching the screen from the lounge, nearly crushed his teacup in his hand. He had never received such humiliation since he had become famous.

A mere greenhorn of a brat wanted to challenge him? Where did his courage come from? They were already at this point, so he couldn't be at fault for being too ruthless. General Wiley snorted.

In the next moment, General Wiley's stern face appeared on the screen in the competition arena. His expression was filled with disdain. He spoke as though he was giving alms. "I accept your challenge."

The crowd rose up in an uproar. The people in the outside world were also given a huge shock.

Even if Prince Latiao had never lost ever since he appeared and even if he had successfully defeated Augustine this time, the distance between him and General Wiley wasn't something that could be closed in an instant.

As soon as he got General Wiley's response, Prince Latiao set a time to battle next week and immediately logged off.

Afterwards, all kinds of social media featuring these news exploded. It trended significantly more than when Prince Latiao and Time were about to battle.

Countless people were shocked by Prince Latiao's arrogance, and also by his courage. Many people knew that if they were in that position, they would never be able to say the same words.

At first, the people who had been mocking Prince Latiao were ashamed after the match finished. Now that they saw he was challenging General Wiley, many of them scolded him online, saying that Prince Latiao didn't understand how to respect his elders and he was just too arrogant.

After all, General Wiley was so strong that he was right no matter what he did. Even when he had said that Prince Latiao was no good he was simply giving guidance to a newbie. But Prince Latiao going so far as to challenge General Wiley was just showing that he couldn't tell good from bad. There were even people who said Prince Latiao wanted to use General Wiley for hype.

But there were also some people who were inspired by Prince Latiao's spirit and became his fans. There were also some die-hard fans online who said, "Who doesn't know Prince Latiao will win?" He had won so many battles that everyone thought he would lose. It wasn't necessarily hopeless this time.

Of course, people like that were being mocked and called brainless fanboys and fangirls, but after the previous fight, even though everyone knew clearly that it was impossible, they couldn't help from considering the possibility. If Prince Latiao really won, what would happen?

---

Meanwhile, General Wiley's subordinates didn't understand why he had accepted Prince Latiao's challenge.

"Sir, why did you accept?"

"Regardless of whether you win or not, that brat will be famous."

"Besides, isn't it fine for us to deal with trash like that?"

General Wiley frowned. "Even Augustine lost. Are you all sure you yourselves can win?"

Immediately, they went quiet. Although they were confident in their strength, Augustine was in no way an easy opponent. It was clear that Prince Latiao wasn't so simple.

When Augustine remembered how he had lost to that Prince Latiao guy, he spat, "If it wasn't for that brat being so underhanded and making it so that I didn't get the chance to use my spiritual energy, how would I have lost so easily?" As he spoke, he hammered a fist into the wall, sinking a depression in the sturdy wall.

Augustine remembered something. He quickly said, "Sir, as long as you use your spiritual energy to attack that Prince Latiao, his spirit energy will immediately collapse."

After a spiritual energy collapse, a person would typically become disabled.

"You're correct," General Wiley said calmly. "I was thinking of the same thing. I knew Prince Latiao had potential when I saw him. If I keep letting him develop on his own, it will most certainly bring us disaster. I might as well act now."

At his words, they all saw the light. One after the other, they began to praise General Wiley's resourcefulness.

In the meantime, Phainon practiced mecha maneuvers on the virtual net every day. He pretty much understood the movements and principles behind mechas now. What he was missing was practice with spiritual energy.

Although his spiritual energy was strong, it didn't have enough offensive power. As soon as Phainon remembered how Khaslana's spiritual energy had nearly peered into his heart, he shivered again.

But there were few books about spiritual attacks, and even fewer about how to fight with spiritual energy. Phainon just kept trying different ways of using his spiritual energy as practice, recalling what Khaslana had done that day and slowly fumbling his way through the principles.

Soon, the day of the match arrived.

This match had caused a bigger commotion than the previous ones. Many people, and even members of the imperial family, were paying attention. Even if the winner was already clear, they still wanted to see the legendary General Wiley's grace on the battlefield.

The government officials were especially shameless and adopted an auction format to sell tickets. In the end, the prices were sky-high.

Many of Prince Latiao's die-hard fans were young. Naturally, they couldn't get their hands on these tickets, but Mydei bought several tickets in one swoop and gave them away to his fans.

When Phainon entered the arena, he spotted the high-grade mecha that General Wiley was using on the other side of the battlefield. His heart rate spiked.

Although General Wiley had shielded his people to the point it was unreasonable, he was truly powerful. Even though he had strong spiritual energy, Phainon still wasn't confident.

Thus, Phainon wasn't using an old-fashioned mecha today. Instead, he had used the strongest modern mecha. These kinds of mechas could at least last a bit longer and wouldn't get one-hit KO'ed as soon as he entered the battlefield.

After the match started, General Wiley burst into the offensive, testing Prince Latiao's strength. But he was met with the same circumstances as Augustine, and discovered that Prince Latiao had been able to copy his moves at an astonishing pace.

Just as I expected, General Wiley thought. Prince Latiao is a genius. If he was left to grow on his own, in the future he would certainly have a boundless future... He might even be able to surpass me.

If he had brought a genius like this under his wing from the beginning, it would be fine. It was a pity that he hadn't thought anything of Prince Latiao at the start. Now, they had no relationship. He couldn't let Prince Latiao continue to grow.

"It's just a pity that plenty of geniuses have faced defeat at my hand. I'll make you into a complete cripple right here and now."

General Wiley sneered, directing his spiritual energy at Prince Latiao across the battlefield. His spiritual energy was SS-grade, and it had incredible offensive power. Even many of the people who had decades of battle experience couldn't match up to him, much less a young newbie like Prince Latiao.

Even though Phainon had incredibly strong spiritual energy, he just barely dodged General Wiley's attacks.

After all, there was a chasm between their fighting abilities.

Many of General Wiley's guesses were accurate, but he was mistaken about exactly how strong Prince Latiao's spiritual energy was.

"This is the most crucial moment." Phainon took a deep breath. Imitating what Khaslana had done, he concentrated his spiritual energy, forming it into a razor-sharp knife. Ruthlessly, he stabbed at the body of General Wiley's mecha.

In the split second their spiritual energies connected, General Wiley was stunned.

How strong was this? It was a terrifying spiritual energy just like an endless sea.

If he continued, he would die. General Wiley barely thought for another second. He retracted his spiritual energy with the help of his years of experience. Despite his quick reaction, a sharp pain stabbed through his head like an explosion.

In that moment, General Wiley even recalled the terror he felt when he encountered the Zerg Queen in the Zerg nest years ago.

He had never said it, but in fact he didn't kill the Zerg queen. Instead, under the crushing pressure of her spiritual energy, he had fled in panic.

Back then, General Wiley thought that it was over, but unexpectedly the Zerg withdrew, and everyone called him a hero. Naturally, General Wiley didn't explain the truth. But now Prince Latiao's spiritual energy was as strong as the Zerg Queen's. He had lost all of his fighting spirit and sank into terror. He didn't have the courage to move a single inch. The Zerg Queen was a slightly different from what the data had said, but he didn't have the extra energy to take notice either.

With these circumstances, Phainon's weapon easily stabbed through General Wiley's cockpit.

The arena went silent. Even the MC couldn't say a word. They all wondered if they were dreaming.

When the system announced the winner, everyone finally woke up from their daze. Prince Latiao's fans erupted in shocked cheers, almost afraid to believe their eyes. They began to cry, hugging each other in tears and in laughter. But this time there was nobody giving them any stares.

Nobody else could believe it. When Prince Latiao defeated Augustine, they could say that he had more talent, but he had won against General Wiley? Who was he? How old was he? He could do something like this?

"The winner of this match..." The MC's voice was trembling. "The winner is Prince Latiao. He managed to be victorious... He managed to win against General Wiley. Perhaps I had always underestimated his strength."

The MC suddenly felt that he seemed to be witnessing the meteoric rise of the genius of a new age.

The people in the stands were quiet for a moment, as though they were processing the results. One by one, they began to cheer, and the name that they were shouting loud enough to deafen the heavens was Prince Latiao. No matter how they had thought of Prince Latiao before the match, they had been completely persuaded by his strength and turned thoroughly into his fans.

---

In the empire, the strong were respected. Even though General Wiley had so many honors, his brilliance had dimmed significantly the moment he lost to Prince Latiao.

In some sense, Prince Latiao had stepped on General Wiley to succeed. Moreover, something like this was something only he alone could do. Many people had attempted it before, but they didn't have the same strength.

Nearly the moment after the match ended, the number of views on articles about Prince Latiao skyrocketed crazily, causing many sites to go down. All the news sites were changing their tunes, hurrying to make their apologies one by one and praising Prince Latiao madly.

Similarly, the people who had mocked Prince Latiao quickly deleted their old messages. Some people were slow to delete their messages and discovered that there were already several hundred thousand comments cursing them. They apologized speedily, saying that they had also become Prince Latiao's fan.

Nobody expected that a newbie who had begun to show their skills in the virtual mecha competition a few months ago would defeat General Wiley today.

Now, the people who thought Prince Latiao had remained undefeated through luck were stunned by the discovery that in fact it had nothing to do with luck. It was all because Prince Latiao had enough strength to crush everyone.

And the people who lost to Prince Latiao in the beginning were no longer upset. Instead, they felt honored from the bottom of their hearts. They even pulled up videos of their fights with Prince Latiao to flaunt to the people around them.

Everyone was guessing Prince Latiao's identity. As long as he revealed himself, even if he was the ugliest coal miner who lived on the most remote planet, there would be plenty of people worshipping his face and throwing money at him.

Sadly, Prince Latiao was extremely low-key. Even if they racked their brains, they had no way to figure out exactly who he was.

It was fine if they couldn't figure out his identity. It was all the same online, anyway. The night the match ended, there were millions of people online showering their love on Prince Latiao. There were even all kinds of attractive, highly-ranked nobles who were willing to spend their entire family fortune to arrange a single meeting with Prince Latiao. It didn't matter even if the meeting was just ten minutes long.

Everyone had heard that Prince Latiao had once agreed to fight one-on-one with someone for a million empire coins. Immediately, many people sent letters saying that they were willing to give ten million empire coins or a hundred million empire coins; they just wanted Prince Latiao to fight one match with them.

The companies that had gotten Prince Latíao to advertise for them saw their sales jump up by several times and celebrated their foresight, while the companies that didn't think of Prince Latiao regretted everything.

Overnight, Prince Latiao became the entire empire's favorite celebrity. If he had any social media accounts, he might gain hundreds of millions of fans in the blink of an eye.

But Caelus, who knew Phainon's identity, gritted his teeth and cut down on his daily rest time. Even if he couldn't catch up, he had to try his hardest.

Because of his exhaustion, after the competition Phainon rested the entire night. When he logged into the virtual net the next day, he was given a huge shock by the volume of mail in his inbox. Because there were such a crazy amount of emails, Phainon was frozen and booted offline.

"...I just won't look at my mail this time." Phainon logged into the virtual net again with lingering fear.

But why was there so much mail? Was Phainon being cursed out by General Wiley's fans?

Then Phainon glanced casually at the forum and was stupefied.

Although he knew he was pretty strong to be able to defeat General Wiley, this should be too much of an exaggeration... He didn't expect that he would go from being cursed out to this kind of treatment.

Especially the people who were willing to spend a hundred million empire coins as long as they could get a thrashing from him. Phainon even had the urge to agree. In the beginning, he had agreed to fight with Caelus for a mere million empire coins. Why wouldn't he agree for this many coins now? Besides, it wasn't for a match. It was just to give a beating.

Then Phainon received a message from Mydei. He arrived at Mydei's virtual home... Although he obviously lived in a house, he still had to do something like this for a chat.

"You mustn't agree to their requests." Mydei spoke almost without waiting for Phainon to sit down. "If you need money, I'll provide you as much as you need. I just ask that you don't agree to fight."

"Why?" Phainon didn't really understand.

Although Mydei was ecstatic that Prince Latiao had achieved such accomplishments, hundreds of thousands love rivals had appeared. Mydei couldn't help worrying that Phainon would get stolen away.

"At the moment, everyone has a strong desire to discover your true identity," Mydei said. "I myself have received several inquiries. Even my elders have come to ask me."

After all, Mydei was the president of Prince Latiao's fan club. If someone couldn't reach Prince Latiao directly, they would naturally wonder if Mydei knew what was going on.

Phainon: "!"

"Of course, I would never say anything about you," Mydei said quickly. "This will slowly calm down as well. These people will give up as soon as they realize it's impossible. But if you agree to someone, whoever can bring out a hundred million empire coins can't be ordinary. They'll certainly go in a frenzy to discover your identity."

Phainon: "!"

He was right. Although the system had been able to maintain secrecy so far, who knew when something would happen.

"Alright then." Phainon had no choice but to give up unwillingly.

---

After General Wiley was defeated, he was completely dumbfounded. He was almost unable to accept that he had somehow lost to a greenhorn brat. But he was very clear how strong Prince Latiao's spiritual energy was.

If he had stubbornly fought against it, he would have been left off with a spiritual energy collapse. He was doomed to lose, but it was still hard to take the jeers from his enemies the Kremnoan family.

General Wiley's subordinates were afraid to say a word for fear of making General Wiley angry.

"Who in the world is that person?" General Wiley gritted his teeth. "How can it be that he's so strong, but there's not a shred of information about him?"

At first, he thought things would pass, but soon something nobody had expected happened.

Several people began to speak up on behalf of Prince Latiao, snidely taunting certain people for trying to crush a newbie without being aware of their own power. They were practically pointing their fingers right at General Wiley.

Someone who had the mind to investigate a bit further would discover that these people were all backed by the Kremnoan family. It looked like Prince Latiao was relying on the Kremnoan family. Still, that made sense. The Kremnoan family was the strongest clan in the empire.

But when all was said and done, General Wiley still had some influence. There were only a few people who mocked him quietly. There was nobody who had the courage to say it boldly in the open.

Later, there were people who suddenly posted threads digging up information about how Augustine, Prince Latiao's previous opponent, had gone so far as to kill someone from his own troops in the past. His personality was also disgusting. He would even force omegas from other families to serve him and then throw them aside.

But all of these offenses had been hidden away by General Wiley. He even had his subordinates beat the people who reported the crime until they were bruised and bloody, and silenced the witnesses.

Normally, General Wiley would be able to use his influence to delete the discussion in an instant, but the other person had the Kremnoan family supporting them from behind. The topic grew increasingly intense. Moreover, Augustine had made a name for himself throughout the empire when he fought with Prince Latiao last time.

But this wasn't the end. Perhaps because they gained courage after the first thread, more and more threads that exposed General Wiley's subordinates' sins began to appear.

Quickly, everyone's image of General Wiley crumbled. They began to doubt the way they thought in the past.

After all, everyone was in a panic when the Zerg made their surprise attack. The empire needed a hero to stabilize the populace. Because General Wiley had real strength, and because he was close with the emperor, he was the natural choice to be promoted. But he was the kind of person who would shield another's shortcomings unconditionally. In these few years, he had completely covered up the messes his subordinates had caused. He had absolute confidence in his own strength and never thought there would be one day that someone caught hold of his weak point.

More and more people began to curse out General Wiley online. Soon, it was so bad his influence took a hit. He even received a message from the emperor.

If it wasn't for the fact that General Wiley's strength was universally acknowledged, he might be drowning in the people's disdain.

When Augustine found out about the news, he was furious. He smashed a fist into the wall. "Isn't the reason we worked long and hard to protect those useless peasants just to get some omegas? Besides, it's the honor of a lifetime for omegas as ugly as that to service me. Do they need to make such a big fuss?"

"That's not the problem right now." General Wiley's brows were deeply furrowed. "It's the Kremnoan family that wants to take the chance to take us down. It's not something we can deal with easily."

"In the end, it's all because of that damn Prince Latiao. If he wasn't so arrogance, how would he have pushed us to this point?" Augustine was furious.

But Augustine didn't have the guts to fight another round with Prince Latiao. Even General Wiley had lost; what else could he do?

His other subordinates began to swear up a storm at the Kremnoan family.

General Wiley sighed. He knew things couldn't be dealt with so easily. "You guys go out first."

When the people in the room were pretty much gone, there was still one other person who remained.

The person was someone who had just been added in: Khaslana.

"Is there something you want to say?" When General Wiley saw the youth, someone who looked incredibly similar to his first love, his heart softened. It was as though the person in front of him was his own child with Amelia.

"Sir, I have some thoughts about this situation." Khaslana had a harmless smile on his face. He said softly, "I think that we can turn Augustine in."

Since Khaslana joined them, he discovered that his treatment was significantly better than the other newbies. He was also promoted rapidly.

There were people who could barely see General Wiley after trying with all their might, but he would meet him by chance again and again. General Wiley also looked at him with incredible affection.

Khaslana was too suspicious to let this go without notice. He investigated himself, and because nobody had thought to hide it, he quickly discovered the relationship between General Wiley and his mother. He pretty much understood what had happened in the past.

Khaslana could make use of anything regardless of what it was. He pretended that he didn't know anything, and when he ran into General Wiley, he put on an act of an obedient younger junior. He even made several useful suggestions. Naturally, his position rose quickly.

Later, Khaslana pretended to happen upon the relationship between General Wiley and his mother by coincidence. He hurried to ask the general, even asking if he was the general's child.

At first, General Wiley, who was well aware of Khaslana's identity, had no way to explain the truth, and he shook his head. Finally, he sighed, saying that he would treat Khaslana as his own child.

General Wiley didn't dare to tell Khaslana his true identity. He was afraid that if the Kremnoan family discovered it, then Khaslana's life would be in danger.

Khaslana similarly hid the fact that he knew about his identity long ago. Now, he took advantage of their relationship to speak about turning Augustine in without any restraints.

"What did you say?" General Wiley looked at Khaslana in shock before flying into a rage. "This isn't something you should be saying. Augustine is a brother who has been by my side for so many years. How could I turn him in just because you say so?!"

But Khaslana spoke with complete sincerity. "I'm truly saying this for you, sir, from the bottom of my heart."

In truth, Augustine had blocked Khaslana from moving forward. Besides, Augustine had humiliated Prince Latiao several times in the past. Khaslana didn't have a high opinion of him.

"Sir, look, out of all of your subordinates only Augustine is so arrogant. He doesn't have any merits other than his strength. Moreover, he's brought you so much trouble..." Khaslana looked like he was thinking whole-heartedly of General Wiley. "We can say that what happened this time is what he's caused. Now, the situation is so serious, but he still doesn't know his problem. If you keep someone like this, he'll definitely cause another problem."

If this was coming from someone else, General Wiley would have them dragged out and beaten to death, but this was coming from Khaslana. It was crystal clear who out of Khaslana or Augustine was closer to him.

How could a subordinate like Augustine compare to the child of the woman he had loved deeply for years?

"And you're just like my father. Would I lie to you?" Khaslana's words made General Wiley's entire body stiffen in shock.

"Yes... You're right." General Wiley immediately remembered all of the annoyances that Augustine had caused and all of the time and energy he had spent to help cover things up. But Augustine had never been regretful. His last shred of attachment disappeared into thin air.

When Khaslana saw General Wiley's expression, he let out a profound smile.

As such, General Wiley turned Augustine straight in. What everyone else had done could be forgiven, but Augustine's crimes had already incurred the public's wrath.

Immediately, General Wiley told his subordinates that he had absolutely no idea of what he had done. Although nobody believed him, the situation was settled as such, and General Wiley's renown declined. He never felt the same glory again.

---

Mydei was always afraid of Caelus. After all, the love rivals who had a few dozen billion coins were completely unaware of Phainon's identity. Even if they were bigger threats, they weren't strong enough to make a difference. But the only person besides himself who knew Phainon's identity was Caelus. Although Caelus spent all day either in training or in practice, he and Caelus weren't far at all. If Mydei wanted to meet, he could arrange it in minutes.

The semester just happened to be about to end. After considering it from all kinds of angles, Mydei invited Phainon to stay at his home. On the surface, he said he wanted Phainon to relax, but in fact he wanted to take Phainon to meet his parents...

Since he had already marked Phainon, Mydei felt that if they got a fake marriage to hide Phainon's identity, Phainon probably wouldn't reject him... Step by step, sooner or later, he would achieve his goal.

Phainon had nothing else to do, so he agreed. Besides, he had become extremely reliant on Mydei recently. If there was nobody to wake him up in the mornings, and nobody to make him breakfast... After experiencing such a happy life, who would want to return to their bitter days!

If Phainon were to stay in this world forever, Mydei would probably be proposed to by him in a few years.

---

In the palace, Nanook watched the battle video before him, slowly sipping wine from the cup he was holding. A smile crept up into his blue eyes.

"Truly worthy of being the person I've taken a fancy to..."

Soon, his personal terminal suddenly buzzed. Nanook looked down at it, and his eyes immediately filled with an indecipherable emotion. He said in a low voice, "Oh? I see... It looks like I have to pay a visit to the Kremnoan family."

Chapter End Notes

The Author Has Something To Say: Yay! New Chapter! And I'm actually on time this week! But we set up a lot of things in the end of this part and I'm very excited for next part as we will see Mydei and Nanook clash. This chapter was too big so it will be split into 2 parts. Also love that General Wiley got his due karma as well as Khaslana being annoyed that Augustine insulted Phainon? AHHH! Really selling the whole 'Only I can bully him' vibes Khas XD.

chapters.title: Chapter 17: Cousins Fighting Over A Man (Pt.2)
chapters.html:
On the flight back, Mydei gave Phainon a rundown of his family and a few key points he should take notice of.

The Kremnoan family was the greatest family in the empire. There were several famous people who came from his family, and even more families that were connected to them by marriage. Their influence covered practically the entire empire. Mydei's mother, a female alpha named Gorgo, was the leader of the current generation in the Kremnoan family. Her younger sister was the deceased empress.

Chief Gorgo was a person with incredible influence, and she had several lovers, but her first husband had been tossed aside. After all, they had only arranged to marry to benefit their families, and they had no feelings for each other.

It was for this same reason that Mydei and his mother only had a cordial relationship. Instead, he was closer to the empress. When he was young, he often stayed in the imperial palace. After the empress passed away, he still had a good relationship with the crown prince.

Mydei was fortunate that when he had stayed there, he never saw the times empress and Nanook went crazy...

Of course, after Mydei became Khaslana's subordinate in the original novel, their close relationship also went away... This time, without Khaslana, the cousins shouldn't break off relations in such a dramatic way.

Phainon was slightly worried that his interference would make it so that Khaslana couldn't attain a high position. Khaslana and he were obviously at odds, but if Khaslana couldn't reach the height of achievement then Phainon wouldn't be able to leave the world. His feelings were complicated.

Still, Khaslana was fate's favorite. Even if he was missing a few subordinates, with the world consciousness on his side, he would certainly be able to prosper, and succeed on the path to the finale.

Mydei deeply respected the crown prince. He kept telling Phainon about all kinds of the crown prince's achievements, including how excellent his grades were when he was in school and how powerful he was piloting a mecha.

Once again, Phainon felt that Khaslana was a terrifying man to be able to make Mydei betray the crown prince.

When he finished, Mydei sighed again. "His Highness has a great character. Although he has power and influence, he isn't happy."

After all, his biological mother didn't care for the emperor in the slightest, so where would she have the time to bother with Nanook? Later, she did something so terrifying and died spectacularly. The emperor was even more disinclined to take another glance at Nanook.

At the same time, because Mydei was feeling blessed, he felt Nanook was even more tragic.

Phainon decided it was better for Mydei not to know about the truth after all. After all, in fact the crown prince was a huge villain who was pure on the surface and completely evil once you cut him open. Whatever Mydei thought about his great character was all pretend. He was someone who was extremely cold.

Perhaps he didn't feel anything towards Mydei at all, and it was all an act... After all, this fit his villainous setting better.

When he saw Phainon's upset expression, Mydei thought Phainon was angry by what he said. He said quickly, "Of course, you are still the most outstanding to me. Even His Highness can't compare to you."

"Alright, I know what you mean." Phainon felt like Mydei was like a proud lion begging for praise. He couldn't stop himself from reaching out to pat his head. Mydei's face immediately flushed.

Since it was a private airship, there was no need to make detours or stop at any planets along the way. They soon arrived at the planet where the Kremnoan family's main residence was located.

In the past, this planet was famous for its wellness resort. It had a hot spring that was especially well-known. Supposedly, because it contained all kinds of microelements, besides being able to eliminate fatigue, it was especially effective to train after soaking in the hot spring.

Later, the Kremnoan family spent a huge some of money to buy the planet. Now, only the Kremnoan family and their guests were on the planet, as well as the servants who waited on them. Anyone else who came had to undergo a strict investigation.

As the heir of the next generation, any classmates that Mydei brought were naturally allowed enter straightaway. As soon as the security staff saw Mydeimos, they bowed respectfully.

Phainon guessed that the only person here who was stronger than Mydei was the family chief. He would be able to test whether the system would let a girl be a capture target. He might even be able to rescue his sexuality... Though a female alpha still had a peepee. No matter how often he said it, he still felt the world was too terrifying.

The airship stopped at the entrance of the estate. The sky had already turned dark, and it was impossible to see what the mansion looked like other than the fact that it was incredibly large.

Phainon looked in. It seemed as though there was some banquet being held. The mansion was brightly lit, and there were all kinds of magnificent decorations around the courtyard.

"Mother loves holding banquets. It's probably the same now." And she would always invite many of her lovers. Every time there was a banquet, the lovers would start a fight for favor. It was because of this same reason that Mydei normally didn't want to come home.

"Have we come at the wrong time..." Phainon said. They had managed to run into someone else throwing a banquet.

Mydei was a little worried. He said, "If she sees you, she'll certainly ask some unnecessary questions... But that's fine. If she asks any rude questions, you can just ignore them."

The main reason he had come back was just to let Phainon meet his mother and father and tell them that he had already decided on the person he would spend the rest of his life with. If his mother went as far as to blurt out some things, she couldn't control him even if she opposed more fiercely.

"Is there really no problem with this..." Phainon had a bad feeling. He felt like something bad would happen as soon as he walked in.

But they were already here. It would be too much for him to say that they should leave. Of course, Mydei would agree, but Phainon would feel rude.

Thus, he braced himself and went inside with Mydei.

He saw several people assembled in the middle of a magnificent hall. When they saw Mydei, they were stunned. They gathered around Mydei with excitement.

"Young Master Mydeimos, I didn't expect you would come back this year."

"Madam Chief will be ecstatic."

"Do you still remember me, sir? I actually met you once a few years ago."

"By the way, Young Master, you and my child were sweet on each other when you were younger, do you still remember?"

Immediately, the two of them were surrounded by the crowd. Every single one of them was enthusiastic, so enthusiastic that it was terrifying. If it wasn't for Mydei's always cold expression, they could even squeeze their way in front of him.

Mydei's attitude was already very cold, so aloof it was like he wanted to keep everyone a thousand miles away from him, but they continued to fight with their all to get closer.

After all, Mydeimos was the heir of the Kremnoan family. Although Gorgo had plenty of paramours, she didn't have a single illegitimate child.

Moreover, Mydei didn't have a partner yet. The families who had omega children, and even the families who only had alpha children, were all excited. If it wasn't for the fact that Mydei didn't give them a second look, they would push their children onto him.

Phainon, on the sidelines, was completely ignored. After all, he just looked like an unthreatening beta. He was probably just a classmate who was friendly with Young Master Mydeimos.

"Young Master Mydeimos, could it be that you also heard the news that His Highness is coming, so you hurried back?"

Mydei suddenly heard those words from the midst of noise. He turned to look at the person who had spoken. "You said His Highness?"

The person Mydei replied to was stunned, feeling a sense of honor at being called on. He said quickly, "Yes, exactly. His Highness the Crown Prince. As it turns out, you were unaware of this?"

Mydei frowned slightly. His Highness Nanook would never come over unless it was his mother's birthday. Why in the world was he here this time? Could it be that something had happened?

When Phainon heard their conversation, his face turned pale. "!"

Why did Nanook, the ultimate villain in the original novel, run over at this time? He had a feeling that something bad was going to happen. Besides Nanook's strength was clearly higher than Mydei's...

Did he still have time to leave?

Phainon looked at the people crowded at his side. Despairingly, he discovered that there was no chance he could squeeze his way out.

At that exact moment, the hostess of the banquet, Chief Gorgo, appeared from the second floor. The crowd immediately stopped making conversation so they wouldn't make Gorgo fed up with them.

Chief Gorgo was in her fifties. In the future, where the life expectancy was two hundred years old, she was extremely young. She had blonde hair, yellow eyes, and devastatingly gorgeous features. She was an enchanting woman.

But at that moment, compared to the person at her side, Gorgo looked much much more dull.

The young man at her side had silver hair and molten gold eyes. He was smiling slightly, but his forehead creased slightly as though he had some faint worry. He was beautiful in a way that was impossible to describe in words. No matter what kind of beauty was at his side, they would feel a keen sense of inferiority.

After all, this was the face that came from the most envied beauty in the empire.

When they saw Nanook, the crowd froze. Even though most of them had seen His Highness in photos online, he was a hundred times better looking in person than in pictures. For a moment, they couldn't think of anything to say.

Normally, a face like this should make people fall in love, but everyone had a keen feeling that they couldn't match up to His Highness the Crown Prince. They admired him the same way they admired a work of art. Forget about wooing him; there weren't even many people who would confess to him.

But Nanook didn't have any intentions to other people either. He had always kept out of trouble, living an honest life. He didn't have a single sex scandal.

Gorgo was already used to the assault Nanook's beauty caused on people, so she didn't care. Compared to what was happening with Nanook, there was something even more important.

She knew that her son was coming back a long time ago. She looked towards Mydei, a slight smile immediately revealing itself on her face, and walked over. Everyone else immediately took the initiative to draw back, giving her space to move.

When Mydei saw his older cousin, who he hadn't seen in a long time, his expression warmed greatly.

"This is your classmate?" Gorgo looked towards Phainon with curiosity. It was the first time Mydei had brought back a classmate. It truly was a rare occurrence.

Unlike Mydei, who was in a high spirits, Phainon was in a bad mood. Even his face was ashen.

No….Please No….He was perfectly fine with Mydeimos so-

[Beep beep beep... Detected a more powerful character... Beginning to change capture targets in accordance with the system's regulations... Change complete. The current capture target is Nanook.]

It really fucking went there. What the heck was he supposed to do so he could get close to his capture target, huh? Nanook's difficulty level was definitely no lower than Khaslana's.

The only way he was better than Khaslana was the fact that Phainon hadn't made an enemy out of him yet...

"This is my..." Mydei was halfway through his introduction when he suddenly stopped. For a moment, he had no idea how to describe his relationship with Phainon. 'Classmates' made them sound too unfamiliar, but they were obviously closer than that now.

As Mydei hesitated, a slight smile appeared on Nanook's face. He looked towards Phainon. "You finally came."

Phainon couldn't register his words until Nanook picked up his hand.

In front of everyone, Nanook lifted Phainon's hand up to his lips, lowering his head to press a kiss to the back of his hand. "I've already waited for you for a long time."

A thousand fucks steamrollered across Phainon's brain. "!?" Wait, what the heck was happening?!

The surrounding crowd reacted about the same as Phainon. If it wasn't for the fact that they had to do their utmost to maintain proper bearing in front of Nanook, their jaws might have fallen right off.

What did they just see?! Why did His Highness the Crown Prince look like he had such a good relationship with this beta who looked like a normal passerby? This was completely illogical. Or did this mean that this passerby beta was actually someone with incredible talent?

Gorgo was also stunned. Facing Mydei, she said, "So you brought back His Highness's friend? Why didn't you mention it before? How rude have we been!"

But Mydei was completely frozen. He didn't hear what his mother said, just looking at the scene in front of him in astonishment. Why would his cousin know Phainon? This wasn't right... And how could he be so intimate with Phainon?

Phainon finally came back to his senses, asking the same question that everyone around them wanted to know. "Your Highness, d-do we... know each other?"

Nanook leaned in to speak into Phainon's ear. "We've already known each other for a long time... Think about it some more. You'll certainly remember." He grabbed Phainon's hand and turning to the crowd and Gorgo. "Allow me to introduce my fiancé, Phainon."

Nanook's voice was quiet, but it struck through the crowd like a bolt of lightning.

Fiancé?? Wait, what did they just hear?!

Phainon was stupefied. He looked at Nanook with astonishment, but suddenly he felt that his voice was familiar.

...He remembered now. Wasn't this the person who spent two million empire coins to fight with him on the virtual net? The nouveau riche who said a single terrifying sentence and then ran off?!

No wonder Nanook said he found him... Although he didn't know how exactly Nanook had recognized his true identity from the virtual net, he pretty much knew the reason. There was no use in worrying about things like that.

Phainon felt uncomfortable all over. He thought he had kept his sockpuppet account quiet, but it turned out that practically all of the main characters knew! What was the difference between having a sockpuppet and not having one then!

Everyone else finally processed Nanook's words.

"What? What did I just hear?"

"His Highness has a fiancé??"

"W-when did this happen?! How come I never heard of it at all?"

"I'm actually dreaming, right?"

Everyone was wondering if they had missed some important news in the last few days. Why had the future emperor, the incredibly outstanding alpha His Highness the Crown Prince, chosen a beta as his companion? This just couldn't be justified, okay?!

And they had never heard of the name Phainon before. There were no families with this surname in the great clans and nobles of the empire.

But with their statuses, they had no way to question His Highness the Crown Prince's decisions. They could only hide away their shock, putting their uncertainty in their hearts, and turn to giving out their blessings.

Gorgo was also shocked. She frowned. "Your Highness, are you being serious? Have you consulted His Majesty? An event as important as a wedding isn't child's play."

Nanook glanced towards her indifferently. "It's enough for me to decide myself."

Nanook's attitude was mild, but Gorgo's heart iced over. In that moment, it was as though she was seeing her beautiful but obstinate younger sister.

The gentle beauty who became famous was a mere frail omega, but she had done something nobody dared to believe.

That year, her younger sister could even do something like that. If they opposed His Highness the Crown Prince's decision, who knew what the crown prince would do?

Gorgo immediately compromised. "If Your Highness likes him, then I won't say anything else."

"Your Highness, this is a joke, right?" Mydei stared at Nanook, doing his best to maintain his calm, but he couldn't stop his voice from trembling. "Might you have made this decision too quickly..."

Mydei simply couldn't imagine that his older cousin he looked up to the most had done something like this.

"I'm very serious this time?" Nanook smiled slightly. "Besides, now that I have someone I like, you must also be quite happy, right?"

Mydei's expression turned ugly. He looked towards Phainon with a prayer in his eyes, as though he was hoping he would say everything was false.

But Phainon had bound to Nanook. Although he didn't know what exactly Nanook was going to do, at this time it was clear that he couldn't say the truth! So, reluctantly Phainon gritted out, "It really is true."

Mydei wanted to put on a reluctant smile, but no matter how he tried, he couldn't do it.

Gorgo immediately noticed there was something wrong with her son. Could it be that Mydeimos also liked this beta?

If this was the past, Gorgo would probably advise him to marry an omega from an illustrious family, then take his true love as his lover or something. After all, Gorgo had done the same thing.

But the fact that he had fallen in love with the same person as His Highness Nanook was too terrifying. Gorgo quickly said, "Mydei, you just came back, you haven't said hello to your father yet, have you? He's been waiting for you for a long time. You should find him quickly."

"Yes, you're right." Mydei was in a trance. "I truly apologize. I'll leave first."

The way he left made people wonder if he would be okay.

But Gorgo was the hostess of the party, and she couldn't leave any time she wanted. She was left to say, "Alright, everyone has arrived, so we'll begin the dance proper."

Nobody had enough of the love triangle. They felt a bit sorry.

The music began. Gorgo hurried away.

And Nanook, who had started the entire series of events, acted just like nothing had happened. He looked down at Phainon, smiling slightly. In that moment, it was as though the radiance around him had turned dark.

"Come, dance with me."

"...!" Phainon's heart tightened into a knot. Before he figured out what exactly Nanook was trying to do, how would he be in the mood to dance? He said, "But I don't know how to dance..."

"It's fine, I'll lead you." Nanook had a gentle attitude, but Phainon felt his heart go cold. He had the feeling that if he rejected Nanook, something bad would happen.

Thus Phainon braced himself and walked with Nanook to the center of the dancefloor.

The rest of the people slowly digested the stunning news, swaying on the dancefloor as if nothing had happened, but in their minds they wished the dance was already over and they could run over to discuss the gossip they learned today.

When the first song ended, Phainon, who had absolutely no idea how to dance, had already stepped on Nanook many times. He had a feeling that if they kept going he would get beaten to death, and finally he couldn't stand it anymore. He said, "I feel a bit tired. Can I go rest first?"

"Of course you can." Nanook didn't have any intentions of forcing Phainon.

After shaking off Nanook, Phainon practically flew to the flower garden outside. He found an isolated area to sit down before he was able to let out a breath of relief.

There were only two possibilities to explain why Nanook had said what he said. First, he could be one of Prince Latiao's fervent fans, and when he met Phainon he was seized with the sudden impulse to confess.

But anyone who read the original novel would know that Nanook wasn't a naive sweetheart like Mydei or Caelus. He had enough strength on his own, and he had no particular thoughts about anyone else who was strong. Even the most outstanding people were just chess pieces in the palm of his hand.

If it wasn't for Khaslana's plot armor, he absolutely wouldn't be defeated so easily.

Then Nanook was probably trying to draw Phainon over to side?

But he didn't have to do something like this. He could just draw over a few subordinates. There was no need to force him in front of a crowd and say some stuff about a fiancé...

The dignified crown prince didn't have to go so far as to use these method to keep an expert, right?

Besides, in reality, Phainon was still such a useless potato.

Phainon felt his head ache. He heaved a sigh. He had no idea how he would live his days in the future. His heart ached when he thought about Mydei’s reaction but he didn’t understand why...He was just another supporting character so why… It was probably that he wouldn't be able to eat the tasty foods that Mydei made anymore….yeah, that must be it.

Just then, someone walked over. It was a pale-faced Mydei.

"I have something to ask you."

It was obvious that Mydei didn't go to his room earlier. Instead, he was waiting in this remote are the whole time. He looked like a mess, but when he looked at Phainon, he was trying his best to maintain calm. "Was everything you said genuine?"

Just as Phainon was about to explain, Mydei carefully reached out, wanting to hold Phainon's hand.

And Phainon, who wasn't paying much attention, felt the terrifying electric shock, one he hadn't felt for a long time, from touching a previous capture target.

The shock was several times stronger than the previous electric shocks.

In a split second, Phainon drew back his hand rapidly. Because his movement was too intense, he nearly fell to the ground. Mydei wanted to pull him up, but Phainon flung him away.

Phainon vowed with the utmost integrity that it wasn't on purpose. It was all the system's fault! The shock was obviously several more times painful than it was in the previous world!

[It's to prevent some masochistic hosts from purposefully violating the rules to attain pleasure.]

Phainon: "!" Damn it, of course masochists would feel excited when they get a shock, okay! Only innocents like him would be even more miserable.

Mydei was already as pale as a piece of paper. He bit his lip, taking several steps back. "It was my mistake. I shouldn't have touched you. I shouldn't ask you a question like this... B-but why... why..."

He must have been too confident in himself. Although he had always been together with Phainon, it didn't necessarily mean that Phainon had to tell him about everything he did and everyone he met.

It wasn't that he couldn't understand what he didn't know about Phainon. Maybe Phainon and Nanook got to know each other some time he didn't know about... And Nanook really was a good match for Phainon, who he had always yearned after. He should be congratulating them.

But... He should be congratulating them, but why couldn't he be happy? Instead, he even had some terrifyingly extreme thoughts.

"Wait, it's not what you think. I can explain." When Phainon saw Mydei’s expression he felt an inexplicable panic rise up. He immediately wanted to explain.

"Explain what?" Nanook's voice suddenly resounded.

Phainon turned and spotted Nanook walking over slowly. He looked at the two of them with a slight smile. "Can I listen in on what you two are talking about? I also really want to know what you guys are chatting about."

Phainon had no choice but to swallow his words back down. "It's nothing, I wasn't going to say anything."

"Mydeimos, thank you for taking care of My Deliverer these days." Nanook turned to look at Mydei. "I've noted it all down. If there's anything you have trouble dealing with, you can come look for me."

Mydei turned his eyes to the person he used to worship so fervently. Suddenly, he found Nanook's smile incredibly ugly. The dark feelings in his heart suddenly exploded. He opened his mouth to speak reluctantly. "...I will."

When he finished speaking, Mydei staggered away as though he didn't want to see the scene again.

Phainon decided to explain to him when he went online again. This wasn't the right time. There was something more important waiting for him to deal with.

"What's wrong?" Nanook said. "You're looking at me like that all of a sudden. Is there something you want to say to me?"

"Your Highness, what exactly do you want to do?" Phainon said with narrowed eyes. "Even if you know my online identity, you didn't have to say something like that in front of everyone. This has no benefit to you... Besides, you see it too, I'm just a beta. My strength isn't as outstanding as it is on the virtual net."

He ought to make it clear first so that Nanook wouldn't get mad when he discovered he was a potato in the future →→

"I know. I know much more than you think," Nanook said. "I already noticed a long time ago... After all, someone with enough power to prevent me from finding their identity would make me very curious about their true identity."

Phainon: "..." Hey, so it turned out that the source of all of the trouble was actually right here?

"I was always looking for exactly who that person was. After what you did, I was finally certain." Nanook smiled slightly. "Besides, after I found out that Prince Latiao was you, I investigated thoroughly. It's true that you currently don't have the same strength as you do in the virtual net."

"Then why do you have to do this..." Phainon just couldn't understand what Nanook was thinking. Then again, if he could figure it out, then Nanook would just be a normal villain...

"If someone is powerful in the virtual world, but is just a common beta in real world, how interesting is that?" Nanook said. "I'm truly interested."

Phainon: "..." I'm begging you not to be so interested in this.

"Besides... I really do like you a lot." Nanook leaned in, extending a hand to cup Phainon's cheek. He whispered into his ear, "Do you remember the time when you were on that planet attending the training and suddenly went into heat?"

"!!!" Phainon's body went stiff. He retreated unconsciously, but Nanook pulled him into his arms firmly. He could do nothing but ask, "H-how do you know about that?!"

The only person who knew about that should be the Zerg youth, right?!

"I don't just know. Back then, I was there." Nanook looked at the nape of Phainon's neck. "Your scent in heat is delicious..."

Phainon: "You!?" Fuck, what the heck was happening! Don't tell him that the Zerg was Nanook's disguise?! Wait, if he remembered correctly that Zerg youth also had pale hair with gold eyes... Although he looked completely different, who knew whether or not Nanook used some high-tech technology to disguise himself.

The fact that the crown prince of the empire was a Zerg completely overturned a ton of the plotlines in the original novel, didn't it?! No, when he thought about it, he could make a subtle connection. But it was still crazy.

Before Phainon could completely digest the new information, Nanook's gaze darkened slightly. "Why is there the scent of someone else's pheromones on you?"

Phainon: "..." Fuck. T-this... He nearly forgot about the intimate things that couldn't be described that he did with Mydei during his heat.

"Could it be that somebody marked you?"

Chapter End Notes

The Author Has Something To Say: Yay! New Chapter! And our Phainon got stolen!! (T^T) No Mydei~! But Nanook was quite swoonworthy with his forceful lines. I'm excited to see your reaction to this chapter. I have some fun things planned for Nanook and Phainon for the next few chapters. Sorry Mydei, I promise to make it up to you one day QAQ. This is one of favourite chapters and I'm excited for Nanook's possessiveness XD.

See you next week!

chapters.title: Chapter 18: Meeting The Parents
chapters.html:
Fuck, why did he feel like he got caught cheating?

Still, he could take advantage of this change. In this omegaverse setting, wasn't it that an omega couldn't sleep with someone else after they were marked by an alpha? With this kind of reason, Nanook should give up on those improper thoughts!

Phainon's mood cheered up. He said in a low voice, "Your Highness, you can tell too... You're right. I'm someone who doesn't think ahead. I'm not faithful, and I'm weak to handsome faces. I'll fall in love at first sight. I even like omegas."

In order to make Nanook change his improper thoughts, Phainon already started putting himself down. It didn't matter even if he put himself down even more.

Anyways, what he said about liking an omega was the truth. Even if Phainon hadn't even seen a single omega before.

"Your words," Nanook said, "instead make me think that we're quite well-matched."

Phainon: "?!"

"I'm fed up with this plain, ordinary life. You always bring me new surprises," Nanook said. "You can't change my mind with these words..."

"...l-it's fine even if I mess around all the time?!"

"Of course not." Although Nanook had a slight smile, his eyes were cold. "No matter who you like, from beginning to end, you can only stay by my side... And you can only keep your eyes on me."

"...Then what if someone else gets close to me?" Phainon said.

Nanook said, "Isn't it fine if I just kill the people who get close to you?"

Phainon: "...." Hey! With these kinds of thoughts, you really are worthy of being a villain, aren't you?! Then what if that person's your younger cousin!

When he thought about it, Phainon had the feeling that Nanook really could do something like killing off his younger cousin.

"Still, I won't force you."

Phainon knew that villains like this would begin to threaten people right after saying something like this. He immediately braced himself.

"I know everything about your parents," Nanook said. "The reason they had you pretend to be a beta should also be to protect their noble title. As long as you marry me, they'll be able to continue their clan, and they'll also be able to rise up to high society."

Phainon: "!" Fuck, he even brought out the parents! He already said he wouldn't use force, but as expected...

"But if you turn me down, things will probably take a turn for the worse," Nanook said. "You need to make your decision carefully."

With a heavy heart, Phainon thought about how the other party was his capture target. Finally, he made his decision. He grabbed Nanook's hand, looking up at his face earnestly. "I've thought it over."

"Oh?"

"Actually, I admire Your Highness a lot," Phainon said. "Please let me stay at your side."

Morals? Just let them die in the wind.

And he wouldn't bother with how an omega would be together with another alpha after being marked!

---

Mydei didn't even know how he got back to his room. When he returned to his senses, his things were already strewn everywhere. Even the photo album in his cabinets where scattered.

When he lowered his head, Mydei could still see the press photos of his older cousin's graduation that he had specially collected in the photo album.

The Nanook in the pictures was gentle, but even so, because of his face, he was still dazzling.

...He was so dazzling that he was instead harsh and blinding.

No matter what, Mydei had never expected that he would encounter such a situation when he came home.

Of course, Mydei would never blame Phainon no matter what.

Besides, Phainon had always seemed completely willing... But why did he fling him aside like that later? Was he led astray by that face?

Yes, it was all Nanook's fault. If he hadn't suddenly appeared, things wouldn't become like this...

As long as he could die, everything would be just like it was in the beginning.

Mydei was shocked to discover that when he thought about killing his own cousin, the one he had always worshipped, his emotions were calm.

It was already late. After straightening out his feelings, he walked to the shower.

But under the illumination of the moonlight, a photo album was laid bare on the ground. A sparkling silver dagger was stabbed through the face of the charming young man in the photo.

---

After going back, Phainon found out that Gorgo had arranged for him and Nanook to share a room... After all, Gorgo thought of the them as an engaged couple. It was a perfectly normal arrangement.

Even if he wanted to explain, he had no idea how he would explain it. Phainon could only brace himself to sleep in the same room as Nanook.

He didn't even have time to carry out his original plan to go online and explain what happened to Mydei.

And Phainon didn't know how he should explain. Things had already gotten to this point. Why not just let Mydei think it was real then?

Luckily, the bed in the room was big enough. After he finished bathing, Phainon went straight to lay down on the furthest edge, still struggling to accept what he found out earlier... How exactly was Nanook related to the Zerg!

"You're thinking about why I appeared on the planet back then?" Nanook asked. He suddenly leaned in, looking into Phainon's eyes.

Phainon was so shocked he nearly fell off the bed. He nodded. "That's really important to me."

"I can tell you. Because I like you a lot, you know." Nanook pressed himself closer to Phainon lazily. He said, "Those were actually bodies cloned from my genes. Of course, those bodies don't have my will. When I want to go somewhere, I can use them whenever I like. They're quite convenient."

"Modern technology can already do something like that?" Phainon was a bit shocked. "It can even let someone's mind get moved to someone else's body?"

He already thought that sending his consciousness to the spiritual world was incredible.

"... Of course not," Nanook said, his tone careless. "The reason I can do something is naturally because... I'm not human."

Phainon: "!" The fuck, why'd you say something like this so out of the blue? He had the feeling he was going to be silenced, okay!!

"It's a joke." Nanook reached out to poke Phainon's cheek, smiling slightly. "You actually believed it? You really are naive. It's easy for people to cheat someone like you."

Phainon: "..."

No, with his experience from years of reading novels, this was absolutely real... But if it was true, how exactly was Nanook a Zerg?

It was impossible that he inherited from the emperor. After all, Khaslana was also the emperor's son. In that case, this novel would also become a record of a Zerg's counterattack.

But if it was from the empress, then didn't that mean the Kremnoan family was all... and Mydeimos was also...

No, that shouldn't be right. Maybe it was just that Zerg genes had been introduced to the cloned body for some need. This sounded a bit more reasonable.

Phainon immediately sighed a breath of relief. He felt like he could finally explain everything.

Just at that moment, the time hit midnight. The system sounded right on schedule. [Daily task refreshed. The current task is [Kiss the capture target once]. Host, please do your best.]

Phainon: "..." There was actually a difference between a forced kiss and a kiss? The kiss didn't need to be lip-to-lip now?

[Correct.]

He really never thought that the system would release a task with so much kindness. Phainon felt unexpectedly moved.

If the system released a healing task, he would be able to test whether or not Nanook was a Zerg... Wait, even if the system didn't release a task, he could still try it out.

Phainon turned his head. Nanook had already fallen asleep next to him at some point. This was a golden opportunity to test out his theory.

Nothing bad happens nine times out of ten, Phainon reasoned. He lowered his head towards Nanook, slowly leaning in.

Just as his hand touched Nanook's shoulder, the other person's eyes suddenly opened. His yellow eyes were closer in color to liquid gold, as though he was completely emotionless. He said, "What are you trying to do?"

"It's a... good night kiss... Yes, a good night kiss!" Phainon was nearly scared out of skin, but he gathered his wits and blurted out an excuse before leaning down and pressing a kiss on Nanook's cheek.

He could even finish off his daily task while fooling him. He really was a genius.

Nanook grabbed his hand, pressing Phainon into the bed and raising one eyebrow. "Ever since earlier, I've been controlling myself, but you're still seducing me."

"I just- I just couldn't control myself because you're too good-looking," Phainon said quickly.

"Oh?" Nanook bent over, whispering into his ear, "Do you know what happens to omegas who have been marked by an alpha but can't get married to them?"

"No."

Phainon thought this setting was a pain in the ass. After an omega was marked by an alpha, they couldn't be marked by anyone else. Wouldn't it be a bother if the alpha didn't take responsibility?

Although the empire's laws dictated that alphas had to take responsibility in these circumstances, there was nothing they could do if a powerful and influential scumbag alpha didn't want to take responsibility.

And it was also illegal if an omega reached a certain age and hadn't gotten married yet. They had to pay an incredible sum in fines, and their families could even force the omega to get married or something like that... This was just a feudal society, dammit.

Although the status of an omega had risen quite a bit in the last few years, and it wasn't like in the past when they had no rights at all and they were considered solely a part of an alpha's riches, they still had to stay at home and couldn't leave.

"Those omegas will be forced to marry someone else. Even if they were already marked, they'll be forcibly possessed by that other person... You know, don't you? It's incredibly painful for an omega to couple with someone who didn't mark them," Nanook remarked. "And their spouse would detest them. When their child is born, they're worthless. There would be no one asking after their life or death."

Phainon's face turned white in terror. "!!" Fuck, system, hurry up and think of a solution!

[There's no need to worry. To prevent a situation like this, when the host transmigrated into this body, the system already transformed the body. Still, an accident occured because of a lack of familiarity with this world's world consciousness.]

"What accident..." Phainon had a bad feeling.
