[Although the host himself can let anyone mark him without minding, the alphas who marked the host will never be able to mark another person again... Still, this doesn't matter to the host. Host, you can mess around without worries."]

Phainon: "..." What kind of roast was this?! And he didn't even mess around.

When he saw Phainon's ugly expression, Nanook thought he was scared. He said, "Don't worry, I won't do anything... Recently, the research institute has begun to investigate an alteration medicine. It's almost become successful. In the future, it can resolve this problem."

Phainon sighed a breath of relief. Science truly benefited mankind, though there was no way for the people who slept with him to benefit.

No, actually he didn't want to go sleeping around with other people, okay! Even if it was someone as attractive as Nanook!

"Then what if there's no medicine?" Phainon asked. "What will happen?"

"What do you think?" Nanook smiled slightly, patting Phainon's cheek.

Phainon felt uncomfortable all over. "..." He didn't want to think about something like that!!

And even though he didn't show much on his face, in reality Phainon was still afraid of Nanook. After all, he was the villain, and he had that crazy mother. In front of him, Phainon felt like his life was at risk.

---

Despite that, when Phainon immediately spotted Nanook's beautiful face in the rays of early morning light the next day, he felt he had nearly turned gay.

"He really is too terrifying." Phainon twisted his head away quickly, feeling some lingering fear. It was just a waste for this face to be on a man!!

If he had transmigrated around fifteen years ago, he would probably have been able to see the number one beauty, the empress.

Phainon simply couldn't understand the emperor's sense of aesthetic. He didn't like someone as beautiful as the empress, but instead liked a pretty face with a vicious heart... Well, that could just be his taste.

After they got out of bed, Nanook brought Phainon to a restaurant to eat.

Mydei was already waiting for them. His expression looked exactly the same as normal, and his eyes also looked normal when he looked at Phainon. He didn't like someone who had been cheated on yesterday night.

Gorgo felt a bit worried after she hadn't been able to find Mydei when she went looking for him yesterday, but when she saw her son's current attitude she relaxed.

When Mydei saw the two of them approaching, he stood up to speak. "Yesterday, I was too shocked to process the circumstances. I truly apologize for leaving the way I did."

Nanook smiled slightly, as though he had absolutely no idea what his cousin was thinking. "That's great."

Phainon sighed in relief. It would be for the best if Mydei could think things through. But how would he tell Mydei about what the system said yesterday?

The system had dug a deep hole for Mydei. The bootlicking system was so good to the capture target that it even made the host a little jealous, but its attitude to the previous capture target was terrifyingly indifferent.

The system certainly wouldn't bother with a capture target like Mydei who had a modification trap set up for them... In other words, Mydei had been bound to Phainon.

Still, the circumstances were a little better than in the original novel. After all, in the original novel, the person Mydei liked was even more scary and even more scummy.

"It's enough if you're happy." Mydei looked at Phainon, looking incredibly genuine.

"Of course I'll bring him happiness," Nanook said, smiling slightly.

His attitude made it seem like he had some hidden intention. Still, looking at his warm smile, there was probably no one would think he was doing it on purpose...

Phainon: "..." Hey, this guy was simply insane! No wonder Mydei was betrayed in the original novel. He probably felt really happy making his little cousin despair...

They began to eat breakfast. Of course, everyone was immersed in their own thoughts. Other than Phainon, not a single person could enjoy the flavor of the delicious food.

After they finished eating, Nanook said, "I'm planning to bring My Deliverer home today."

"So soon?" Gorgo was a bit shocked. "Your Highness, won't you stay here a little long?"

In reality, Gorgo wanted to send His Highness the Crown Prince away as soon as possible. When His Highness the Crown Prince first came, it was something to be proud of, but who knew it would cause something like this to happen... Even if Mydei was perfectly normal right now, who knew if he would do something irrational?

"No... The purpose for my visit was to pick up My Deliverer and leave." Nanook smiled slightly. "Now this purpose has been accomplished, we can leave." As he spoke, he even turned to look at Phainon.

Phainon had no choice but to speak up. "Yeah, I think we can leave now too."

In fact, Phainon really wanted to try out the hot springs, but how could he say it now?

If it was the past Mydei, he might have been so disgusted that he lost his appetite. Now, though, he still looked calm, as though he didn't care about what was happening at all.

After finishing his food, Phainon was taken out the door and straight onto Nanook's private airship.

Phainon was very nervous. He didn't know where he would be taken.

Nanook said, "Mm, it's time to meet Mother-in-Law and Father-in-Law."

Phainon: "Huh!?"

So when Nanook said they were getting married, he was actually being serious?! Would others really have no objections... Still, when he thought about it, with the emperor's attitude of turning a blind eye towards Nanook, the emperor would probably be ecstatic if he heard that Nanook was randomly getting married to someone from an impoverished noble family.

As for other people, even the chief of the Kremnoan family Gorgo couldn't control Nanook. What could anyone else do?

At that moment, the airship sailed towards the planet that Phainon thought he would never visit again.

Phainon felt a bit disturbed. After all, last time he even brought Mydei home. Besides, Audata and Hieronymus really liked Mydei. They practically thought of Mydei as his future partner. Wouldn't it cause any problems if he brought another person?

After they got out of the airship, they should have taken an aircar straight to their destination. However, Nanook suddenly had the strange idea to take a look around Phainon's hometown. No matter how Phainon tried to persuade him, nothing worked. He took Phainon straight out from the port.

In moments, the two of them drew the surrounding crowd's attention.

Nanook was incredibly attractive. Even if he wasn't the crown prince, he would still be someone that people paid attention to. Although he was currently wearing a pair of sunglasses to conceal his identity, in reality there wasn't much of a different compared to if he wasn't wearing them.

After everyone got over their shocked, they became incredibly excited. "It's His Highness the Crown Prince?!"

"Why would His Highness the Crown Prince be here!"

"Ahhhh am I dreaming?"

Immediately, the port became a mass of chaos. Huge numbers of people squeezed closer. Still, nobody dared to come close to the two of them, and there were still two hundred meters around Nanook left empty. Outside of those two hundred meters, a sea of people had already gathered.

Phainon was intimidated. The spectacle made him feel like he was going to be trampled in the next second. At his side, Nanook looked like he was already used to it and didn't have the slightest bit of anxiety. Instead, he waved at the people around them with a slight smile, making everyone begin to shriek.

Because they were right outside the port, what happened completely affected the port's normal operations. People around them who didn't know what happened even thought there might be some kind of riot.

Finally, the governor of the planet hurried over. At first, he just wanted to find out who was causing the disturbance, but when he realized the person who had come was His Highness the Crown Prince, he was so excited his hands began to tremble. He immediately invited Nanook onto his aircar.

When Nanook was gone, the crowd dispersed quickly, but they couldn't calm down. They quickly posted the pictures they took onto the virtual net.

And the person next to His Highness the Crown Prince in the photos drew the other people's attention.

---

On the aircar.

Phainon remembered from the original owner's memories that the governor was high and mighty. He had never been polite. Unexpectedly, now that he was in front of Nanook, he changed completely.

"Could I ask what Your Highness is doing here?" Along with his excitement, the governor felt completely off-balance. He was afraid that the things he had done in the past had been exposed. "I-Is there something we've done poorly here?"

One of his subordinates, who was pouring tea on the side, was extremely nervous. Several times, he nearly poured tea outside of the cup. Even when he tried his best to maintain his calm, he couldn't stop his trembling hands.

"No, I just wanted to come see my future in-laws... But things turned out like this." Nanook sighed. "I also feel very troubled."

Phainon: "..." Actually, this guy should be really happy. He was as happy as however much of a mess he made. He wouldn't care what other people were thinking.

When the governor heard him, he was stunned.

The Crown Prince's in-laws?! How could someone with such a high status be on this planet? He knew very clearly that although the planet was relatively closer to the capital planet, it wasn't some kind of tourist planet. Other than a few nouveau riche who wanted to be a bit closer to the noble circles, there was only a few downtrodden nobles who resided on the planet.

The person next to the governor saw Phainon's face clearly. Immediately, he froze. "This young man is Hieronymus’s..."

The governor suddenly recalled that he hadn't thought about the young man at all, though he thought Phainon looked familiar. After all, his family was such an impoverished noble family. How could they know someone as awe-inspiring as His Highness the Crown Prince? Now that his subordinate reminded him, he suddenly remembered.

"It's been a while since we last met," Phainon greeted, although he didn't really want to explain his identity.

The governor thought that Phainon was just one of the crown prince's followers, but that position alone was enough to stun him. He didn't expect that a mere beta from a rundown noble family would be able to lick the crown prince's boots. If he had known earlier, he would have had his own child get on friendly terms with him.

In the next moment, Nanook pulled Phainon right into his arms, announcing their relationship openly. "Actually, Deliverer here is my fiancé. In the last few years, he's received your care."

The governor was stupefied. He wished he could go back in time. He completely regretted that he hadn't gone to cozy up with his family.

But the subordinate at his side was as white as paper. He tugged at the governor's clothing cautiously.

This was their signal. Immediately, the governor smiled apologetically, saying that he had something to care of, and walked out to the hallway.

The governor looked at his subordinate with worry. "What in the world is it? Quick, spit it out." He was in a rush to seize the opportunity to show his kindness to His Highness the Crown Princess. If he wasted this change, he wouldn't have such a precious opportunity again.

"Sir... You must have forgotten." His subordinate's face was pale. "Recently, sir, you agreed to some of the that family's requests... Now, they might already have..."

The governor went stiff. He suddenly remembered.

Some people in the family's side branches had gotten him some benefits. They seemed to have plans to do something to the main branch, so he pretended that he didn't see them and allowed them to mess around on the main family's territory. Anyway, a family as downtrodden as this one could't cause any ruckus.

He didn't expect that now the supposedly downtrodden family's Phainon had managed to cling onto such a powerful person. He had no idea how Phainon had managed to become the crown prince's fiancé. Was he done for?!

The governor nearly fainted. His subordinate quickly caught him. The governor took a long time before he came back to his senses, and he hoarsely rasped, "Hurry and stop those people quickly. We can't let His Highness find out..."

If he got found out, there was no need to mention his future. He might not even be able to keep his current position!

---

Meanwhile, Audata and Hieronymus was gloomy.

Recently, a side branch of the family produced an extremely outstanding alpha named Herklas. He was a few years older than Phainon, and he was measured to be a genius when he was born. After Audata had her accident, she had thought about adopting Herklas, but it had been left unsettled for a variety of reasons.

Recently, Herklas had succeeded in becoming subordinate to a patriarch of one of the Kremnoan's branch families. Although it was just a branch family, they suddenly had unprecedented influence and power. Afterwards, they began to make moves towards the main family's title.

At first, Audata and Hieronymus put out a huge price for the people who were coveting their position. But even though the family was in dire straits, their only child Phainon was still an omega pretending to be a beta. They had no way to resist Herklas, someone under the Kremnoan family's protection.

Although Mydei had visited the other time, Hieronymus and Audata were completely in the dark about his identity. They had even less of an idea about the heir of the distant Kremnoan family coming to pay a visit

that day. They still went to the kitchen and cooked, thinking that it was just one of Phainon's average classmates.

"What exactly is the best way to go forward?" Audata couldn't stop her tears. Her health had finally recovered, and Phainon was doing much better in school. She thought that they could finally shake off their difficulties. She had never expected that something like this would happen.

"When you think about it, it's all this title's fault." Hieronymus sighed. "We might as well just turn it over. Herklas shouldn't treat us poorly in the future... This way, Phainon will be able to be a normal omega."

"You're right..." Audata said.

They were about to continue discussing when the front door was flung open. It was haughty young man with a forehead full of sweat and a huge group of people. He walked in, swollen with pride. When the people behind him were inside, they began to pound on the walls around the room.

"What are you doing?" Hieronymus hastily shielded Audata, looking at Herklas with fury.

"Gosh, Uncle Hieronymus, didn't I say that the decorations in this house were too awful?" Herklas sat right down on the sofa, his attitude lazy. He raised an eyebrow, looking at Audata and Hieronymus. "Anyway, this house is going to be mine in the end. Why don't I start putting things in order now? It'll make it easy for me to move in quickly.

"You...! I haven't agreed yet. Hurry up and stop!" Hieronymus gritted his teeth. Although he was an alpha, his natural talents were mediocre, and he still wasn't very strong today. Otherwise, he wouldn't have let his family fall to such straits.

"Oh?" Herklas looked indifferent. "Does it matter whether you agree or not?"

"We're all relatives. Why go to such extremes?" Hieronymus said furiously. "Don't think that you can do this just by taking advantage of the Kremnoan name."

"Gosh, Uncle, you're already so old, don't get too angry. It'll be bad if your health is affected," Herklas sneered. "Still, Uncle, what you mean is that you want to go against the Kremnoan family with your strength alone? You really make people shocked by your courage... I admire you."

"You..." Hieronymus had no choice but to admit it. Forget about fighting back; the Kremnoan family could flatten them with the strength in their little finger.

"If you kiss up to me quickly, I can still look after you until you're old," Herklas said coolly. "At first, I didn't value this stupid title too much."

"We don't need you to look after us until we're old..." It was obvious that even if Audata was planning to hand over their title on a silver platter, the other party wouldn't treat them well. She gritted her teeth. "We have an heir ourselves."

"Oh? An heir?" Herklas had naturally investigated before coming, but he only knew that the dukedom had servants.

Herklas didn't dare to offend the duke, but a duke's servant had the courage to resist the Kremnoan family? He said with disdain, "That Phainon guy... Isn't he just a beta? He's just useless trash."

Suddenly, a voice came from the door. "Who did you call useless trash?"

Chapter End Notes

The Author Has Something To Say: Yay! New Chapter! I hope you enjoy spending time with Nanook because we'll be seeing a lot more of him from now on. Haha i love Phainon questioning Mydei's previous crush on Khas calling Khas a scummy crazy person XD. This chapter was kinda boring but we're heading towards the ending soon!

See you next week!

chapters.title: Chapter 19: He's My Fiancé
chapters.html:
Herklas was unhappy to be interrupted halfway through his sentence. He had already given the governor plenty of benefits, but he had still been disturbed by someone else.

He turned his head in annoyance. Immediately, he spotted Phainon and the governor standing at the door.

Although Herklas hadn't seen Phainon in many years, for better or worse he had looked up his information before coming and had an idea of what Phainon looked like. He snorted at once. "And here I thought it was someone important. So it's just Phainon. Do you think there's a problem with something I said? Do you think you're so amazing?"

"What's going on here?" Phainon immediately turned to look at the governor. "You'd better explain this clearly."

Despite his words, Phainon could pretty much guess what was happening... Just now when they were on the airship, he had a feeling the governor's attitude was off.

The governor's face was ashen. He blurted, "Actually, this is all a mistake. It was just that a member of the branch family wanted to come and take a look around. I don't know where the miscommunication was..." Simultaneously, he gave Herklas several meaningful glances, hoping he would play along.

He had barely managed to calm down on the airship just now and resourcefully said that they ought to bring gifts when visiting the in-laws. He had successfully managed to delay the crown prince.

But Phainon had noticed something, and insisted on hurrying back. The governor had no choice but to come along, thinking he would still be able to salvage the situation. He didn't expect that he would spot this kind of situation at once. He immediately felt his head begin to spin.

Even if you wanted to snatch someone else's noble title, there should be no need to act like this! Herklas was too arrogant. He had even begun to plunder the house.

As the governor thought, he also forgot what he had guaranteed Herklas when he first accepted his bribes.

It was a pity that Herklas completely missed the governor's signals. He snorted. "I came this time for the family's noble title. There's no mistake at all. It seems to me, sir, that you've forgotten something."

Audata and Hieronymus looked at the governor next to Phainon in shock. They knew that Herklas had bought over the governor a long time ago, so they thought the governor had come to pressure them. Their hearts sank.

They just didn't expect that Phainon would also come. If he impulsively began to argue with the governor, it would be terrible. Audata quickly stepped forward, tugging at Phainon. With worry, she said, "Phainon, why are you here? You don't need to worry about this... We can deal with it."

But Hieronymus stared coldly at the governor. "We've stayed on this planet for several years. We paid plenty of fees every year. Sir, if you've become biased towards someone else for this trifling benefits, my heart has truly gone cold."

When the governor heard his words, he was ready to faint away. He hurried to say, "You've made a mistake, my lord. I haven't come because of that."

Hieronymus was shocked by his address. It was the first time the governor used the words "my lord" in all these years.

Although the governor was unwilling to let go of Herklas's benefits at first, Phainon was right next to him. This was the crown prince's fiancé! How could he offend him? Were those bribes as important as his position?! Did he even need to think about it?

The governor made a prompt decision. He said to Herklas, "I have no idea what is happening here. The way you barged into Phainon’s family's house truly has no regard for me as governor. As for the family's noble title, you're just a member of the branch family. Unless the heir of the family dies, it's impossible for you to inherit the family."

Phainon: "..." Hey, your attitude changed too fast, didn't it? Besides, he should be the one saying these cheesy lines... The governor was making it seem like he was the heir of the family.

Audata and Hieronymus were stunned by the governor's rapid change of heart. They had absolutely no idea the governor would speak up for them like this. They had already known each other for decades, but he had never faced them with a smile. If the governor, who only recognized wealth and not personality, turned into such a fair and honest person, the world didn't feel quite real.

Herklas couldn't help but laugh in his anger. He sneered, "I've already given you the money. You don't want to recognize it anymore, sir? The Kremnoan family is supporting me. You should think it over one more time."

Should the governor choose Herklas, who had the Kremnoan family supporting him, or three people who had nothing but their noble title?

The governor chose almost without hesitation. Damn it, compared to the crown prince, Herklas's Kremnoan family meant jack shit. The crown prince could kill them all without even lifting his pinky finger.

"So what if you have the Kremnoan family? I won't subdue because of something like that." The governor looked firm and just. "Even if the chief of the Kremnoan family came personally, I would still stand by my word!"

Audata and Hieronymus were dumbfounded. They wondered if the governor had been possessed.

It was the first time Herklas met someone who would remain unmoved after hearing the Kremnoan name. He frowned, wondering how much money Phainon had bribed the governor with to make him speak up on his behalf.

Although he was close to the Kremnoan family, he had no way to keep rising up if he didn't blow his money. After all, there were many strong people around. If it wasn't for this, he wouldn't insist on seizing the family's title.

Herklas said, "According to clan laws, only the strongest alpha of the next generation can inherit a title. Phainon is just a useless beta. He has no right to inherit. Even if I'm a branch member, I'm the strongest alpha in this generation. I'm clearly more qualified than he is."

The governor's head ached. This was rule from hundreds of years ago. It had been abolished ages ago.

Although there were some people who held nostalgia for the past and still practiced the tradition, in reality there weren't many families who followed it. He didn't expect that Herklas would bring it up. He was truly shameless! It was obvious how many times his parents had said it to him.

Just as the governor was going to sneer something at Herklas, Phainon suddenly spoke up.

"What you mean is that you're sure you're the strongest in our generation?"

"Of course." Herklas curled his lip, looking at Phainon. "I'm different from a beta like you who could only get into the empire's military institute through a back door. I was admitted into a military institute by recommendation, and I graduated in the top ten."

However, he attended one of the lower-ranked schools in the five major military institutes and not the empire's military institute. This had always made Herklas unhappy. Regardless of whether it was natural gift or ability, he was several times stronger than Phainon. Why could Phainon get into the empire's military institute with the help of his parents' connections? On the other hand, he had struggled long and hard and was only able to make it into a lesser military institute.

If he was in Phainon's position, he would certainly have even greater achievements. He would be on par with Khaslana of the empire's military institute.

"Then I'll fight a match with you. If you win, then I'll give you the position of heir. What do you think?" Phainon said suddenly.

He had completely given up on the idea of hiding his strength. In any case, he was already sucking up to the crown prince. He could just leave everything to Nanook to deal with.

Audata and Hieronymus were stunned. They were very clear about Phainon's abilities. He would certainly lose. They nearly grabbed onto Phainon's clothes to stop him on the spot.

Again, the governor felt like he was going to faint. If he kept getting shock after shock like this, he wouldn't be able to take it.

Things had been going perfectly smoothly. Why did Phainon say something like this? If he couldn't keep the title with Phainon’s family, the crown prince would cut him into bits!

"You guys don't need to say anything. I've already thought it over," Phainon said to his parents.

Hieronymus sighed. Secretly, he thought that Phainon must want to hand over the position of heir in a more respectable way. That was fine. Anyway, he had earned a good amount of money in the last few years. Even if they didn't have their title, they wouldn't be in complete poverty with no way forward.

Herklas laughed in delight. "Phainon, do you really think you're so amazing just because you attend the empire's military institute? Let me beat you into the ground, and I'll let you know what strength really is."

"And if you lose?" Phainon said.

"If I lose," Herklas sneered, "then I'll go straight to a rural planet and mine. I'll never come back to the heart of the empire." He didn't consider Phainon to be his match in the slightest. He threw out a promise casually.

After both parties signed a contract, they got ready to fight. However, the family didn't have a mecha or a fighting arena, so the group of people went to a mecha training site in the heart of the city.

Mecha training sites like these allowed people who couldn't afford mechas to practice. Normally, there were occasional fights, but there weren't many spectators. After all, the competitors were all quite amateur.

But this time, after hearing it was a fight for a noble title, and the governor was acting as guarantor, the manager of the training site sensed a financial opportunity. He immediately allowed to let them use the arena for free. Simultaneously, he began to spread the word.

The tickets sold out in seconds. All of the spots were packed. There were even some of Herklas's fans who became incredibly excited after hearing that he had come to fight.

Herklas had never participated in a virtual mecha competition, but he would occasionally participate in a few small-scale competitions. That, combined with his decently handsome appearance, meant he had some popularity.

"Is that Herklas? I've seen his mecha fights on the virtual net before. With his skill, if he participates in the virtual mecha competition, he'll certainly be in the top hundred."

"My god, why is someone so amazing fighting here?"

"I heard that he's here to win his family's title."

"The heir of the main branch of the family... I think his name is Phainon. He's just a beta, right? I saw him in a mecha fight before. He has absolutely no skill. It made me wonder if he even knew how to pilot a mecha."

"Then the winner of this fight is obvious."

"Sure enough, it's better to give the title to someone with real strength like Herklas."

"It's too bad. It would be nice if they were evenly matched. I wanted to watch an exciting match... Still, it'll be pretty cool to see an expert like Herklas crush his opponent."

No matter how you thought about it, it was Herklas who was in the wrong for coming to take someone else's title, but this was an empire that respected the powerful, so everyone was on Herklas's side. Only a small portion of people would take pity on the original heir, Phainon.

The governor couldn't stop Phainon. His forehead was full of sweat, but he could do nothing. He could only buy the best seats and invite Audata and Hieronymus to sit. He fawned over them, hoping to give himself a few more brownie points in the crown prince's in-laws' hearts.

He didn't have any dreams of being promoted up to the peak of achievement. He would be happy as long as he was able to avoid being banished to a remote planet.

Two mechas walked into the center of the arena. Both of them were provided by the training site, and they were both exactly the same. It was quite fair.

Immediately, many people in the stands began to shout Herklas's name. There were even several people who were confessing directly.

Herklas felt incredibly proud. He opened his mouth to speak.

The model of mecha he was using had a special function that allowed the contestants to amplify their voices for everyone to here.

"Thank you for your support, everyone. If there's anyone in the audience who is interested, after the competition ends, I'll perform for a few minutes for everyone. If there's anyone feeling uncertain about mechas, you can also come and ask me directly."

He spoke as if he had already won, and he could defeat Phainon in minutes.

But nobody in the audience felt that there was anything wrong with his attitude. In fact, they felt like they had lucked out. Even Audata and Hieronymus felt the same. They watched the arena nervously, afraid to even breathe.

On the other hand, Phainon was perfectly calm. He didn't say a word even until the match began. Whispers erupted in the stands, discussing whether or not he was so scared he couldn't say anything.

When the match started, Herklas opened with an incredibly difficult move. It was the kind of move that drew the most attention from young people. Although it was magnificent, it was in fact a flashy trick without much use.

The crowd immediately burst out in applause, as though they were watching a mecha exhibition show.

Herklas charged at Phainon, who still had no reaction. He was moving as though with great difficulty, just like a beginner piloting a mecha.

Herklas smirked. To maintain his outside reputation, he faked a gentle attitude. "Phainon, I really apologize. Although I don't want to see you lose the position of heir... Well, we need a strong person to inherit the position to lead the family back to glory." As he spoke, his weapon thrust right at Phainon's cockpit.

The weapons in competitions like these were specially made. In reality, they didn't have much capacity to harm; when they stabbed through the opponent's cockpit, they would simply make the other person's mecha stop operating.

Audata was already covering her eyes, afraid to look. Hieronymus forced himself to keep watching, but he knew what the result would be.

The governor watched on, feeling like his world had already collapsed, but he had to endure. If anything happened, he had to have people immediately bring Phainon to the hospital... Today, his health felt especially fragile.

But Phainon's mecha moved. It was just a gentle, minute movement, and he caught Herklas's blow as if by accident.

Herklas was stunned. He gritted his teeth. "A good-for-nothing caught my attack? How utterly humiliating."

He immediately maneuvered his mecha to pull back, spouting out fakely wise words. "Phainon, I'll give you this one as courtesy for all the years we've known each other."

The crowd, who had felt uncertain after the earlier situation, suddenly saw the light. So Herklas was going easy on him. No wonder his attack would be caught.

After he spoke, Herklas got ready to use an even more flashy move to defeat Phainon. He immediately prepared his position.

"Isn't Herklas using the move that's talked about in the textbook?!"

"Oh my god, this move is incredibly difficult. I used to be a mecha teacher, and I can't even do it!"

Everyone was worked up. Many people had their terminals out to record, wanting to catch the legendary move on camera.

But what they couldn't have imagined was that when the magnificent, amazing move was used against Phainon, it was caught again. It made the magnificence dim into nothing.

"Shit, what's with this Phainon guy?!" Herklas was going crazy. He braced himself. "This time, I'm giving courtesy to your mother and father. I'll give it to you one more time. Next time, I'll fight for real."

Now, Herklas didn't dare to act cool. He grabbed his weapon, aiming at the weakest point of Phainon's mecha, and attacked.

But Phainon didn't stand in place obediently waiting for his beating anymore. He maneuvered his mecha to dodge the attack and then took the offensive.

Phainon didn't use any flashy moves, but his speed and ease was astonishing. It was obvious at a glance that he was skilled with mechas.

The crowd couldn't help but feel like they had been thinking along the wrong lines. It looked like Phainon had been practicing properly at the empire's military institute. The people who hadn't spared a glance for him now had a change of heart.

When Herklas was suddenly attacked, he was given a shock. He counterattacked furiously and successfully blocked Phainon's attack, but he still felt a wave of lingering fear. Luckily, his combat experience allowed him to react and counterattack by relying on his instincts.

Herklas felt another wave of humiliation. He wanted to fight back in his fury, but he was shocked to find that he had no opportunity.

It was as though Phainon had an eye on every part of the battlefield. He attacked Herklas continuously so that he could block one spot but not the other. His limbs moved in a flurry, but his mind could barely keep up.

At some point, the crowd began to hold their breaths. They watched the competition seriously, feeling that the match they were watching wasn't the one-sided beating they had expected. Instead, they felt an unforeseen excitement.

Not even a minute had elapsed, but Herklas was already feeling exhausted. His panting, heavy from nerves, was broadcast to the entire arena, making everyone feel a sense of panic.

"...How could he be so strong? He's just a beta... How could he..."

Unexpectedly, Herklas felt the same feeling he had when he first entered the Kremnoan family and he had been easily defeated by the bodyguard of a branch family head. He had never known until then that he wasn't the most outstanding. There were countless people even more impressive than him.

"I-it's impossible. No matter how impressive he is, he's just a beta. He can't win over me at all!"

In the next moment, Phainon pulled back his offensive.

But Herklas didn't dare to advance. The attacks just now had shaken his morale. He felt as though no matter where he attacked, Phainon would be able to counter easily.

"The warm up should end here," Phainon suddenly said.

The stands rose up in an uproar. Could it be that all of Phainon's moves just now were warmups? That was too ridiculous!

Before the match, they would have jeered at Phainon. Now that the match had started, there was nobody who would say anything, because they all had a feeling that Phainon was probably the real deal.

"What did you say?! A mere beta has the guts to be so arrogant!" Herklas was enraged. He rushed up, planning to attack Phainon.

Because of his agitation, Herklas completely forgot to guard. His mind was a ball of fire that wanted to teach Phainon not to give him cheek.

But he discovered that he couldn't operate at all. The mecha wouldn't move at all.

"What?" Herklas was breathless in his shock. "Did this mecha break?"

The crowd was silent. Everyone had an unusual expression on their face.

Herklas realized something had happened. He looked up and realized that Phainon's weapon was pressed against his mecha's cockpit... It was for this same reason that his mecha had stopped moving.

"You lost," Phainon said.

Herklas was stunned. He wanted to resist, unwilling to accept his defeat, but he discovered that his body was weak. At some point, it had filled with cold sweat, and almost felt like he couldn't even stand.

The people in the stands were also shocked. It had only been minutes since the start of the match to now, but victory had been reversed easily. Phainon, who they thought had no strength at all, had won so easily, and Herklas, who they all expected to win, had lost so badly.

The crowd began to applaud fiercely. No matter who won, the person they worshipped would always be the one with strength.

When Audata heard the applause around her, she moved away her hands, looking at the arena with sorrow, but she discovered that Hieronymus was incredibly worked up. She blurted, "What happened? Phainon is fine, isn't he?"

"He's fine, he's fine." Hieronymus almost couldn't calm himself down. Although he was an alpha, he didn't have the slightest bit of talent with a mecha. After he grew up, he had no choice but to admit it, and he was forced to give up on his dreams and choose to become a businessman.

In the past, Hieronymus had once hoped that his child could carry on his dreams, but he only had an omega child, and because of the difficult birth, his wife was left with an illness and could never bear a child again.

Since then, Hieronymus had never held onto his hopes. Although he had always raised Phainon as a beta, when all was said and done, he wasn't a real beta and he was completely ignorant about mechas. They couldn't force him to learn.

But now, looking at the sight of Phainon fighting in the arena, Hieronymus remembered his dreams from the past. He couldn't help tearing up.

Audata finally realized that Phainon had won. When she thought about how Phainon was actually an omega, she was both excited and distressed. She even began to cry. "Our Phainon, he... he's really worked himself too hard."

After the governor let out a sigh of relief, he felt that it was only natural. Phainon was the person His Highness the Crown Prince selected as his fiancé! Of course he was talented. Although he was a beta, he wasn't any worse than an alpha. It was no wonder that he was able to cling onto the crown prince's side.

After the match ended, the two people got off from their mechas.

After bitter training, Phainon was able to extend the time he could pilot a mecha using spiritual energy up to five minutes... Moreover, he wouldn't be so weak after he disconnected.

Now that he had finished the fight, Phainon felt like all his training was completely worth it. It was too bad that omegas have too many physical limitations. If he had transmigrated into an alpha, he would even be able to become as OP as Long Aotian.

Herklas stayed in his mecha in a daze. He couldn't accept that he had lost right in front of everyone. He rushed to grab Phainon, but the sharp-eyed governor hurriedly called people over to stop him.

"Phainon, how could you win against me?" Herklas was being held back by several people. He glared at Phainon, besides himself in his rage. "You must have cheated!"

"If you're saying I cheated, then bring out the evidence." Phainon looked back at him calmly.

The governor's attitude similarly cooled. "Everyone saw how you did during the match. Everything was inspected before the match, and you signed the contract. Even if you don't want to honor the contract, you can't wrong someone and say they cheated for no reason."

"I'm someone that the Kremnoan family has recognized! How could I lose to a beta?!" Herklas refused to admit it, but he couldn't bring out any evidence that Phainon cheated. He could only say, "It's because I didn't bring out my all just now. I demand another round! If Phainon wins again, then I'll believe that he didn't cheat!"

The crowd's disdainful expressions changed when they heard the name "Kremnoan". If Herklas was telling the truth, then he might really have lost because he didn't bring out his all. After all, the Kremnoan family was the number one family in the empire.

As for what Herklas said about Phainon cheating, there weren't many people who believed it. Mecha training sites had high-level examination machinery. It was as hard to cheat as it was to climb up to the sky. If it was really cheating, it was absolutely expose several scandals. Even the governor wouldn't be able to assume responsibility.

"Who cheated?" A voice came from the door.

Everyone froze. They turned their heads. In the next second, the crowd erupted in screams.

"Ahhhh I was able to see His Highness here?"

"I didn't believe it when someone said they saw him before..."

"Oh no, I'm going to faint..."

Nanook walked over, wearing black sunglasses. He had a slight smile on his face and looked incredibly gentle. The people following after him were holding several bags, both large and small.

"Your Highness?" Herklas naturally recognized the crown prince. He got up, feeling excited.

If he could seize this opportunity, why would he pledge his loyalty to whatever Kremnoan family? If he could go to the crown prince for shelter, he would have an even better future. Besides, he was so strong. The crown prince would certainly be happy to take him into his troops.

The governor broke out in cold sweat. He didn't know what he could this time and if he could make His Highness the Crown Prince let him go for his hard work.

The more Herklas thought, the harder he struggled free of the people holding him back. He rushed up to Nanook, half kneeling, his voice serious. "Your Highness, there's a contestant in this match who may have cheated. Sir, you must investigate clearly."

Herklas began to explain his fair competition with Phainon over the position of heir. He didn't expect that Phainon, a beta without any fighting power, would cheat and make him lose. He took the chance while he was in front of Nanook to introduce some of his glorious achievements, thinking himself to be quick-witted and sure that he would leave a deep impression on the crown prince.

"Why do you think Phainon cheated?" Nanook said.

Herklas was bold and confident. "He's just a beta. How could he win against me?" He looked at the crown prince.

"Oh?" Nanook looked at him with a smile that wasn't a smile.

Herklas thought that the crown prince believed him. He turned his head proudly and spotted the governor's ugly expression. He even thought that the governor was afraid that he would be exposed for taking bribes, and he quickly said, "This governor actually accepted that family's money. He shamelessly covered up Phainon's cheating. Someone like this doesn't match up to his position."

Now that the crown prince was involved, the governor ought to forget about shielding Phainon... Besides, the family's noble title was naturally Herklas's.

But, he suddenly wondered, why in the world did someone like the crown prince come to this planet? Still, it wasn't anything important. The important thing was that the crown prince had come, and he could go a step further.

The governor's face turned even more colorful. He was looking at Herklas almost with pity. He was certain now; with Herklas drawing all the hatred, no matter what he said, he wouldn't be left too miserable.

But Audata and Hieronymus was panicked. They looked hastily towards Nanook. "Phainon certainly didn't cheat."

"Your Highness, you can't believe his one-sided statement."

Immediately, Nanook looked down at Herklas. "Do you think I'll believe you?"

"Why not?" Herklas thought the crown prince was testing him. He immediately said, "No matter what happens, as someone the Kremnoan family chose, I would never lose to Phainon. The truth of this matter is already very clear."

The audience couldn't bear to look. After all, Herklas only knew how to say again and again that he couldn't lose, but he couldn't bring out any evidence that the other party cheated. Still, the Kremnoan family was behind Herklas, and the crown prince's mother was also from the Kremnoan family. Would he believe Herklas because of this?"

"Then do you know Phainon's identity?" Nanook smiled slightly.

"He's nothing but a student at the empire's military institute. He doesn't matter at all," Herklas said without hesitation. "I know everything. He got into the institute through bribery, and he's always messing around at school."

"Then do you know," Nanook said softly, "that he's my fiancé?"

Chapter End Notes

The Author Has Something To Say: Yay! A new chapter!! We get some more face slapping done by Phainon! Can you tell that's my favourite genre of Phainon? Putting people in their place. I hope these recent chapters aren't too boring haha but there's only about three chapters left of this fic so bare with me. And gotta love Nanook stirring the pot and staking his claim XD.

See You Next Week!

chapters.title: Chapter 20: Nanook
chapters.html:
Herklas was frozen on the ground. For a long time, he was speechless. His mind was blank. He knew every word the crown prince was saying, but why couldn't he understand what he meant?

The surrounding crowd was thoroughly stupefied. Were their ears malfunctioning? They seemed to have heard the crown prince say something about a fiancé?

"So you're saying that even if my fiancé cheats, he has to lose against you?" Nanook looked at Herklas with a slight smile.

By now, Herklas didn't feel that His Highness the Crown Prince was smiling at him because of his value. In his terror, his legs went weak, and he fell to the floor.

Why was it like this? That Phainon was clearly just trash without a single redeeming feature. Why did His Highness the Crown Prince like him? What was wrong with this world...

"N-No, it was an accident..." In reality, Herklas knew perfectly well that Phainon couldn't have cheated, but he wasn't willing to believe it. He could only mumble over and over, "I couldn't fight at full strength just for a moment earlier..."

But Nanook ignored him. He turned and walked towards Phainon.

Audata and Hieronymus were completely dumbfounded. Next to them, the governor stood close to them as though he was a good friend. He stepped forward enthusiastically and said to Nanook, "Your Highness, I didn't expect that a branch member of the family would be so shameless. If I hadn't come so promptly, I don't know how things would have turned out." He spoke as though he hadn't accepted any bribes from Herklas.

When Herklas heard the governor, he whipped his head up furiously. He didn't have the courage to put his hatred on Phainon, the crown prince's fiancé, so he diverted all of his anger onto the governor.

It looked like the governor had known about this already. Why else would his attitude change so quickly? The worst part was that the governor exposed him completely. It was obvious that he had already decided to push all the blame onto Herklas!

Herklas completely forgot how he responded when the governor was signaling him when things started.

"Mother-in-law, Father-in-law, hello." Nanook looked towards Audata and Hieronymus with a slight smile, motioning for his subordinates to bring the gifts over. "I was a little delayed because I was buying gifts earlier. It's great that nothing happened."

Audata and Hieronymus were more frightened than they were pleasantly surprised. They had never expected that the crown prince would start liking their own son. They worried about whether or not the crown prince knew Phainon was actually an omega.

The governor began to explain again. Of course, he hid the truth about how he accepted bribes and told them about everything Herklas and his lackeys had done.

It made everyone sigh in wonder. They had never thought that Herklas, a handsome man with outstanding bearing, could do something so shameless. The people who used to be his fans felt humiliated and left stealthily. On their way home, they unfollowed him, wishing they could erase all traces of their worship as if it had never happened.

"You've done quite well." Nanook looked towards the governor. Naturally, he had already investigated the situation thoroughly, but he was quite satisfied with the governor's attitude. Although the governor's previous actions weren't very sensible, his change was pretty good.

After Nanook's praise, the governor was as energized as if he had been shot with a dose of adrenaline. He said quickly, "I'd be the first one to stop someone like this from running rampant. They can't do whatever they want just because they think they're so strong and amazing." Though he didn't mention any names, it was obvious he was talking about Herklas.

After being pointed out, Herklas jolted back to his senses. He knew that if he didn't retract his words, he would have no chance at redemption. He threw himself at Phainon, hugging him around the leg. "Phainon-ge, I was wrong. I shouldn't have done something like this... I know I can't say anything to make up for it, but we grew up together. Why don't you have His Highness the Crown Prince spare me this time?"

Phainon, who had been thinking of himself as a bystander, was given a shock. He wasn't able to shake off Herklas even if he tried. Besides, what was with that Phainon-ge! Anyways, Herklas was several years older than him... He was so shameless.

But Nanook's gaze turned cold. What he hated the most was when outsiders touched the people he cared about. He immediately had his subordinates pull Herklas aside. He looked at him coldly. "I don't know who in the Kremnoan family accepted scum like you as their subordinate. It looks like their judgement is lacking."

It was easy to imagine how the person who accepted Herklas would react when they found out what the His Highness the Crown Prince had said.

Herklas's body was trembling as he was dragged away. He was filled with regret. He hated himself for his lack of foresight. Why didn't he think ahead?

Phainon, who used to be so lacking, had shockingly become amazing. His Highness the Crown Prince had suddenly come to this planet and even came to the training site personally... If he could have found out earlier, using his familial relation to Phainon, why would he fight for a noble title? When Phainon got married to the crown prince, what would he still need?

He could only hope that His Highness the Crown Prince would let him off because of his relation to Phainon.

"Still, someone like this isn't worth taking up my personal time to deal with." Nanook said calmly to one of his subordinates, "Send him back to wherever he came from. Just have the Kremnoan family decide how to deal with him."

When the onlooking crowd saw his actions, they immediately sighed over how kind the crown prince's attitude was. He even treated someone like this so well.

In fact, only Herklas knew that he would naturally have no good ending if he returned to the Kremnoan family after offending the crown prince. His face turned deathly pale.

---

After things were worked out, Nanook left with Phainon, Audata, and Hieronymus.

But that wasn't the end of it. In the next few days, the mecha training site was packed. Countless people came over specially to see the place that His Highness the Crown Prince had been to, feeling as though they had also been there with him.

And the people who were there immediately uploaded everything online after they calmed down.

At first, many people didn't take it seriously. What was all that about the crown prince liking a beta from a downtrodden noble family? Was this a fairy tale?

But more and more pictures appeared, and when the pictures of the crown prince and that beta acting intimately surfaced online, everyone was stunned. They finally realized that this probably wasn't something that someone fabricated out of nothing.

Soon, someone found out the identity of the other person in the photos. Shockingly enough, it was a student at the empire's military institute. He was a beta, and his grades were awful. It was obvious that he had gotten in through connections.

Most people were even more certain that the person was just leeching off of the crown prince after finding out. The pictures were just a bit suggestive. As for the videos... they were all blurry. Who knew if the person in the videos really was the crown prince?

Forget about being a couple or something. It was already unlikely that the crown prince and this beta were friends. Being his fiancé was just preposterous.

Moreover, the crown prince hadn't publicized anything yet. This Phainon guy was probably spreading things online to cause a sensation.

Everyone was confident in their belief.

---

Meanwhile, Nanook brought Audata and Hieronymus straight onto the airship, and they arrived at the capital planet.

Phainon remembered how he had just left the capital planet a few days ago... He was still a layabout lazing around in his room, eating, and waiting for death. Who would have expected that in just a few days so many things would happen?

This simply solidified Phainon's determination to squat at home in the future.

The airship arrived at the district in the capital planet that noble families resided in. Caelus's residence was also nearby. Phainon felt a bit nostalgic.

Soon, Nanook ushered them into a villa. He said to Audata and Hieronymus, "This house is a present for you, Mother and Father. Please accept it without being courteous."

Audata and Hieronymus turned uneasy and wanted to decline. It was terrifying for someone to be gifting them a house in the capital planet for no reason.

But Nanook smiled. "This is all to thank you for caring for and loving Phainon these last few years. You don't need to refuse... Besides, your previous residence has been ruined. Can you still live there? Somebody has cleaned this place up, and you can move in right away. You can have people move your other things over as well."

Phainon: "..." A house like this absolutely wasn't something someone could buy immediately. Nanook must have gotten it ready long ago. Besides, it looked like the things he was saying weren't things he thought of casually. It looked like he was incredibly sincere.

Hieronymus hesitated for a moment. Finally, he couldn't stop himself from saying, "Your Highness, could I ask what you like about our family’s Phainon?"

Compared to his status, Phainon's happiness was actually the most important.

And His Highness the Crown Prince, high above the masses, had a sudden interest in him. In comparison, that Mydeimos fellow who came to visit last time felt more reliable. Besides, Mydei was so kind and he knew how to cook. He looked like a good kid.

Phainon had to admit that the methods Mydei made use of were good at getting people to like him.

If Hieronymus and Audata knew that Mydei was actually the heir of the Kremnoan family, they would probably be even more worked up.

Phainon was given a shock. He had a feeling that the upcoming topic wouldn't be great, so he said that he would go to the kitchen to pour everyone a cup of water, then took the opportunity to leave. Of course, he was actually hiding at the side and eavesdropping.

With Nanook's personality, he would certainly say things that made people feel ashamed without a care for whether Phainon was there or not, but Phainon himself was embarrassed...

Nanook said, "Sir, you want to know what I like about him?" He lowered his head, as though he was considering carefully, then looked up with a slight smile. "My Deliverer looks very cute, and on the surface he seems obedient, but he's always secretly planning something. It feels as though he's about to do something overboard at any time... I really like it."

Phainon, hiding at the side: "!" Hey, is this something a normal person would think was good?!

Audata and Hieronymus were also stunned. For a moment, they couldn't tell if Nanook was praising Phainon or complaining about him. He was indeed worthy of the name of His Highness the Crown Prince; his taste was so unique.

"In the past, I never thought of getting married, but after I met my Deliverer, my thoughts changed," Nanook said. "I want him to stay at my side."

He also wanted Phainon to only look at him, to only think of him.

Nanook's eyes darkened slightly.

When Hieronymus finally processed what Nanook was saying, he kept opening and closing his mouth again, as though he wanted to say something but didn't have the courage to speak.

Nanook immediately understood. He said, "Sir, you don't need to worry. I know about how Phainon is actually an omega. In fact, when he had his last heat, I was the one who helped him deal with it."

Phainon nearly charged forward. "!" Fuck, what the hell are you saying, huh!

Audata and Hieronymus were stupefied.

Although Nanook hadn't done a single thing, anyone would begin to imagine all the lively things that he and Phainon had done together after hearing his words. At the same time, Phainon couldn't come out to refute him.

This reason was more believable than any of the many other things that Nanook had said, because it could be something like helping someone deal with his heat and thus marking him by accident, so then they could only be together...

After those words, Audata and Hieronymus could only accept it. After all, an omega would typically have no way to remove a mark, unless the alpha that marked them died.

In fact, Nanook had planned for this. He just hadn't said it to Phainon before.

Audata and Hieronymus had never gotten the chance to be picky. After all, they had always thought that their son would always be alone, but he had found a partner who knew his true identity, and his partner was someone with such an honorable position.

And they could only sigh and say that they had no natural affinity with Mydei, who they had originally set their sights on.

Soon, Nanook and Phainon went to the same room to rest. After all, to an outsider, they had already done some intimate things together, and it was perfectly normal for them to stay together and prevent something like an omega going into heat in the middle of the night.

Even though Phainon really didn't want to, he was afraid Audata and Hieronymus would worry, so he had no choice but to brace himself to continue to sleep in the same room as Nanook.

When Phainon went downstairs to get a glass of water at night, Audata came looking for him. They found a corner out of sight to talk privately.

"Phainon, you have to tell Mom the truth." Audata looked at Phainon sternly. She said, "What exactly happened? How did you meet His Highness the Crown Prince?"

Phainon had no choice but to make something up. He said that he had run into His Highness the Crown Prince on the airship in a twist of fate. Later, when he went into heat, he got help from the crown prince.

After Audata heard his explanation, she sighed again. "It looks like that Mydei child really doesn't have an affinity with you. He really took a liking to you."

When Phainon thought about Mydei and their last interaction his heart felt uncomfortable again so he just pushed the thought away. What’s done was done, he was stuck with Nanook now.

Phainon: "Mydei... He'll be fine even without me." Although he got trapped by the system and was already bound to Phainon _(:3」∠)_

When Phainon got back to his room, he spotted Nanook sitting like an interrogator waiting for his turn to ask questions. Nanook raised an eyebrow and said, "...Is there anything else I don't know between you and Mydeimos?"

"Were you eavesdropping just now?" Phainon was given a fright.

Nanook said casually, "I was just worried for your safety, so I decided to move... I don't think you care about little things like this, right?"

Who didn't care!!

Phainon just knew Nanook was a pervert. Based on the settings in the original novel, it wouldn't even be strange for someone like Nanook to bug him with listening devices. Dammit... He had miscalculated.

"Well, it's nothing much." Phainon resigned himself to his fate. "I think what happened between me and Mydei is perfectly clear, isn't it... Is there anything else to add?"

"Of course there's something I'm still not clear about. For example, what did he do after he came to your house?" Nanook sighed. "The fact that Mother-in-law and Father-in-law both like him so much makes me feel hurt."

"He didn't do anything much," Phainon said. "It's just that when he came last time, he happened to cook at home. After all, Mydei's cooking skills are really good..."

"I see." Nanook smiled slightly. "You don't need to be scared. Isn't it fine now that you've told me? I won't do anything to you. I just wanted to know how you were doing. I like you, so I want to know everything that has to do with you."

A normal person wouldn't insist on knowing everything about someone just because they liked them.

Phainon said, "But I don't know anything about you."

"Then why don't I tell you now?" Nanook looked like he was in high spirits. "Want to listen?"

Phainon quickly shook his head. "No, I don't want to." He had a feeling he was going to hear something that would make him feel like the world had turned on its head!

Soon, it was time for bed. The two of them laid down side-by-side as before. Although Nanook seemed crazy, most of the time he would let Phainon do whatever he wanted. If Phainon wasn't willing to do it, he usually wouldn't force him.

In his daze, Phainon suddenly heard the system's alert. After hearing that the daily mission was to heal the capture target, he was startled into wakefulness.

"I can't believe it's this mission." Phainon opened his eyes. "It looks like what today I can do what I didn't do yesterday."

He turned and saw that Nanook was already sleeping. Phainon thought to himself, Today shouldn't be like yesterday, and cautiously leaned in. After reaching out to touch Nanook's wrist, he carefully sent his ability in.

If he sent his healing ability into a normal human's body, there would be absolutely no problem, but if they weren't a human it was very likely something would happen, especially Zergs who would go into heat.

In the next moment, Nanook, who should have been asleep, furrowed his brows. His cheeks quickly flushed red.

Phainon froze. His heart skipped a beat. "Huh?!"

This meant that Nanook wasn't actually a human?!

Nanook opened his eyes gently. He grabbed Phainon's hand, pulling him down to his side.

Phainon quickly began to struggle, but it was completely useless. To Nanook, it probably hurt as much as a kitten's scratches.

Nanook was like a different person. His face was flushed red and his gold eyes were as deep as the sun. He cupped Phainon's face, dipping his head to give him a furious kiss.

He followed the line of Phainon's neck, nipping gently. When he reached his shirt, he finally reached up to take it off.

To be honest, his actions didn't seem like someone in heat, but Phainon knew very clearly that after a Zerg went into heat they would suppress their reason. If he didn't seize the opportunity to escape, he would be done for.

Just as the third button of Phainon's shirt was unbuttoned, he finally broke away. He dove off the bed, but Nanook hugged him around the waist. Because of his movements, his clothes were completely ripped open.

They rolled across the ground. Luckily, there was a rug spread across the floor, and Phainon wasn't hurt when he fell.

But what was terrible was that Nanook was still hugging him. It was like he was drunk; his movements were sluggish, and his breathing was hot against Phainon's waist. His hands reached straight into Phainon's pants.

Phainon blurted, "C-calm down, this isn't the time to be doing something like that."

"Oh?" Nanook looked up. His voice was low. "Then you're saying that this is the time for...?"

---

Phainon was pressed against the carpet and fucked the entire night. At some point, he fainted away. When he woke up the next day, it was already noon.

Phainon was sitting on Nanook's lap. His torso was prim and proper, but his lower body was completely bare, and his legs were both exposed.

He bit his lip harshly, afraid to move an inch. If he moved at all, a strong pleasure would jolt through his body, and he would most definitely let out a humiliating noise.

It seemed like nothing had happened to Nanook at all. He pressed a spoonful of congee to Phainon's lips. "Here, this is congee that I made myself... It looks like Mother-in-law and Father-in-law are quite happy."

Phainon opened his mouth with difficulty, swallowing the congee. In these circumstances, he didn't have any extra energy to think about whether the congee tasted good or not.

Who knew if someone as dignified as His Highness the Crown Prince had exploded the kitchen the first time he went to cook...

"I'm no worse than Mydeimos." Nanook looked very confident about his cooking skills. He leaned in and said, "It's delicious, isn't it?"

Phainon didn't even know what Nanook was talking about. He hurriedly nodded. After what happened yesterday, he felt weak all over, and he could only lay weakly against Nanook.

He had dug his own grave. Phainon regretted it as soon as he thought about it.

After eating a whole bowl of congee, Phainon was ready to collapse. He tugged Nanook's clothes. "Hurry up... and put me down..."

"It's not time yet." Nanook hugged Phainon like he was hugging a child and leaned in close to his ear. "You've discovered it, haven't you? In fact, I'm not a normal human."

Phainon: "...!" When you're talking about business, can you not do something like that!

"You know, right? My mother was the empire's greatest beauty, born from the Kremnoan family," Nanook said. "But what nobody knows is that she actually liked someone else. Right when they eloped, her lover betrayed her and sent her to the imperial palace. On the road there, she killed herself to retaliate against her family and her lover."

Phainon focused his attention with great difficulty. "Huh...?" Wasn't this exciting? The original novel clearly said that the empress focused on the emperor single mindedly, so focused that she was crazy.

"Back then, there was a Zerg on the airship." Nanook smiled slightly. "It's funny, thinking about it. Everyone thought that the Zerg had been chased away ages ago... In fact, long ago, the Zerg had already slipped into the empire."

Everyone had thought that General Wiley chased the Zerg queen off. In truth, their flight was an act. In their first year at war with the humans, they had already taken on human appearances and infiltrated into the empire.

Many humans had always looked down on Zerg for their appearances. In reality, their intelligence was no lesser than humanity's.

And General Wiley never said that he failed to kill the Zerg Queen, so nobody suspected a thing.

"At that time, the Zerg sensed their chance, so the Zerg Queen took on the appearance of the Kremnoan family's daughter and entered the imperial palace, arriving at the emperor's side." Nanook spoke the thrilling news as though he was telling an ordinary story.

Phainon: "?!"

Wait, this info dump is kind of big! Are you fucking saying that the empress has actually always been the Zerg Queen, and for all these years she's been... with the emperor... He suddenly felt a wave of sympathy for the emperor.

...Then Phainon remembered what the empress's son had done to him, and suddenly felt that he was even more miserable.

"At first, the Zerg's goal was to kill the emperor, then turn into him and take advantage of the opportunity to occupy the empire," Nanook said. "But the Zerg Queen fell in love with my father. After all, despite the fact that he's pretty useless, he has a good-looking shell."

Out of the emperor's two sons, one looked like the empress and one looked like a delicate, beautiful flower, but neither of them looked like the emperor.

Phainon was a bit shocked. "..." Hey, isn't this plot too overdramatic? The horror movie exposition suddenly turned into a palace drama with a love triangle.

"After that, I was born..." Nanook said. "I knew ever since I was young that I actually wasn't human, even if part of the blood running through my veins was human."

Phainon: "...." He didn't want to think about how a Zerg and a human could have children so casually.

"The funny thing is, the emperor doesn't like my mother. Although he didn't marry a concubine, he has a lover," Nanook said. "I don't know how that woman is doing now. If she has a child, he must be around the same age as you now..."

Phainon's heart stopped for a moment. He suddenly thought of Khaslana, and it affected how lower body. He couldn't stop his breathing from quickening.

"Deliverer, do you know who it is?" Nanook leaned to ask. He naturally wouldn't pass up this opportunity.

If he could say it, Phainon would certainly spit it out, but this had to do with the plot, and he couldn't say a thing. He just shook his head. "I... I don't know..."

"You really don't listen... I just told you everything about me, but you're hiding something from me." Nanook's eyes narrowed, and he lowered his head to nip Phainon's neck. "As punishment, I'm going to mark you now."

"...Wait... C-calm down..."

Though the person who suffered after the mark wouldn't be him anyways.

---

Because there was never anyone from the imperial family who stepped out to clarify, the pictures from before spread even further. Public interest boiled over, and a huge number of people were shocked.

Most people didn't believe that there was anything between the crown prince and Phainon. They would rather believe that Phainon was sucking up to the crown prince.

The people who were the most shocked were the people in empire's military institute. The fact that Phainon had somehow managed to return to school after being expelled by latching onto Caelus was shocking enough. Later, he somehow managed to grab onto the heir of the Kremnoan family, Mydeimos. If it wasn't for the sake of keeping up their reputations, plenty of people would have gone up to Phainon to ask how he did it.

But now Phainon had managed to suck up to His Highness the Crown Prince! This guy's bootlicking skills were expert!

Some people had a vague understanding that if the news hadn't been deleted after so long that it couldn't be simple.

Later, the crown prince finally announced his engagement. He said that he would host an engagement banquet in a few days, and his fiancé was, of course, Phainon.

Everyone was flabbergasted. They had no idea what part of Phainon drew the crown prince's attention. Whether it was strength or personality, they didn't think he was good in any aspect. He couldn't match up to His Highness the Crown Prince at all.

But the emperor didn't bother with it at all. He was happy to have Nanook marry a beta from a downtrodden noble family. As soon as he thought about how furious the Kremnoan family would be, he was delighted.

Besides, the emperor had heard of Amelia's whereabouts recently. After hearing news about his true love, he had no time left to consider things to do with Nanook.

Soon, the internet filled with people beginning to shame Phainon. They cursed him for using some kind of despicable methods to seduce the crown prince. There were also people suspecting that he had relied on some sinister tricks to sleep with the crown prince, then forced him to marry him to take responsibility.

After all, the crown prince had such noble character. How could he mess around with someone randomly!?

These people also thought ordinary nobles weren't worthy of the crown prince. The only people who were worthy of the crown prince couldn't be someone ordinary; even if they came from an influential clan, they weren't worthy of him.

In the end, someone suddenly remembered Prince Latiao who had risen to fame a while back. They said that only someone as amazing as Prince Latiao was worthy of the crown prince.

Although Prince Latiao should be an alpha, technology was so advanced anyways. Two alphas could have their own descendants with the aid of technology.

At first, these words were only brought up as a joke. In the end, most people approved. In moments, the people online began to say that compared Phainon, who was as good as a couch potato, they could only accept an expert like Prince Latiao being together with His Highness the Crown Prince.

Chapter End Notes

The Author Has Something To Say: Yay! New Chapter! Lmao Nanook really said whatever Mydei did I'm gonna do too. It took Mydei so long to get that cookie and Nanook just went for it. Haha am I the only one who loves his possessiveness. Its jus the right brand of gentlemanly and forceful <3

See You Next Week!

chapters.title: Chapter 21: The Transition Into The Finale
chapters.html:
Phainon's balls ached as soon as he got online. A forced marriage could even happen like this... What would these people think if they knew he was the same person as Prince Latiao? Still, they probably wouldn't ever know in their lifetime.

Besides, Phainon thought that the bigger pain in his ass was the problem of Nanook's identity. In fact, he didn't want to know it at all.

Speaking of which, the fact that Nanook was a Zerg-human mix was several times more shocking than the fact that Phainon was actually an omega pretending to be a beta. How was Nanook able to say it so casually, completely without fear that Phainon would spread it around?

Still, when he thought about it, Nanook probably wasn't afraid of him talking about it at all. Even if he did say it, nobody would believe him. They would probably think he had gone crazy.

After all, people still thought of Zerg as monsters with savage appearances. Who would imagine that Zerg were hiding right at their sides? Who would believe that His Highness the Crown Prince was actually not human?

If it wasn't for the protagonist Khaslana, the empire would simply be on its way to destruction. Still, these people were busy worrying that His Highness the Crown Prince was going to marry an ordinary beta.

No matter how other people protested, everything proceeded as normal. The engagement banquet was held at the same time they spoke about how a fresh flower was being stuck in a pile of cow dung.

Although outsiders were cursing up a storm, the people who attended the banquet had decent attitudes.

The people who were aware of Nanook's personality just thought that Phainon was someone with courage.

The people who weren't aware felt that someone as lowly as Phainon must have had plenty of tricks to be able to get successfully engage to the crown prince. They couldn't get on his bad side too easily.

Mydeimos arrived with Gorgo, smiling slightly as he gave his congratulations. Nobody could tell anything was wrong with him.

But only Anaxagoras came from the duke's family. He could do nothing but express that his younger brother couldn't attend because he had been ill recently.

In fact, Caelus had faced an incredible shock after hearing the news. He went to an extremely dangerous area to train alone. Anaxa couldn't stop him, and he could only send a few bodyguards look after him.

Phainon wasn't used to banquets like this at all. He found an excuse to go to the lounge to take a break and happened to run into Mydei sitting inside.

Mydei stood up hurriedly. He said to Phainon, "You're fine, right?"

After he leaned in, he smelled the thick alpha scent on Phainon. His gaze immediately darkened.

"I'm perfectly fine." Phainon sat down immediately. He thought of what the system had said, and he said, "About that... If you have someone you start to fall in love with, how about you let me know..."

That way, he could avoid the tragedy when Mydei couldn't mark the other person, though Phainon couldn't do anything at all.

"How could I fall in love with another person?" Mydei grabbed Phainon's hands, but after a thought he pulled them back. He dropped to the ground, half kneeling in front of Phainon. "The most important person in my heart is you alone. There's no one who can take your place."

Phainon was emotionless. "But you're the heir of the Kremnoan family. Soon or later, you'll have to face it, won't you?"

"Those matters are of no importance," Mydei said. "I have never wanted to bother with the Kremnoan family's matters."

In any case, his mother had so many lovers. When the time came, couldn't she just birth another one? Why did he have to do something he didn't want to do?

When he thought of how his mother had brought up forming an alliance through marriage, Mydei made up his mind.

"I may leave for a period of time." Mydei looked at Phainon. "You must wait for me to come back. By then, I'll certainly be even stronger... And I'll be able to protect you even better."

And with those words, Mydei gave Phainon a profound glance and left the lounge.

---

A few days after the engagement banquet, the Zerg who had disappeared for years suddenly crawled back from their defeat, trying to invade the planets at the empire's frontier.

But the news didn't make the common people of the empire panic. After all, the Zerg had already been beaten away once, and the hero who beat them away, General Wiley, was still as healthy as a horse.

The frontiers were too distant from the capital. It was several days away even traveling by airship. Nobody felt a sense of crisis at all.

But Phainon, who was staying at Nanook's side, knew perfectly well that the Zerg at the frontier were merely the weakest and dumbest low-level Zerg. If these people knew that the Zerg had actually occupied over half of the empire's territory, what would they think... After all, high-level Zerg could transform into human shape.

If it wasn't for the fact that in the original novel, the Zerg were all connected to the Zerg Queen and their strength would plummet after she died, the Zerg in the original novel would probably already have succeeded in seizing control of the empire.

Yet now Nanook was actually a Zerg, and he was the child of the Zerg Queen. He really was worthy of being the villain boss...

When he thought about how Nanook's identity hadn't been exposed by the finale of the novel, and how he had been exiled instead... Who knew if he had an opportunity to do something else in the future? Suddenly, he felt that the finale wasn't very probable.

Meanwhile, the emperor was searching for news about Amelia. Later, with the help of General Wiley, he successfully met Khaslana and they mutually acknowledged their relationship as father and son.

After all, it was the child the woman he loved the most left behind. With the addition of his memories of his unattainable first love, tears nearly fell from his eyes when the emperor first set eyes on Khaslana.

The emperor simply had no feelings towards the empress or the children of the concubines he had married before.

In front of the emperor, Khaslana put on an act of a clever, adorable child. Time and time again, he let slip how miserable he had lived for the last few years. The emperor immediately felt even more regretful, and he poured almost all of his paternal love into Khaslana. The only reason he didn't publicize Khaslana's identity was because he was obstructed by the Kremnoan family.

The emperor didn't have any plans of passing on the throne to Khaslana yet. He just wanted to give the child he had failed the power and wealth that he deserved, but if he gave it too casually, he was afraid he would draw the Kremnoan family's notice.

It was right at that time that the empire ran into the problem with the Zerg, and the emperor immediately sent out General Wiley.
